title: The green code VIC VJC brought 2 Vietnamese billionaires to the top of the list of the world's richest people
sapo: As of the morning of December 1, 2025, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets reached 24.3 billion USD, while billionaire Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao's assets stood at 4.7 billion USD.
content:
According to Forbes Magazine's world billionaires ranking, updating the scale of individual assets according to stock prices and exchange rates as of the morning of December 1, 2025 (Vietnam time), billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong has a fortune of 24.3 billion USD.
This number has put the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Group - JSC (MCCK: VIC, HoSE) at 94th place in the list of the richest people in the world and is still the richest person in Vietnam.
The increase in Mr. Vuong's assets took place in the context that VIC shares continued to maintain a strong upward momentum on the stock exchange.In the morning trading session of December 1, 2025, the VIC code is trading at 272,100 VND/share, an increase of 4.5% compared to the previous trading session.
As of November 26, 2025, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong owns more than 389.9 million VIC shares, equivalent to a capital ownership ratio of 10.048% of capital at Vingroup.
Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and billionaire Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao
Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and billionaire Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao
Two other stocks belonging to the Vingroup ecosystem are VHM code of Vinhomes Joint Stock Company (MCCK: VHM, HoSE exchange) and VRE code of Vincom Retail Joint Stock Company, also trading actively at 105,000 VND and 34,800 VND/share respectively.
In addition, the majority of Mr. Vuong's assets are also in the shares of VinFast Production and Business Joint Stock Company (VinFast) - a business currently listed on the Nasdaq (USA) with the code VFS.
Also according to Forbes' update, Vietnam has 5 USD billionaires as of the morning of December 1, 2025.
Standing behind Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong is Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao - Vice Chairwoman of the Board of Directors of Ho Chi Minh City Development Joint Stock Commercial Bank (HDBank), Chairwoman of the Board of Directors of Vietjet Aviation Joint Stock Company.Ms. Thao currently owns a fortune of 4.7 billion USD and is ranked 863 in the world.
In the morning trading session of December 1, 2025, Vietjet's stock code VJC is trading at 207,500 VND/share, an increase of 1.97% compared to the closing price of the previous trading session.
According to the management report for the first 6 months of 2025, Ms. Thao currently owns nearly 47.5 million VJC shares, equivalent to 8.02% ownership of Vietjet's charter capital.With the above trading stock price, it is estimated that the total value of VJC shares held is about more than 9,850 billion VND.
In addition, HDB shares of HDBank are also trading at 31,550 VND/share in the morning session of December 1, 2025.Also according to the management report for the first 6 months of 2025, Ms. Thao owns nearly 130.8 million HDB shares, the estimated total value of shares at the above trading price is about more than 4,125 billion VND.
With the above assets, Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao is ranked above three other Vietnamese USB billionaires according to Forbes' update as of the morning of December 1, 2025.
Specifically, ranked 3rd belongs to Chairman Tran Dinh Long - Chairman of Hoa Phat Group Joint Stock Company, recorded assets at 2.7 billion USD and ranked 1,482 in the list of world USD billionaires.
In fourth place is Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank), Ho Hung Anh, who owns assets of 2.3 billion USD and is ranked 1,711 in the world.
The last Vietnamese businessman named on Forbes' list of USD billionaires is Mr. Nguyen Dang Quang - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Masan Group Joint Stock Company with assets of 1.1 billion USD, ranked 2,949 on the list of world USD billionaires.
author: According to Khanh Han

title: Don't be sad if you "missed the boat" Vingroup: Korean Chaebol even sold all VIC shares before the price increased twice as much
sapo: Many investors sadly stood outside and watched the Vingroup high-speed train speeding forward with "no goods", even selling out before VIC shares rose to the top.
content:
Vingroup shares (code VIC) have increased more than 6 times since the beginning of the year, continuously setting new peaks to the surprise of investors.Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's group became the first Vietnamese enterprise with a capitalization exceeding 1 million billion VND, setting an unprecedented record.
However, the party is not for everyone.Many investors sadly stood outside and watched the Vingroup high-speed train speed forward with "no goods".However, "missing the train" is probably less sad than stopping right at the doorstep of paradise.
On Vingroup's steep climb recently, the saddest investor is probably SK Group.The Korean corporation was once a major shareholder holding more than 6% of Vingroup's capital with a strategic cooperation agreement signed in 2019.
At that time, SK poured about 23,300 billion VND (about 1 billion USD) to buy a total of 205.7 million VIC shares (equivalent to 113,000 VND/share), including 154.3 million shares offered for private sale from Vingroup and bought back 51.4 million secondary shares from VinCommerce (now WinCommerce).
SK then did not trade VIC shares, but only received 1 round of stock dividends at the rate of 12.49% from Vingroup in 2021. This group increased its holdings in Vingroup to more than 231 million shares but the ownership ratio did not change.
After 6 years of companionship, Chaebol Korea decided to "break up" with billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's group.SK's 2024 annual report released earlier this year ranked Vingroup in the category of assets held awaiting sale.In fact, the divestment activity was carried out through an agreement method, in 3 phases.
On January 16, 2025, SK transferred nearly 51 million VIC shares (transaction value of more than 2,000 billion VND) for the purpose of restructuring its investment portfolio.The Korean corporation's ownership ratio in Vingroup accordingly decreased from 6.05% of capital to 4.72% and is no longer a major shareholder.
By April 17, SK continued to sell nearly 65 million VIC shares with a value of nearly 4,600 billion VND.The final divestment took place on August 4-5 with a total agreed sales volume of nearly 116 million shares, worth about 12,600 billion VND.
It is estimated that the Korean corporation has earned a total of more than 19,000 billion VND from the Vingroup divestment deal.This number is much lower than the amount SK spent to hold Vingroup shares.And even sadder, since SK divested all its capital, VIC shares have increased by about 120% in market price.
SK is currently one of the largest multi-industry corporations in Korea with operating areas such as telecommunications, technology, electronics, energy, logistics and services.Having "poured money" heavily into Vietnam since 2018 with a total investment value of more than 3.5 billion USD, SK quickly became a strategic shareholder in many leading corporations.
However, over the past year or so, Chaebol Korea has continuously divested large investments in Vietnam such as Vingroup, Masan, Imexpharm, etc. The divestment is part of the global restructuring strategy, helping SK focus its resources on semiconductors, artificial intelligence and electric vehicle batteries, areas that are considered new growth pillars of the group.
As for Vingroup, billionaire Pham Nhat Sau's corporation has been shaping a large ecosystem, covering many fields from technology, industry to real estate, infrastructure, energy and culture - society with a series of "steeds" such as VinFast, Vinhomes, VinSpeed, VinMetal,...
As of the end of the third quarter of 2025, Vingroup's total assets have exceeded the 1 million billion VND mark, becoming the second non-financial enterprise in Vietnam to reach this milestone after PVN.
Vingroup is also implementing the largest stock issuance deal in history (nearly 3.9 billion shares) to double its charter capital to VND 77,000 billion.The final list of registered shareholders to receive issued shares will be finalized on December 8.
If the issuance is successful, Vingroup will surpass Hoa Phat to become a non-financial enterprise with the largest charter capital on the Vietnamese stock exchange, only less than 3 banks Vietcombank, MB and VPBank.
author: Ha Linh

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong transferred VIC shares worth VND 10,800 billion to VinSpeed
sapo: On November 26, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and VinSpeed ​​High Speed ​​Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company announced the transaction of Vingroup's VIC shares.
content:
Accordingly, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong registered to transfer ownership of 44.054 million VIC shares to VinSpeed ​​(ratio 1.135%).
After the transaction, Mr. Vuong still holds 345.867 million VIC shares (ratio 8.923%) while VinSpeed ​​owns 423.163 million shares (ratio 10.905%).
The transaction announcement was made on the day VIC stock capitalization continued to set a new peak: 245,000 VND/share, corresponding to an increase in capitalization value to 944,000 billion VND.
At the current price, the amount of shares that Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong transferred to VinSpeed ​​is worth about 10,800 billion VND.
According to Forbes, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong is currently the 103rd richest person in the world with a fortune of 22.3 billion USD.
As for VinSpeed, in a recent interview with Thanh Nien newspaper, General Director Nguyen Viet Quang provided a lot of important information.According to Mr. Quang's analysis, international research and actual implementation in many countries show that most high-speed rail projects suffer long-term losses, except for the Beijing - Shanghai route.With the North-South route, VinSpeed ​​estimates losses of up to tens of billions of dollars.
The pre-feasibility study report approved by the National Assembly shows that the average revenue/year (first 30 years of operation) is about 5.6 billion USD, while direct operating costs (not including depreciation and interest) have reached 4.2 billion USD/year.To achieve passenger traffic corresponding to this revenue, the business also has to invest an additional 18.06 billion USD to expand capacity - an expense that is not part of the total initial investment of 61 billion USD.
With 10.51 billion USD in loan capital, interest payments are estimated at 1.05 billion USD/year for the first 10 years.After 30 years of operation, the total recoverable cash flow is only about 10.5 billion USD - much lower than the 49.08 billion USD that must be returned to the state, not including 10.51 billion USD of VinSpeed's initial counterpart capital.After every 30 year cycle, ship systems and equipment must be replaced almost entirely.
Faced with concerns that businesses may give up, Mr. Quang affirmed that the financial plan has been carefully prepared for the 30-year journey:
From prioritizing the use of dividends from Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's companies, if not, he will sell shares in private companies such as GSM, VinEnergo, V-Green... and finally, if that is still not enough, after 30 years, he will sell a portion of shares in Vingroup."There is no such thing as 'running away from the village' or 'giving up money and running for people,'" he said.
Faced with information that the high-speed rail project aims to pave the way for real estate development along the route, Mr. Quang completely denied it.He affirmed that railway stations are often located far from the central area, so TOD development does not have outstanding profit implications.VinSpeed proactively proposed to the Ministry of Construction to remove the TOD part from the project to show goodwill.
Mr. Quang said that VinSpeed and Vingroup will respect all decisions of the Government - whether public investment, PPP or assignment to other businesses.He said: "If we are not assigned, we will regret not having the opportunity to contribute to a project that means so much to the country.But from a business perspective, there will actually be a lot less pressure."
author: According to Minh Quan

title: VIC set a historic peak, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and his wife's assets increased by 17,000 billion, Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao 'refused to lose' when VJC increased to the ceiling
sapo: The assets of billionaire couple Pham Nhat Vuong increased by more than 17,000 billion VND today.
content:
In the trading session on November 20, Vingroup's VIC shares increased 3.4% to a price of 228,000 VND/share, surpassing the old peak at the end of October to set a new historic peak.Compared to the beginning of the year, VIC shares have increased 5.6 times.
With this increase, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets have increased by more than 16,000 billion VND, to nearly 512,000 billion VND.At the same time, the assets of Ms. Pham Thu Huong, Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup - Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's wife also increased by more than 1,200 billion to more than 38,700 billion VND.
Also today, VJC shares of Vietjet Aviation Joint Stock Company increased to the ceiling, leaving the selling side blank.HBD shares increased 1.6% to 31,800 VND/share.﻿
With the rising momentum of stocks, female billionaire Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao's assets increased by about 2,600 billion VND to 42,700 billion VND today.
According to Forbes' real-time rankings, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increased by 575 million USD during the day to 20.9 billion USD, making him the 113th richest person in the world.
Recently, Vingroup shareholders approved a plan to issue nearly 3.9 billion bonus shares by collecting written opinions.Specifically, VIC will issue nearly 3.9 billion bonus shares to existing shareholders at a ratio of 1:1, meaning that shareholders who own 1 VIC share have the right to receive 1 new share.
The implementation time is expected to be in the fourth quarter of this year, the specific time will be left to the VIC Board of Directors to decide.New shares are not subject to transfer restrictions.However, the right to receive issued shares will not be transferable.
The Board of Directors of Vingroup also issued a resolution approving the stock issuance dossier to submit to the State Securities Commission and a resolution on implementing the bonus stock issuance plan approved by shareholders.
After the issuance, Vingroup's charter capital will double, to more than 77,000 billion VND.Vingroup is currently the largest enterprise in the entire stock exchange with a capitalization of nearly 800,000 billion VND.
In the first 9 months of this year, Vingroup achieved total consolidated net revenue of 169,611 billion VND, an increase of 34% over the same period last year.Consolidated profit after tax reached 7,565 billion VND, 1.9 times higher than the same period in 2024, completing 76% of the profit plan set for this year.
As of September 30, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 1,087,870 billion, an increase of 30% compared to December 31, 2024.
author: Ngoc Diep

title: Behind the story of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong contributing 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo
sapo: Vingroup has proposed to participate in an offshore wind power project in Ha Tinh.Ky Anh Wind Power Plant Project with total investment capital of 17,051 billion VND.
content:
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Corporation (HoSE: VIC) has just completed procedures to transfer ownership of more than 60 million Vingroup shares (HoSE: VIC) to VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company to contribute additional equity capital.
The transaction was carried out on October 9, 2025 through Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC).Calculated according to the closing price of VIC shares on October 9 session of about 179,800 VND/share, the deal value is estimated at nearly 10,800 billion VND.
VinEnergo is an enterprise invested by Mr. Vuong, operating in the energy sector, considered one of the strategic expansion directions of the Vingroup ecosystem in the period of sustainable development, associated with green energy and digital transformation.
VinEnergo was established on March 10 with a charter capital of VND 2,000 billion.By June 2025, this enterprise will register to increase its charter capital to 10,000 billion VND.
As of October 3, according to VinEnergo's registration, the enterprise's charter capital is still VND 2,000 billion, with Vingroup holding 19%, Pham Nhat Minh Hoang 5%, Pham Nhat Quan Anh 5%, and Pham Nhat Vuong 71%.
VIC shares continue to increase in price, exceeding VND 205,000.With billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong contributing an additional 60 million VIC shares, VinEnergo's charter capital can increase by VND 10,000 billion.
Notably, 10,000 billion VND is the minimum charter capital to implement offshore wind power.
The Ministry of Industry and Trade is implementing a draft Resolution on removing difficulties in national energy development for the period 2026-2030, including many updates on offshore wind power.
According to the new draft, the Prime Minister approves offshore wind power investors to sell electricity to the national grid without auctioning land use rights or bidding to select investors for the following investors:
﻿State-owned enterprises whose main business is electricity trading, minimum charter capital of VND 10,000 billion, with minimum equity of not less than 15% of the total investment capital of the proposed offshore wind power project (excluding disbursed capital for ongoing projects and other long-term financial investments);
﻿Private enterprises whose main business is electricity trading, minimum charter capital of VND 10,000 billion, with minimum equity not less than 15% of the total investment capital of the proposed offshore wind power project (excluding disbursed capital for ongoing projects and other long-term financial investments).
In addition, businesses and investors that satisfy the above conditions must be approved in writing by the Ministry of National Defense, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Ministry of Finance.﻿
﻿Not only that, the draft also has regulations on the scale, time, price of electricity purchase contracts, documents and procedures...
﻿Currently, there is no specific information about the offshore wind power project that Vingroup will participate in.However, Vingroup has proposed to participate in a project in Ha Tinh.
According to the Ha Tinh Province E-Portal, the project is located in Ky Xuan, Ky Anh and Ky Khang, Ha Tinh province with an operating term of 50 years from the date the state allocates land, leases land and water surface.
It is expected that the project implementation progress will be completed and put into operation in the fourth quarter of 2028, specifically: Complete the documents and procedures according to regulations no later than the third quarter of 2026;Start construction of the project no later than the fourth quarter of 2026;Putting the project into operation: fourth quarter of 2028.The project has design capacity: 400MW.Products and services provided: electricity 1,053.3GWh/year.
Ky Anh Wind Power Plant Project with total investment capital of 17,051 billion VND.
In April 2025, Vingroup also proposed to research and invest in a near-shore wind power project in Tra Vinh with an investment capital of 4.5 billion USD.
On September 29 in Hanoi, VinEnergo and FIMO Center (University of Technology - Hanoi National University) signed a memorandum of cooperation to transfer the first set of offshore wind measurement data in Vietnam.This is an important preparation step for large-scale wind power production projects.﻿
The NASA OSW (Offshore Wind) wind measurement data set is the research result of the project "Promoting Vietnam's marine spatial planning to develop offshore wind energy" implemented by the US Aeronautics and Space Administration - NASA JPL.Data measuring wind speed and total wind volume off the coast of Vietnam have been collected by NASA's satellite radar for more than a decade, focusing on areas along the coast, around islands and shoals, with a scale of more than 1 million square kilometers.
The project is funded by the US Department of State with the coordination of the US Embassy in Vietnam and the FIMO Center, starting at the end of 2023, with results announced in mid-2025. Data is provided in standard geocoding format (GeoTIFF), received, stored, and used by FIMO.
In another type of power, recently, on September 26, VinEnergo started the construction project of Hai Phong LNG Thermal Power Plant (located in the land of Tan Trao Industrial Park), with a total investment of 178,000 billion VND.
author: Tri Duc

title: Nearly 600 million VIC shares left billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's personal account and poured into the dream of clean electricity, green taxis and high-speed rail.
sapo: Most recently, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Group transferred ownership of more than 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company to contribute more equity capital.
content:
From the end of last year until now, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong has contributed capital to establish many new companies.
Besides Vingroup, the richest person in Vietnam currently holds shares in more than a dozen companies:
+ Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company (Vietnam Investment Group - VIG)
+ GSM Green and Smart Mobility Joint Stock Company
+ Hung Long Real Estate Investment & Management Joint Stock Company (formerly known as VMI Real Estate Investment & Management Joint Stock Company)
+ VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company
+ VinSpeed High Speed Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company (VinSpeed)
+ VinFuture Award Fund Joint Stock Company﻿
+ Asian Star Trading & Investment
+ Green Future Trading and Services Joint Stock Company
+ VinRobotics Robotics Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company
+ VinMotion Multifunctional Robot Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company
+ V-Green Global Charging Station Development Joint Stock Company
+ ﻿VinVentures Venture Capital Joint Stock Company
+ Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Joint Stock Company﻿
+ VinDynamics Humanoid Robot Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company
Vietnam Investment Group (VIG) has long been known as Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's key personal investment company, holding the two most important investments including 32.5% of Vingroup's shares and 32.9% of VinFast Auto Ltd's capital.
Through Star Asian Trading & Investment - an investment company in Singapore - Mr. Vuong also indirectly owns 14.3% of VinFast Auto's capital.Vingroup also owns 50.7% of VinFast Auto's capital.
Up to now, Mr. Vuong has used nearly 600 million VIC shares to contribute capital to establish 4 enterprises: Hung Long (formerly named VMI), GSM, VinEnergo and VinSpeed.﻿
﻿294 million VIC shares contributed to Hung Long and GSM
At the end of 2022 and early 2023, Mr. Vuong used 294 million personally owned VIC shares to use as capital contributions to establish two companies, Hung Long and GSM, which are pioneers in their business segments: Hung Long follows the model of dividing VinHomes products to sell to retail investors, and GSM specializes in providing car rental services, electric motorbikes and VinFast taxi services.
Currently, GSM has developed a network of thousands of taxis and electric motorbikes in a series of provinces and cities across the country and expanded taxi services to Laos, Indonesia, Philippines,...
From a charter capital of 3,000 billion when first established, in December 2024, GSM's capital has increased to 18,000 billion VND.GSM owns 1.3% of Vingroup's capital.
In Hung Long, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong contributed 90% of the charter capital, equivalent to a capital worth 16,200 billion VND in VIC shares while Ms. Pham Thu Huong contributed 900 billion VND (5%) and VinHomes contributed the remaining 5% of the capital.After completing capital contribution, VMI has become a major shareholder holding 6.3% of Vingroup's shares.
165.6 million VIC shares contributed to VinEnergo and 136 million VIC shares contributed to VinSpeed
﻿In March and May this year, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong continued to contribute capital to establish VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company and Vinspeed High Speed Rail Development and Investment Joint Stock Company.
About ﻿VinEnergo, the business mainly operates in the field of electricity production and electrical equipment.VinEnergo is determined to be a joint venture partner with Vingroup to invest in the Hai Phong LNG gas thermal power plant project, expected to be located in Tan Trao Industrial Park, Kien Thuy district.
On October 9, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong completed procedures to transfer ownership of more than 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company to contribute additional equity capital.
Previously, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong announced the use of more than 35 million shares held by VIC to contribute capital to establish VinEnergo.In June, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong transferred ownership of more than 70.6 million VIC shares to contribute more capital to VinEnergo.
Regarding VinSpeed, this is a company that has registered to invest in the North-South high-speed railway project.The project has an investment capital of nearly 1.6 million billion VND (equivalent to about 61.35 billion USD), excluding compensation costs, relocation support, and resettlement for site clearance.
In July, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong transferred ownership of nearly 88 million VIC shares to contribute more capital to VinSpeed.﻿The total number of VIC shares owned by VinSpeed ​​is 135.6 million shares, equivalent to 3.5% of Vingroup Corporation's charter capital.
Previously, on June 11, VinSpeed ​​High Speed ​​Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company also announced that Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Pham Nhat Vuong had completed the transfer of ownership of more than 48 million Vingroup shares (stock code: VIC), equivalent to 1.24% of capital to contribute capital to VinSpeed.
In addition to Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Vietnam Investment Group also owns 35% of VinSpeed's capital, and his two sons and Vingroup are also shareholders of this business with 0.5% of capital.
VinRobotics or VinMotion are like two "twin" companies, both with a charter capital of 1,000 billion VND, with the same shareholder structure including Vingroup holding 51%, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong holding 39%, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's two sons, Pham Nhat Quan Anh and Pham Nhat Minh Hoang, respectively holding 5%.
Both companies are registered businesses with the main field of manufacturing industrial robots and smart robots for different purposes.
Green Future, a car rental service provider within the ecosystem of Vingroup, is led by Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang as General Director and legal representative.Previously, the company was called FGF and changed its name to Green Future in March 2025.
Green Future was established on July 2, 2024 with an initial charter capital of 200 billion VND.Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong is a founding shareholder, holding 90% of the shares.In February 2025, the company increased its capital to 2,000 billion.﻿
VinVentures is a technology investment fund sponsored by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and Vingroup, launched on October 28.The person holding the position of CEO of VinVentures is Ms. Le Han Tue Lam.
VinVentures was established on October 10, 2024 with a charter capital of 100 billion VND.Of which, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong holds 85% of the capital, Vingroup holds 10%.The remaining major shareholder of VinVentures is Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang - the second son of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, holding 5%.In February 2025, VinVentures just increased its capital to 125 billion VND.
In September, Vingroup contributed capital to establish VinDynamics Humanoid Robot Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company.This enterprise has a charter capital of 500 billion VND, of which Vingroup owns 51%, equivalent to a contribution of 252 billion VND.﻿
On October 6, Vingroup announced the establishment of VinMetal Production and Business Joint Stock Company, officially joining the metallurgical industry, expanding the current Industry - Technology pillar.The company has an investment capital of 10,000 billion VND with the goal of building a high-tech industrial steel production complex with a capacity of about 5 million tons/year in phase 1, in Vung Ang, Ha Tinh.Vingroup holds 98% of VinMetal's charter capital.
author: Ngoc Diep

title: VIC stock set a record of more than 200,000 VND/share, VN-Index extended its "sublimation" chain.
sapo: Vingroup's VIC shares set a record at the highest ceiling price in listing history at more than 205,000 VND/share, and led the market to accumulate more than 17 points.
content:
Accordingly, on the session of October 13, Vingroup's VIC stock continued to be the focus when it increased to the ceiling by nearly 7% to 205,400 VND/share, marking a historical milestone, recording the highest price since listing, bringing Vingroup's capitalization nearly to the mark of 800,000 billion VND.With this peak capitalization, Vingroup is gradually outpacing other Bluechips such as Vietcombank, Vinhomes, VietinBank,...
The trading volume reached nearly 7.2 million shares, with a transaction value of more than 1,400 billion VND.Foreign investors also poured in a strong net of nearly 272 billion VND, thereby strengthening VIC's "support" role in this volatile trading session.
VIC shares reached a historic peak, exceeding the mark of 200,000 VND/share.
VIC shares reached a historic peak, exceeding the mark of 200,000 VND/share.
The above movement of VIC shares is in response to the information that Vingroup Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong has just completed using more than 60 million VIC shares, equivalent to 1.55% of the Group's charter capital, to contribute capital to VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company.
According to information from the City Stock Exchange.HCM (HoSE), Mr. Vuong sent a report to the State Securities Commission, HoSE and Vingroup about internal stock transactions.These shares have a par value of more than 600 billion VND and were transferred to serve investment activities in the energy sector through VinEnergo.
The highlight of today's trading session, VN-Index closed increased by 17.57 points, bringing the index to 1,765.12 points.HNX-Index gained 1.73 points, stopping at 275.35 points;UPCoM-Index increased 1.09 points to 112.70 points.
The market was vibrant, causing cash flow to increase sharply to nearly VND 48,700 billion on all 3 exchanges.HoSE accounted for 44,500 billion VND with more than 1.3 billion shares transferred during the session.
The stock market continued to "sublimate", VN-Index set a new historical peak.
The stock market continued to "sublimate", VN-Index set a new historical peak.
The highlight of active trading was in the real estate stocks group thanks to the "super pillar" VIC rising to the ceiling, two other stocks of the same family including VHM +0.98% and VRE +6.57% also increased well, in addition CRV continued to hit the ceiling in the second session after its debut on HoSE at the session on October 10.
A series of stocks of this code increased dramatically, such as: NVL +2.56%, KBC +2.8%, PDR +4.23%, DXG +3.14%, TCH +4.66%, DIG +5.14%, VPI +2.94%, ... CEO, HDC and Purple Tran.On the contrary, SIP, SNZ, NTC, CRE,... had their capital withdrawn by investors.
Although the index increased at a high level, the number of falling stocks still dominated the electronic board.In the group of banking stocks, the majority of stocks with reduced prices include shares of VCB, BID, VPB, MBB, ACB, VIB, EIB, TPB, MSB, etc. The positive direction recorded CTG +1.45%, TCB +4.96%, HDB +2.51%, LPB +1.74%, PGB +2.34%,...
In addition, the market also highlights bare purple spots in industries such as VJC, CII,... stocks in the stock groups SHS, VND, HCM, and CTS all have a green color.Negatively, raw materials stocks HPG, NKG, DCM were sold strongly, market price decreased by more than 2%.
Foreign investors continued to maintain a net sale of more than 1,200 billion VND, the focus of this group's strongest selling was HPG with more than 365.5 billion VND, followed by VRE, VHM and MBB, all of which were divested of more than 300 billion VND, MSB and VPB were also sold by foreign investors with 218.5 billion VND and 217 billion VND respectively.
In the afternoon of buying, VIC was bought by foreign investors up to nearly 272 billion VND, SHB +170 billion VND, VNM +113 billion VND, HDB +98 billion VND, MWG and CII were bought more than 80 billion VND, followed by TCB, HDG, BSR, TCH,... net bought more than 50 billion VND,...
author: According to Thu Thuy

title: Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong completed the capital contribution of more than 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo
sapo: Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong used more than 60 million VIC shares, equivalent to 1.55% of Vingroup's charter capital, to contribute capital to VinEnergo.
content:
Information from the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE), Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong has sent a report to the State Securities Commission, HoSE and Vingroup-JSC (MCCK: VIC) on the results of stock trading by insiders.
Accordingly, the Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup used more than 60 million VIC shares, equivalent to 1.55% of Vingroup's charter capital, to contribute capital to VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company (VinEnergo).The transacted value calculated at face value is more than 600 billion VND.
After the transaction, Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong reduced his ownership from more than 449.9 million VIC shares (11.59%) of Vingroup's charter capital to more than 389.9 million VIC shares (10.04%).
The transaction time is October 9, 2025 with the method of transferring ownership through VSDC.Closing the trading session on October 9, VIC shares were at 179,500 VND/share.Temporarily calculated at this price, the amount of shares Mr. Vuong plans to transfer to VinEnergo is worth about 10,770 billion VND.
Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong.
Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong.
Previously, Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong transferred ownership of 70.65 million VIC shares to VinEnergo with a value of more than 6,200 billion VND (calculated based on VIC stock price on June 17).
Thus, after receiving more than 60 million more VIC shares from Mr. Vuong on October 9, VinEnergo increased its ownership to more than 165.7 million VIC shares, equivalent to 4.27% of Vingroup capital.
VinEnergo was established in March 2025, operating mainly in the field of electricity production.At the time of establishment, the enterprise had a charter capital of 2,000 billion VND, the shareholder structure included: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong (71%);Vingroup (19%);Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh (5%) and Pham Nhat Minh Hoang (5%).
In June 2025, VinEnergo increased its charter capital to VND 10,000 billion.
Recently, Vingroup announced information related to the establishment of a subsidiary with trillion VND capital.Most recently, on October 6, Vingroup's Board of Directors approved capital contribution to establish VinMetal Production and Trading Joint Stock Company (VinMetal), headquartered at: Symphony Office Building (Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside Urban Area, Phuc Loi Ward, Hanoi City).
VinMetal plans to operate in the field of steel production and trading;charter capital of 10,000 billion VND;Of which, Vingroup's capital contribution ratio is 98%.
Further, in mid-September 2025, Vingroup's Board of Directors issued a resolution approving the group's participation in establishing a subsidiary with the expected name of VinDynamics Humanoid Robot Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company (VinDynamics).
VinDynamics' main business is research, development, production and technology transfer in the field of robotics manufacturing.
VinDynamics' expected charter capital is 500 billion VND, of which Vingroup contributes 51% of the capital.VinDynamics headquarters is also located at Symphony Office Building.
author: PV

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong has a new move with VIC shares worth more than 10,000 billion VND
sapo: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong plans to transfer more than 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo to contribute capital.
content:
VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company recently announced information about stock transactions of people related to insiders of Vingroup Corporation - JSC (code: VIC).
Accordingly, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup, plans to transfer ownership of more than 60 million VIC shares to VinEnergo for the purpose of contributing more equity capital.Before the transaction, Mr. Vuong directly owned nearly 450 million VIC shares, equivalent to 11.59% of the shares.
According to the announcement, the above shares are equivalent to 1.55% of Vingroup's charter capital, with a par value of 600 billion VND (equivalent to 10,000 VND/share).
The expected implementation time is from October 9 to November 7, through Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC).After the transaction, VinEnergo will increase the total number of shares held by VIC to 165.7 million units, equivalent to 4.27% of shares.
About VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company, the enterprise was officially established on March 12, 2025, operating mainly in the field of electricity production and electrical equipment.The company appeared in the context of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong announcing his strong participation in the field of energy development, because according to him, "Vietnam is currently very short of energy, especially green energy".
In addition to Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, his two sons and Vingroup are also shareholders of this enterprise.Of which Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh and Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang each own 5% of the capital.
VinEnergo is determined to be a joint venture partner with Vingroup to invest in the Hai Phong LNG gas thermal power plant project, expected to be located in Tan Trao Industrial Park, Kien Thuy district.The project is expected to be implemented in the period 2025-2030 if added to the adjusted Power Plan VIII.﻿
On the market, VIC's market price closed on October 3 at a historic peak of 176,500 VND/share.Temporarily calculated at this price, the deal value is up to 10,590 billion VND.
Thanks to VIC reaching a record high, Vingroup's market capitalization also exceeded the threshold of 680,000 billion VND (~25.8 billion USD) for the first time.This number puts billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's corporation firmly in the No. 1 position on the entire stock exchange and far behind the top.
author: Duong Ngoc

title: Since the day billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong advised "choose VIC instead of gold": VIC shares have increased nearly 3 times, while gold has almost stood still.
sapo: After less than 5 months of billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong giving advice, VIC shares increased 2.5 times, bringing Vingroup back to the position of the enterprise with the largest capitalization in the Vietnamese stock market.Meanwhile, the new gold price increased by 7% to 129 million VND/tael.
content:
Remember, at the 2025 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders of Vingroup at the end of April, Chairman of the Board of Directors Pham Nhat Vuong attracted attention with the statement: "Should I choose VIC or choose gold? You are right to choose VIC, with the enthusiasm and effort of each of these people, step by step value will be created, class will be recognized. However, like a ship, there must be times when there are waves and winds, so if you jump off the ship in a hurry, it will be difficult to continue swimming.".
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong also emphasized: "If you haven't sold it, you haven't lost it, VIC's market price will return."This comment was repeated during VIC's most difficult period and has now become a reality when the stock has broken out spectacularly.
Since then, VIC's market price has increased rapidly, from the price range of 58,000 VND/share to 143,100 VND/share, equivalent to a 2.5-fold increase.
This increase has brought Vingroup's capitalization to more than 555,000 billion VND, surpassing "giant" Vietcombank (VCB) to become the stock with the largest capitalization on the Vietnamese stock exchange.
VIC market price developments.
VIC market price developments.
Previously, in the period 2018 - 2020, VIC was the enterprise with the highest capitalization in the market.However, since 2021, Vietcombank has surpassed and maintained the leading position until the September 17 session.
Meanwhile, compared to the price of 121 million VND/tael of gold (closing session on April 24 when Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong confirmed), the current gold price has increased by 7% to 129 million VND/tael.From that time until now, the amplitude of gold price increase is quite modest compared to VIC's increase.
Gold price developments in nearly 5 recent months.
Gold price developments in nearly 5 recent months.
Not only VIC, two other Vingroup stocks, VHM and VRE, have also doubled in the past 5 months.
The sublimation of Vingroup shares also led to a significant increase in the value of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's personal assets.
According to data from Forbes, by September 17, 2025, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increased by 424 million USD to 14.2 billion USD.Compared to the figure of 4.4 billion USD at the end of 2024, from the beginning of the year until now his assets have increased by 9.8 billion USD (equivalent to 257,700 billion VND).
With this fortune, he is currently ranked 188th on the list of the world's richest billionaires and continues to be the richest person in Vietnam.
The above assets are even larger than the total assets of four other Vietnamese billionaires, Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao - Vice Chairman of HDBank, Chairman of Vietjet Air, Mr. Tran Dinh Long - Chairman of Hoa Phat, Mr. Ho Hung Anh - Chairman of Techcombank and Mr. Nguyen Dang Quang - Chairman of Masan Group.
author: Tu An

title: How much did billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increase on the day VIC surpassed VCB to become the largest market capitalization stock on the stock exchange?
sapo: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increased by 424 million USD on the day Vingroup's VIC shares surpassed Vietcombank (VCB) to become the largest capitalization stock on the Vietnamese stock exchange.
content:
In the trading session on September 17, Vingroup shares (code VIC) increased 6% to 143,100 VND/share, bringing business capitalization to more than 555,000 billion VND.With this level, Vingroup surpasses Vietcombank to become the most valuable enterprise on the Vietnamese stock market for the first time since 2021.
This development helped Vingroup Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increase by 424 million USD (equivalent to 3.08%), bringing his total net worth to 14.2 billion USD, according to Forbes' update.With this level, Mr. Vuong ranks 188th on the list of world billionaires, continuing to maintain his position as the richest person in Vietnam.
Meanwhile, other Vietnamese billionaires recorded reduced volatility.Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao (Vietjet Air) has assets of 3.6 billion USD, down 67 million USD.Mr. Tran Dinh Long (Hoa Phat) owns 2.9 billion USD, down 117 million USD.Mr. Ho Hung Anh (Techcombank, Masan Consumer) has 2.6 billion USD, down 65 million USD.
Since the beginning of 2025, VIC stock price has increased 3.5 times, capitalization increased by about 400,000 billion VND - the strongest increase among the VN30 group.
VIC stock developments since the beginning of the year.
VIC stock developments since the beginning of the year.
Regarding business results, in the first 6 months of 2025, Vingroup recorded revenue of 130,476 billion VND, double the same period in 2024. Profit before tax reached 11,159 billion VND, an increase of 69%.In the industry - technology segment, VinFast delivered 72,167 electric cars globally, 3.2 times more than the same period;In Vietnam, the number of deliveries reached 67,569 vehicles.The electric motorbike segment also set a new record with more than 114,000 vehicles, an increase of 5.5 times over the same period.
In the commercial and service segment, real estate revenue in the first half of the year reached 70,500 billion VND, nearly three times higher than the same period last year.Vinhomes continues to make a major contribution with sales of 67,500 billion VND and unrecorded contract value of more than 138,000 billion VND.
In its analysis report, Vietcap forecasts that VinFast electric car sales will reach 151,000 units in 2025 and 187,000 units in 2026, thanks to domestic demand and policies to support electric vehicles.This unit also forecasts that Vingroup's pre-tax profit for the whole year 2025 will reach VND 20,100 billion, of which the second half of the year will be driven by real estate sales and the hotel segment.
author: According to Thao Van

title: If you buy exactly 1 VIC share of Vingroup every day, after 18 years will it be a profit or a loss?
sapo: From the amount of 125,000 VND to buy 1 VIC share on the first trading day, if persistently implementing the strategy, after nearly 4,500 trading sessions, the investor's profitability will reach nearly 700%.
content:
Vingroup's VIC shares went public on September 19, 2007, with 80 million shares listed and closed the first trading session at a price of 125,000 VND/share, corresponding to a capitalization of about 10,000 billion VND.
If we assume that we maintain the strategy of buying exactly 1 VIC share every day, after 18 years, investors will have bought nearly 4,500 shares.In addition to the number of shares received from bonuses and exercise of rights, investors will hold about 19,700 VIC shares. Besides, investors also receive cash dividends from the company.According to calculations, the total amount of money investors spend after 18 years is 345.4 million VND.
What do investors get in return?
In the early stages of implementing the strategy, the investment was almost unprofitable, sometimes even losing more than 60%.For example, by March 2009, the amount spent was about 38 million VND, but the value of the investment was only 13.7 million VND.
Since August 2009, the investment officially 'returned to shore', and began to make a profit.The first wave of strong price increases took place in 2017, when Vingroup announced its automobile production strategy and officially started construction of a factory in Hai Phong.That year, Vingroup's capitalization increased from about 110 trillion VND to 200 trillion VND in just 3 months.Profitability in the period 2017-2019 is up to 600-800%.
However, the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic caused VIC shares to plummet from 2021 to 2024. Profit efficiency ranged from 800% to sometimes only 140%.
In 2025, Vingroup's shares are having a series of strong price increases in the context of the group announcing the expansion of its development strategy into new areas with long-term fundamentals, such as infrastructure and energy, in addition to the old pillars of industry, technology and service trade.
As of the end of the trading session on September 15, the investment value was 2,718 billion VND, equivalent to a profitability of 687%.

author: According to Tu An

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong once said "If you don't sell, you won't lose, VIC market value will return": Vingroup is about to regain the largest position in the stock market from Vietcombank?
sapo: Vingroup once held the position of enterprise with the largest capitalization for 3 consecutive years from 2018 - 2020, but from 2021, Vietcombank has risen to hold the number 1 position from then until now.
content:
Closing the trading session last week, Vingroup's VIC shares increased 1.32% to a price of 137,800 VND/share,  establishing a new price peak in listing history with nearly 2 million shares matched.
Since the beginning of the year until now, VIC shares have increased by 240%. At the current price, Vingroup's capitalization has reached nearly 531,000 billion VND, making it the second largest enterprise in the market and about 19,000 billion VND compared to the enterprise with the largest capitalization in the market today - Vietcombank.
Vingroup once held the position of enterprise with the largest capitalization for 3 consecutive years from 2018 - 2020, but from 2021, Vietcombank has risen to hold the number 1 position from then until now.﻿ With the current increase in Vingroup shares, this stock is currently very close to the opportunity to reclaim the throne from Vingroup.
At the 2023 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, a period when Vingroup shares were falling sharply, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong once affirmed: "VIC's value is very low compared to its real value. If you are a loyal shareholder, you will not lose anything, you only lose when you sell, if you haven't sold, you haven't lost anything. Over time, VIC's market value will return."﻿
With the current developments of Vingroup shares, investors recall the words of billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong.﻿
Regarding business results, in the first 6 months of 2025, Vingroup reached VND 130,476 billion in revenue, doubling compared to the same period last year.Minus expenses, pre-tax profit reached 11,159 billion VND, up 69% over the same period.﻿
In the Technology - Industry segment, VinFast delivered 72,167 electric cars to the global market, an increase of 3.2 times compared to the same period in 2024. In the domestic market, VinFast maintained its leading position in the automobile market with 67,569 cars delivered in the first 6 months of the year.
In the electric motorbike segment, VinFast set a new record with 114,484 vehicles delivered, an increase of 5.5 times over the same period.
In the Trade and Services sector, in the first half of 2025, Vingroup recorded total revenue from real estate sales reaching VND 70,500 billion, nearly tripling over the same period last year.In particular, Vinhomes continues to lead the recovery of the real estate market, with sales reaching 67,500 billion VND and unrecorded sales reaching 138,200 billion VND at the end of the second quarter of 2025.
In the field of Resort tourism, with the industry's strong recovery momentum, Vinpearl recorded positive business results.Vinpearl's total operating revenue reached 7,900 billion VND, of which net revenue from hotel service business throughout the system (including facilities directly owned by Vinpearl and facilities managed by Vinpearl) reached about 5,100 billion VND, an increase of 26% over the same period last year;and revenue from VinWonders (including facilities managed by VinWonders) reached VND 2,400 billion, up 32% over the same period last year.
author: Ngoc Diep

title: VIC stock adjusted, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets decreased by more than 15,000 billion VND
sapo: Not only VIC, other stocks in the Vingroup ecosystem also dropped sharply today such as VHM (down 4.2%), VRE (down 1.5%) and VPL (down 1.3%).
content:
The trading session on July 21, around 2:30 p.m., VIC stock price suddenly dropped sharply, even reaching the floor price of 110,700 VND/share.At the end of the trading session, although VIC stock price was no longer at the floor price, it also decreased by nearly 6% at 112,000 VND/share.
Not only VIC, other stocks in the Vingroup ecosystem also dropped sharply today such as VHM (down 4.2%), VRE (down 1.5%) and VPL (down 1.3%).

Last year, VinFast became the best-selling car company with sales of approximately 87,000 cars after 12 months.With a sales volume of nearly 67,600 cars after just half a year, VinFast will likely be able to successfully defend the title of best-selling car company in Vietnam.
author: Ngoc Diep

author: Ha Linh

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's VIC shares hit the ceiling
sapo: VIC shares rose to the ceiling in the morning session, helping the stock market continue to set new highs.
content:
In the stock trading session at the beginning of the week of July 14, the market opened with a boom when a series of large-cap stocks increased sharply, pushing the VN-Index up more than 13 points to more than 1,470 points before cooling down to 1,465 points at the end of the morning.However, this index still temporarily increased by nearly 7.5 points.VN30-Index also increased more than 8 points and temporarily stopped at 1,602 points despite many other stocks facing profit-taking pressure.
The main driving force of the indexes comes from the ceiling increase of VIC shares of Vingroup corporation and other member codes such as VHM, VPL, VRE.
Right after opening, VIC increased to the ceiling by 6.94% to 115,500 VND/share, contributing 6.63 points to the increase of VN-Index this morning.
With this upward momentum, Vingroup's market capitalization has reached nearly 437,000 billion VND, equivalent to 17 billion USD.The value of shares that billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong holds also increased by nearly 14,000 billion VND, bringing the total value of his shares on the stock exchange to about 256,000 billion VND.
At the same time, Forbes' real-time billionaire rankings recorded that Mr. Vuong's assets had increased to 11.9 billion USD, consolidating his position as the richest person in Vietnam and continuing to rise in the group of Asian billionaires.
Along with VIC shares, a number of other stocks in the VN30 basket (large capitalization stocks) such as VPB, VHM, BID, GVR... also traded well.Liquidity on HoSE increased this morning, when in the morning alone, the transaction value was approximately VND 15,200 billion.
VIC shares peaked for many years
VIC shares peaked for many years
Previously, in the past strong week, the VN-Index increased by more than 70 points and the Vingroup group (VIC, VHM, VRE) alone contributed 27 points.
Foreign investors have been net buyers in many consecutive sessions in recent days, approximately VND 12,000 billion since the beginning of July until now.
Foreign investors have been net buyers in many consecutive sessions in recent days, approximately VND 12,000 billion since the beginning of July until now.
Commenting on the market this week, MBS Securities Company said that although there has been a strong week since the end of 2022, the transaction volume has reached a record level, but the cash flow is quite differentiated.
The increase in liquidity and performance in the index focused on a few stock groups of banks, securities, real estate, Vingroup, construction and building materials, and food.

author: According to Thai Phuong

title: VIC shares hit the ceiling, the richest person in Vietnam just gained nearly 3,400 billion VND in one morning
sapo: The increasing momentum pushed Vingroup's market capitalization to VND 441,600 billion, firmly holding the position of the largest private enterprise on the Vietnam stock exchange.
content:
The first session of the week of July 14 recorded sublimation movements of VIC shares - Vingroup Corporation.The market price quickly jumped to the purple price, reaching 115,500 VND/share.This is also the highest price in more than 4 years, since May 2021.
Since the beginning of 2025, VIC shares have increased 185%, becoming one of the best gainers on HoSE.The increase pushed Vingroup's market capitalization to 441,600 billion VND, equivalent to 17.3 billion USD.This number helps Vingroup firmly hold the position of the largest private enterprise on the Vietnam stock exchange.
Not only VIC, other Vin stocks also increased positively, VHM increased by over 2% < VRE increased by 1% while VRE also increased by nearly 1% in the morning session at the beginning of the week and are all trading in the peak area.
VIC shares "picked up" pushing billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's asset value to skyrocket.In the morning session of July 14 alone, it is estimated that the amount of VIC shares directly held by Mr. Vuong increased by nearly 3,400 billion VND.
However, the Chairman of Vingroup also indirectly owns VIC shares through two related legal entities, Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company and VMI Real Estate Investment and Management Joint Stock Company.It is estimated that the total value of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's assets on the Vietnam stock exchange has now exceeded 256,000 billion VND (more than 10 billion USD).This number helps the Chairman of Vingroup maintain his position as the richest person on the Vietnamese stock exchange, far behind names such as Mr. Tran Dinh Long, Do Anh Tuan, Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao...
According to the latest update from Forbes, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong is the richest person in Vietnam with assets as of March 23 of up to 12 billion USD.This number brings the Chairman of Vingroup to 216th position in the list of the world's richest people, up 318 places compared to the time entering 2025.
Positive information from the beginning of the year has boosted Vingroup's stocks.Recently, the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City has just issued Decision No. 3429 on approving land prices for the Can Gio Beach Management Urban Area project (trade name Vinhome Green Paradise in Long Hoa commune and Can Thanh town, former Can Gio district), invested by Can Gio Tourism Urban Joint Stock Company - VinGroup.
In April 2025, the Can Gio sea reclamation urban area project was invested and broke ground at the gate of Long Hoa commune and Can Thanh town with a total area of ​​2,870 hectares.This is a leading project in Vietnam and globally such as the largest theater complex in Southeast Asia, the largest artificial lake in the world, 2 world-class golf courses;108-storey multi-purpose tower, modern hotel chain and commercial center, large modular entertainment - entertainment complex, international standard education system...
Most recently, the Prime Minister just signed and issued Directive No. 20/CT-TTg dated July 12, 2025 on a number of urgent tasks to drastically prevent and resolve environmental pollution.Accordingly, by July 1, 2026, there will be no motorbikes or motorbikes using fossil fuels circulating in Belt 1 - Hanoi.
From January 1, 2028, there will be no motorbikes or motorbikes, and personal cars using fossil fuels will be limited from circulating on Ring Road 1 and Ring Road 2;From 2030, continue to expand implementation in Ring Road 3.
Currently, VinFast is maintaining its leading position with a strategy to expand the electric vehicle segment.Parent corporation Vingroup is still investing heavily in this electric car company, investing an additional 10,000 billion VND in the first quarter of 2025, thereby bringing the total investment capital up to 37,300 billion VND from 2023 to present.
Expect to attract a lot of money when upgrading
From the perspective of investing on the stock exchange, Vietnam's stock market is facing a great opportunity to be upgraded to emerging market status by FTSE Russell in October 2025.In the latest report, SSI Research believes there is a 90% chance that Vietnam will be upgraded this year and estimates that the upgrade by FTSE could attract about 1 billion USD from ETF funds, not including active funds.
SSI Research has released a list of potential stocks to attract capital flows into emerging markets, with 15 names, most of which are Bluechips with foreign room.In particular, the focus is on the Vingroup group (VIC, VHM, VRE) which is forecast to be able to net absorb more than 300 million USD.
author: Tue Giang

title: VIC exceeded 100,000 VND/share, how much did billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increase?
sapo: VIC shares reached a new milestone, helping billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's total assets increase to 10.9 billion USD, ranking 254th on Forbes' list of the richest people on the planet.
content:
On the trading session of July 10, Vietnam's stock market continued to trade vibrantly with green color spreading across many industry groups.
Notably, Vingroup's VIC stock officially reached the 3-digit milestone when it rose to the ceiling at 101,600 VND/share.As of 2:40 p.m. on July 10, there were more than 7 million VIC shares traded and overbought surplus at the ceiling price of more than 1 million units.
Since the beginning of the year, VIC's market price has increased about 150%, among the group of stocks with the strongest increase on the stock exchange.Vingroup's market capitalization reached more than 394,000 billion VND.
Besides, two other stocks from Vingroup also increased well.In particular, VHM also increased by 5.01% to 85,900 VND/share with more than 6.5 million shares "changed hands".
And VRE increased by 6.16% to 28,450 VND/share, with 13.4 million shares traded.
With the explosion of the above stock codes, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's total assets increased to 10.9 billion USD, thereby ranking 254th on the list of the richest people on the planet according to Forbes.Compared to yesterday, his assets have increased by 670 million USD, equivalent to more than 17,500 billion VND.
Source: Forbes
Source: Forbes
In recent developments, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Group reported on the transfer of ownership of more than 87.5 million VIC shares, equivalent to 2.26% of Vingroup Group's charter capital to Vinspeed High Speed Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company (Vinspeed).The transaction date is June 27, 2025.
After the transaction, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong lowered his ownership ratio in Vingroup from nearly 537.5 million shares (ratio 13.86%) to nearly 450 million shares (ratio 11.6%).
Previously, on June 10, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong also transferred 48 million VIC shares to VinSpeed.
Currently, Vinspeed owns more than 135.6 million VIC shares, equivalent to 3.5% of Vingroup's charter capital.Currently, VIC stock is trading around more than 90,000 VND/share), it is estimated that this stock is worth more than 12,000 billion VND.
Vinspeed High Speed ​​Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company was established in May 2025, headquartered at Symphony building, Chu Huy Man street, Vinhomes Riverside urban area, Hanoi city.The main field of this business is railway construction.
Vinspeed's charter capital is 6,000 billion VND, of which Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong contributed 3,060 billion VND, owning 51% of the shares.
The list of shareholders also includes Mr. Vuong's related parties such as Vingroup, which contributed 600 billion VND and owns 10% of the shares;Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company contributed VND 2,100 billion, owning 35% of the shares;Ms. Pham Thuy Hang (Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup) contributed 180 billion VND, owning 3% of shares...
Currently, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong is also Chairman of the Board of Directors of VinSpeed.

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong has used hundreds of millions of VI shares to contribute capital to which businesses?
sapo: After establishing many new companies, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's personal investment portfolio is now quite massive.
content:
During the end of last year and the first half of this year, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong contributed capital to establish many new companies.
Besides Vingroup shares, the richest person in Vietnam currently holds shares in more than a dozen companies:
+ Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company (Vietnam Investment Group - VIG)
+ GSM Green and Smart Mobility Joint Stock Company
+ VMI Real Estate Management & Investment Joint Stock Company
+ VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company
+ VinSpeed High Speed Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company (VinSpeed)
+ VinFuture Award Fund Joint Stock Company﻿
+ Asian Star Trading & Investment
+ Green Future Trading and Services Joint Stock Company
+ VinRobotics Robotics Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company
+ VinMotion Multifunctional Robot Research, Development and Application Joint Stock Company
+ V-Green Global Charging Station Development Joint Stock Company
+ ﻿VinVentures Venture Capital Joint Stock Company
+ Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Joint Stock Company﻿
Vietnam Investment Group (VIG) has long been known as Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's key personal investment company, holding the two most important investments including 32.5% of Vingroup's shares and 32.9% of VinFast Auto Ltd's capital.
Through Star Asian Trading & Investment - an investment company in Singapore - Mr. Vuong also indirectly owns 14.3% of VinFast Auto's capital.Vingroup also owns 50.7% of VinFast Auto's capital.
As of mid-June 2025, nearly 450 million VIC shares were used by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong to contribute capital to 4 companies VMI, GSM, VinEnergo and Vinspeed.
As of mid-June 2025, nearly 450 million VIC shares were used by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong to contribute capital to 4 companies VMI, GSM, VinEnergo and Vinspeed.
At the end of 2022 and early 2023, Mr. Vuong used 294 million personally owned VIC shares to use as capital contributions to establish two companies, VMI and GSM, which are pioneers in their business segments: VMI follows the model of dividing VinHomes products to sell to retail investors, and GSM specializes in providing car rental services, electric motorbikes and VinFast taxi services.
Currently, GSM has developed a network of thousands of taxis and electric motorbikes in a series of provinces and cities across the country and expanded taxi services to Laos, Indonesia and the Philippines.The company has also recently entered the food delivery industry.From a charter capital of 3,000 billion when first established, in December 2024, GSM's capital has increased to 18,000 billion VND.GSM owns 1.3% of Vingroup's capital.
At VMI, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong contributed 90% of the charter capital, equivalent to a capital worth 16,200 billion VND in VIC shares, while Ms. Pham Thu Huong contributed 900 billion VND (5%) and VinHomes contributed the remaining 5% of the capital.After completing capital contribution, VMI has become a major shareholder holding 6.3% of Vingroup's shares.
﻿In March and May this year, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong continued to contribute capital to establish VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company and Vinspeed High Speed ​​Rail Development and Investment Joint Stock Company.
About ﻿VinEnergo, the business mainly operates in the field of electricity production and electrical equipment.VinEnergo is determined to be a joint venture partner with Vingroup to invest in the Hai Phong LNG gas thermal power plant project, expected to be located in Tan Trao Industrial Park, Kien Thuy district.
On June 18, VinEnergo just announced a report on the results of stock transactions by people related to insiders.Accordingly, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong transferred ownership of more than 70.6 million VIC shares to contribute more capital to VinEnergo.
Previously, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong announced the use of more than 35 million shares held by VIC to contribute capital to establish VinEnergo.After the transfer, the total amount of shares held by Mr. Vuong at VinEnergo is 105.6 million shares, accounting for 2.72% of Vingroup's charter capital.
After Mr. Vuong's move to contribute more capital, VinEnergo's charter capital increased from VND 2,000 billion to VND 10,000 billion.Previously, Mr. Vuong held 71% of VinEnergo's capital, Vingroup held 19% and Mr. Vuong's two sons - Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh and Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang each owned 5% of VinEnergo's capital.
Regarding VinSpeed, this is a company that has registered to invest in the North-South high-speed railway project.The project has an investment capital of nearly 1.6 million billion VND (equivalent to about 61.35 billion USD), excluding compensation costs, relocation support, and resettlement for site clearance.
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong has registered to transfer ownership of nearly 88 million VIC shares to contribute more capital to VinSpeed.﻿After completing the transaction, the total number of VIC shares held by Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong at VinSpeed ​​will increase to 135.6 million shares, equivalent to 3.50% of Vingroup Corporation's charter capital.
Previously, on June 11, VinSpeed ​​High Speed ​​Rail Investment and Development Joint Stock Company also announced that Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup Pham Nhat Vuong had completed the transfer of ownership of more than 48 million Vingroup shares (stock code: VIC), equivalent to 1.24% of capital to contribute capital to VinSpeed.
In addition to Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Vietnam Investment Group also owns 35% of VinSpeed's capital, and his two sons and Vingroup are also shareholders of this business with 0.5% of capital.
VinRobotics or VinMotion are like two "twin" companies, both with a charter capital of 1,000 billion VND, with the same shareholder structure including Vingroup holding 51%, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong holding 39%, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's two sons, Pham Nhat Quan Anh and Pham Nhat Minh Hoang, respectively holding 5%.
Both companies are registered businesses with the main field of manufacturing industrial robots and smart robots for different purposes.
Green Future, a car rental service provider within the ecosystem of Vingroup, is led by Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang as General Director and legal representative.Previously, the company was called FGF and changed its name to Green Future in March 2025.
Green Future was established on July 2, 2024 with an initial charter capital of 200 billion VND.Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong is a founding shareholder, holding 90% of the shares.In February 2025, the company increased its capital to 2,000 billion.﻿
VinVentures is a technology investment fund sponsored by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong and Vingroup, launched on October 28.The person holding the position of CEO of VinVentures is Ms. Le Han Tue Lam.
VinVentures was established on October 10, 2024 with a charter capital of 100 billion VND.Of which, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong holds 85% of the capital, Vingroup holds 10%.The remaining major shareholder of VinVentures is Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang - the second son of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, holding 5%.In February 2025, VinVentures just increased its capital to 125 billion VND.

title: VIC personalizes each project
sapo: VIC affirms its position in the high-end aluminum door segment thanks to four core values: personalized solutions, sophisticated construction, accompanying the entire project life cycle and being endorsed by international brands.
content:
Personalization – Taking the homeowner's personality as the center of creation
Different from the popular market, which is familiar with mass-produced door models, VIC chooses a challenging path: designing personalized solutions for each project.
Putting the homeowner at the center, VIC's technical team conducts field surveys and coordinates with relevant departments to come up with solutions suitable for each project condition - from sun direction, ventilation, natural lighting, to the connection between indoor and outdoor spaces.
Not following the popular path, VIC creates a space with a personal impression
Each completed door system meets three criteria: suitable for function, consistent in architectural style and enhances the homeowner's living experience.This is also one of the reasons why VIC becomes the preferred choice in architectural projects that require high design personality and focus on personalization.
Exquisite construction - When every detail becomes an aesthetic statement
At VIC, construction does not stop at "installation", but is the process of realizing strict aesthetic, technical and safety standards.The entire process is implemented under strict control, ensuring technical elements, safety and high aesthetics for the project.
It is known that, with a modern machinery system and construction capacity accumulated through hundreds of high-end projects, every detail - from aluminum cutting, corner pressing, installing accessories to surface finishing - is strictly controlled by this unit.The technical team has many years of experience and a deep understanding of the characteristics of each aluminum system and accessory, ensuring that the output product has high accuracy, uniformity and outstanding aesthetic perfection.
Sophisticated construction is not only a technical process but also the way VIC realizes architectural standards
Thanks to the combination of high technical skills and deep product understanding, projects carried out by VIC always achieve outstanding structural stability and aesthetic perfection.It is the sharpness in every detail and overall seamlessness that has helped VIC become the top choice in projects that require strict construction quality and aesthetic standards.
After-sales for the entire life cycle - Companion thinking, not just sales
According to research, not only stopping at construction and handover, VIC chooses to accompany customers throughout the project's life cycle - a long-term service philosophy rarely seen in the market.VIC's warranty and maintenance policy is methodically and transparently built with a technical team ready to provide quick support, ensuring the door system always operates effectively and retains its aesthetic value over time.The "proactive after-sales" mindset not only improves reliability, but also helps VIC continuously improve products and services, maintaining its position in the high-end aluminum door segment.
International authentication - Positioning class through strategic cooperation
In addition to internal construction capacity, VIC is also one of the few Vietnamese businesses certified by the world's leading aluminum door brands.By 2025, VIC marks 20 years of cooperation with Schüco and 10 years of holding the Premium Partner position - a relationship that is not only nominal, but also a testament to the system of technical standards, implementation process and construction capacity meeting international standards.
All materials, components and technology that VIC uses are synchronized from the genuine manufacturer, helping to optimize stability, sustainability and limit incidents during operation.In particular, the enterprise's technical team is trained and transferred directly by international experts, ensuring a thorough grasp of the installation and maintenance process according to global standards.This is an important foundation to help projects using VIC aluminum door systems always achieve high perfection, while meeting strict requirements from domestic and foreign projects.
VIC staff is experienced, has deep expertise and has a deep understanding of the products
With a clear positioning and consistent development strategy, VIC not only provides aluminum door solutions, but also accompanies architectural projects on the journey to conquer standards of aesthetics, technique and user experience.

title: Portrait of an American "shark" wins the biggest from their galloping momentum Vingroup: Tens of millions of dollars in profits, a rare fund for both VIC and VHM to account for the largest proportion
sapo: In the current portfolio of VanEck Vietnam ETF, Vingroup's VIC shares account for the largest proportion with more than 16.2 million shares, accounting for 13.77% of the fund's net assets.
content:
In the context of many fluctuations in the Vietnamese stock market, VanEck Vietnam ETF (VNM), one of the largest foreign ETFs investing in the Vietnamese market, has recorded outstanding returns.
Data show that the total net assets of VanEck Vietnam ETF as of May 20 was 397.05 million USD, the net asset value (NAV) of 1 share of the fund was 12.95 USD, an increase of 11.48% compared to the beginning of the year.
This increase will be even higher when both Vingroup and Vinhomes - the two largest stocks in the fund's portfolio - continue to increase on May 20, of which VIC shares increased by 2.2% and Vinhomes shares increased by 7%.﻿
Currently, the price of VanEck Vietnam ETF fund certificates is also fluctuating at the highest level since April 2024.
VanEck Vietnam ETF, established in November 2009, is one of the largest foreign ETFs investing in the Vietnamese market and is the largest and most liquid US ETF providing exposure to Vietnamese companies.VanEck Vietnam ETF (VNM) is designed to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price performance and yield of the MarketVector™ Vietnam Local Index.
In the current portfolio of VanEck Vietnam ETF, Vingroup's VIC shares account for the largest proportion with more than 16.2 million shares, accounting for 14.38% of the fund's net assets.Next are shares Vinhomes (VHM) accounting for 10.13% of net assets, Hoa Phat (HPG) accounting for 6.1%, Vinamilk (VNM) accounting for 5.52%, Vietcombank (VCB) accounting for 4.85%, ...

The second stock in the fund's portfolio - VHM is also on a strong upward trend.From the beginning of the year to May 21, VHM shares have increased more than 68%.
With VIC and VHM both accounting for a significant proportion of the portfolio, the strong upward momentum of these two stocks has directly boosted the net asset value and fund certificate price of VanEck Vietnam ETF.VanEck Vietnam ETF is also a rare fund where both VIC and VHM account for the largest proportion in the portfolio.
