title: VIC shares hit the ceiling, regaining the peak of 3 years ago
sapo: During the May 19 session, the "Vin" stock group became the focus of the market when VIC increased to the ceiling, setting the highest price since February 2022.
content:
Closing the session on May 19, Vingroup Corporation shares (Code: VIC) increased to the ceiling, "on the sell side", to 85,600 VND/share, the highest in more than 3 years since the beginning of February 2022.After only 3 months, Vingroup shares have witnessed an increase of more than 110%, marking the strongest price increase among the VN30 group.
Thanks to that, Vingroup's market capitalization increased to more than 327,300 billion VND (equivalent to 12.6 billion USD), consolidating its position as the largest private enterprise on the Vietnam stock exchange, with capitalization only inferior to Vietcombank in the entire market.
VIC shares hit the ceiling, regaining the peak of 3 years ago.
VIC shares hit the ceiling, regaining the peak of 3 years ago.
Two other codes in the Vin family group also had positive developments.VHM of Vinhomes increased by 3.3% to 58,800 VND/share with 3.2 million shares matched, while VRE of Vincom Retail increased slightly by 0.6% with liquidity of more than 5.4 million units.
VIC's developments coincide with the information that Vingroup is one of the contractors participating in the Tu Lien Bridge construction project - one of Hanoi's key infrastructure projects, which just officially started on the morning of May 19.
The project includes 4 components, with a total investment of nearly 19,830 billion VND, of which the construction of bridges and roads at both ends of the bridge is worth about 15,498 billion VND.The construction consortium includes Pacific Construction Group (China), Vingroup and other partners.The investor is the City Traffic Construction Investment Project Management Board.Hanoi.
Tu Lien Bridge is located in the capital's traffic planning until 2030, with a vision to 2050, with the role of connecting Hanoi center with the northern region, northeast of the Red River and Thai Nguyen province.The project is expected to contribute to promoting the capital's economic growth beyond 8% in 2025 and towards double-digit levels in the following years.
Closing the session on May 19, VN-Index decreased 5.1 points to 1,296.29 points.Liquidity on HoSE is low with matched order value reaching about 19,600 billion VND.
Regarding foreign transactions, this group continued to net sell more than 540 billion VND in the entire market.
On the HNX, the HNX-Index decreased 1.45 points to 217.24 points, liquidity reached 946 billion VND.
Meanwhile, UpCom index increased 0.21 points to 95.71 points, liquidity reached 544 billion VND.

title: Vingroup (VIC) reported a 287% increase in first quarter revenue over the same period
sapo: Consolidated profit after tax reached VND2,243 billion, up 68% over the same period.
content:
Vingroup Corporation (stock code VIC) has just announced its Consolidated Financial Report for the first quarter of 2025 with total consolidated net revenue in the quarter reaching VND 84,053 billion, growing 287% over the same period in 2024 thanks to recording positive growth from the fields of industrial production and real estate development and business.
Consolidated profit after tax reached VND2,243 billion, up 68% over the same period.As of March 31, 2025, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 823,270 billion.
With the Technology - Industry pillar, VinFast consolidates its No. 1 position in electric car market share in Vietnam with total vehicle deliveries in the first quarter of 2025 reaching more than 35,100 vehicles.Thanks to that, the company's global sales reached 36,330 vehicles, equivalent to nearly 4 times compared to the same period last year.The three best-selling car models in the domestic market all belong to VinFast with the cars VF 3, VF 5 and VF 6.
In the first quarter of 2025, the company will also officially launch and accept deposits for the Green vehicle line optimized for transportation business.After only 72 hours of opening for sale, VinFast received 45,813 orders for 4 VinFast Green car models, creating a new record in the Vietnamese auto market.
Electric motorbike products also recorded positive signs with the number of vehicles delivered in the first quarter reaching nearly 45,000 vehicles, 5.7 times the number of vehicles sold compared to the same period last year.
In the Trade and Services sector, in the first quarter, Vinhomes recorded revenue of 15,700 billion VND, profit after tax of 2,700 billion VND.Vinhomes officially launched the Vinhomes Wonder City project (Dan Phuong, Hanoi) with a scale of 133 hectares.The project achieved a sales rate of 92% in the Hung Dong subdivision in just 4 days and 70% in the Binh Minh subdivision in just 1 day of opening.
In March, the Vinhomes Green City project with a scale of nearly 200 hectares (Duc Hoa, Long An) was officially started.In April 2025, Can Gio - Vinhomes Green Paradise sea reclamation tourist urban area with a scale of up to 2,870 hectares will also be started.
In the field of resort tourism, Vinpearl's activities grew well in the context of international visitors to Vietnam in the first quarter reaching 6 million, the highest in history.During the Lunar New Year 2025, VinWonders at 4 major destinations (Phu Quoc, Nha Trang, Nam Hoi An, Ha Tinh) simultaneously organized a series of Tet festival activities lasting from January 20 to February 16, 2025.
By the end of the first quarter of 2025, the total number of visitors of Vinpearl hotel group recorded an increase of 18% in visitors compared to the first quarter of 2024 while VinWonders reached nearly 1.6 million, an increase of 29% compared to last year.
author: Ngoc Diep

title: The newly established 2,000 billion electricity company of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong received 35 million shares VIC capital contribution from the billionaire
sapo: Mr. Vuong holds 71% of VinEnergo's shares.Temporarily calculated based on VIC's closing price on April 23, 2025, the amount of capital contributions has a market value of 2,053 billion VND.
content:
On April 23, VinEnergo Energy Joint Stock Company received transfer of ownership of 35.04 million VIC shares from Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup.These shares are equivalent to 0.9% of Vingroup's charter capital.
This is an ownership transfer transaction by Mr. Vuong contributing capital to VinEnergo with VIC shares.
The closing price on April 23, 2025 of VIC is 58,600 VND.Temporarily calculated at this price, the amount of capital contributions has a market value of 2,053 billion VND.﻿VinEnergo's charter capital is 2,000 billion VND.
Before the transaction, VinEnergo did not hold any VIC shares.After completing the transfer, VinEnergo became a shareholder of Vingroup with an ownership ratio of 0.9%.
The ownership ratio at Vingroup of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong and related people is still 17.82% of charter capital.
VinEnergo was established on March 12, 2025, headquartered in Symphony office building (Hanoi), main activities in the field of electricity production and electrical equipment.
Regarding shareholder structure, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong holds 71% of the shares (equivalent to 1,420 billion VND, contributed capital by 35 million VIC shares - equivalent to valuing VIC at 40,000 VND/share);Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh - the billionaire's eldest son holds 5% of the shares;Mr. Pham Nhat Minh Hoang - the second son of the billionaire holds 5% of the shares.The remaining 19% belongs to Vingroup.
VinEnergo was born in the context that Vingroup is promoting its investment strategy in renewable energy.At the end of March, Vingroup sent a document to the Government, proposing to add a series of solar and wind power projects with a total capacity of 47,500 MW to the adjustment of Power Planning VIII.
The Group hopes to form national energy centers in the future, while contributing to realizing Vietnam's green transformation goals.
With the above proposal, the Ministry of Industry and Trade said it will soon work with the Chairman of Vingroup to clarify proposals related to the clean electricity development strategy.The meeting will focus on determining specific locations, implementation capacity and Vingroup's commitment to implementation progress for proposed projects.
author: Phuong Anh

title: SK has moved to divest capital from VIC in the week of April 14-18, in the opposite direction of foreign investors strongly gathering "steel king" stocks.
sapo: Foreign transactions were a minus point last week with a net selling value of more than 5,000 billion.
content:
After a week of good recovery under strong selling pressure, the stock market recorded a continued recovery in the trading week of April 14-18 to the price range of 1,240 points.Short-term profit-taking pressure began to increase after many stocks increased sharply. The VN-Index suffered a correction as it approached the resistance threshold of 1,220-1,230 points and retreated to the strong psychological support of 1,200.At the end of the week, VN-Index decreased 3.34 points (-0.23%) to 1,219.12 points.
Foreign trading was a minus point last week with sudden net selling.In total, after 5 sessions, foreign investors net sold VND 5,170 billion across the market with the focus of net selling over VND 4,500 billion in Thursday's session.
Considering each exchange separately during the week, foreign investors net sold VND 4,722 billion on HoSE, net bought VND 253 billion on HNX and net sold VND 194 billion on UPCoM.
Statistics by stock codes, the focus of net selling was recorded on VIC shares with a value of 4,394 billion VND, the focus was on the April 17 session when foreign investors were the strongest net sellers in the entire market with a value of 4,446 billion VND.
In a related development, according to the 2024 annual report, SK Group (Korea's 3rd largest chaebol) is classifying its investment in Vingroup shares as assets held awaiting sale.This move is part of SK's plan to restructure its international investment portfolio.Therefore, the above transaction can be considered as SK's divestment.
Besides, HCM and FPT were also net sold 371 billion and 339 billion respectively.VNM shares were also net sold 292 billion VND.The list of net sellers of foreign investors last week also included IDC, GMD, CTG, KBC... net sold over 100 billion VND.
On the contrary, HPG bank shares suddenly received the strongest net purchase by foreign investors with 535 billion VND.Foreign capital also flowed into two stocks, MWG and ACB, with net purchases of MWG 381 billion VND and ACB 299 billion VND after 5 sessions last week.Net buying power last week also recorded VCI, VHM, HVN, VCG, BMP...
author: Tue Giang

title: Investors taking profit on VIC shares?
sapo: Vingroup is still the enterprise with the second largest market capitalization on the stock exchange, only after Vietcombank.
content:
After an impressive series of increases of up to 57% since the beginning of March, on April 18, VIC shares decreased to 66,100 VND/share. The total volume of VIC shares traded was nearly 10.6 million shares.
﻿This move is likely to make investors take profits after VIC has recorded an impressive increase of up to 57% since the beginning of March. Previously, this stock code did not fall too deeply even during periods when the general market was adversely affected, such as concerns about US tariff policies.
﻿After today's session, Vingroup's capitalization is at more than 252,700 billion VND, the second largest on the stock exchange after Vietcombank.
﻿On April 17, VIC appeared in an agreement transaction that was identified as being from SK with a value of 4,446 billion VND.According to the 2024 annual report, SK Group (Korea's 3rd largest chaebol) is classifying its investment in Vingroup shares as assets held awaiting sale.
This move is part of SK's plan to restructure its international investment portfolio.
﻿Previously in January 2025, SK Investment Vina II - a member fund of SK Group sold nearly 51 million VIC shares, thereby reducing its ownership to 180.61 million shares, equivalent to 4.72%.SK's transactions will no longer be subject to information disclosure because it is no longer a major shareholder at Vingroup.
SK's decision to divest capital shows that this unit has found an investor to buy back VIC shares, through an agreement method.
On April 24, the group will hold the 2025 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders in Hanoi.According to newly published documents, Vingroup targets net revenue from production and business activities of about 300,000 billion VND and profit after tax of 10,000 billion VND, an increase of 56% and 90% respectively compared to 2024.
﻿In the previous year 2024, Vingroup recorded total consolidated net revenue of VND 192,159 billion, an increase of 19% compared to the previous year and the highest level in history.The main driving force comes from the strong handover speed of real estate in major projects, in parallel with the outstanding growth from the electric vehicle segment.Profit after tax reached 5,251 billion VND, up 155% over the same period, exceeding the yearly plan.
On April 19, 2025, Vingroup plans to hold a groundbreaking ceremony for the Can Gio sea reclamation tourist urban area project in Long Hoa commune and Can Thanh town (Can Gio district).
It is known that the project was just approved by Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee last March.The project is a group A project, with a lifespan of 50 years. The Can Gio sea reclamation urban area will be built into an urban area for marine tourism, resort tourism for seminars, conferences, smart urban areas, high-tech services, housing, services, hotels...
Can Gio sea reclamation tourist urban area has a total area of 2,870 hectares.The project is divided into 4 subdivisions A, B, C and D-E, with a population of nearly 230,000 people, capable of welcoming 8-9 million visitors each year.
author: Ngoc Diep

content:
Along with the recovery momentum of VN-Index, Vingroup's VIC stock increased the strongest in the VN30 basket on April 17.The market price of this stock increased by 4.6% to 71,000 VND/share, the highest within 20 months from August 2023.
Notably, VIC is the stock with the strongest net sale by foreign investors in the entire market with a value of 4,446 billion VND.

Therefore, this transaction is considered a SK divestment.However, VIC stock price still increased, showing that SK has found an investor to buy VIC stock agreement, and also demonstrated domestic investors' confidence in Vingroup's potential.

VIC shares increased sharply, pushing Vingroup's capitalization beyond VND 271,000 billion (~ USD 10.5 billion).This number puts billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's group ahead of BIDV to become the second most valuable name in the entire Vietnam stock exchange.Vingroup's market capitalization is currently only inferior to Vietcombank.﻿
On April 24, the group will hold the 2025 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders in Hanoi.According to newly published documents, Vingroup targets net revenue from production and business activities of about 300,000 billion VND and profit after tax of 10,000 billion VND, an increase of 56% and 90% respectively compared to 2024.
In the previous year 2024, Vingroup recorded total consolidated net revenue of VND 192,159 billion, an increase of 19% compared to the previous year and the highest level in history.The main driving force comes from the strong handover speed of real estate in major projects, in parallel with the outstanding growth from the electric vehicle segment.Profit after tax reached 5,251 billion VND, up 155% over the same period, exceeding the yearly plan.

title: VIC shares hit the ceiling, the richest person in Vietnam just gained more than 2,000 billion VND in one morning
sapo: In the past 1 month, VIC shares have increased more than 40%.The increase pushed Vingroup's market capitalization to 215,600 billion VND, equivalent to 8.5 billion USD.
content:
The first session of the week of March 24 suddenly recorded sublimation movements of VIC shares - Vingroup Corporation.The market price quickly jumped to the purple price, reaching 56,600 VND/share, before cooling down a bit to 56,400 VND/share (as of 10:30 a.m.).This is also the highest price within 18 months from September 2023.Today's session is also a trading day without the right to attend Vingroup's 2025 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.The meeting time and location have not been announced at this time.
In the past 1 month, VIC shares have increased more than 40%.The increase pushed Vingroup's market capitalization to 215,600 billion VND, equivalent to 8.5 billion USD.This number helps Vingroup firmly hold the position of the largest private enterprise on the Vietnam stock exchange.
Not only VIC, other Vin stocks also increased positively, VHM increased by over 3% while VRE also increased by nearly 2% in the morning session at the beginning of the week and are all trading at an 18-month peak.
Positive information from the beginning of the year has boosted Vingroup's stocks.Right in March 2025, Vinpearl announced the submission of HoSE listing documents.If Vinpearl is approved to list, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong will have one more share in the same ecosystem on the Vietnam stock exchange.After the issuance in February (more than 70 million shares at 71,350 VND/share), Vinpearl's charter capital is now nearly 18,000 billion VND.
VIC shares "picked up" pushing billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's asset value to skyrocket.In the morning session of March 24 alone, it is estimated that the amount of VIC shares directly held by Mr. Vuong increased by more than 2,200 billion VND.However, the Chairman of Vingroup also indirectly owns VIC shares through two related legal entities, Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company and VMI Real Estate Investment and Management Joint Stock Company.It is estimated that the total value of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's assets on the Vietnam stock exchange has now exceeded 110,000 billion VND (4 billion USD), an increase of about 1 billion USD since the beginning of the year.This number helps the Chairman of Vingroup maintain his position as the richest person on the Vietnamese stock exchange, far behind names such as Mr. Tran Dinh Long, Do Anh Tuan, Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao...
According to the latest update from Forbes, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong is the richest person in Vietnam with assets as of March 23 of up to 7.1 billion USD.This number brings the Chairman of Vingroup to 449th position on the list of the world's richest people, up 263 places compared to the time entering 2025.

content:

From only 660 million VND in initial capital, investors can own a 2-bedroom apartment.For the remaining amount, the Bank also supports 0% interest rate for 18 months.Using appropriate financial leverage helps investors at VIC Grand Square earn regular profits.Fully resonating with the above mentioned advantages, VIC Grand Square continuously maintains its attraction in the Northern real estate market.

title: VIC shares hit the ceiling, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's family got more than 2,500 billion VND
sapo: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's asset value increased to more than 31,300 billion VND after the ceiling increase of VIC shares.
content:
At the end of the trading session on March 7, VN-Index closed at 1,326 points, up nearly 8 points compared to the previous session.
Notably, Vingroup's VIC shares in the rising session hit the ceiling, reaching 45,300 VND/share.The selling surplus at the ceiling price at the end of the session is still more than 130,000 units.This is the stock that contributed the most to the increase in VN-Index, while most stocks narrowed their increase compared to the morning due to profit-taking pressure.
Two other stocks belonging to Vingroup members, VHM of Vinhomes Joint Stock Company and VRE of Vincom Retail Joint Stock Company, also increased slightly compared to yesterday's session, at 44,950 VND and 18,200 VND/share, respectively.
With this strong and unexpected increase, the asset value of Vingroup Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong, who owns 691 million VIC shares, increased by more than 2,000 billion VND, from 29,263 billion VND to more than 31,300 billion VND.
Similarly, the asset value of Ms. Pham Thu Huong, Mr. Vuong's wife, increased by more than 520 billion VND, pushing the value of 170 million VIC shares that Huong holds to over 7,728 billion VND.Mr. Vuong's son, Pham Nhat Quan Anh, also increased his asset value by more than 500 million VND, to 6.8 billion VND.
Thus, after the ceiling increase in VIC shares, the family of Vingroup Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong increased its asset value by more than 2,500 billion VND.
VIC shares have increased sharply recently
VIC shares have increased sharply recently
The move to increase to the ceiling of VIC shares took place at the same time that the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HOSE) announced that on March 3, the unit had received the listing registration dossier of Vinpearl Joint Stock Company, a member of VinGroup.
There is also other positive information that Vingroup Corporation aims to start construction on the Can Gio sea reclamation urban area with a scale of up to 2,870 hectares before April 30, 2025.This content was raised by a representative of Vingroup in a meeting with Ho Chi Minh City leaders on March 6.
In 2024, Vingroup recorded a consolidated net revenue of up to 192,159 billion VND, an increase of 19% compared to 2023. This is the highest revenue level in the group's 31-year history, thanks to the strong handover of large real estate projects such as Vinhomes Royal Island and the outstanding growth of the electric vehicle segment.
Vingroup's pre-tax profit reached 16,724 billion VND, an increase of 21.5%, while profit after tax reached 5,251 billion VND, an incredible growth of 155.4% over the same period last year.This result far exceeds the plan set at the 2024 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
author: According to Le Tinh

title: Vinpearl has just filed for listing, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets are back above the VND 100,000 billion mark thanks to VIC's sky-high increase.
sapo: It is known that Vinpearl is also a member of the Vingroup ecosystem, headquartered on Hon Tre island, Vinh Nguyen ward, Nha Trang city, Khanh Hoa province.
content:
Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE) has just announced the receipt of registration documents to list shares of Vinpearl Joint Stock Company.The number of registered listings is nearly 1.8 billion units, corresponding to a charter capital of 17,933 billion VND.The consulting organization is SSI Securities.
Previously, on November 15, 2024, the State Securities Commission (SSC) issued an official dispatch confirming the completion of Vinpearl's public company registration.
In February, Vinpearl issued more than 70 million shares at a price of 71,350 VND/share, increasing its charter capital to the current 17,933 billion VND.This capital source is used to contribute capital to VinWonders Nha Trang, receive shares of some projects from Vingroup (stock code VIC), pay principal and interest, as well as supplement working capital.
On February 20, Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC) announced to receive custody of nearly 1.8 billion VPL shares of Vinpearl, in the form of book entry.
Vinpearl is a member of the Vingroup ecosystem, headquartered on Hon Tre island, Vinh Nguyen ward, Nha Trang city, Khanh Hoa province.
Vinpearl owns 48 facilities present in 18 provinces and cities nationwide, including 31 hotels and resorts with a capacity of over 16,100 rooms, 4 theme parks, 5 entertainment areas, 1 conservation and care park for semi-wild animals, 1 water park, 1 horse academy, 4 golf courses, and 1 culinary convention center.
Vinpearl was listed on HoSE in January 2008 but then delisted in December 2011 to merge with Vingroup.﻿
According to the 2024 audited financial report, Vinpearl recorded total annual revenue from sales and service provision reaching 14,388 billion VND, an increase of 55% compared to the previous year.
According to structure, the hotel, tourism and entertainment services business segment still makes the main contribution with nearly 75% of total revenue, reaching 10,678 billion VND, an increase of 2.1% compared to the previous year.
Excluding expenses, profit after tax reached 2,550 billion VND, a sharp increase compared to 671 billion VND in 2023.
Vinpearl's move to submit listing documents made Vingroup stocks prosper on the afternoon of March 7.﻿
Closing the trading session, Vingroup (VIC) increased to the ceiling to 45,300 VND.Vinhomes also increased by 3% and Vincom Retail also increased by 2%.

title: Latest developments on the progress of Vingroup's (VIC) nearly VND 44,000 billion resort "super project" in Da Nang
sapo: According to information from the Da Nang Department of Natural Resources and Environment, there are currently 169 documents needing site clearance to implement Vingroup's nearly 44,000 billion VND Lang Van resort project.
content:
The project has an area of ​​about 512 hectares, with a total investment capital of about 43,922.03 billion VND.
The project has an area of ​​about 512 hectares, with a total investment capital of about 43,922.03 billion VND.
On February 26, the Da Nang Department of Natural Resources and Environment (Natural Resources and Environment) informed about the progress of the Lang Van Tourism and Urban Resort Complex Project.
Accordingly, the project is invested and built in Hoa Hiep Bac ward, Lien Chieu district, with a scale of more than 512 hectares;population is about 19,000 people.Total project investment capital is about 43,922 billion VND.﻿
The project will form a complex including commercial and service works, eco-tourism development combined with low-density accommodation associated with nature conservation to serve the tourism and living needs of local people and domestic and foreign tourists with a civilized and modern architectural space.
Da Nang City People's Committee approved the land use boundary diagram in 2008;Adjust detailed planning at 1/500 scale in 2014 and 2016.
Vinpearl Joint Stock Company (a subsidiary of Vingroup - VIC) was approved as a project investor by the People's Committee of Da Nang City on August 27, 2016 and was allocated and leased land with an area of 10,446,951m2 by the People's Committee of Da Nang City in the same year to implement phase 1 of the project.
For the remaining area of ​​the project, the land use plan, detailed planning at a scale of 1/500, and investment policy of the competent authority have been approved.The project is eligible to carry out land recovery, land allocation, and land lease according to regulations after completing site clearance work.
The Department of Natural Resources and Environment said that through statistics, the area of ​​phase 2 has 679 records that need to be cleared, including: 38 records of land with houses, 641 records of agricultural land and other land.
Basically, relevant organizations, households, and individuals agree with the policy of land acquisition to implement the project.
By February 20, the Lien Chieu District Land Clearance Council had completed processing 510/679 dossiers (reaching a rate of 75.1%), leaving 169 dossiers (rate 24.9%).
Lien Chieu District People's Committee is focusing on completing the site clearance work, expected to hand over the clean site no later than early April 2025 to ensure the project is soon implemented.
The Lang Van project was approved by the Prime Minister and approved investment policy adjustments on November 20, 2024.Project progress is 5 years from the date of approval of investment policy adjustment.

title: VIC Grand Square won the prestigious Real Estate Award in Southeast Asia
sapo: On December 12, at the Dot Property Southeast Asia Awards 2024 ceremony held in Bangkok, Thailand, the VIC Grand Square project excellently won the prestigious award "Best Lifestyle Design Development Southeast Asia 2024" (Project with the most beautiful lifestyle design in Southeast Asia 2024).
content:
This is one of the most prestigious awards in the real estate industry in Southeast Asia, honoring projects with excellent design, contributing to enhancing lifestyle and promoting sustainable development for the community.
Prestigious award for real estate developers and projects in Southeast Asia
With rigorous and comprehensive evaluation criteria, this award was given to VIC Grand Square for its superiority in design, architecture, creativity and influence on the region.This is the first time a real estate project in Phu Tho has received this prestigious international award along with other representatives from Southeast Asia.
The VIC Grand Square project stands out with its unique architecture combining modernity and tradition, imbued with the cultural influence of the Dat To region.The project's architecture is inspired by the image of King Hung's hat - a sacred cultural symbol, and is also a way to show respect for tradition in a classy living space.Modern elements in the project's design also reflect new living trends, aiming to optimize functionality, but still retain core cultural values.
Criteria for creative breakthrough
One of the highlights of VIC Grand Square is its creative breakthrough criteria. Creative elements in the project include unique design concepts, modern architecture, and smart planning.In particular, the Expert Home product line, expert standard apartments, designed to suit the living standards for the intellectual class, elites and domestic and foreign experts, is a breakthrough innovation in creating living spaces suitable to development needs as well as the orientation to become the "Northern industrial capital" of Phu Tho province.
Not only focusing on design, VIC Grand Square provides an optimized living space using natural light, creating spacious views and contributing to improving air quality and improving residents' health.This not only creates a quality living space but also demonstrates the investor's commitment to sustainable development and environmental protection.
Organizer representatives and Developer representatives in Southeast Asian countries took souvenir photos after the ceremony
The "Best Lifestyle Design Development Southeast Asia 2024 - Project with the most beautiful lifestyle design in Southeast Asia" award is not only a recognition for VIC Grand Square but also affirms the reputation and capacity of the Investor.The fact that the project was honored within the framework of a major award such as the Dot Property Southeast Asia Awards opens up new opportunities for Phu Tho province, helping to attract domestic and foreign investors.
VIC Grand Square has brought a new breeze to the regional real estate industry, contributing to the local socio-economic development and creating conditions to attract experts, investors and tourists.Located in the city center.Viet Tri, one of the areas with great cultural value in the country, VIC Grand Square is not only a real estate project but also a part of the tourism and cultural development strategy in the area.The project not only meets living needs, but also contributes to enriching the cultural identity and traditions of the Land of To.
With this prestigious award, VIC Grand Square not only affirms its value and development potential but is also a source of inspiration for other real estate projects in Phu Tho and neighboring provinces.
In the future, VIC Grand Square (Hung Vuong Square commercial, financial and multi-functional apartment tower) promises to become a symbol of modern and creative lifestyle, creating motivation for improving the quality of life of residents and promoting sustainable development locally.The strong development of the project not only brings economic benefits but also enhances the value of the area, helping Phu Tho become an attractive destination for investors and tourists.

title: Invest in expert-standard apartments in VICGrand Square in the industrial core area
sapo: Vietnam is becoming an attractive investment destination thanks to the continuous influx of FDI capital, leading to a rapid increase in the number of experts working in industrial parks across the country.
content:
This has created an increasing demand for high-quality accommodation, especially apartments meeting professional standards - opening up the trend of investing in professional rental apartments.In the context of scarce supply, expert-standard apartment projects such as VIC Grand Square have become the focus of attracting investment in key industrial areas such as Phu Tho.
Investors prefer expert-standard apartments
Recently, Ms. Tran Thu Huong (Hanoi) met with many real estate brokers to learn about apartment projects near key industrial zones.She focuses on 1-2 bedroom apartments, targeting tenants who are experts and senior engineers working in industrial parks.
"When I came to Phu Tho, I saw that Viet Tri city has only one high-end apartment project that meets the standards for renting to experts, even though the area has 7 industrial parks," Ms. Huong said.She shared that at the end of this month, when her savings deposit at the bank matures, she will withdraw to invest in an Expert Home apartment at the VIC Grand Square project, right in the center of Viet Tri city."I researched very carefully and found that the profit from renting apartments here can be significantly higher than bank interest rates," she said."Furthermore, with its expensive location, the apartment value will also have the potential to increase in price in the future."
A recent report from real estate services research firm Savills shows that Vietnam is currently an attractive investment destination for foreign direct investors (FDI) thanks to its political context, stable economic development and competitive labor costs.According to the General Statistics Office, as of October 31, total registered FDI capital in Vietnam (including newly registered capital, adjustments and value of capital contributions and share purchases by foreign investors) reached 27.26 billion USD, an increase of 1.9% over the same period last year.
In the context of abundant FDI capital, according to Savills, some real estate segments have outstanding growth, including service apartments.In fact, Ms. Huong is just one of many investors who are turning to buying apartment products for professionals because they realize the actual demand from the market.However, due to low supply, this market is becoming more and more vibrant in some places that are industrial core areas.
As in Phu Tho, this locality has 7 large industrial parks and 28 industrial clusters, attracting nearly 14,000 high-tech workers, foreign experts and nearly 50,000 young workers of the "golden generation" age to work here.However, foreign experts working here still have to choose to rent nearby hotel apartments or accept to travel every day to Hanoi because there are not many projects that meet their needs.
What is the factor to "surely win"?
Mr. Pham Thanh Nam, assistant of a Korean expert, is looking for information about apartments in Phu Tho to advise his superiors.Mr. Nam said his superior was a foreigner and wanted to find a place with internal security and a variety of amenities so he wouldn't have to go out much.Because they only need to stay in Vietnam while working, they also prioritize having enough space, avoiding waste and not feeling empty.
High-end shopping center at the podium of VIC Grand Square project
In fact, foreign experts have high requirements for apartment quality, location, professional management services, especially security, safety and other amenities.In the context of increasing demand for apartment rentals but limited supply, this segment is expected to continue to be a potential type of investment with attractive profit rates.However, to attract tenants, investors need to meet their high living standards.
Thanks to its prime location and standard utility and service system, the VIC Grand Square project quickly attracted attention upon launch, becoming the top choice of investors and elites.
The project is located right next to the 6-lane wide Hung Vuong Avenue - the main road of the city.Viet Tri - easy connection to key locations such as large industrial parks, Noi Bai - Lao Cai highway and neighboring economic areas.Expert Home apartments here are also fully equipped with amenities and high-end furniture from leading brands from Europe.Along with that, amenities such as shopping centers, sky bridges, skybars, mini golf courses... are also focused on development by the investor.
Furthermore, with prices starting from just over 1.1 billion VND/unit, VIC Grand Square is even more attractive to investors.Because compared to many other areas, especially big city centers, to buy a similar apartment, investors may have to spend 3 times more money but the rental price is only equivalent, due to the highly competitive market.
Investors are interested in learning about the VIC Grand Square project
With the investment goal of "sure win", future growth potential is also an important factor that cannot be ignored.With the orientation of becoming a new industrial capital in the North, by 2030, Phu Tho plans to have 12 industrial parks with a total area of ​​over 5,000 hectares.Among them, the province will invest in expanding 7 existing industrial parks and forming 5 new industrial parks.
Along with efforts to reform institutions and improve the business environment, FDI capital flows combined with increasingly improved infrastructure will positively impact accommodation demand.This shows that demand for specialist apartments will continue to increase strongly in the future, promising attractive profits for projects like VIC Grand Square.
author: Anh Duong

title: Invest in an Expert Home apartment for only 1.1 billion/unit at VICGrand Square
sapo: Investor VIC Grand Square launches a line of apartments in the rare segment from only 1.1 billion VND, with attractive sales policies that investors cannot ignore.
content:
Policy to "activate" investors
Since the beginning of the year, records show that real estate is still the channel with the highest investment yield.According to Savills' third quarter market report, apartment prices in Hanoi increased 6% quarter-on-quarter and 28% year-on-year, reaching 69 million VND per square meter.Meanwhile, VNIndex, which shows stock price fluctuations, ended the third quarter up 12% over the same period, savings interest rates were also only around 6% per year.
This attractive profit level makes real estate still considered an attractive investment channel.In particular, in the context of bank interest rates remaining low and investors continuously launching "trigger" sales policies, it has helped buyers easily access this investment channel.
Typically, at the VIC Grand Square project (Viet Tri, Phu Tho), the investor is applying an extremely attractive sales policy for investors, with payment progress divided into 8 installments to help customers easily balance cash flow.Customers only need to spend 15% of the apartment value (less than 200 million VND for a studio apartment) to sign a sales contract.Customers who need to pay early also receive a discount policy of up to 10% of the apartment value.As for customers using financial leverage, the bank will support 0% interest loans within 20 months and a grace period on principal debt for the first 12 months.
Mr. Tran Thai Minh, an investor in Hanoi, shared the reason why he decided to invest money to buy 5 apartments at the VIC Grand Square project: "With a small initial capital investment, it is paid in many installments, making it easier for investors like me to decide to invest money. In addition, taking advantage of reasonable loan capital is also a way to increase the profitability of the investment."
Attractive investment problem
VIC Grand Square owns the Expert home product line with a high-end utility system that fully meets the living standards for foreign experts and senior engineers.In addition to the activation policy from the investor, this project is also attractive to investors thanks to its prime location, bringing outstanding investment value.
Rooftop amenities at VIC Grand Square project
VIC Grand Square project is located right next to the 6-lane wide Hung Vuong Avenue - the main road of the city.Viet Tri - easy connection to key locations such as large industrial parks, Noi Bai - Lao Cai highway and neighboring economic areas.This location brings outstanding transportation advantages, helping residents move quickly and conveniently to important areas inside and outside the province.Viet Tri is also the administrative, economic and cultural center of Phu Tho province with developed infrastructure and methodical planning.According to the orientation to 2040, Viet Tri city will be the central city of the region, the pole of development in the Northwest of Hanoi capital.This will give real estate projects here the potential to increase prices, helping investors increase profits in the long term.
Not to mention, the stable source of profit from rental apartments is also a factor that attracts investors.Phu Tho has 7 large industrial parks and 28 industrial clusters, attracting nearly 14,000 high-tech workers, foreign experts and nearly 50,000 young workers of "golden generation" age to work here.However, the luxury apartment segment for this group is still scarce.
In addition to the prime location, Expert Home apartments ensure rentability thanks to tailor-made standards for experts and elite owners.Currently, in Phu Tho province, there are no projects that fully integrate high-end amenities such as shopping centers, sky bridges, skybars, mini golf courses... Each apartment is completed with high-end interiors from leading brands from Europe.In addition, the project is expected to be operated and managed by Savills, a leading real estate services provider with more than 160 years of experience in many countries around the world.
Expert-standard luxury apartment interior at VIC Grand Square
Comparing the investment problem, we can see that an apartment in a potential rental area for professionals like VIC Grand Square can cost up to 13-15 million VND per month.In fact, senior experts working in Phu Tho are choosing accommodation options such as renting apartments at top hotels around for 10-20 million VND/month, and even some high-end service rooms at hotels can be up to 30-45 million VND/month.However, these projects can only be counted on the fingers of one hand and cannot meet the needs of nearly 14,000 existing experts.This is also a temporary solution for experts because they actually need a better quality living space, integrated with enough amenities and services and served according to international standards.
The number of experts and senior engineers will even increase many times in the future, along with the need to develop industrial parks and industrial clusters to increase Phu Tho's ability to attract investment.With the orientation of becoming a new industrial capital in the North, by 2030, Phu Tho plans to have 12 industrial parks with a total area of ​​over 5,000 hectares.Among them, the province will invest in expanding 7 existing industrial parks and forming 5 new industrial parks.
With a price of just over 1.1 billion/unit, good liquidity due to high demand but still a shortage of goods makes the rental market in Viet Tri more attractive than many other areas.For example, currently investors can choose to buy an apartment in the west of Hanoi with 3 times the value of a similar apartment in VIC Grand Square but the rental price is only equivalent, or even lower.
author: Anh Duong

title: Potential from investing in Expert Home -VICGrand Square apartments
sapo: Along with inner-city apartment prices continuously establishing new, high levels, capital flows are looking to shift to product lines that have a lot of growth potential in the future.
content:
Cash flows looking for new markets
After the first three quarters of the year, apartment selling prices in the Hanoi market have shown no signs of slowing down, and even continued to escalate.Real estate services consulting firm Savills said apartment prices in Hanoi increased in both new and old projects in the third quarter.In particular, the average primary price increased 6% quarter-on-quarter and 28% year-on-year, reaching 69 million VND per m2.The increase in primary projects also caused the selling price of old apartments to escalate, at 41% year-on-year, to 51 million VND per square meter.
According to the Vietnam Real Estate Market Research Institute (VARs IRE), the apartment price index continues to maintain an increasing trend in the capital Hanoi as well as some other key cities.As of the third quarter of 2024, the average selling price of project clusters in Hanoi is close to 60 million VND/m2.Compared to the base period (second quarter of 2019), the selling price of primary apartments in Hanoi recorded an increase of up to 64%, more than double the 30% increase rate of the Ho Chi Minh City market and 1.5 times higher than that of Da Nang.
With real estate prices constantly setting new levels, at high levels, far exceeding the income growth rate of most people, many investors fall into a dilemma.Because, if you invest at the "peak" price, many people determine that it will be difficult to "surf".Meanwhile, if you buy to rent, the profit margin will not be high due to the large investment capital.
Since then, emerging investors tend to "shift" to provincial real estate.Suburban areas such as Phu Tho, Bac Ninh, Bac Giang, Thai Nguyen, Hung Yen have become new bright spots to welcome this cash flow.These are all localities with increasingly perfect transportation infrastructure, combined with industrial development and urbanization, expected to bring high profit potential.Land prices in these areas, although increasing, are still much lower than in major urban centers, creating attractive investment opportunities.
Expert home - a potential "niche" market
Along with the capital flow shifting to suburban provinces, there is also a change in long-term real estate investment strategy.Investors are looking for new products with the potential to bring more sustainable profits.Among them, the Expert Home type (apartments that meet the accommodation needs of experts) has become a "branded item" sought after by many people.
Expert Home apartment interior at VIC Grand Square project
Expert home was first mentioned after VIC Grand Square launched in the Phu Tho real estate market.This product line is developed in the centers of large industrial cities with high standards to meet the accommodation requirements for domestic and foreign experts to rent.
According to investor VIC Grand Square, when developing Expert Home, for them, choosing a potential area is the most important factor.The reason for choosing Phu Tho is because this locality is a new industrial center at the gateway to the Northwest region, the new industrial capital of the North.From 2021-2023, the province has attracted 478 private investment projects (DDI), registered capital of 56.9 trillion VND, 78 foreign direct investment (FDI) projects, registered capital estimated at 2.1 billion USD.The whole province has 7 large industrial parks and 28 industrial clusters, attracting experts from countries such as Korea, China, Japan, Singapore, America, India...
There are currently nearly 14,000 experts, engineers, and senior personnel with high incomes working in industrial parks and industrial clusters in the province.The increase in the number of foreign experts has created a solid source of demand for the rental apartment market, helping this segment grow positively.
Thanks to the strong increase in the force of high-end experts with demand for standard apartments for rent, Expert home at VIC Grand Square is expected to bring in regular monthly cash flow while the investment amount is not too large compared to in Hanoi, about more than 1 billion for small apartments.In fact, the profit margin from investing in apartment rentals can be up to 12 - 15%, much higher than investing in Hanoi due to real demand from high-end experts.
Prime location, valuable view of Expert Home apartment - VIC Grand Square
However, the characteristic of the group of experts and intellectuals is that there is a great need to find a quality place to live, close to the workplace for convenient transportation.In particular, they want their apartment to meet the criteria of living space - services - security and full self-contained amenities.These are also factors that investor VIC Grand Square has focused on developing throughout the project's early stages.
With modern apartments of international standard quality, this tallest twin tower in Phu Tho meets the strict criteria of experts when choosing to settle in the center of Viet Tri City.VIC Grand Square is located right in the center, close to the square and Hung Vuong Street, the radial backbone of Viet Tri City with 6 lanes.From here, apartment owners can easily connect to surrounding amenities such as schools, hospitals, and shopping centers.
Designed according to 5-star standards, each apartment is also furnished with high-class interiors with equipment from leading names such as Kone, Bravat, Grohe, Hafele.In particular, professional operational management and organization of community cultural activities from international brands will also be a guarantee for the sustainable quality of the project.
In addition, Phu Tho also emerged as a cash flow destination with great potential and attractive prices.This market has not had any land fever yet, showing great potential for price increases in the future.Therefore, in addition to leasing to create cash flow, Expert Home VIC Grand Square still has a lot of room to increase prices in the near future, helping to bring double profits to investors.
author: Anh Duong

title: VIC Grand Square - New outstanding project of King Hung land
sapo: Inspired by the design of King Hung's hat and the open epic book representing knowledge, with a height of 36 floors, VIC Grand Square is currently the tallest twin tower, bearing the mark of impressive works of the Land of the Fathers.
content:
New outstanding construction of the King's land
Phu Tho - The land of King Hung has a history of thousands of years, famous for its traditions and culture imbued with national identity.This place is known as the hometown of the Hung Kings, who founded the Van Lang State, the first state of Vietnam.Hung Temple is located on Nghia Linh mountain, Viet Tri city, and is a place of worship for Hung kings.The annual Hung Temple Festival on the 10th day of the third lunar month attracts tens of thousands of people from all over the country.
Choosing to develop the project in the sacred Land - the cradle of Vietnamese culture, the investor of the VIC Grand Square project said that in the early days, the thing that worried them most was how to authentically recreate and honor the cultural values ​​of this place.But at the same time, the project must also integrate features to meet the needs and strict standards of the market.
VIC Grand Square - Notable works of King Hung's land
Currently, the VIC Grand Square project is being urgently constructed to soon be completed and put into operation in the center of Viet Tri city with a design idea inspired by the Hung King hat and the image of an epic book opening.With a height of 36 floors, this is also a prominent twin tower in Viet Tri city, a modern and proud construction of the Land of To.In particular, the image of wings is arranged in the project lobby as a sign of success, promising a strong transformation, helping this land take off to become an eagle in the future.
Not only possessing beautiful architecture, the twin towers are also located in a space that is considered the most classy in Viet Tri city with a chain of 68+ exclusive amenities such as: shopping center, cascading waterfall, sky bar with panoramic city view, 360-degree koi fish pond, nearly 500m2 swimming pool, mini golf course, outdoor cinema, art glass bridge, observatory, chain of theme gardens... The project promises to bring residents a diverse life.Experience international standard amenities.More specifically, VIC Grand Square is also a colorful entertainment, entertainment and shopping destination in Phu Tho that cannot be missed.
Exclusive amenities available only to residents of VIC Grand Square
Thanks to the unique idea, the VIC Grand Phu Tho project (VIC Grand Square) both preserves the historical story and is modern, keeping up with trends.With the orientation of developing into a festival tourism city back to its roots, with the openness to welcome tourists, projects like VIC Grand Square are expected to be an indispensable highlight on the development journey of this land.
Converging the quintessence of the "new industrial capital" in the North
Data released last week from the statistical agency showed that Phu Tho's GRDP growth rate recorded a high of 9.56% in the first 9 months of the year.Notably, this locality is showing its attractiveness on Vietnam's industrial production map, worthy of the title "new industrial capital" in the North.The province's 9-month IPP industrial production index continued to maintain high growth momentum, up 38.65% over the same period.Of which, the manufacturing and processing industry increased by 40.3%, ranking among the top, surpassing many localities that are promised lands in attracting investment capital in this field.
In fact, in recent years, Phu Tho's economy has continuously grown with advantages in industrial production.Thanks to that, the province attracts tens of thousands of experts and high-tech workers to live and work here.Not to mention, Phu Tho aims to nearly double the number of industrial parks by 2030, with a total area of ​​over 5,000 hectares.At the same time, the province is ready to create the most favorable conditions to welcome projects and investors in the fields of high technology, electronics and semiconductor projects with high added value.Attracting large industrial eagles to Phu Tho to nest will cause the number of foreign experts to continue to increase in the future.
According to calculations, to meet the accommodation needs of experts, Phu Tho needs thousands of luxury apartments with synchronous utility systems, operated and managed according to international standards.However, there is no project that meets this requirement.The appearance of the VIC Grand Square twin towers is expected to fill this gap, providing a luxurious living space for people, especially the group of foreign experts and elites living and working here.
VIC Grand Square owns a rare and valuable location in the center of Viet Tri city with high living standards, a complex of shopping centers and 5-star apartments.The project is located close to the center of Hung Vuong Square and Hung Vuong Street, the 6-lane radial backbone of Viet Tri City.From here, apartment owners can easily connect to surrounding amenities such as schools, hospitals, and shopping centers.Each apartment is also furnished with high-class interiors with equipment from leading names such as Kone, Bravat, Grohe, Hafele.In addition, the project is built with a variety of apartment types and reasonable areas, meeting all customers' needs.
"Residents' new living experiences are invaluable. We will constantly realize residents' experiences and wishes by bringing international standards to Phu Tho, raising a new level of living quality for customers," added a representative of investor VIC Grand Square.
author: Anh Duong

title: Top 10 stocks with the strongest increase/decrease of the week: A series of codes broke out 40-70%, capitalization VIC increased by 10,000 billion VND after one week
sapo: On HOSE, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases had quite good increases, the highest being 22% and the lowest being 6%.
content:
After the previous week of increased trading, the market opened the second session this week in the green and VN-Index tested the 1,290 point mark before closing down slightly. The next trading sessions struggled in a narrow range with low liquidity, closing the week of August 26-30 down 1.45 points (-0.11%) to 1,283.87 points.
On HOSE, VCF stock leads the list of stocks with the strongest increase with a series of strong increases of 4 sessions, including 3 sessions hitting the ceiling.Currently, VCF is trading at 267,000 VND/share, corresponding to an increase of 22% after just 1 week.VCF's increase also strengthens its position as the stock with the most expensive market price on the HOSE, far surpassing the stock ranked next, FRT.Market capitalization also improved significantly to nearly VND 7,000 billion.
VCF's upward momentum was triggered after the business announced the final registration date to exercise the right to pay 2023 dividends in cash at a rate of 250%, equivalent to each share receiving 25,000 VND.The last registration date is September 9, expected payment on September 20.
In the same real estate group, VIC also had a breakthrough week, increasing 6% after one week.Market capitalization also increased by nearly 10,000 billion VND after one week, to nearly 169,000 billion VND.
On the contrary, MDG, PMG, ITA, S4A are the codes under pressure to take profits when they all fell over 8% this week.
On HNX, the stocks that increased were mostly small codes with low liquidity such as KSD, BTW, KSV, KKC, etc. Notably, KSD stock recorded the last 7 consecutive sessions of increase.However, liquidity only stopped at a low level and fluctuated, with sessions only matching a few thousand units, while the highest session had just over 57,000 shares changed hands.
On the downside, BXH stocks, TPH, SDC were under pressure to take profits of over 17-32% last week.
On UPCOM, BBM shares of Hanoi - Nam Dinh Beer Joint Stock Company led the way as they continued to increase to the ceiling for 3 sessions this week, pushing the stock market price to 11,700 VND.For the whole week, this stock recorded an increase of nearly 75%.Despite the sharp increase, the trading volume of this code is only a few hundred to tens of thousands of units.
Hanoi - Nam Dinh Beer Joint Stock Company, formerly known as Polish Bread Factory, was established in 1969, operating under the management of Nam Ha Food Company with the Company's main business lines being Beer and Bread.
Behind, VFC shares also attracted attention when they jumped 72% after a week to 115,000 VND/share.However, trading liquidity was bleak with only a few thousand shares changing hands each session.
On the contrary, in the past week, many codes on UPCOM also recorded a decrease of 17% - 40%.Notably, TRS of Maritime Transport and Services Joint Stock Company, when recording a session with a floor price drop of nearly 40%, the market price drifted to 19,500 VND/share, liquidity only reached a few hundred units.
author: Mai Chi

title: Vingroup has settled more than 900 million USD of international bonds with the right to convert into shares VIC, VHM, VFS
sapo: According to Vietcap Securities, in addition to VinFast, most of Vingroup's subsidiaries have the ability to self-sustain to fulfill debt obligations and business operations.
content:
According to information from Vietcap Securities, in the first 8 months of 2024, Vingroup has settled many batches of international bonds with the right to convert into shares at VIC, VinFast (Nasdaq: VFS) and Vinhomes (HoSE: VHM) with a total amount of 906.5 million USD.
Specifically, at the end of April, Vingroup used cash to buy back 50% of the principal amount of 500 million USD, with a fixed interest rate of 3% of the bond lot with the right to convert into VHM shares.After that, Vingroup used the proceeds from issuing a batch of 250 million USD bonds, with an interest rate of 10%, to settle the remaining 50%.
For the $625 million bond with the right to convert to VinFast shares, Vingroup bought back $312.5 million in April and $60 million in July.The group reached an agreement with bondholders to pay the remaining $252.5 million by 2027.
In August 2024, Vinpearl bought back 284 million USD of the principal amount of 425 million USD, due in 2026, with an interest rate of 3.25% and the right to convert into VIC shares.Recently, Vinpearl successfully issued 150 million USD of convertible bonds, due in 2029.
Vietcap expects the remaining outstanding value (equivalent to 141 million USD) of Vinpearl's 425 million USD bond lot due in 2026 will be bought back in September 2024.
Also according to Vietcap Securities, in addition to VinFast, most of Vingroup's subsidiaries have the ability to self-sustain to fulfill debt obligations and business activities.
At the end of the second quarter of 2024, Vinhomes had unrecorded sales of VND 118,700 billion.The company owns a residential land fund of 185.4 million m², with expected sales from new projects in the period 2024 - 2026 reaching 89 - 96 trillion VND/year.
The business results of Vinpearl, Vinmec and Vinschool are expected to gradually improve, supported by long-term drivers from the rise of the middle class and profit margins.Vinpearl is in the process of preparing and aiming to list within the next 12 - 18 months (according to the board of directors).
VinFast is sponsored by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong.By the end of the second quarter of 2024, Mr. Vuong had completed disbursement to VinFast of 1 billion USD (including a grant of 3,300 billion VND in the second quarter of 2024 and 20,600 billion VND in 2023).
Vietcap said that Mr. Vuong will continue to provide new sponsorship in the period 2025 - 2026, according to the statement at the 2024 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders that he will sponsor at least 1 billion USD for VinFast from personal assets.
author: Trong Hieu

title: Business results for the second quarter of 2024 on July 19: VIC, PDR, SHS, VPS... and hundreds of businesses simultaneously announced before the first "deadline"

content:

title: How many VIC shares should Vingroup shareholders sell to own a VinFast VF 3?
sapo: If you want to support "homegrown" products but don't have the cash available, Vingroup shareholders can consider selling some shares.
content:
The mini electric car VinFast VF 3, which billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong just launched, is creating a real fever with the number of consumers paying for the car increasing rapidly.To increase interaction for VinFast VF 3, the Vietnamese auto brand even brought the car to the e-commerce platform with the largest traffic in our country, Shopee, or deployed deposits right on the VINID application.
Customers who make their first deposit between May 13 and 15 will receive many attractive benefits, including: Preferential selling price from only 235 million (battery rental) - 315 million VND (battery purchase), free advanced paint color options - worth 8 million VND.This price makes VinFast VF 3 the cheapest electric car in Vietnam.
If you want to support "homegrown" products but don't have the cash available, Vingroup shareholders can consider selling some shares.Temporarily calculated according to VIC's market price on the morning of May 15 (46,250 VND/share), shareholders need to sell more than 5,000 shares to own a VinFast VF 3 (battery rental).As for buying batteries, the number of VIC shares to sell is about 6,800 units.
VIC market price temporarily concluded the morning session on May 15
VIC market price temporarily concluded the morning session on May 15
Ending May 15, the car price will be adjusted to 240 million VND/car (battery rental) and 322 million VND/car (with battery) for 4 basic exterior colors, respectively.If the stock price does not increase, Vingroup shareholders may have to sell more shares to own a VinFast VF 3. On the other hand, the number of shares to sell may not be as much as currently calculated if the market price of VIC increases.
According to information from VinFast, the Vietnamese automobile company recently signed a contract to sell 50 VinFast VF 3 cars to SSMB International Trade Joint Stock Company.This is also the exclusive distributor of the Korean cosmetic brand KyungLab in the Vietnamese market.This company is headquartered in Thanh Xuan, Hanoi.
In the Vietnamese market, VinFast offers 3 battery rental packages for customers to choose from.The first is a package of 900,000 VND/month limited to traveling less than 1,500 km.Next is 1.2 million VND/month for travel distance from 1,500 to 2,500 km.Finally, there is a package of 2 million VND/month for travel over 2,500 km.
author: Ha Linh

title: Fubon ETF promoted net selling of hundreds of billions of Vietnamese stocks in 4 consecutive sessions, selling a series of codes HPG, VIC, VHM, SSI...
sapo: With the return of net selling, the cash flow into this ETF from the beginning of 2024 recorded a net withdrawal of 19 million USD, equivalent to about 480 billion VND.
content:
After a relatively strong buying period in early May, foreign fund Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF suddenly reversed to net sell Vietnamese stocks.
Statistics from Fubon ETF, in the last 4 sessions from May 9 to 14, this foreign fund had a net withdrawal of about 7.3 million USD, equivalent to 185 billion VND worth of net shares sold.
In terms of selling volume, Fubon ETF sold most of the codes in the portfolio, specifically net selling 837 thousand shares of HPG, 613 thousand shares of VIC, 372 thousand shares of VHM, 33 thousand shares of SSI, 309 thousand shares of SHB... Only PDR and HCM are the two stocks that have not been net sold in the past week.
With the return of net selling, the cash flow into this ETF from the beginning of 2024 recorded a net withdrawal of 19 million USD, equivalent to about 480 billion VND.
At the end of May 14, the size of Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF reached 27.2 billion Taiwan dollars (about 840 million USD, equivalent to 21,400 billion VND), continuing to be the largest ETF fund on the Vietnam stock market.
In the portfolio structure, HPG is still the stock with the largest proportion with 10.19% (holding 70.3 million shares), followed by VIC (42 million shares, proportion 9.3%), VHM (45 million shares, proportion 8.68%), VCB (19.6 million shares, proportion 8.53%), VNM (24.9 million shares, proportion 7.95%)...
The net withdrawal of Fubon ETF is in sync with the movements of foreign investors in general on the Vietnam stock market.Since the beginning of May until now, foreign investors have continued the net selling trend, even with the value gradually strengthening, sometimes reaching the trillion threshold.From the beginning of 2024 to the end of the May 14 session, foreign investors net sold about 25,00 billion VND on HoSE, approximately 1 billion USD in just less than 5 months.

title: VIC Grand Square Phu Tho: Location that creates multi-dimensional value
sapo: Possessing a position on precious land in the heart of Viet Tri city, VIC Grand Square emerges as a proud symbol of the "ancestral land" of Phu Tho, creating unique living and investment values ​​for its prestigious owner.
content:
Golden coordinates of the capital of the Northern midland and mountainous region
At the end of 2023 and early 2024, the Phu Tho real estate market will gradually warm up with the launch of an iconic project, contributing to changing the appearance of Viet Tri city called VIC Grand Square.
The project makes a strong impression first of all because of its rare location right in the "heart" of the city's administrative - economic - commercial service area.VIC Grand Square Phu Tho (Hung Vuong Square commercial, financial and multi-functional apartment tower) is surrounded by Hung Vuong Square, Muong Thanh hotel, central market, theater, Vincom Viet Tri.
Within a radius of only 5-7 minutes, residents can easily move to public administrative areas, stadiums, parks, universities, leading hospitals of the province and city...
With coordinates adjacent to the 6-lane Hung Vuong arterial road, VIC Grand Square possesses a super-connected traffic network, quickly accessing Nguyen Du streets;Tran Phu Street towards Hanoi city center;Convenient access to Hung Temple, Minh Phuong Urban Area, Thuy Van Industrial Park...
Not only that, VIC Grand Square possesses a rare feng shui location as it is located right at the confluence of three rivers: the intersection of the Red River, Lo River and Da River.This location not only brings beautiful views and fresh wind for good health but also brings fortune to the homeowner.
The value comes from the project's location which is summarized in the definition of "Five elite streets" including: Market Street, Square Street, Commercial Street, Existing Residential Street, River Junction City.
It can be said that VIC Grand Square is the project that benefits the most and most completely from the regional utility system, linking the city and the region, bringing a comfortable life and affirming class for residents who own apartments here.
2 functional and utility pieces complete the symbol of the ancestral land
VIC Grand Square is a luxury apartment complex project with a scale of 2 36-storey towers, including up to 3 basement floors;3 floors of commercial center;1 service floor;1 refuge floor with green trees, library, play area;2 floors Sky Collection.
Apartments here have a diverse area structure of 35 - 226m2 from studio, 1 - 3 bedrooms, duplex and penthouse, thus meeting all the needs of customers.The highlight is that the apartments are designed to be square and modern with full glass to welcome wind and sunlight, and high-quality handover materials from leading brands such as Kone, Dulux, Panasonic, Hafele, Schneider, Bravat...
With the vision of creating the first multi-functional apartment in Phu Tho, investor VIC Group diligently takes care of every small detail to meet multiple needs for homeowners at the same time: live happily, work conveniently, and invest successfully.
The "million dollar" view embraces the entire city from the apartment loggia
The investment potential of VIC Grand Square apartments not only lies in the potential to increase value over time, but is also guaranteed by the huge demand for renting high-end apartments from experts, managers, and officials on short- or long-term business trips or working in neighboring industrial parks.
There are more than 68+ exclusive amenities appearing for the first time in Viet Tri, covering from the first floor to the roof, bringing a standard of living beyond expectations to residents.Right at the foot of the house are 5 busy commercial and service floors, integrating amenities such as swimming pool, walking street, Pool Bar, Yoga floor, cinema, event stage, outdoor exhibition area...
Vibrant life on 4 commercial floors - the new shopping and entertainment center of the city.Viet Tri
On the rooftop are luxury amenities such as Sky bar, art glass bridge, BBQ garden, light path, mini golf course, telescope, meditation garden, health garden, music garden...
No need to go far, just one touch and a few seconds of travel with a modern elevator, VIC Grand Square residents can fully enjoy the city's top amenities right in their own residence.
With the trio of golden values ​​of location - functionality and amenities, VIC Grand Square promises to be a destination that brings together the elite community, intellectuals, experts and managers with social status.VIC Grand Square is not only an ideal place to live, a potential cash flow investment channel, but also a proud asset for those who have been, are and will be attached to the historical land of Viet Tri - Phu Tho.
At this time, VIC Grand Square is preparing to officially launch on the market with The Imperial apartment building, expected price from only 1.1 billion/unit with many attractive preferential policies for customers who order early.With a reasonable initial capital investment, conscious customers now have the opportunity to own an apartment with multiple uses in Viet Tri city.

title: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's assets increased by more than 10,000 billion in 3 days, the billionaire's words came true: "VIC price is very low compared to the real value, you only lose when you sell, if you don't sell, you haven't lost anything."
sapo: Within 3 days, VIC's capitalization increased by nearly 17,600 billion, VHM increased by 16,300 billion, VRE increased by 5,000 billion.
content:
The trading session on February 20, continuing the excitement from yesterday's ceiling increase, right from the beginning of the morning session, Vingroup's VIC shares increased rapidly and once reached the price of 49,350 VND/share, an increase of 5% compared to yesterday's closing price.Besides, both VHM and VRE also recorded strong increases in stock prices.As of 10 a.m., VIC shares are priced at 48,700 VND/share (up 3.6%), VHM is 46,000 VND/share (up 1%) and VRE is 25,400 VND/share (up 5.6%).
Notably, in yesterday's trading session, February 19, Vin stocks had an explosive trading session when VIC and VRE closed at the ceiling price and VHM also increased by 6.67%, along with liquidity skyrocketing to tens of millions of transactions.
From the first trading session after the Lunar New Year holiday to the end of yesterday's trading session, VIC shares increased about 11% after 3 trading sessions, VRE increased 10%, VHM increased 9%.
The above move increased VIC's capitalization by nearly 17,600 billion, VHM increased by 16,300 billion, VRE increased by 5,000 billion.At the same time, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's assets also increased by more than 10,300 billion.
However, before this upward momentum, VIC shares experienced a period of decline from the price range of 75,000 VND/share to 44,000 VND/share from mid-August 2023 to the end of September 2023 and moved sideways during that time until recently.
At this time, we remember the words of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong in May 2023.When a shareholder asked the Board of Directors of Vingroup Corporation (VIC) at the 2023 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders about the fact that Vingroup's VIC shares have decreased by more than half in the past 2 years, "If VinFast IPO is successful, will shareholders receive any incentives when buying shares, will loyal shareholders benefit?"
Answering this question, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong affirmed: "VIC's value is very low compared to its real value. Currently, Vingroup, as Mr. Dang Tieu Binh said, is hiding and waiting for the right time. With the VinFast IPO, Vingroup shareholders will not receive any incentives, but if you are a loyal shareholder, you will not lose anything. You will only lose when you sell. If you have not sold, you will not lose anything, over time. I believe that VIC's market value will return."
"Why return? Because Vingroup is the owner of a series of large businesses in Vietnam. All of Vingroup's resources are focused on developing member companies, so why don't we increase?", Mr. Vuong affirmed.
Mr. Vuong also added: "Maybe due to rumors, the general market is difficult, making investors feel unhappy and run away, but I don't see a reason to sell shares."
