title: VinFast made its first move in the Indonesian market, VIC shares suddenly increased sharply, pushing Vingroup's capitalization beyond Hoa Phat
sapo: VIC shares have increased for 5 consecutive sessions to 44,000 VND/share, corresponding to Vingroup's market capitalization of more than 168,000 billion VND (~ 7 billion USD), surpassing Hoa Phat in the list of most valuable listed businesses on the stock exchange.
content:
After exceeding 1,200 points at the beginning of the Year of the Dragon, the stock market continued to prosper under the guidance of Bluechips, in which VIC shares of Vingroup - JSC is one of the names that made a strong impression.With an increase of nearly 3.3% in the February 16 session, VIC is the second largest contributing stock to the VN-Index.
The strong breakout session extended the price increase streak of this stock to 5 consecutive sessions.Estimated at the market price of 44,000 VND/share, Vingroup's market capitalization reaches more than 168,000 billion VND (~ 7 billion USD).This number helps Vingroup surpass Hoa Phat in the list of most valuable listed businesses on the stock exchange.
VIC shares suddenly jumped sharply after VinFast introduced a range of right-hand drive electric vehicles at the Indonesia International Motor Show (IIMS) 2024 opening on February 15 in the capital Jakarta.In particular, the car models VF 5, VF e34, VF 6 and VF 7 belonging to segments from A to C are expected to be sold on this market in the near future.At the event, Indonesian President Joko Widodo and the delegation visited VinFast's showroom and signed a souvenir on the VinFast VF 5.
One of VinFast's first moves after entering Indonesia was to sign a Letter of Intent to cooperate with the first 5 dealers to expand its distribution network.This is also the way VinFast has sold cars in the US in recent times.According to Ms. Tran Mai Hoa, Deputy General Director of VinFast Global Sales and Marketing, shaking hands with distribution agents is an important step affirming VinFast's commitment to expanding its business network and shortening the time to bring products to market.
It is known that in the fourth quarter of 2023, VinFast delivered 13,513 electric vehicles, an increase of 35% compared to the previous quarter.For the whole year, the company has delivered 34,855 electric vehicles, bringing the total number of vehicles delivered globally to 42,291 since the first delivery in 2021. In the North American market, VinFast has received 70 cooperation registrations from dealers across the United States, and is preparing for the first delivery of VF 9 in 2024.
With Vingroup, the group has just recorded a year of record revenue of VND 161,634 billion, an increase of 59% compared to 2022. Growth is mainly due to the speed of handing over low-rise real estate units at the Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 and Vinhomes Ocean Park 3 projects, as well as the strong growth of electric vehicle sales compared to the previous year.
Vingroup's pre-tax profit in 2023 will reach 13,681 billion VND, and after-tax profit will reach 2,051 billion VND, completing the business plan set out at the 2023 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. As of December 31, 2023, Vingroup's total assets reached 669,617 billion VND, an increase of 16% compared to the previous year.
author: Ha Linh

title: After spending billions of dollars to buy VIC, MSN, OIL..., Korean chaebol wants to increase its ownership in a Vietnamese pharmaceutical company to 65% without a public offer.
sapo: Korea's third largest Chaebol has invested trillions of dong in Imexpharm since May 2020.
content:
Imexpharm Pharmaceutical Joint Stock Company (stock code: IMP) has just announced the Resolution of the General Meeting of Shareholders approving many important issues on personnel changes and approving the exemption from public offers for the transfer of shares between SK Investment Vina III Pte.Ltd.
Specifically, Imexpharm's shareholders approved the public offer exemption for the transfer of shares between SK Investment and the company's existing shareholders.With this Resolution, SK Investment becomes an investor holding over 65% of the shares with voting rights.
Currently, SK Investment's share ownership ratio at Imexpharm is 64.83%.The transferor's share ownership ratio is expected to be 0.2% or more.The expected implementation time is after being approved by the General Meeting of Shareholders and depends on negotiations between the parties as well as market conditions.
According to regulations, if the purchase and sale of shares leads to holding 65% or more of the capital, SK Investment must make a public offer or not have to make a public offer if the General Meeting of Shareholders approves the exemption from the public offer.Because the public offer procedures are complicated and lengthy and the number of shares transferred is insignificant, SK needs shareholders to approve the above Resolution.
It is known that SK Investment invested in Imexpharm from the end of May 2020 after receiving the transfer of 12.3 million IMP shares, equivalent to 24.9% of the company's charter capital from funds belonging to the Dragon Capital group along with CAM Vietnam Mother Fund, Kingsmead, Mirae Asset.
SK Investment is a subsidiary of SK Group, the 3rd largest chaebol in Korea. This is the first direct investment project of SK Group in Vietnam.Previously, SK Group was known as one of the major investment corporations in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) deals in Vietnam.
Specifically, SK invested 470 million USD to buy 9.4% shares of Masan Group and 1 billion USD for 6% shares of Vingroup.At the end of 2011, SK spent 340 million USD to buy 4.9% shares of The CrownX - a subsidiary of Masan, which owns Masan Consumer Holding (MCH) and Wincomerce.
SK also announced an investment of 100 million USD in the Pharmacity pharmacy chain.In addition to the above major deals, another SK subsidiary, SK Energy, also holds more than 5% of PV Oil's shares, worth nearly 30 million USD.
Currently, SK is a multi-industry economic corporation with a market capitalization of nearly 63 billion USD, ranked third in Korea after Samsung and LG and recently SK was honored in TIME's list of 100 most influential companies in 2023.The Group's strengths are in the fields of Energy, Pharmaceuticals - Health, Logistics and information communication technology (ICT).
At the end of September, the Hai Phong Economic Zone Management Board announced that it would award Investment Registration Certificates to the ECOVANCE high-tech biodegradable materials factory projects of SK Group (Korea).
The project has a total investment of 500 million USD to build a factory to produce biodegradable materials PBAT, PBS, PBATS on an area of more than 32,000 m2 in DEEP C Hai Phong I industrial park.
Phase 1 of the project is expected to start construction at the end of this year and be completed within 9 months.When put into operation, the factory will reach about 35,000 tons of products/year and after expanding phase 2, the total project capacity will increase to 70,000 tons/year.
Regarding Imexpharm, this company specializes in manufacturing, trading, importing and exporting modern pharmaceutical products, medical instruments, and industrial raw materials.In the third quarter of 2023, this pharmaceutical enterprise recorded revenue of 467 billion VND, an increase of nearly 12% over the same period.Profit after tax reached 69 billion VND, up 25% over the same period in 2022.
Accumulated in the first 9 months of 2023, IMP revenue was recorded at 1,386 billion VND, an increase of 28% over the same period.Pre-tax profit reached 286 billion VND and after-tax profit reached 227 billion VND, up 45% and 47% respectively over the same period last year.

title: Dat Xanh Mien Bac distributes luxury apartments VIC Grand Square Viet Tri
sapo: Through the strategic partnership between two reputable units in the market, investor VIC Group and distribution unit Dat Xanh Mien Bac, the 5-star standard apartment tower VIC Grand Square promises to have an impressive launch in the coming time.
content:
Accordingly, Dat Xanh Mien Bac was selected by investor VIC Group as the business development and distribution unit for the VIC Grand Square project in the center of Viet Tri city (Phu Tho).
Mr. Nguyen Viet Hai - Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of VIC Group highly appreciated the capabilities of Dat Xanh Mien Bac and pledged to put all his heart, mind and effort into creating Vic Grand Square to become a prosperous symbol of architecture and lifestyle in the city.Viet Tri (Phu Tho) in particular and the Northern midland and mountainous region in general.In particular, the legal factors, progress and quality of the project are committed to be guaranteed by the investor.
Being "chosen to send gold" as the most luxurious apartment development and distribution unit in Viet Tri at this time, Mr. Vu Cuong Quyet - General Director of Dat Xanh Mien Bac also expressed high determination in project implementation, bringing quality products to customers with professionalism and dedication.
Mr. Vu Cuong Quyet spoke at the VIC Grand Square project distribution signing event
Appreciating the available advantages and development potential of Viet Tri (Phu Tho), CEO Vu Cuong Quyet believes that VIC Grand Square is the ideal choice for customers with real housing needs and rental investors.
As the first capital of Dai Viet, Phu Tho is known as a land with a rich history, cultural festivals imbued with national identity and rich tourism.Today, Phu Tho is the driving force for economic development in the northern midlands and mountainous regions, is the "backyard" of the capital Hanoi and has strong industrial development (industrial services account for 3/4 of the economic structure), GRDP ranks 16th in the country.
According to statistics, Phu Tho ranks top 1 in the country in terms of industrial production growth rate and currently has 13,700 foreign experts working in industrial parks.
With great economic potential, especially in the industrial and tourism sectors, in Phu Tho there is still a scarcity of high-end apartment products to meet the needs of residence, investment and business.
Therefore, the appearance of VIC Grand Square - 5-star standard commercial, financial and multi-functional apartment tower is expected to create a new symbol in the center of Viet Tri city.
Located on the last diamond land bank right at the intersection of Hung Vuong - Tran Phu, the project includes two 36-storey towers, planned with full functions and unique architecture.Surrounded by Hung Vuong Square, Muong Thanh Hotel, City Market, City Theater, Vincom Viet Tri, Provincial People's Committee, museums, stadiums & schools at all levels.
With its position as the most luxurious apartment building and a proud symbol of Phu Tho, VIC Grand Square has painstakingly created 68+ exclusive amenities appearing for the first time in Phu Tho, notably: 360-degree koi fish pond, nearly 500m2 swimming pool, mini golf course, skybar, outdoor cinema, cascading waterfall, art glass bridge, observatory, chain of theme gardens (flag garden, Light garden).morning, Sculpture garden, BBQ garden, meditation garden, Yoga garden, tea garden, health care garden, massage garden)...
With high-quality planning and construction design while still retaining natural beauty, VIC Grand Square apartment fully converges all modern and classy amenities, the project promises to bring an upscale and classy life to residents.
With a unique position & outstanding quality.VIC Grand Square (Hung Vuong Square commercial, financial and multi-functional apartment tower) has created a fever in Viet Tri right from the first information.
For detailed information, please contact the official distributor Dat Xanh Mien Bac.Hotline: 0969 626 123
Website: https://vicgrandsquare.vn/
author: Anh Duong

title: An individual spent more than 70 billion VND to buy 8.2 million EVS shares, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's son bought VIC shares for the first time
sapo: Mr. Nguyen Hong Tuan - an individual investor has just announced that he bought 8.2 million EVS shares (4.98%) of Everest Securities Joint Stock Company in the session on December 13.Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's son announced his first registration to buy 150,000 VIC shares
content:
Mr. Nguyen Hong Tuan - an individual investor has just announced that he bought 8.2 million EVS shares (4.98%) of Everest Securities Joint Stock Company in the session on December 13.Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's son announced his first registration to buy 150,000 VIC shares
An individual spent more than 70 billion VND to buy 8.2 million EVS shares
Before the transaction, Mr. Hong Tuan did not hold EVS shares.The transaction is likely to be carried out by agreement with an average price of 8,600 VND/share, equivalent to a value of 70.5 billion VND.
With this transaction, Mr. Tuan and a group of related people increased their ownership at Everest Securities to more than 21 million shares (12.76%).Among them, Mr. Nguyen Tran Minh Quan, Mr. Tuan's biological son and Head of Everest Securities Partner Development Department, owns 4.85%;Mrs. Tran Hai Anh, Mr. Tuan's sister-in-law, owns 2.93%.
On the contrary, a major shareholder of Everest Securities, Fusion Suites Saigon Hotel Joint Stock Company, has registered to sell all 32 million EVS shares (19.42%) for the purpose of increasing working capital.The transaction is expected to be carried out from December 5 to December 29, by order-matching and/or agreement trading method.There is currently no report on the results of this transaction.
General Director of Phat Dat sold half of PDR shares held
Mr. Bui Quang Anh Vu, General Director of Phat Dat Real Estate Development Joint Stock Company (code PDR) reported selling 1.2 million shares as previously registered, lowering ownership to 1.2 million units, equivalent to 0.164% of capital.Transactions are carried out from December 7 to December 15.Based on the corresponding closing market price, the above shares are worth about 33 - 35 billion VND.
Besides Mr. Vu, a series of insiders at Phat Dat have registered to divest capital, including Deputy General Director Truong Ngoc Dung (selling 42,457 units), Deputy General Director Nguyen Khac Sinh (selling 45,183 units), Chief Accountant Ngo Thuy Van (selling 323,790 units).Transactions are expected to take place from December 7, 2023 to January 9, 2024.
The business side said that it is a normal and reasonable matter for leaders to register to sell shares this time to serve personal financial needs or restructure investment portfolios.The number of registered sellers is small and does not affect the liquidity of the stock at all.
IPAAM wants to divest all capital in IPA
I.P.A Securities Investment Fund Management Company Limited (IPAAM) has just registered to sell all 3.2 million shares of I.P.A Investment Group Joint Stock Company (code IPA).After the transaction, IPAAM's ownership ratio at IPA decreased from 1.5% to 0%, the transaction will be carried out from December 26, 2023 - January 16, 2024 in the form of order matching and agreement.
IPAAM's move to sell all IPA shares took place in the context that IPA shares have increased 37% since the beginning of November and are currently at 16,300 VND/share.Temporarily calculated at the current market price, IPAAM can earn more than 52 billion VND if all registered shares are sold.
In a related development, recently, VNDirect (VND) completed the transaction of transferring 100% of the capital contribution in IPAAM (100 billion VND) to IPA.The transfer price was not announced by the parties.Previously in 2017, VNDirect carried out a transaction to transfer 100% of capital contribution at IPAAM from IPA.Transfer value 110 billion VND.So after nearly 7 years, IPA has received IPAAM back.
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's son bought VIC shares for the first time
On December 20, Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh, son of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup (code VIC) and Ms. Pham Thu Huong - Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup - just sent a document to the State Securities Commission, Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE), Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) announcing the registration to buy 150,000 VIC shares.The transaction is expected to be carried out on December 21.According to the notice, the transaction is in the case where the person performing the transaction is a related person of an internal person.
Specifically, Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh registered to buy 150,000 shares under the employee option program (ESOP).Currently, Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh does not hold any position at Vingroup and does not hold any shares of Vingroup.
According to Vingroup's management report, Mr. Vuong's three children, Pham Nhat Quan Anh, Pham Nhat Minh Hoang and Pham Nhat Minh Anh, as well as his daughter-in-law Bui Lan Anh, do not hold VIC shares.
author: According to Hoang Ha

title: 560 million USD ETF fund adds only new CEO, plans to strongly buy VIC, VNM, VHM
sapo: In addition to the newly added CEO and VIC, VNM, VHM,... expected to buy strongly, most stocks in VNM ETF's portfolio will have their proportion reduced after the fourth quarter restructuring period.
content:
MVIS Vietnam Local Index - the base index of Vaneck Vectors Vietnam ETF (VNM ETF) has just announced the periodic portfolio structure for the fourth quarter of 2023.During this restructuring period, MVIS Vietnam Local Index added only CEO and did not remove any stocks, thereby increasing the number of stocks in the portfolio to 43.
As of December 7, the size of the VNM ETF portfolio reached more than 560.6 million USD (~ 13,600 billion VND).VNM ETF is estimated to buy about 6.8 million CEO shares with a proportion of 1.17% of the portfolio.In addition, the fund will sharply increase the proportion of some stocks, in which VIC (5.7 million shares), VNM (2.6 million shares), VHM (2.2 million shares),... are names that are expected to be net purchased in large volume.
On the contrary, the majority of stocks in the fund's portfolio are expected to have their proportion reduced after the fourth quarter restructuring period. In particular, HPG (2.1 million shares), SSI (1.9 million shares), VIX (1.5 million shares), PDR (1.5 million shares), VCG (1.1 million shares), POW (1 million shares)... are names that are expected to be net sold with an estimated large volume.
Estimated details of VNM ETF portfolio in the restructuring period of the fourth quarter of 2023:
VNM ETF used to attract money very strongly in the period of late 2022 to early 2023 but has since slowed down significantly.After officially changing the reference index to MVIS Vietnam Local Index (including 100% Vietnamese stocks) from March 17, the fund suffered a strong net withdrawal from mid-April to early May 2023.
Since June, VNM ETF has been "scattered" in attracting capital again, but then stopped completely since the beginning of August. By the end of September, the fund again withdrew capital, although "scattered" but the net withdrawal value per session was quite large.However, from the beginning of the year until now, this ETF has still absorbed a total of 76.7 million USD.This is a relatively positive number in the context of many ETFs experiencing strong capital withdrawals.
Last week, FTSE Vietnam Index - the reference index of FTSE Vietnam ETF added NVL, PDR and did not remove any stocks, thereby increasing the number of Vietnamese stocks to 26 codes.Both VNM ETF and FTSE Vietnam ETF will complete their restructuring next week and the new portfolio will take effect after the close of the trading session on Friday (December 15) and officially be traded from the following Monday (December 18).
author: Ha Linh

title: VinFast jumped 36% after a week, shares VIC, VHM, VRE all prospered after billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's meeting with Indian billionaire
sapo: VinFast's VFS shares increased 17.7% after the end of the November 8 session in the US - the strongest increase since the end of August.
content:
At the end of the trading session on November 8 in the US, VFS shares of electric car company VinFast increased 17.7% to a price of 7.25 USD/share.The matched volume of this stock was at 6.3 million units in yesterday's session.
This is the strongest increase of this stock since the long slide from its peak of nearly 90 USD/share on August 28 this year.Within the past week, VFS has recovered an impressive 36%.
At the current price, VinFast's capitalization currently reaches nearly 17 billion USD, ranked 24th among the world's largest automobile manufacturing enterprises and ranked 4th among electric vehicle companies after Tesla, BYD and Li Auto.Domestically, VinFast's capitalization is still lower than Vietcombank (VCB) at more than 20 billion USD.
Domestically, three "Vin" stocks including VIC, VHM and VRE also traded enthusiastically right from the beginning of the session on November 9.Specifically, after just half an hour of trading, VIC shares increased by nearly 5% to 45,500 VND/share, VRE shares increased by nearly 3% to 24,350 VND/share.VHM stock, after a period of sharp decline, is also recovering.
The excitement of "Vin" stocks from the beginning of the November trading session came right after the meeting between Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of Vingroup and Indian billionaire Gautam Shantilal Adani - the 23rd richest person in the world.Recently, on his personal Twitter account, Mr. Gautam Shantilal Adani shared information about his meeting with Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong and discussed potential business opportunities between India and Vietnam.
I was pleased to meet Vingorup chairman Pham Nhat Vuong to discuss potential opportunities between India and Vietnam.I am truly inspired by this visionary leader's entrepreneurial journey, from the instant noodle business to leading the production of a variety of electric vehicles and advanced battery solutions for the global green mobility mission.All successes were achieved in record time," billionaire Gautam Adani wrote on Twitter.﻿﻿
There is currently no specific information about the cooperation plan between these two billionaires, but it will most likely be related to the electric vehicle segment and VinFast's arrival in India.Last October, The Economic Times reported that VinFast is planning to build an electric vehicle factory in Tamil Nadu or Gujarat state in India.
“Negotiations are at a preliminary stage but VinFast is very interested in setting up a base in India.The investment is expected to be significant," the source added. However, it is unclear whether VinFast is considering exporting or the new production unit will only serve the Indian market.
Another source said the company was in talks with several State Governments before narrowing down Tamil Nadu and Gujarat as potential areas to set up their facility.If this investment plan takes place, this will be the first Vietnamese automobile manufacturer to open a store in India.
author: Trong Hieu

title: Fubon ETF bought nearly 300 billion VND in Vietnamese stocks during the week of deep market decline, gathering a series of codes HPG, VIC, VHM
sapo: Overall, from September 19 to October 27, the net mobilized capital of Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF amounted to 45 million USD, equivalent to disbursement of about 1,100 billion VND.
content:
According to data from Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF, in the week of October 23-17, the fund withdrew a net of 32.5 million fund certificates, equivalent to a value of 12 million USD (more than 280 billion VND), extending a series of consecutive capital withdrawals from mid-September until now.
In particular, Fubon ETF net bought all 30 stocks after 5 sessions last week, the highest buying volume was recorded at HPG (1.2 million shares), SSI (687 thousand shares), VHM (669 thousand shares), VIC (612 thousand shares),...
Overall, from the session of September 19 to the end of the session of October 27, the amount of capital mobilized by Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF was up to 45 million USD, equivalent to disbursement of about 1,100 billion VND to buy Vietnamese stocks in the context of a strong adjustment period in the market, at one point the VN-Index fell deeply below 1,050 points and foreign investors tended to net sell in the general market.
As of October 27, the size of the Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF portfolio reached 23.59 billion Taiwan dollars, equivalent to nearly 17,900 billion VND, the fund spent 100% investing in Vietnamese stocks according to the reference index, FTSE Vietnam 30 Index.In the Fubon ETF portfolio structure, HPG is currently the stock with the largest proportion with 9.9% (holding 76 million shares), followed by VNM (9.76%), VCB (9.6%), VHM (8.88%), VIC (8.6%)...
The amount of net capital withdrawn over the past month has brought the accumulated cash flow into this ETF from the beginning of 2023 until now back to a positive sign after 4 consecutive negative months, worth nearly 30 million USD.
*Data as of October 27, 2023
*Data as of October 27, 2023
The fact that Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF has been attracting capital quite strongly in recent days is a positive signal, contributing to supporting investor psychology when the market drops deeply.
However, the strong correction of the market, especially the group of pillar stocks, encountered strong selling pressure, causing the performance of passive funds to decline significantly even though they were still continuously net absorbing.Cumulatively from the beginning of the fourth quarter to the present, Fubon ETF's performance is negative 10.2%.Previously in the third quarter, Fubon ETF only recorded a performance of 2%, significantly lower than the 4% increase of the VN-Index and very far from the performance of some other ETFs on the market such as DCVFM VNMidcap ETF (12%) and DCVFM VNDiamond ETF (11%) of Dragon Capital or SSIAM VNFinlead ETF (4%).
author: Phuong Linh

title: Week October 23-27: Foreign investors turned to net sell more than 1,300 billion VND, strongly "discharging" MWG, VIC
sapo: In the context of market adjustment, foreign investors become a minus point when they return to strong net selling.Sales force gradually increased towards the end of the week.
content:
Vietnam's stock market recorded an unfavorable week from October 23 to 27.Selling pressure increased in the last two sessions of the week, weighing heavily on the group of stocks, causing the VN-Index to decline negatively, even the general index at one point fell below the 1,060 point area.Many large-cap stocks that have a direct impact on the index such as VIC, VRE, and VHM fell to the floor, creating a negative premise that caused the market to decline sharply.
Closing Friday's session, VN-Index recorded a sharp decrease of 4.26% compared to last week to 1,060.62 points.In the context of market adjustment, foreign investors become a minus point when they return to strong net selling.Selling force gradually increased, cumulatively in 5 sessions, foreign investors net sold more than 1,300 billion VND.
On each floor alone, foreign investors cumulatively sold VND 1,382 billion after 5 sessions on HoSE, net bought VND 76 billion on HNX and net sold VND 5 billion on UPCoM.
Statistics on each code show that a series of stocks were net sold by foreign investors for hundreds of billions in the past week.It must be mentioned that VIC and MWG were sold the most by foreign investors last week with values ​​of 271 billion and 267 billion VND respectively.Last week saw a sharp decline in VIC, the stock lost 4% with one session falling to the floor.Meanwhile, MWG extended the chain of opening foreign room, the return rate was close to 47%.
Besides, MSN and SSI were also net sold with a value of VND 235 billion and VND 202 billion, respectively.In addition, two codes VRE and VIX were also net sold by foreign investors for 147 billion and 64 billion VND respectively last week.The list of net sellers of foreign investors last week also included HDB (-118 billion), SHS (-115 billion), DPM (-96 billion)...
On the contrary, VHM and DGC shares were net bought by foreign investors for 572 and 232 billion VND respectively in 5 sessions last week.In particular, foreign investors continued to "pump" money into Vinhomes shares through a series of huge deals in the first session of the week, with a total volume of more than 26 million units (price 43,600 VND/share).However, the buying momentum narrowed significantly when this was the stock that was under the strongest selling pressure from foreign investors, and the market price also dropped to the floor.
Foreign investors also net bought strongly in STB and IDC shares, worth more than 160 billion and 110 billion VND, besides PVS also net bought 76 billion VND after five sessions.Net buying power last week was also recorded at KBC, FPT, GMD,...
author: Tue Giang

title: A few months ago, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong affirmed, "VIC's price is very low compared to its real value, you only lose when you sell."
sapo: According to Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Vingroup is the owner of a series of large businesses in Vietnam so it will continue to grow.
content:
At the end of the trading session on October 26, all three stocks VIC, VHM and VRE fell to the floor with millions of shares in surplus.Even all three of these stocks have dropped sharply recently to historic bottoms.
Notably, the fluctuations in Vinhomes shares with a large selling surplus. According to Vingroup, on the morning of October 26, a number of international investors participating in the transaction of Vingroup issuing convertible bonds sold Vinhomes shares to complete the investment transaction in bonds (implementing hedging).
The majority of sales of VHM shares in the October 26 session were from foreign investors with a net sale of 5.66 million shares.﻿
VIC and VHM stock fluctuations in 1 year
VIC and VHM stock fluctuations in 1 year
At this time, we again rely on the words of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong in the middle of this year."If VinFast IPO is successful, will shareholders receive any incentives when buying shares? Will loyal shareholders benefit?"– A shareholder asked a question to the Board of Directors of Vingroup Corporation (VIC) at the 2023 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on the morning of May 17, after hesitantly mentioning the fact that Vingroup's VIC shares have decreased by more than half in the past 2 years.
Answering this question, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong affirmed: "VIC's value is very low compared to its real value. Currently, Vingroup, as Mr. Dang Tieu Binh said, is hiding and waiting for the right time. With the VinFast IPO, Vingroup shareholders will not receive any incentives, but if you are a loyal shareholder, you will not lose anything. You will only lose when you sell. If you have not sold, you will not lose anything, over time. I believe that VIC's market value will return."
"Why return? Because Vingroup is the owner of a series of large businesses in Vietnam. All of Vingroup's resources are focused on developing member companies, so why don't we increase?", Mr. Vuong affirmed.
Mr. Vuong also added: "Maybe due to rumors, the general market is difficult, making investors feel unhappy and run away, but I don't see a reason to sell shares."
author: Trong Hieu

title: Vingroup's "family" stocks simultaneously broke out strongly, VIC hit the ceiling on the launch day of the VinFast VF 6 electric car model
sapo: Just from mid-August to today's session, VIC lost nearly 41% to its lowest price in 6 years, VHM dropped 29% and VRE dropped more than 19%.
content:
Opening the weekend session of September 29, green filled the market, helping the VN-Index surpass the 1,160 point mark.The most prominent is the group of "Vingroup" pillar stocks, code VIC which at one point reached the ceiling price, VHM or VRE also increased over 3.5%, thereby becoming the strongest pulling pillars, helping the general market rebound well.
At 10:50, the upward momentum cooled down a bit, VIC increased by 5.6%, VHM increased by 4.4% while VRE increased by 3.1%.
Previously, the Vingroup group's market price recorded a strong correction, just from mid-August to today's session, VIC lost 40.5% to the lowest price in 6 years, VHM also decreased 29% and VRE market price decreased more than 19%.With the strong recovery session, Vingroup shareholders seemed to burst into tears after a period of diligently searching for the bottom of the market price.
Vingroup shares prospered again on the day the VF 6 model in the B-class SUV/CUV segment officially launched in the Vietnamese market in Ho Chi Minh City.It is expected that the car model will be opened for deposits on October 20 and begin handing over to customers in November 2023.This will help strengthen VinFast Auto Ltd's business results.(Nasdaq: VFS), a member company of Vingroup.
Previously, Vietnam's leading electric vehicle manufacturer announced the results of its independent financial report for the second quarter of 2023 ending on June 30, 2023.Total revenue in the second quarter of 2023 is VND 7,953 billion, up 131% over the same period in 2022 and up 303% over the previous quarter, mainly coming from electric car sales.As a result, VinFast had a net loss of VND 12,535 billion.down 8% compared to the second quarter of 2022 and down 11% compared to the previous quarter.
In the second quarter, VinFast delivered 9,535 electric cars and 10,182 electric motorbikes.As of the end of the second quarter, VinFast had 122 showrooms for electric cars globally and 245 showrooms and service workshops for electric motorbikes.
On the Nasdaq, VFS shares just rebounded in the trading session on September 28 (US time) with an increase of 11.94% to 12.56 USD/share.VinFast's capitalization currently reaches more than 29.2 billion USD.
Vinhomes' profits could exceed VND 55,000 billion by 2025
Regarding real estate, VNDirect Securities in a recent report expects that more favorable conditions for the real estate market will better support Vinhomes' sales in the period 2024 - 2025.
VNDirect gives a cautious view on the consumption prospects of the real estate market for the remainder of 2023, in the context that the current lending interest rate is still not attractive enough for the majority of home buyers, house prices in the segment with real housing demand are still high due to lack of supply, removing legal bottlenecks needs more time to create a real impact on the market.
Therefore, VHM's revenue is expected to decelerate in the second half of the year, after strong growth in the second half of 2022 and the first half of 2023. VHM's revenue is forecast to reach VND 105,900 billion in the whole year 2023, equivalent to a growth of 70% compared to 2022. Net profit is estimated to increase by 27%, reaching VND 36,500 billion.
Entering the period 2024 - 2025, it is estimated that VHM's pre-sale revenue will reach 103.2 trillion VND in 2024 and 150.2 trillion VND in 2025. VNDirect expects that a lower interest rate environment will help VHM improve its net profit margin, so we forecast that the business's net profit will grow by 14.6%/32.9% respectively in the future.in 2024-25, reaching VND 41.9 trillion and VND 55.7 trillion.
At the same time, social housing projects are expected in the second half of 2023 to bring in about VND 2.2 trillion worth of newly signed contracts in the 2024-25 period.
author: Phuong Linh

title: VIC shares fell below 50,000 VND, Vingroup's capitalization decreased by 4.6 billion USD after more than 1 month
sapo: VIC shares fell to the floor during the session. VN-Index dropped nearly 40 points.
content:
At the end of the trading session on September 25 - the VN-Index session dropped nearly 40 points, VIC shares of Vingroup (stock code: VIC) fell to the floor at 46,500 VND/share.This is the lowest price of this stock in November 2017.
The market price of VIC shares has been on a downward streak for more than a month.Compared to the 15-month peak on August 16 at the price of 75,200 VND/share, the market price of this code has decreased by 38.5%.This also led to Vingroup's market capitalization decreasing by 111,000 billion VND (4.6 billion USD) in just over 1 month.
On September 21, VinFast - a subsidiary of Vingroup announced a prospectus related to the public offering of a total of more than 75.7 million common shares, including selling shares of existing shareholders, issuing shares to partner Gotion Inc.as well as certain other issuance transactions pursuant to commitments related to the consolidation of Black Spade Acquisition and issuance to exercise warrants.
Most notable in this offering is that Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's two private investment companies, Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company (VIG) and Asian Star Trading & Investment (Asian Star), will sell 46.29 million shares, equivalent to about 2% of the outstanding shares.
After the offering transactions are carried out, Vingroup, along with VIG and Asian Star, still own about 96.6% of VinFast's outstanding shares.﻿
This car company also announced its business results for the first time since listing.Specifically, in the second quarter of 2023, VinFast recorded a total revenue of 7,953 billion VND (334 million USD) in the second quarter of 2023, an increase of 131% compared to the second quarter of 2022 and an increase of 303% compared to the first quarter of 2023.The company's revenue mainly comes from electric car sales.
Excluding expenses, VinFast had a net loss of 12,535 billion VND (527 million USD), down 8% compared to the second quarter of 2022 and down 11% compared to the first quarter of 2023.The car company's total assets were at 116,828 billion VND (4.9 billion USD) as of June 30.﻿
author: Trong Hieu

title: After spending billions of dollars to buy VIC, MSN, OIL and learn about the semiconductor industry, Korean chaebol poured 500 million USD to build a biodegradable materials factory in Hai Phong.
sapo: Phase 1 of the project is expected to start construction at the end of this year and be completed within 9 months.
content:
Hai Phong Economic Zone Management Board announced that it will award Investment Registration Certificates to the ECOVANCE high-tech biodegradable materials factory projects of SK Group (Korea).
The project has a total investment of 500 million USD to build a factory to produce biodegradable materials PBAT, PBS, PBATS on an area of more than 32,000 m2 in DEEP C Hai Phong I industrial park.
Phase 1 of the project is expected to start construction at the end of this year and be completed within 9 months.When put into operation, the factory will reach about 35,000 tons of products/year and after expanding phase 2, the total project capacity will increase to 70,000 tons/year.﻿
Previously, in June, SKC signed a memorandum of cooperation with Hai Phong city to explore the investment environment for advanced semiconductor materials, secondary batteries and a number of other environmentally friendly materials.
SKC is a subsidiary of SK Group, the 3rd largest chaebol in Korea. This is SK Group's first direct investment project in Vietnam.Previously, SK Group was known as one of the major investment corporations in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) deals in Vietnam.
Specifically, SK invested 470 million USD to buy 9.4% shares of Masan Group and 1 billion USD for 6% shares of Vingroup.At the end of 2011, SK spent 340 million USD to buy 4.9% shares of The CrownX - a subsidiary of Masan, which owns Masan Consumer Holding (MCH) and Wincomerce.﻿
SK also announced an investment of 100 million USD in the Pharmacity pharmacy chain.
Also in the pharmaceutical segment, according to the financial report for the first quarter of 2023, this Group holds 64.79% of the capital of a large drug manufacturing company, Imexpharm (IMP).
In addition to the above major deals, another SK subsidiary, SK Energy, also holds more than 5% of PV Oil's shares, worth nearly 30 million USD.﻿
Currently, SK is a multi-industry economic corporation with a market capitalization of nearly 63 billion USD, ranked third in Korea after Samsung and LG and recently SK was honored in TIME's list of 100 most influential companies in 2023.The Group's strengths are in the fields of Energy, Pharmaceuticals - Health, Logistics and information communication technology (ICT).
A member of SK Group, SK Hynix, and Samsung Electronics are currently two of the three largest semiconductor manufacturers in the world.
Recently, Vietnam's semiconductor industry has become very hot with a series of American businesses such as Amkor Technology, Synopsys, and Marvell announcing investments in semiconductor projects in Vietnam.﻿
author: Trong Hieu

title: Foreign investors were strong net sellers of nearly 500 billion VND in the first session of the week, focusing on the duo VIC and VRE
sapo: On HOSE, foreign investors net sold with a value of approximately 477 billion VND, VIC suffered the strongest selling pressure from foreign investors with a value of 136 billion VND;Following VRE, SSI, VPB and VHM were net sold over 40 billion VND per share.
content:
The Vietnamese stock market's trading session on September 18 was not very positive when at one point the VN-Index lost more than 20 points before narrowing slightly towards the end of the session.
Closing, VN-Index decreased 15.55 points (-1.27%) to 1,211.81 points;HNX-Index decreased 2.28 points to 250.48 points and UPCoM-Index decreased 0.59 points to 93.17 points.Liquidity on HoSE decreased compared to last week's session with matched order value reaching approximately VND 17,500 billion.
In that context, foreign investors' transactions became gloomy when they returned to a net sale of VND 486 billion across the market.
On HOSE, foreign investors were net sellers with a value of approximately 477 billion VND
On the selling afternoon, VIC shares were under the strongest selling pressure from foreign investors with a value of 136 billion VND;Following VRE, SSI, VPB and VHM were also net sold over 40 billion VND per share.
On the contrary, DXG was bought the most with a value of 62 billion VND.Besides, DGC ranked next on the strong net buying list on HoSE with 20 billion VND.Next, foreign investors also net bought from 12 billion to over 15 billion VND in DCM, VHC, and FRT stocks.
On HNX, foreign investors net bought 4 billion VND
On the buying side, PVS had the strongest net purchase with a value of 4 billion VND.Besides, HUT, SHS, TNG are next on the list of strong net buyers but the value is not much.
On the contrary, NVB, IDC and CEO were net sold by foreign investors with the same value of 1 billion VND;Following PSD, VIG was also net sold on HNX.
On UPCOM, foreign investors net sold about 13 billion VND
On the buying afternoon, foreign investors bought 3 billion VND of LTG shares today, similarly, GHC, MCH, AAS also net bought each share from a few hundred million to 1 billion VND.
On the contrary, OIL, QNS and VTP were sold the most on UPCOM with a value of 5 to 8 billion VND;In addition, they also sold net at ACV, VGG,... about a few hundred million to 1 billion per code.
author: Ngoc Ly

title: HOSE's billion USD group increased sharply, but VIC was not the stock with the strongest increase
sapo: The event of VinFast being listed on NASDAQ stirred up the market, helping Vingroup's VIC shares rise to second place in terms of market capitalization.After cooling down, many stocks in the billion USD group of HOSE had better increases in August.
content:
According to statistics from HOSE, by the end of August 2023, the floor had 43 enterprises with a capitalization of more than 1 billion USD, of which VCB of Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam was the only enterprise with a capitalization of over 10 billion USD.Thus, compared to July, the number of codes over 1 billion USD has not made any further progress.
However, in reality, stocks in the $1 billion capitalization group create a lot of volatility.The most prominent is the case of VIC shares, which at one point increased by up to 39% compared to the end of May, thanks to the effect of VinFast listing on NASDAQ.This helped VIC at one point surpass both the Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV-BID) and VINHOMES (VHM) to reach the No. 2 market capitalization position.
However, after the information effect passed, VIC shares also cooled down and narrowed their increase to 12.7%.At the same time, VIC also returned the position of VHM and BID codes to return to 4th position.
If caught up in VinFast's story, investors may miss more impressive growth opportunities in the group of stocks with a market capitalization of more than billions of dollars.Cases such as Vietnam Import-Export Commercial Joint Stock Bank, Eximbank - EIB (+23.51%), Duc Giang Chemical Group - DGC (+21.53%), Lien Viet Postal Commercial Joint Stock Bank -LPB (+26.37%) are the stocks that bring the best results.
It is known that in August, the State Bank approved EIB to pay stock dividends at the rate of 18%.EIB's charter capital will increase from VND 14,814 billion to VND 17,470 billion.
With LPB, the Bank ended the issuance of stock dividends at a rate of 19% on August 23.It is expected that in September-October 2023, 328.51 million LPB shares will return to investor accounts.
As for DGC, the strong increase came thanks to foreign investors reversing a net purchase of more than 320 billion VND after 4 consecutive months of selling.In fact, since March 2023, DGC has continued to increase prices without a single month of adjustment.
Width statistics of 43 billion USD capitalization codes show that 44% of codes increased compared to 56% of codes decreased.With many large stocks turning to the downside, the increase margin of VN-Index (+0.09%) has become the narrowest in the 4-month winning streak.
According to forecasts of BIDV Securities Company (BSC), VN-Index may return to test the 1,280 - 1,300 point range in addition to less negative developments in foreign investors.In case variables such as exchange rates, foreign investors or the outlook for the Chinese economy become less positive, VN-Index may witness shaky sessions and return to test the 1,200 point threshold and lower milestones previously set.
author: According to Mai Huong

title: Vingroup (VIC) spent more than 297 billion VND to own 5% of GSM's charter capital
sapo: After 4 months of launching electric taxis, on August 14, 2023, the VinFast electric motorbike passenger transportation service of GSM - Xanh SM Bike Company officially went into operation in the first area, Hanoi.
content:
On August 25, Vingroup - JSC (HoSE: VIC ) just announced the Board of Directors Resolution approving Vingroup's capital contribution to GSM Green and Smart Mobility Joint Stock Company.Specifically, Vingroup will contribute capital to GSM with a capital of more than 297 billion VND, accounting for 5% of GSM's charter capital.
On March 25, 2023, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong completed the transfer of nearly 50.8 million personally owned VIC shares to contribute capital to GSM.The capital contribution is valued at 2,850 billion VND, determined by the average price of 50 sessions of VIC shares as of March 25, 2023 and equivalent to 95% of GSM's charter capital of 3,000 billion VND at that time.
On May 8, 2023, GSM increased its charter capital to VND 5,650 billion.
On April 8, GSM officially opened electric taxi service in Hanoi from April 14, 2023.Up to now, GSM electric taxis have covered many provinces and cities across the country.﻿ After 4 months of launching electric taxis, on August 14, 2023, the VinFast electric motorbike passenger transportation service of GSM Company - Xanh SM Bike officially went into operation in the first area, Hanoi.
Speaking at the launching ceremony of Green SM Bike service in Hanoi, Mr. Nguyen Van Thanh - General Director of GSM Company said: "In parallel with the plan to expand electric taxi services in 27 provinces and 3 countries, Xanh SM plans to cover electric motorbike services in 5 provinces and cities with the number of vehicles up to 60,000 units in 2023."﻿
author: Huyen Trang

author: Mai Chi

title: VIC shares increased to the ceiling after VinFast's explosive listing on Nasdaq, Vingroup's capitalization is only equal to 1/7 of the electric car company's capitalization
sapo: Vingroup's market capitalization currently reaches 288,330 billion VND (~ 12 billion USD), equivalent to only 1/3 of the capital contribution value at VinFast and 1/7 of the capitalization of the electric car company.
content:
Opening the trading session on August 16, Vingroup's VIC shares immediately increased to the ceiling by 6.9% to 75,600 VND/share with nearly 11 million units matched, with a surplus of nearly 4 million shares purchased at the ceiling price.This is also the highest price of this stock code within 14 months from the end of June 2022.
Since the end of July until now, VIC has had 4 closing sessions at the purple price level, with the market price increasing by 48% in just less than a month.Liquidity became vibrant with nearly 12 million shares traded each session.As of the morning of August 16, VIC's market capitalization reached 288,330 billion VND (~ 12 billion USD), corresponding to an increase of nearly 94,000 billion VND (~ 4 billion USD) after nearly a month.
VIC's positive performance was recorded after VinFast had its first trading session on the US stock exchange after the merger.The company's shares and warrants trade on the Nasdaq exchange with the listing codes "VFS" and "VFSWW", respectively, closing up 68.4% compared to the floor price (22 USD).Currently, the capitalization value of this electric car company in the US is up to 85.5 billion USD, 3.7 times the initial valuation of 23 billion USD and more than 3 times the revaluation after the successful merger with Black Spade.This is also the highest valuation that a Vietnamese enterprise has ever reached, surpassing the capitalization of many automobile industry names such as Ford, General Motor...
Thus, currently Vingroup's capital holding in VinFast (51%) is worth more than 40 billion USD, while Vingroup's current capitalization is only about 12 billion USD, corresponding to 1/3 of the capital contribution and 1/7 of VinFast's capitalization.The value does not include other assets and subsidiaries, which all have very large valuations.
The bell ringing event at Nasdaq, officially listed in the world's largest capital market, is a historic milestone in VinFast's development roadmap.According to Ms. Le Thi Thu Thuy, Global General Director of VinFast, the successful listing will create a solid foundation for the goal of popularizing smart, safe and environmentally friendly electric vehicles to a large number of consumers, fulfilling commitments in the sustainable mobility revolution on a global scale.Besides, the event also opens up access to the world's largest capital market and an important direction for the company's future development.Ms. Thuy expressed her hope that VinFast's story will inspire and open many opportunities for Vietnamese brands to go global.

author: Ngoc Ly

title: Top 10 stocks with the strongest increase/decrease of the week: A series of stocks broke out strongly, capitalization of VIC increased by 40,000 billion VND after one week
sapo: On HOSE, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases had quite good increases, the highest being 40% and the lowest being 13%.
content:
VN-Index recorded signals of creating a short-term peak last week around the 1,250 area.However, demand from large-cap stocks in the weekend session helped the market regain its green color, closing above the 1,230 point range.
On HOSE, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases had quite good increases, the highest being 40% and the lowest being 13%.
The market focus this week continues to be VIC with an increase of 17% after one week of trading.In the past half month alone, VIC has increased by nearly 42% to climb to its highest level in 14 months since the end of June last year.Liquidity improved sharply with an average matched order volume of over 10 million shares, even on the August 11 session, VIC had a record matched order volume of more than 23 million units.Market capitalization also increased by nearly 40,000 billion VND after one week, to nearly 277,000 billion VND.
PIT of ﻿Petrolimex Import-Export Joint Stock Company is a prominent name when it increased to the ceiling all week.PIT market price reached 8,470 VND/share, equivalent to an increase of 40% after only 1 week of trading.Along with the index's increase, PIT liquidity also improved from a few tens of thousands of shares, even up to hundreds of thousands of units.
According to the written explanation, PIT said that the reason why the stock increased to the ceiling continuously in recent times was due to market supply and demand, and the decision to buy and sell shares by investors was beyond the Company's control.The company affirms that there is no impact on the market transaction price.﻿
On the downside, a series of stocks on HOSE also recorded a decrease of over 6%.
On the HNX, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases also had increases of 20-38%.The stocks that increased were mainly small, highly speculative stocks.
A typical example is VC9 of BGI Group Joint Stock Company when it increased sharply in 4 sessions last week.The market price of this construction stock increased by 38% to 33,500 VND/share. From the beginning of August until now, this stock has broken through 72% of its value.
On the downside, last week many stocks also recorded a decrease of 9% - 19% on HNX.
On UPCOM, the trading range was wider, so a series of stocks also increased sharply from 42% to 85% last week.
Notably, PLA of Petroleum Infrastructure Services Investment Joint Stock Company suddenly became popular with 5 sessions of ceiling price increases to push the stock market price to 12,700 VND, equivalent to an increase of nearly 85% after one week.Liquidity also improved to hundreds of thousands of matched shares.Compared to the price at the beginning of the month, PLA has increased 3 times.
On the contrary, last week many codes on UPCOM also recorded a decrease of 22% - 40%.A typical example is XDC of Tan Cang Construction Company Limited when it decreased by up to 40% after just one trading session.Extending the accelerating chain, XDC increased to the limit in all 3/5 trading sessions of the week.XDC skyrocketed from 18,000 VND (May 5 session) to 288,600 VND/share (June 17 session), equivalent to a 16-fold increase in just over 1 month.
After 27 sessions of "laying dormant" at reference, XDC shares of Tan Cang Construction Joint Stock Company turned to the floor price in the session of August 10.With the first trading session after nearly a month of "turning off" liquidity, XDC market price "evaporated" 399,900 VND (equivalent to nearly 40%) to fall back to 600,000 VND/share.The decrease of 399,900 VND in one trading session is also the largest absolute decrease for a stock in Vietnam ever.﻿ However, the liquidity of this stock is quite sluggish with only 100 units matched during the session.
author: Mai Chi

title: Week 7-11/8: Foreign investors suddenly spent nearly trillion to net buy a bank stock, HPG and VIC were also strongly "collected"
sapo: Although the total transaction value still recorded a net purchase of 27 billion VND, it was mainly thanks to sudden agreement transactions on UPCoM.
content:
After two strong increasing sessions at the beginning of the week, the market was somewhat out of breath as it approached the 1,250 point area again, and the VN-Index retreated.However, demand from large-cap stocks still helped the market regain its green color and close above the 1,230 point range.At the end of the week of August 7-11, VN-Index closed at 1,232.21 points, an increase of 6.23 points, equivalent to 0.51% compared to the previous week.
In the context of the market continuing to rise, foreign investors' transactions are somewhat less active.Although the total transaction value still recorded a net purchase of 27 billion VND, it was mainly thanks to sudden agreement transactions.If excluding the net purchase transactions agreed upon on UPCoM, foreign investors net sold hundreds of billions of dong on the matching order channel last week.
Looking at each exchange separately, in the week of August 7-11, foreign investors net sold 695 billion VND on HoSE and net sold 49 billion VND on HNX.In contrast, foreign investors net bought 771 billion VND on UPCoM.
Statistics on each stock code, SGB shares were net purchased by foreign investors up to 914 billion VND, of which the August 8 session alone recorded a net purchase of 44 million SGB shares, equivalent to a value of nearly 872 billion VND.
Foreign investors also net bought strongly in HPG shares, worth more than 296 billion VND, besides VIC was also net bought 274 billion VND after 5 sessions.Net buying power last week was also recorded at VNM and MSN with values ​​of VND 274 billion and VND 199 billion, respectively.
On the other hand, SSI and GMD were net sold by foreign investors for 275 billion and 249 billion VND, respectively.In addition, VRE and VPB were also net sold by foreign investors for 149 billion and 146 billion VND respectively last week.The list of net sellers of foreign investors last week also included VHM (-143 billion), VCB (-110 billion), VND (-101 billion)...
author: Phuong Linh

title: Top 10 stocks with the strongest increase/decrease of the week: VIC shines, a rice stock increased nearly 4 times after half a month
sapo: The market's focus was on real estate stocks as they all "hit the top" with outstanding increases, the most prominent of which was VIC with an increase of 21%.
content:
VN-Index recorded a struggling and shaky trading week along with differentiation with alternating increasing and decreasing sessions.Specifically, after facing strong profit-taking pressure, the index reversed and broke out in the last trading session of the week to climb to 1,225 points.Liquidity improved sharply with the matched order value on HOSE exceeding the threshold of 21,000 billion VND/session.
On HOSE, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases had quite good increases, the highest being 40% and the lowest being 16%.The market's focus was on real estate stocks as they all "hit the top" with outstanding increases, the most prominent of which was VIC with an increase of 21%.
After only 7 trading sessions, VIC increased nearly 22% in market price, thereby climbing to the highest level in 8 months since the end of December last year.Market capitalization also increased by 42,600 billion VND after one week, exceeding 237,000 billion VND.
Notably, VIC's liquidity also improved significantly compared to the previous period.In the August 4 session, VIC also matched orders of up to 21.2 million units, the highest number since its listing in 2007.
MHC stock is also a notable name when it recorded 4 consecutive sessions of hitting the ceiling, pulling the market up 40% after one week.Thus, after only half a month, this stock has increased by 63%.
MHC shares had positive developments after this enterprise announced its consolidated financial statements for the second quarter of 2023.It is known that MHC is investing heavily in Vietnam Export-Import Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Eximbank, stock code: EIB), VIX Securities Joint Stock Company (code: VIX), Gelex Group Joint Stock Company (code: GEX).As of June 30, 2023, MHC has spent 512 billion to invest in securities, doubled compared to the beginning of the year, provision for stock price decline of 2.6 billion.
On the downside, a series of stocks on HOSE also recorded a decrease of over 7%.Notably, the pressure to take profits continued to appear at CTD after "running out of breath" before the expectations of the Long Thanh Airport construction bidding project.Accordingly, the Hoa Lu joint venture led by CTD was not included in the list of contractors that meet the technical requirements for construction of bidding package No. 5.10 of Long Thanh airport.
On the HNX, the top 10 stocks with the strongest increases also had increases of 19-33%.The stocks that increased were mainly small, highly speculative stocks.
Typically, HCT and MCF increased by 44% and 36% respectively after just one week.
On the downside, last week many stocks also recorded a decrease of 11% - 18% on HNX.
On UPCOM, the trading range was wider, so a series of stocks also increased sharply from 34% to 95% last week.
The "champion" of price increases on UPCOM this week continues to name VSF of the Southern Food Corporation - Joint Stock Company.After 5 sessions of price increases, including 4 sessions of ceiling increases, VSF has increased by 95% in value.After just 2 weeks, VSF has climbed from 7,900 VND to 28,500 VND/share.
In fact, rice industry stocks in general and VSF in particular are being supported by a lot of positive information from the export rice market.Most notably, Vietnam's rice export activities are expected to benefit greatly in the coming time when India - the world's largest exporter - suddenly bans the export of all cheap rice to stabilize domestic prices.After India, Russia and the UAE have also announced a temporary suspension of rice sales abroad.
On the contrary, in the past week, many codes on UPCOM also recorded a decrease of 21% - 40%.

author: Mai Chi

title: Vingroup (VIC) established a subsidiary Vinpearl Cua Hoi to do hotel and tourism business with a charter capital of more than 1,200 billion VND
sapo: The new company expected to be established is called Vinpearl Cua Hoi Joint Stock Company, separated from Vinpearl Joint Stock Company, with headquarters in Cua Lo town, Nghe An province.
content:
Vingroup Joint Stock Company (code VIC) has just passed a resolution on separating its subsidiary Vinpearl Joint Stock Company and establishing a new subsidiary, based on the separation of the above business for the purpose of restructuring internal ownership.
Accordingly, Vingroup separated Vinpearl Joint Stock Company, a subsidiary of the Group, and established a new subsidiary on the basis of business separation.﻿
The new company expected to be established is called Vinpearl Cua Hoi Joint Stock Company, headquartered at Binh Minh Street, Nghi Hai Ward, Cua Lo Town, Nghe An Province, Vietnam.﻿
The expected charter capital of Vinpearl Cua Hoi is 1,263.8 billion VND.Of which, Vingroup holds 99.99% of the charter capital. Vinpearl Cua Hoi's business line is hotel and tourism services.
Currently, in Nghe An, Vingroup owns real estate projects such as Vinpearl Cua Hoi;Vincom Shophouse Vinh;Renovation project of area B - Quang Trung apartment complex, Vinh city...
In particular, Vinpearl Cua Hoi is a villa and resort hotel complex with a scale of 38.7 hectares, including 184 hotel rooms located on an area of 5,000 square meters, many villas are planned on a land area of 6.9 hectares, 6 meeting rooms and 3 restaurants.In which, Vinpearl Cua Hoi villa area is planned to include 2 types.The 2-bedroom apartment has a sea view with an area of ​​each apartment from 540 - 589m2 and the 4-bedroom apartment has an area of 920m2.﻿
Total investment capital is nearly 900 billion VND.The project has been under construction since 2015 and inaugurated in April 2017.
author: Linh Phong

title: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong: "VIC price is very low compared to the real value, you only lose when you sell, if you don't sell, you haven't lost anything"
sapo: Mr. Vuong also added: "Maybe due to rumors, the general market is difficult, making investors feel unhappy and run away, but I don't see a reason to sell shares."
content:
"If VinFast IPO is successful, will shareholders receive any incentives when buying shares? Will loyal shareholders benefit?"– A shareholder asked a question to the Board of Directors of Vingroup Corporation (VIC) at the 2023 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on the morning of May 17, after hesitantly mentioning the fact that Vingroup's VIC shares have decreased by more than half in the past 2 years.
Answering this question, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors affirmed: "VIC's value is very low compared to its real value. With Vinfast's IPO, Vingroup shareholders do not receive any incentives, but if you are a loyal shareholder, you will not lose anything. You only lose when you sell. If you haven't sold, you haven't lost anything. Over time, VIC's market value will return."
Mr. Vuong also added: "Maybe due to rumors, the general market is difficult, making investors feel unhappy and run away, but I don't see a reason to sell shares."
However, another shareholder raised the issue of Vingroup changing its business plan and staff quite "quickly", affecting the corporate brand.In fact, Vingroup's decision to quit producing gasoline cars and producing phones was both sudden and quick.
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong said: "If we say that giving up gasoline cars and cell phones affects the brand, I think differently. Anything that is weak must be eliminated. When we do it, there will be many people who don't understand. But in society, there are half of the people who understand us, which is already too strong."
Talking about the story of making cars, Mr. Vuong shared that when starting, Vingroup could not immediately make electric cars because five years ago, very few people wanted to use electric cars and making smart electric cars was very difficult.Even at this point, it cannot be sold and cannot be made.After seeing that the electric car opportunity was very strong, Vingroup immediately put all its effort into it. If VinFast is successfully listed, it will be the 3rd largest car company in the world.
"With compliments and criticisms that are correct, we immediately learn, follow, and correct. If smear or slander, we immediately fight. With our actions, with our results, they will understand. Anything that has a bright direction needs to be strengthened. Sitting there to burn more money into nothingness is not right" -  Vingroup Chairman emphasized.
Regarding the story of Chinese cars, Mr. Vuong was frank: "The point is that river water does not violate well water, they have their customers, we have our segments."
According to Mr. Vuong, products are expensive or cheap depending on the needs and tastes of customers.In Vietnam, there are many patriots who support VinFast, and with the supporting Vingroup ecosystem, Mr. Vuong "is not afraid of the Vietnamese market."
According to the reports approved at the congress, in 2023, Vingroup sets a target of net revenue of 190,000 billion VND and profit after tax of 2,000 billion VND.Compared to 2022, revenue grows nearly 90% while profits are almost flat.
In 2023, VinFast plans to develop its sales network in all domestic and foreign target markets, accelerating the speed of sales and product delivery in the key market (USA).VinFast will deploy a direct marketing strategy, promote test drives of car models, and promote new car models to be sold in 2023 through exhibitions and car display activities in all markets.
In production activities, the company promotes mass production of car models launched for sale in 2022 to deliver on time to customers (VF 5, VF 8 and VF 9), prepares to deploy production of new car models to be introduced (VF 6 and VF 7), and accelerates the implementation progress of the factory project in North Carolina, USA.In R&D activities, VinFast continues to research and produce other environmentally friendly vehicles (electric buses, electric motorbikes and electric bicycles).
author: Lan Ha

title: VIC shares increased by 6%, Vingroup's capitalization increased by 500 million USD after information about the merger with VinFast's SPAC
sapo: VinFast Auto Pte.Ltd.and Black Spade Acquisition Co (“Black Spade”) (NYSE: BSAQ) have entered into an agreement to merge their businesses.After the transaction, VinFast has a valuation of more than 23 billion USD and continues its plan to list on the US stock exchange.
content:
Right in the morning trading session at the beginning of the week on May 15, Vingroup's VIC code quickly increased by 3,000 VND (5.8%) to 54,700 VND/share.This is VIC's second consecutive increase after the May 12 session and is the code's highest price since the April 10 session.
﻿With this increase, Vingroup's capitalization increased by 11,500 billion (nearly 500 million USD) to 208,400 billion VND, equivalent to nearly 8.9 billion USD.
Effective support information comes from the fact that on May 12, VinFast officially announced that it will list in the US through a merger transaction with a SPAC company, valued at 23 billion USD.
Accordingly, VinFast Auto Pte.Ltd.and Black Spade Acquisition Co (“Black Spade”) (NYSE: BSAQ) have entered into an agreement to merge their businesses.
The combined company will have an enterprise value of approximately $27 billion.The equity value is 23 billion USD after the merger, not including the amount that will be converted from 169 million USD in trust cash.
The transaction is expected to close in 2023 following receipt of regulatory and shareholder approvals, as well as other customary closing conditions.After the transaction, VinFast's existing shareholders will own 99% of the merged company.
Black Spade is a blank check company established in 2021 for the purpose of conducting a business combination transaction with a target company (Special Purpose Acquisition Company - SPAC).Black Spade's headquarters are located at Wyndham Street Central, Hong Kong.
Not only VIC, after information about the deal with VinFast was announced, BSAQ shares increased slightly by 1% to 10.36 USD/share, corresponding to a current capitalization of nearly 220 million USD.
author: Nhuan Hoa

title: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong completed transferring 50.8 million VIC shares to GSM, Vingroup had new institutional shareholders
sapo: After the transaction, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong still holds 691.27 million VIC shares (equivalent to 17.87% of Vingroup's charter capital) and GSM Company owns 1.31% of Vingroup's charter capital.
content:
Vingroup Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong has just completed the transfer of nearly 50.8 million VIC shares (corresponding to 1.31% of Vingroup's charter capital) under his personal ownership to contribute capital to Green and Smart Mobility Joint Stock Company (GSM) - a newly established electric taxi rental and trading business.
The capital contribution is valued at 2,850 billion VND, determined by the average price of 50 sessions of VIC shares as of March 25, 2023 and equivalent to 95% of GSM's charter capital of 3,000 billion VND.
After the transaction was completed, Mr. Vuong still holds 691.27 million shares (equivalent to 17.87% of Vingroup's charter capital) and GSM Company owns 1.31% of Vingroup's charter capital.

title: Revenue reached a record of more than 41,000 billion VND, Vingroup (VIC) reported 4th quarter pre-tax profit of nearly 4,000 billion VND
sapo: Accumulated for the whole year of 2022, VIC recorded net revenue of 101,523 billion VND, down 19%, and net profit of 8,352 billion VND, in contrast to the loss of 2,514 billion VND in 2021.
content:
Recently, Vingroup (stock code: VIC) announced its Consolidated Financial Report for the fourth quarter of 2022.
Accordingly, the Group's net revenue from sales and service provision reached 41,168 billion VND, an increase of 18% over the same period and reached the highest record ever.Of which, revenue from real estate transfer accounted for 71% with 29,153 billion VND, an increase of 26% over the same period in 2021. Revenue from manufacturing activities reached 3,601 billion VND, down 12%, contributing nearly 9% to the Group's revenue.
Vingroup said real estate revenue in the quarter mainly came from low-rise real estate units at the Vinhomes Ocean Park 2 - The Empire project.
In addition, other activities such as investment real estate rental, hotel services, tourism, entertainment, health and education all increased over the same period.
Minus the cost price, Vingroup's gross profit is 12,804 billion VND, an increase of 48% compared to the fourth quarter of 2021.
Vingroup's financial revenue in the quarter decreased by 27% to VND 2,529 billion, mainly from investment transfer profits, financial expenses also decreased by 20% to VND 2,269 billion due to reduction in exchange rate difference losses.﻿ In the fourth quarter, VIC profit from exchange rate differences was more than VND 1,200 billion.
Selling expenses increased sharply to VND 3,683 billion, an increase of 96%, while corporate management expenses decreased by 45% to VND 5,170 billion due to the company reducing charity sponsorship costs and provisioning.
Minus other expenses and losses, VIC's pre-tax profit was 3,955 billion VND, in contrast to the loss of 6,568 billion VND in the fourth quarter of 2021. Profit after tax was 410 billion VND and the parent company's net profit was 1,559 billion VND, the same period net loss was 5,706 billion VND.
Accumulated for the whole year 2022, VIC recorded net revenue of 101,523 billion VND, down 19% and net profit of 8,352 billion VND, in contrast to the loss of 2,514 billion VND in 2021.
Real estate transfer business is still the segment that brings in the largest revenue for VIC. In 2022, real estate transfer business brings in 54,861 billion VND in net revenue, accounting for 54% of net revenue for the whole year.Other business activities include: Investment real estate rental bringing in 8,112 billion VND (accounting for 8%);Hotel, tourism, and entertainment services brought in 7,532 billion VND (accounting for 7%);Production activities brought in 13,564 billion VND (accounting for 13%);Healthcare brought in 4,480 billion VND (accounting for 4%);Education brought in 3,760 billion VND (accounting for 4%) and Other brought in 15,070 billion VND (accounting for 15%).
As of December 31, 2022, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 574,807 billion, an increase of 34% compared to December 31, 2021.The Group's cash and deposits increased to VND 28,224 billion.
Unrecorded real estate sales of the entire Vingroup including Vinhomes and its subsidiaries reached a record level of 110,500 billion VND at the end of 2022, an increase of 2.1 times compared to the same period in 2021. Accordingly, the real estate sector promises to record a large total revenue in 2023 thanks to the continued handover of a large number of products after completing construction.
In capital mobilization activities, in 2022, Vingroup successfully raised nearly 1.1 billion USD from the international capital market.In December 2022, VinFast filed Form F-1 with the US Securities Exchange Commission ("SEC") to register for the initial public offering of common shares.
In Technology - Industry activities, VinFast focuses on delivering two electric car models, VFe 34 and VF 8, in the domestic market, while preparing for the delivery of VF 8 in the US.
Since the beginning of the year, VinFast has delivered a total of 7,400 electric cars and 60,000 electric motorbikes in 2022.
In the retail real estate sector, Vincom Retail recorded high growth in both revenue and profit compared to the previous year and exceeded the set plan, although still affected by the Covid-19 epidemic in early 2022. Visitors to shopping centers increased by 93% compared to 2021 and gradually recovered to pre-Covid-19 levels.
Regarding the resort tourism sector, Vinpearl's activities recovered following the general momentum of the tourism market.The total number of room nights sold in 2022 will reach nearly 1.3 million rooms, an increase of 60% compared to 2021.

title: Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong transferred more than 243 million VIC shares to VMI, Vingroup has a new major shareholder
sapo: After the transaction, VMI JSC became a major shareholder of Vingroup, accounting for 6.29% of the group's charter capital.
content:
Vingroup Joint Stock Company (stock code: VIC) has just announced the stock trading results report of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company.Accordingly, Mr. Vuong transferred more than 243 million VIC shares to VMI Real Estate Management and Investment Joint Stock Company (VMI JSC), the transaction took place on November 17, the transaction method was to transfer ownership through the Securities Depository Center.
Before the transaction, the number of VIC shares owned by Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong was more than 985.5 million shares, accounting for 25.47% of Vingroup's charter capital.After the transaction, the number of shares Mr. Vuong owns is more than 742 million shares, accounting for 19.18% of charter capital.
VMI JSC became a major shareholder of Vingroup, accounting for 6.29% of the group's charter capital.
Previously, billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong announced that he would contribute capital and become the main shareholder of VMI JSC.VMI JSC was established with the goal of supporting small capital investors with real estate investment opportunities, managing real estate and developing the secondary market to increase liquidity and value of Vinhomes real estate.
Accordingly, VMI has a charter capital of 18,000 billion VND, of which Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong contributes 90% of the capital equal to the value of Vingroup shares.Specifically, Mr. Vuong will contribute capital with 243 million Vingroup shares, equivalent to VND 16,200 billion according to the average market price of 50 sessions as of September 13, 2022.Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong pledged to maintain investment and long-term control in VMI JSC.
In addition to direct ownership, Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company - a company controlled by Mr. Vuong - is currently the largest shareholder owning 32.6% of Vingroup's shares.In addition to Vingroup and Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company, Vingroup's chairman currently also directly holds capital in VinFuture, VinES and Asian Star Trading & Investment company.
Closing the trading session on November 18, VIC stock price stopped at 65,600 VND/share, so the number of shares Mr. Vuong transferred to VMI JSC was worth 15,971 billion VND.
