title: Why can billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong contribute capital with VIC shares to VMI?
sapo: In addition to being interested in the operating model of VMI JSC - VMI Real Estate Investment and Management Joint Stock Company, public opinion is also curious about billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong's capital contribution in shares equivalent to 90% of VMI JSC's shares.In fact, in addition to contributing capital in VND, the law allows shareholders to contribute capital with many other assets such as land use rights,... or even intangible assets such as intellectual property rights, technical know-how...
content:
On October 6, 2022, VMI Real Estate Investment and Management Joint Stock Company (VMI JSC) with Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong as the main shareholder along with Ms. Pham Thu Huong and Vinhomes Joint Stock Company was established.
VMI JSC has a charter capital of 18,000 billion VND, operating with the goal of supporting small capital investors with real estate investment opportunities, managing real estate and developing the secondary market to increase liquidity and value of Vinhomes real estate.
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup (Stock code: VIC) contributed capital to VMI JSC with more than 243 million VIC shares, equivalent to 16,200 billion VND according to the average market price of 50 sessions as of September 13, 2022.
Contributing capital by shares may sound strange to many people, but in fact this activity has been done before by some businesses, although it is not common.So which legal corridors in Vietnam allow capital contribution by shares?
Firstly, can I contribute capital by shares?
According to the provisions of Clause 1, Article 34 of the Enterprise Law 2020, there are regulations on capital contribution assets.In particular, the assets contributed as capital are Vietnamese Dong, freely convertible foreign currencies, gold, land use rights, intellectual property rights, technology, technical know-how, and other assets that can be valued in Vietnamese Dong.
Thus, stock codes that meet the requirements of the Enterprise Law can become capital contributions.
Article 4 - Securities Law 2019 stipulates: Securities are assets, including the following types:
a) Stocks, bonds, fund certificates;
b) Warrants, covered warrants, share purchase rights, depository certificates;
c) Derivative securities;
d) Other types of securities prescribed by the Government.
Besides being recognized as assets, stocks have value and can be valued.Shares of businesses listed on the stock exchange are bought and sold at market prices.
Second, how to value capital contribution by shares?
Article 36 of the Enterprise Law regulates the valuation of assets contributed as capital, accordingly:
Capital contribution assets other than Vietnamese Dong, freely convertible foreign currencies, or gold must be valued by members, founding shareholders or valuation organizations and expressed in Vietnamese Dong.
Assets contributed as capital when establishing an enterprise must be valued by members and founding shareholders according to the principle of consensus or by a valuation organization.In case a valuation organization determines the value, the value of contributed assets must be approved by more than 50% of the members and founding shareholders.
Thus, the most important thing with a capital contribution asset is that it must be priced and this price must be approved by the majority of members and founding shareholders.
In the case of Vinhomes, the value of 243 million shares of capital contribution is determined according to the average market price of 50 sessions as of September 13, 2022, the average market price during this period falls to 66,667 VND/share.
Price movements of VIC shares in the past 6 months
Third, capital contribution by shares is essentially a share transfer activity
Article 35 of the Enterprise Law 2020 regulates the transfer of ownership of assets contributed as capital.Accordingly, for assets with registered ownership or land use rights, the capital contributor must carry out procedures to transfer ownership of that asset or land use rights to the company according to the provisions of law.
It can be seen that the nature of shareholder capital contribution activities is a share transfer activity.Because, after the new Company is established, capital contributing shareholders will have to transfer ownership of shares to the newly established Company.
In the case of Vingroup, after releasing information about contributing capital to establish VMI, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong also registered to transfer ownership of 243.46 million shares to VMI through the Securities Depository Center.The transaction is expected to take place from October 12 to November 10, 2022.

title: HoSE cuts margin with 62 stock codes in the fourth quarter of 2022, VIC is not on the list
sapo: These are mainly familiar stocks that are under warning;controlled or by an enterprise whose parent company shareholder's profit/ PAT on the reviewed consolidated financial statements for the first 6 months of 2022 is negative.
content:
Recently, the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HOSE) announced a list of 62 stock codes that are not eligible for margin trading in the fourth quarter of 2022.
These are mainly familiar stocks that are under warning or control such as CIG, DLG, DXV, HNG, HOT, HU1, HU3, ITA, MCG, OGC, PMG, PTL, RDP, SCD, SII, SJD, TCR, TNI, TTF, VFG, VOS,...
Also appearing on the list is the FLC ecosystem stock group such as FLC, GAB, HAI.The stock code ROS is no longer on the list because it was forced to be delisted from September 5.Regarding the reason for the margin cut in the fourth quarter, GAB stock has been on the restricted trading list since October 5 while FLC and HAI are under trading suspension, with an unknown time to return to the exchange.
Some "hot" stocks in the previous period were also subject to margin cuts in the third quarter such as TGG of the Louis group;JVC, NVT code of "DNP-Tasco" group...
HVN shares of Vietnam Airlines and HAG shares of Hoang Anh Gia Lai also continued to have their margins cut in the fourth quarter because they are under the control of HoSE.With being placed on warning due to the late submission of the 2022 semi-annual reviewed financial report, the stock code of the LHG - Long Hau industrial park real estate industry was also cut by HoSE in this fourth quarter.
In addition, the list of 62 stocks that cannot be traded on margin in the fourth quarter also has some codes that have been listed for less than 6 months so they cannot participate in margin trading such as FIR, or FUEVTVGF4 fund certificates of Thien Viet 4 Growth Investment Fund, FUEDCMID of DCVFMVNMIDCAP ETF.
Some reasons leading to margin cuts are also the fact that the company has a negative number in the parent company's shareholders' profit/NPAT on the reviewed consolidated financial statements for the first 6 months of 2022 such as AGM, ASP, BCE, HAS, KHP, MHC, POM, PSH, PTC, SBV, SJF... or the Company receives a conclusion from the tax authority about tax violations such as SCS, TDW.
The two fund certificate codes FUEIP100 of the IPAAM VN100 ETF and FUEKIV30 of the KIM Growth VN30 ETF are also not allowed for margin trading on HoSE in the 4th quarter because the public investment fund has at least one month's net asset value (NAV) calculated on a fund certificate unit smaller than the par value based on the monthly net asset value change report considered for 3 consecutive months.
A notable point is that Vingroup's VIC shares were not included in the list of stock codes ineligible for margin trading.Previously, Vingroup announced its semi-annual audit report with parent company shareholders' after-tax profit reaching VND 5,846 billion, an increase of 63.8% over the same period.
Being profitable in the first 6 months of the year has helped VIC qualify for margin trading again.Previously, VIC had its margin cut from April 5 because it recorded a loss of VND 7,558 billion in 2021. The cause of the loss was funding VND 6,072 billion for Covid-19 prevention activities and setting aside a provision of VND 4,494 billion to pay for fees paid to suppliers due to contract termination related to the decision to stop vehicle production to focus on electric vehicles.According to regulations, a company's stock margin will be cut when it records a loss on its semi-annual or annual financial statements.
author: Phuong Linh

title: Profitable after the first half of the year, VIC stock is about to be granted margin?
sapo: Vingroup recorded profit after tax in the first half of the year of VND 1,065 billion, down 28.3% over the same period.
content:
Vingroup (HoSE: VIC) has just released its semi-annual reviewed financial report with net revenue of 31,623 billion VND, down 48%.The main reason for the decrease in the group's revenue was that real estate transfer revenue decreased by 75.3% to VND 9,058 billion.However, profit after tax for shareholders of parent company Vingroup still reached 5,846 billion VND, an increase of 63.8% over the same period.
Thus, VIC shares will prepare for margin trading again in the near future.Previously, this code had its margin cut from April 5 because it recorded a loss of VND 7,558 billion in 2021. The cause of the loss was funding of VND 6,072 billion for Covid-19 prevention activities and a provision of VND 4,494 billion to pay for fees paid to suppliers due to contract termination related to the decision to stop vehicle production to focus on electric vehicles.According to regulations, a company's stock margin will be cut when it records a loss on its semi-annual or annual financial statements.
Semi-annual business results for the first half of the year.
One of the reasons why Vingroup was profitable in the first half of the year was because financial revenue increased by nearly 91% to VND 21,090 billion.In particular, this unit recorded a profit from the transfer of subsidiaries and financial investments of VND 19,591 billion, twice as much as the same period.In addition, the company also recorded an additional profit of VND 4,976 billion from asset liquidation.However, Vingroup suffered a net loss of VND 1,180 billion from exchange rate differences due to many loans in USD.
As of June 30, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 528,958 billion, an increase of 23% compared to the beginning of the year.Of which, cash and cash equivalents are VND 42,209 billion, 2.3 times the number on December 31, 2021.Inventories increased by 61% to VND 80,978 billion, mainly due to an increase of 80.4% in real estate items for sale under construction.
Short-term receivables increased by 45% to VND 104,422 billion, an increase of 45%.Of which, short-term receivables from customers reached 20,688 billion VND.Buyers paid 62,718 billion VND in advance, 2.9 times the amount at the beginning of the year.Unrealized revenue is 7,278 billion VND.
Financial debt is at 156,873 billion VND, an increase of 28.5% compared to the beginning of the year, of which 70.7% is long-term debt.Outstanding bond debt is VND 57,115 billion.Equity reached 132,043 billion VND, lower than total debt.

title: HoSE liquidity continues to cool down in July 2022, the 10 billion USD capitalization club only has 3 units VIC, VHM and VCB
sapo: Monthly stock market liquidity recorded an average session value and trading volume of over 11,502 billion VND and 492.90 million shares, respectively, down 20.84% ​​in value and 10% in average volume compared to June.
content:
Recording information from the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE), at the end of the last trading session of July 2022, the VN-Index reached 1,206 points, up 0.73% compared to June and down 19.49% compared to the end of 2021.
VN30 alone reached 1,232 points, down 1.35% compared to June and down 19.78% compared to the end of 2021.
Monthly stock market liquidity recorded an average trading value and volume of over VND 11,502 billion and 492.9 million shares, respectively, down 20.84% in value and 10% in average volume compared to June.
Total stock trading volume reached more than 10.3 billion shares with a transaction value of 241,545 billion VND;correspondingly decreased 14.1% in volume and 24.4% in value compared to June.
In particular, the transaction value of foreign investors in the month reached over 36,203 billion VND, accounting for 7.49% of the total transaction value of both buying and selling sides of the entire market.Foreign investors made net purchases during the month with a value of over 332 billion VND.
Market scale on HoSE as of July 29, 2022, there are 554 listed stock codes, including: 402 stock codes, 2 closed-end fund certificate codes, 9 ETF fund certificate codes, 137 guaranteed warrant codes and 04 bond codes.The total volume of listed stocks is over 134 billion shares.Listed capitalization value reached more than 4.79 million billion VND, an increase of 0.75% compared to the previous month, reaching about 57% of GDP in 2021 (GDP at current prices).
HoSE currently has 43 enterprises with a capitalization of more than 1 billion USD, of which 3 enterprises have a capitalization of over 10 billion USD, including: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (VCB), Vinhomes Joint Stock Company (VHM) and Vingroup Corporation (VIC).
author: Tri Tuc

title: VISpectacular recovery at the end of the session, VN-Index narrowed the decline to more than 16 points
sapo: The most surprising thing in today's session was the "VinGroup" group of stocks that changed color so quickly.
content:
After two quite positive recovery sessions, the stock market had the first trading session of the week with not very positive developments.Selling pressure narrowed in the morning session, helping VN-Index's downward momentum narrow in the morning session even though the red color was still present.However, in the afternoon session, the situation turned around when the selling force burst out and spread strongly to many stock groups.This caused the index to break through the bottom of 1,449 points last week before narrowing the decline at the end of the session.
The sharp decline in today's session mainly came from the negative developments of the Bluechips group.In the VN-30 group today, there are only 2 codes that maintain the green color, with a fairly thin increase amplitude, and 4 codes stand at reference, the rest are in red covering the entire group of stocks.Among them, a series of strong falling factors pulled down the index, most notably a series of banking codes such as VPB, TCB, and VCB which simultaneously took away more than 1 point from the index.
The most surprising thing in today's session was the "Vin" group of stocks that changed color so quickly.Before the ATC session, the trio of VIC, VHM and VRE were the biggest factors causing the general market to plummet when they simultaneously fell deeply.There was even a time when VIC dropped almost all of its amplitude to the price range near the bottom in March 2020, VHM fell below the bottom in last April and VRE hit the bottom in May.
However, unexpected demand during the ATC session caused this group to change color in an instant.At the end of the session, VIC dropped from the floor to stand at reference level, VHM also narrowed its decline to 0.5%, VRE decreased by 1%.
The banking group today is under strong profit-taking pressure.In the entire group, only 3 stocks maintained their upward momentum, the rest were all red.The strongest declines were TCB (-5.2%), VIB (-4.6%), TPB (-4.1%), VCB (-2.7%).Besides, a series of other banking codes also dropped sharply by over 1%.
The stock group had similar developments as the downward trend still dominated the trend even though differentiation still occurred.Many stocks dropped sharply such as HCM (-6.8%), VCI (-3.8%), VND (-2.7%).Besides, there are still stocks that maintain good upward momentum such as SSI, CSI, and AAS.
In line with oil price developments, oil and gas stocks today also dropped quite sharply.In particular, BSR, PVT, and PVC all decreased deeply with a margin of over 1%.According to experts, the evolution of oil and gas prices in the near future will largely depend on the level of tension between Russia and Ukraine and the EU's measures to ban oil imports.Therefore, investors who have disbursed shares continue to hold oil and gas stocks and closely monitor geopolitical developments to take appropriate actions.
While most industry groups had negative developments, a bright spot appeared in the construction stocks group with a series of positive trading codes.For example, VCG, FCN, CTD, PHC, C4G,... all maintained the green color with an increase of over 1%.Coal stocks also showed positive signs when they simultaneously increased.Most notably, NBC and TVD both increased by over 3.6%.
At the end of the trading session, VN-Index decreased 16 points (1.37%) to 1,155 points.HNX-Index decreased slightly by 0.87 points to 277 points and UPCoM-Index decreased by 0.71 points to 88 points.Liquidity on HOSE is still quite low with matching value reaching 11,445 billion VND during the session.
Foreign investors' transactions today did not have many fluctuations when foreign investors only net bought nearly 400 million VND in the entire market, of which they net bought 5.7 billion VND on HOSE, slightly net sold 2.8 billion VND on HNX and net sold more than 2.5 billion VND on UPCoM.
author: Minh Minh

title: Self-trading Securities companies sold a net of more than 620 billion VND, the duo VIC and VHM were sold strongly
sapo: Proprietary trading Securities company sold a net of 13.7 million shares, worth 624 billion VND in the session on May 18.
content:
According to statistics from HoSE, in the trading session on May 18, the self-trading sector of securities companies (CTCK) bought 5.7 million shares, worth 233.5 billion VND, and sold 19.5 million shares, worth 857.7 billion VND.Thus, self-trading securities companies sold a net of 13.7 million shares, worth 624 billion VND.
The stocks that were sold strongly were Vingroup's VIC with a net sale value of 57 billion VND, VHM shares of Vinhomes were also sold for more than 50 billion VND.Many stocks in the VN30 were sold strongly such as HPG, VPB, MSN, VNM...
On the contrary, stocks that were traded by securities companies net bought in the session on May 18 including BCM, PVT, REE, GMD, BMI... However, the net purchase value was low, the highest was Becamex IDC's BCM shares with 7.4 billion VND.

In agreement transactions, this block bought 20,020 units and sold 500,000 units, worth 541 million VND and 15.8 billion VND, respectively.
The stock market has mixed movements.HoSE had the second consecutive gaining session, VN-Index increased 12.39 points to 1,240.76 points.On the contrary, HNX-Index decreased 5.6 points and UPCoM-Index decreased 1.16 points.
Market liquidity was at the same level as the previous session, total matched order value reached 15,162 billion VND, HoSE alone reached 12,968 billion VND.
author: According to Thuy Yen

title: Vingroup (VIC) completed issuing 525 million USD of international bonds to supplement capital for VinFast
sapo: Thus, Vingroup has completed the first step in the plan to mobilize international bonds with an expected maximum total value of 1.5 billion USD.
content:
On May 16, Vingroup (HoSE: VIC) sent a document to the Hanoi Stock Exchange announcing information about international bond issuance.
Accordingly, Vingroup has completed issuing 525 bonds with code VICD2227001 with a 5-year term, with a par value of 1 million USD/1 bond, corresponding to a total issuance value of 525 million USD.The issuance completion date is May 10, 2022, the maturity date is May 10, 2027.The above bonds were issued to the international market based on the provisions of the Securities Act 1933 of the United States and will not be offered for sale or traded in Vietnam.
The above bonds will be repurchased by the issuing organization at the request of the bond owner or at the request of the issuing organization in cases specifically stipulated in the terms and conditions of the bond.
Thus, Vingroup has completed the first step in the plan to mobilize international bonds with an expected maximum total value of 1.5 billion USD.Initially, the group planned to implement it in the first quarter but then changed the implementation time to 2022 and divided it into 2 phases.
The proceeds will be used to supplement Vingroup's operating capital (pay fees and expenses for the issuance), increase the scale of the group's operating capital through direct capital contribution to VinFast to implement the VinFast automobile production complex project.
As for VinFast, the car company continues to affirm its position with a total sales of more than 6.7 thousand cars in the first quarter, of which VinFast Fadil continues to be the most popular car model in March. After only three months of opening registration, VinFast has received a total of about 60 thousand orders for VF 8 and VF9 globally.On March 29, 2022, VinFast announced the construction of its first overseas manufacturing plant in Chatham County, North Carolina, USA.
In addition, on April 7, VinFast Trading & Investment Pte.Ltd., a subsidiary incorporated in Singapore of Vingroup Corporation, announced that it has submitted a draft preliminary listing application on form F-1 to the United States Securities Commission ("SEC") in connection with the proposed public offering of common shares.The scale of the issuance and the share offering price have not yet been determined.
Regarding the business situation, Vingroup's total consolidated net revenue in the first quarter reached 18,229 billion VND, down 21.7% over the same period last year.According to VIC, if adjusted to add up revenue from large real estate sale transactions recorded in financial income, consolidated net revenue reached VND 25,145 billion, up 0.4% over the same period last year.Pre-tax profit in the first quarter of 2022 reached VND 1,928 billion, and after-tax profit reached VND 512 billion.
As of March 31, 2022, Vingroup's total debt reached VND 306,808 billion, of which total loan debt is VND 139,548 billion (VND 63,604 billion is bond debt).In addition, in September 2021, Vingroup issued 425 million USD of exchangeable bonds with no collateral and fixed interest rate of 3.25%/year.
At the end of the trading session on May 17, VIC stock price was trading at 78,000 VND/share, an increase of 1.3%.
author: Huyen Trang

title: Vingroup (VIC) profit after tax is 512 billion VND in the first quarter of 2022
sapo: If adjusted to add up revenue from large real estate sale transactions recorded in financial income, Vin Group's consolidated net revenue will reach VND 25,145 billion,
content:
On April 28, Vingroup (stock code VIC) announced its Consolidated Financial Statements for the first quarter of 2022.
Total consolidated net revenue in the first quarter reached 18,229 billion VND, down 21.7% over the same period last year.According to VIC, if adjusted to add up revenue from large real estate sale transactions recorded in financial income, consolidated net revenue reached VND 25,145 billion, up 0.4% over the same period last year.
Pre-tax profit in the first quarter of 2022 reached VND 1,928 billion, and after-tax profit reached VND 512 billion.
As of March 31, 2022, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 441,367 billion, an increase of 3.0% compared to the beginning of the year.Equity reached VND 134,558 billion.
In Technology - Industry activities, in the Vietnamese market, VinFast continues to affirm its position with a total sales of more than 6.7 thousand vehicles in the first quarter, of which VinFast Fadil continues to be the most popular car model in March.
After only three months of opening registration, VinFast has received a total of about 60 thousand orders for VF 8 and VF9 globally.On March 29, 2022, VinFast announced the construction of its first overseas manufacturing plant in Chatham County, North Carolina, USA.
In Trade and Service activities, the residential real estate sector continues to be a bright spot.During the period, Vinhomes continued to launch 1,500 apartments in two buildings P1 and P3 of the Vinhomes Ocean Park project, reaching an absorption rate of 80% by the end of March. At the Vinhomes Grand Park project, 74 low-rise commercial service villas were 100% sold out after only one week of opening.
For the retail real estate sector, on April 28, Vincom Retail officially opened Vincom Mega Mall Smart City - the fourth Mega Mall shopping center in Hanoi.
Regarding the resort tourism sector, Vinpearl's operations recovered strongly during the quarter.The total number of room nights sold increased by 23% over the same period last year thanks to a sharp increase in domestic tourists during the holidays.
In addition, in early March, VinBus officially put into operation the first electric bus route connecting to the public passenger transport system in Ho Chi Minh City.At the same time, in Hanoi, VinBus has also deployed 3 more bus routes from the beginning of 2022 until now, bringing the total number of electric bus routes in the Capital to 6 routes.
author: Huyen Trang

title: Vingroup (VIC) sets a 2022 plan with record revenue of 140,000 billion VND, profit of 6,000 billion VND
sapo: Vingroup's Board of Directors said it will submit to the General Meeting of Shareholders for approval the 2022 plan with net revenue of about 140,000 billion VND, an increase of 11.4% compared to 2021. The planned profit after tax is about 6,000 billion VND, while in 2021 VIC will lose 7,558 billion VND.
content:
Vingroup Corporation (Stock code: VIC) has just announced documents for the 2022 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Accordingly, Vingroup's Board of Directors said it will submit to the General Meeting of Shareholders for approval the 2022 plan with net revenue of about 140,000 billion VND, an increase of 11.4% compared to 2021. The planned profit after tax is about 6,000 billion VND, while in 2021 VIC lost 7,558 billion VND.
Specifically about the plans for each subsidiary, in 2022, VinFast will introduce smart electric car models to the global market, officially accepting orders for three car models VF 5, VF 8 and VF 9. At the same time, VinFast continues to hand over the VF e34 model to customers in the Vietnamese market and prepares for the handover of VF 8 and VF 9 to the global market from the end of the year.New electric car models are expected to help VinFast continue to maintain its position in the domestic market, quickly building its brand in international markets including the US, Canada and Europe.
For Vinhomes Joint Stock Company (stock code: VHM), after the success of 3 mega urban areas: Vinhomes Ocean Park, Vinhomes Smart City and Vinhomes Grand Park, the company will launch 3 new mega projects in 2022 in big cities with synchronous infrastructure systems, rich in development potential with constantly increasing housing demand.Mega projects and Super projects under the Vinhomes brand will also have large scale, unique landscapes, high-class utility systems and many smart features in operation management.With a stable market foundation, sales in 2022 are expected to grow well.
For Vincom Retail Joint Stock Company (stock code: VRE), in 2022, VRE plans to open Vincom Mega Mall Smart City (Hanoi) and 2 Vincom Plazas.
VIC said that the company will deploy many forms of capital mobilization at home and abroad through many financial tools, effectively control new investment and optimize the efficiency of capital use to serve the Group's business strategy.
In addition, Vingroup's Board of Directors will also submit to the Congress for approval a plan to list bonds issued to the public.Accordingly, the company will list on the Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) all non-convertible corporate bonds, without warrants, not secured by assets and establish direct debt repayment obligations of the Issuing Organization to the public with a total par value of VND 4,375 billion.
Specifically, the bond lots include VND 1,515 billion in VICB2023001 bonds issued on February 18, 2021, VND 1,000 billion in VICB2124001 bonds issued on March 11, 2021, VND 1,860 billion in VICB2124002 bonds issued on March 11, 2021.

title: Vingroup (VIC) has finalized the date for the 2022 annual general meeting of shareholders
sapo: The list of attending shareholders was finalized by VIC on April 7.
content:
According to the latest announcement, Vingroup - JSC (stock code: VIC) has just announced the Resolution of the Board of Directors on organizing the 2022 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Specifically, on May 11, Vingroup will hold the 2022 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders in the form of a video conference.
The list of attending shareholders was finalized on April 7.
Previously, Vingroup announced to delay the 2022 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders by a maximum of two months from April 30, 2022 in accordance with legal regulations.
The reason is so that the Board of Directors, Board of Directors, and departments of the Group have time to more thoroughly prepare related issues when asking for opinions from the General Meeting of Shareholders.
Regarding the business situation, in the context of the complicated Covid-19 epidemic situation, in 2021, Vingroup for the first time had an after-tax loss of more than 7,500 billion VND although EBT was still positive of more than 3,300 billion VND.
The main reason for negative profits is that service businesses such as rental real estate, resorts and entertainment are greatly affected by prolonged quarantine periods.The company also decided to stop producing gasoline cars to focus resources on electric vehicles, incurring a one-time cost.Besides, the cost for Covid epidemic prevention support activities in 2021 alone is nearly 6,100 billion VND.
If not counting the costs arising beyond the plan at the beginning of the year as mentioned above, Vingroup recorded a profit after tax of VND 4,373 billion in 2021, equivalent to 97% of the plan at the beginning of the year.
As of December 31, 2021, Vingroup's total assets reached VND 427,324 billion, equity reached VND 159,147 billion, an increase of 1% and 17% respectively compared to the end of 2020.

title: Reti successfully raised capital from Cyberagent and VicPartners
sapo: RETI - A real estate distribution company that applies technology to help digitize the real estate buying and selling process has signed a seed round investment agreement by two leading investment funds in Vietnam, CyberAgent Capital and VIC Partners.
content:
Established at the end of 2018 by a team of experienced founders in the fields of technology and real estate, RETI is an outstanding startup in the field of real estate distribution with technology applications (Proptech).The goal is to build a seamless real estate distribution model from online to offline (O2O), combining the superiority of technology and human expertise, between traditional and modern real estate distribution methods, improving the efficiency and professionalism of Sale Agents/Brokers, thereby indirectly improving the experience of customers/real estate buyers.RETI's vision is to become the leading trusted real estate distributor with technology applications in Vietnam and beyond in the region.
RETI is increasingly proving its effectiveness in its business model when chosen by a series of large investors in Vietnam as a strategic partner.Currently, RETI is the official strategic distribution agent for projects of Sun Property - a member of Sun Group in the markets of Hanoi, Thanh Hoa and Phu Quoc.In 2021, RETI will achieve 10-fold growth compared to 2020 and expand its chain of real estate trading floors - RETI Hub in potential markets such as Hanoi, Hai Phong, Thanh Hoa, Bac Ninh, Phu Quoc and Saigon.It is expected that in 2022, the RETI Hub chain will be further developed in other major cities and provinces such as Hai Duong, Hoa Binh, Ha Nam, and Da Nang for easier and more transparent access for customers.
RETI Hub system in major cities in Vietnam
Along with that, with the orientation "Anyone can become a professional Sale Agent", RETI has developed the RETIZY mobile application for the real estate sector, creating a platform to connect and empower all users in all fields to become a professional real estate broker, helping them easily create passive income sources.With the RETIZY application, users can share opportunities and entrust customers, receive attractive commissions when customers make successful transactions;Access shopping cart with thousands of high-end products, full information and transparency;Participate in courses to improve real estate consulting skills;Track sales performance instantly.RETIZY is currently available on CH Play and App Store, users can easily download by searching the keyword "RETIZY" on the app store.
RETIZY - Professional application for Real Estate customers and brokers
Established at a time when Vietnam's real estate market was booming in all aspects, but those interested were overwhelmed by many different sources of information.Grasping the needs and understanding the real estate market in the country, RETI gradually realizes its mission of helping investors bring products to customers with professional overall solutions and applying technology to bring breakthrough experiences, helping customers buy and sell real estate safely and effectively, through analysis and predictions with "personalized" elements.
Talking about the motivation, Mr. Nguyen Anh Ngoc - CEO and Co-founder of RETI shared: "The two subjects we realized are having difficulty in the fast-growing real estate market but still lack transparency in each transaction in Vietnam are Sale Agents/Brokers and Customers buying/selling real estate. RETI's goal is to create an Online to Offline (O2O) platform to support the above two customer groups to carry out buying - selling transactions and investments.real estate in the most effective and convenient way."
Shared by CEO of CyberAgent Capital, Mr. Nguyen Minh Tuan: "What attracts me to RETI is the sincerity, passion and market understanding of RETI's co-founders and great leadership team. People who use all their energy day and night to fiercely implement a big vision of transforming the real estate market, bringing real value to millions of Vietnamese people. Together with investors, I am very excited to accompany and support the team.RETI team realizes its vision."
Mr. Tran Tung - CEO of VIC Partners fund said: "I am very impressed with RETI's founding team because of their enthusiasm and long-term vision of applying digital transformation to enhance transparency in primary real estate transactions and bring practical value to both investors, home buyers and brokerage teams. In the context of residential real estate in Vietnam forecast by Mordor Intelligence to grow by an average of 15% per year in the next 5 years,With the current rapid growth rate, RETI has the opportunity to catch up and surpass major competitors in the market."
About CyberAgent Capital
CyberAgent Capital, a member unit of Japanese corporation CyberAgent Inc, currently invests in more than 350 companies globally.Of these, 50 companies are listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.The fund focuses on technology companies from Seed to Series A stages.
Some notable investments of the fund include Kakao Talk (Korea), Tokopedia (Indonesia), Tiki (Vietnam), Foody (Vietnam), Batdongsan.com.vn (http://batdongsan.com.vn/) (Vietnam) and many other companies.
About VIC Partners (VIC)
Established in 2017, VIC Partners (VIC) is a startup investment fund created by a group of startup entrepreneurs and leaders of some of the leading businesses in Vietnam.VIC invests in businesses at the seed round stage (Seed) to Pre-Series A. In addition, VIC also actively supports startups in many aspects such as raising capital, finding partners, expanding markets, recruiting and developing products.
With the slogan "Built by Founders, for Founders", up to now, VIC has invested and accompanied many founders on the journey of building businesses from scratch, including TopCV, Ladipage, CoolMate, Schola Kids.

title: The "billion dollar" fund managed by Dragon Capital was removed from the top 10 portfolios, increasing the amount of money held to the highest level since Lunar New Year
sapo: As for VIC, this is the first time in many years that this stock has left the top 10 of VEIL.In the previous week (March 2, 2022), VEIL still held VIC with a proportion of 3.89%, equivalent to about 29.5 million VIC shares.While at the end of 2021, VEIL held about 34.3 million VIC shares.
content:
Vietnam Enterprise Investments Limited (VEIL), the largest fund managed by Dragon Capital, has just released an operational update report with many notable points.
As of March 3, 2022, VEIL's asset scale reached 2.63 billion USD, of which the fund's cash proportion was up to 2.59%, equivalent to 68.1 million USD, this is the largest amount of money Dragon Capital has held since the Lunar New Year until now.
The move to increase the proportion of VEIL's money took place in the context of recent market fluctuations that were relatively unpredictable due to information from the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
The top 10 largest stocks in the VEIL portfolio notably have the appearance of MBB with a proportion of 3.51%, replacing VIC which is no longer in the top.
On March 1, Dragon Capital announced information about becoming a major shareholder of MBB when the fund group managed by Dragon Capital holds a total of nearly 189.3 million MBB shares, equivalent to an ownership ratio of more than 5%.Among them, VEIL is the fund holding the most MBB with more than 41.4 million shares, corresponding to an ownership ratio of approximately 1.1%.
VIC is no longer in the top 10 largest stocks of VEIL
As for VIC, this is the first time in many years that this stock has left the top 10 of VEIL.In the previous week (March 2, 2022), VEIL still held VIC with a proportion of 3.89%, equivalent to about 29.5 million VIC shares.While at the end of 2021, VEIL held about 34.3 million VIC shares.
Recently, VIC has been one of the strongest net selling foreign stocks in the market.VIC shares also had fluctuations that were not really positive.At the end of the March 10 trading session, VIC's market price was only 79,100 VND/share, down 17% compared to the beginning of the year and down nearly 40% compared to the peak set in the middle of last year.
Regarding business activities, in 2021, VinGroup has an after-tax loss of more than 7,500 billion VND although EBT is still positive of more than 3,300 billion VND.
The main reason for negative profits is that service businesses such as rental real estate, resorts and entertainment are greatly affected by prolonged quarantine periods.The company also decided to stop producing gasoline cars to focus resources on electric vehicles, incurring a one-time cost.Besides, the cost for Covid epidemic prevention support activities in 2021 alone is nearly 6,100 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Steel, fertilizer and coal stocks simultaneously rose to the ceiling, the duo VIC and VHM "pulled down" VN-Index
sapo: Today was a convincing gaining session for steel stocks as the market price increased along with clearly improved liquidity.Similarly, many coal and fertilizer stocks also recorded a full increase
content:
The afternoon session took place with selling pressure continuing to increase on large capitalization stocks. The market at times sank deeply into the red and lost the 1,490 point mark.However, the strong increase of the steel industry's "big brother" HPG (closing up 2.8% to 47,200 VND) helped VN-Index maintain this important milestone.
The duo of VIC, VHM and many bluechips such as BID, CTG, BCM, VCB, VJC, MSN, NVL... all fell, negatively impacting the market.On the contrary, in addition to HPG, GAS, DPM, DCM, HSB, MBB are large stocks with notable increases.Among them, DPM, DCM, and HSG closed at ceiling prices.
The focus of today's session's cash flow poured heavily into fertilizer, coal and steel stocks, helping many stocks upstream in the market increase sharply, with a purple color recorded in many stocks.Today was a convincing gaining session for steel stocks as the market price increased along with clearly improved liquidity.
On the other hand, developments were divergent as some stocks in the securities and banking groups were under strong selling pressure today and turned down while the rest remained green until the end of the session.Similarly, many real estate and construction codes increased well such as FCN, LCG, HUT, VCG, even DRH increased to the ceiling;On the contrary, QCG, KBC, CII, DXG, NBB, CEO closed in the red.
Closing the session, the VN-Index decreased 8.76 points (0.58%) to 1,490.13 points;while HNX-Index increased 0.06% to 440.42 points and UPCom-Index decreased 0.41% to 112.2 points.
The entire market liquidity is at a high average level with the transaction value of 3 exchanges reaching 28,200 billion VND.However, foreign investors' transactions were not really positive as they net sold nearly 800 billion VND on HoSE, the selling force focused on HPG, CTG, VIC...
=======================================================================
Towards the end of the morning session, the market's downward momentum increasingly widened in the context of increased selling pressure, while demand was not willing to chase.Many large stocks such as VIC, VJC, VHM, NVL, VNM, PDR, POW... all fell, holding back the market's upward momentum, in which VIC fell sharply by 2.4%, thereby creating the greatest pressure on the VN-Index with a contribution of nearly 2 points of decline.
Meanwhile, banking stocks also recorded a dominant red color when ACB, BID, CTG, HDB, LPB, MSB, VCB, VIB, VPB all dropped.
In the opposite direction, GAS stock is the locomotive pulling the market up, followed by HPG.In addition, BVH, FPT, MBB, PLX, SSI also increased points to help VN-Index not fall too deeply.
Steel stocks continued to record positive developments, most stocks such as HSG, NKG, SMC, POM, TIS, TLH, and TVN all increased well.Fertilizer stocks also shared the same upward trend, BFC, DPM, DCM, LAS increased with a amplitude of over 4%, even SFG hit the ceiling of 7%.
The coal industry group suddenly woke up this morning when many codes were recorded with impressive increases. TC6, TDN, NBC, THT, MDC are currently increasing at full amplitude while TVD, MDC, HLC are also approaching the ceiling price.
Pausing the morning session, the VN-Index decreased 7.15 points (0.48%) to 1,491.74 points;HNX-Index increased 0.11% to 440.63 points, while UPCom-Index is currently down 0.5% to 112.1 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the transaction value of 3 exchanges reaching more than 16,000 billion VND.
Foreign investors are currently net sellers on HOSE with a value of approximately 240 billion VND, of which HPG is the most net sold stock with a value of 89 billion VND, followed by VIC (54 billion VND), POW (45 billion VND)...
=======================================================================
The first few minutes of the session were quite positive. Strong selling pressure throughout the market caused the VN-Index to turn down right after the ATO session, at one point falling close to the threshold of 1,490 points.
Escalating tensions between Russia and Ukraine and the fact that cash flow is not really ready to return are having a significant impact on investor psychology as well as the momentum of the domestic market.
A series of large stocks such as GVR, KDH, MSN, NVL, PDR, PLX, VIC, VJC, VHM, VRE,... all dropped, making the market easily sink into the red.Stock groups, real estate, construction, seaports, etc. mostly also adjusted, causing VN-Index to lose its support.
Similarly, banking stocks such as BID, CTG, VCB, TPB, TCB, HDB... are currently all down, causing the market to not be able to make a breakthrough.
On the contrary, steel stocks today became the focus when upstream increased, in which HPG is currently increasing 1.4% to 46,550 VND, the most positive contribution to help the market not fall too deeply.Besides that, HSG, NKG, POM, TLH, and SMC all performed quite positively and are rare names going upstream with an increase of more than 3% to 124,400 VND.
The oil and gas group is back after attracting cash flow, PVS, PVC, PVB, OIL, and GAS are all increasing strongly.
At 9:40 a.m., the VN-Index decreased 4.03 points (0.27%) to 1,494.86 points;HNX-Index increased 0.18% to 440.96 points and UPCom-Index decreased 0.41% to 112.2 points.The transaction value of the 3 exchanges currently reaches 5,100 billion VND.

author: Nhien An

title: In the first week of Nham Dan spring, foreign investors strongly net sold nearly a trillion billion in the entire market, the focus of net selling was more than 1,600 billion VIC
sapo: Considering the matching channel, the net selling value of foreign investors this week reached 758 billion VND, and an additional net selling of 156 billion VND on the agreement channel, thereby expanding the overall net selling momentum.
content:
The stock market had a relatively positive trading week after the Lunar New Year holiday.The VN-Index recorded a good increase right from the beginning of the week, thereby easily surpassing the important milestone of 1,500 points.However, the upward momentum somewhat slowed down at the end of the week when large capitalization groups adjusted under selling pressure. VN-Index even struggled, at one point retreating close to the 1,490 point mark before recovering and successfully holding the 1,500 point threshold thanks to traction from some bluechips.
Summarizing the first trading week of spring, VN-Index increased 22.75 points (up 1.54%) and reached 1,501.71, more positive was HNX-Index when it increased 2.44% compared to last week to reach 426.89 points;while UPCoM-Index increased 2.6% to reach 112.54 points.The liquidity of order-matching transactions is still maintained at an average of 25,000 billion VND/session.
In the market trend that is shaking strongly at a major resistance level, foreign investors' trading movements are a minus point as they have a net selling trading week on the Vietnamese market, the net selling value for the whole week reached 915 billion VND.Thus, in the first week of the lunar new year, foreign investors' capital flows showed not very positive signs.
Specifically, in the week of February 7-11, foreign investors mixed net buying and selling in the first three sessions of the year, but then turned to net selling in the last two days of the week with a value significantly higher than the net buying sessions.Considering the matching channel, the net selling value of foreign investors this week reached 758 billion VND, and an additional net selling of 156 billion VND on the agreement channel, thereby expanding the overall net selling momentum.
Looking at each stock code separately, the selling force in early spring of foreign investors focused on bluechips of the Vin family, VIC, with a sudden selling value of over 1,600 billion VND. In addition, HPG shares, after recovering during the week, also recorded net selling pressure of more than 321 billion VND.They also net sold NVL and E1VFVN30 fund certificates with values exceeding 100 billion VND in just 1 trading week, in addition to continued net selling pressure on a number of other stocks such as VHC, NKG, VRE, PVD, HVN...
On the contrary, the focus of net foreign cash flow in the week was recorded in FUEVFVND fund certificates, in addition, other codes such as VHM, GMD, VND, VCB were also net bought hundreds of billions per share.Foreign cash flow also flows into PNJ, VGC, KBC, HCM stocks...
On HoSE, foreign investors mixed net buying and selling in the first 3 sessions of the week, followed by two consecutive net selling sessions with large values, the total net selling value for the whole week reached 1,084 billion VND.Specifically, foreign investors net sold 939 billion VND through order matching on the floor, in addition to continuing to net sell an additional 145 billion VND through agreement transactions.
VIC was the focus of net selling last week with a suddenly high value, up to 1,600 billion VND.The performance of Vin's bluechips last week was not very positive when 5/5 sessions were red, the market price lost nearly 16% of its value.The list of net withdrawals by foreign investors also includes HPG, NVL or E1VFVN30 with values ​​of VND 321 billion, VND 201 billion and VND 109 billion respectively, in which the "big brother" of the steel industry HPG had a flourishing trading week with 4/5 sessions increasing, the market price increased by 12% to 47,150 VND/share (February 11 session).
In addition, foreign investors also net sold shares of VHC, NKG, VRE, and PVD with values ​​all over 50 billion VND.
On the buying side, the prominent codes in the list are fund certificates FUEVFVND (437 billion VND), VHM (175 billion VND), GMD (138 billion VND), VND (125 billion VND), VCB (104 billion VND)... Other stocks on HoSE that were strongly net bought last week can also be mentioned as CTG, PNJ, VGC...
On the HNX, foreign investors had a week of net buying with a recorded value of 56 billion VND, of which they net bought 168 billion VND on the matching order channel and net sold 12 billion VND through agreements.
Foreign investors continued to be the strongest net buyers on the HNX in oil and gas stock PVS with 37 billion VND;It can be seen that the escalation of world oil prices has created expectations that oil and gas businesses will benefit.In addition, the PVI code was also net bought by foreign investors of VND 5 billion.Stocks that were net bought last week also included THG, APS, EVS, CDN, NVB, HUT...
Afternoon selling transactions at HNX recorded the strongest net selling of TNG, CEO and EID shares with values of 14 billion VND, 4 billion VND and 3 billion VND respectively.Followed by IDC, TDN, TIG, VCS, NTP... with a value of less than 1 billion VND
Similarly on UPCoM, foreign investors net bought 113 billion VND, of which trading at the order matching channel when they bought 184 billion VND and sold about 71 billion VND;while a slight net buy of 1 billion VND on the put-through channel.
QNS shares this week were the most net bought by foreign investors with about 53 billion VND, mainly through order matching.In addition, foreign capital flows also came to CTR with a net purchase value of 37 billion VND.The net buying list also includes VEA, VOC, QTP, WSB...
On the selling side, BSR shares this week led the net selling list when foreign investors net sold up to 6 billion VND, all on matching orders.In addition, some stocks that were net sold from foreign investors last week on UPCoM include TCI, AAS, TTN, VTP, SEA...
author: Phuong Linh

title: How many VIC shares are ETFs holding?
sapo: Among domestic ETFs, DCVFM VN30 ETF managed by Dragon Capital currently holds 7.54 million VIC shares, equivalent to 633 billion VND and is the domestic ETF holding the most VIC.
content:
For many years, VinGroup (Stock code: VIC) has always been one of the largest capitalized enterprises in the Vietnamese stock market.With a large influence on the market, most investment funds in Vietnam allocate their portfolios to VIC, especially ETF funds.
According to our estimated data, the holding scale of VIC shares of ETF funds on the Vietnamese stock market is currently about 52.3 million shares, corresponding to a total value of VND 4,390 billion.
In particular, domestic ETF funds use as reference the index sets provided by HoSE such as VN30, VN50 or VN100 currently holding about 8.55 million VIC shares, equivalent to a total value of 719 billion VND.The remaining 43.7 million VIC shares are held by foreign ETFs such as VNM ETF, FTSE Vietnam ETF, Fubon ETF...
Among domestic ETFs, DCVFM VN30 ETF managed by Dragon Capital currently holds 7.54 million VIC shares, equivalent to 633 billion VND and is the domestic ETF holding the most VIC.
Other ETFs such as SSIAM VN30 ETF;SSIAM VN50 ETF (managed by SSIAM), MAFM VN30 ETF (managed by Mirae Asset), KIM Growth VN30 ETF (managed by KIM – Korea), VinaCapital VN100 ETF (managed by VinaCapital) or IPAAM VN100 ETF (managed by IPAAM) hold not too many VIC, only from a few dozen to a few hundred thousand shares.
Among the foreign ETF fund group, Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF from Taiwan (China) currently holds the most VIC with 16.6 million shares, equivalent to a value of 1,395 billion VND.In the Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF portfolio, VIC shares currently account for the largest proportion of the portfolio with 12.07%.
FTSE Vietnam ETF currently holds 12.34 million VIC shares, equivalent to 1,036 billion VND.While VNM ETF also holds nearly 10 million VIC shares, equivalent to 830 billion VND.
iShare ETF and S&P Select Frontier ETF also hold 3.5 million and 1.4 million VIC shares in the portfolio, respectively.
On the market, VIC shares fell quite sharply in recent trading sessions.At the end of the February 10 session, VIC's market price was only 84,000 VND/share, down 12% compared to the end of 2021 and down 34% compared to the peak set in the middle of last year.
Foreign investors have also net sold VIC quite strongly since the beginning of the year until now with the net selling value through the matching channel reaching nearly 1,600 billion VND.
Regarding business activities, in 2021, VinGroup has an after-tax loss of more than 7,500 billion VND although EBT is still positive of more than 3,300 billion VND.
The main reason for negative profits is that service businesses such as rental real estate, resorts and entertainment are greatly affected by prolonged quarantine periods.The company also decided to stop producing gasoline cars to focus resources on electric vehicles, incurring a one-time cost.Besides, the cost for Covid epidemic prevention support activities in 2021 alone is nearly 6,100 billion VND.

title: MSCI Frontier Markets Index maintains the Vietnamese stock portfolio in the restructuring period of the first quarter of 2022, HPG, VIC, VHM, VNM are still in the top largest proportion.
sapo: The top 10 largest stocks in the MSCI Frontier Markets Index portfolio have 4 Vietnamese stocks, including HPG (4.11%), VIC (4.1%), VHM (3.89%) and VNM (2.7%).
content:
MSCI has just announced the periodic portfolio structure report for the first quarter of 2022 with the MSCI Frontier Markets Index basket.
During this restructuring period, MSCI will not have many changes in the composition of the MSCI Frontier Markets Index basket by adding only 1 stock from Sri Lanka to the portfolio.For the Vietnamese market, MSCI Frontier Markets Index does not add or remove any stocks.
Currently, Vietnam is the largest market in the MSCI Frontier Markets Index basket.As of January 31, the Vietnamese market accounted for 30.19% of the index basket, far ahead of the following market, Morocco, with a proportion of only 10.82%.
The top 10 largest stocks in the MSCI Frontier Markets Index portfolio have 4 Vietnamese stocks, including HPG (4.11%), VIC (4.1%), VHM (3.89%) and VNM (2.7%).
MSCI Frontier Markets Index is currently the most important index among MSCI's frontier market tracking indexes when there are quite a few active funds with a scale of hundreds of millions of dollars using this index as a benchmark, such as Schroder International Selection Fund, Templeton Frontier Markets Fund, Morgan Stanley Institutionam Fund, Magna Umbrella Fund,...
The new MSCI Frontier Markets Index index will officially take effect from March 1.

title: Session January 11: Foreign investors suddenly returned to net buying, focusing on "gathering" VIC, DXG while strongly selling FLC, DGC
sapo: Foreign investors focused on net buying in stocks such as VIC, DXG, and VCB while recording net selling in DGC and FLC codes.
content:

The developments were not very positive in the banking, securities and steel groups when many stocks dropped sharply;Meanwhile, cash flow towards real estate and construction stocks caused many stocks to increase to the ceiling such as CEO, DIG, LCG, LDG, NBB, PTC, VPH, D2D, L14...

title: VIC dropped deeply, Vn30-Index lost 10 points in the last trading session of the week
sapo: Bank and real estate stocks are strongly differentiated amid widespread profit-taking pressure.
content:
Real estate stocks distributed strongly today.Many stocks are in the gray, but a number of "purple" codes also appear, making this segment more unpredictable for investors.In the VN30 group, VIC and NVL decreased quite strongly today.Smaller but highly liquid real estate stocks such as PXL, NTB, CLG, PVL, TNT, HPX, and IDC all raced down in price with soaring liquidity.The real estate stocks group has had a strong price increase cycle recently, so great profit-taking pressure has been occurring in this group of stocks.
On the upside, PVR, PPI, LDG, CII, ITA, NDN, HAG saw strong price increases and high liquidity.
The group of banking stocks also differed strongly today.In this group, half of the codes increased and half of the codes decreased.On the upside, TPB, BID, VIB increased more than 1% but did not close at the highest price of the day.
Closing the trading day, VnIndex decreased 4.44 points to 1,464 points;VN30-Index decreased more than 10 points to 1,519 points;HNX-Index lost nearly 2 points and still maintained the milestone of 450 points.Stock market liquidity cooled down to 23 trillion and 2.8 trillion last on HSX and HNX.
=========
The sellers became more aggressive as the stock market approached the final trading hour of the weekend session.Investor psychology during this period always has the scene of "birds afraid of bent branches".When selling pressure occurs, investors often tend to run quickly even though there is no notable news.This causes a situation where when selling pressure occurs, it occurs on a large scale.
At 2:05 p.m., VnIndex only lost 3 points but there were 305 codes decreasing while only 135 codes increased on HoSE;HNX-Index lost 2.1 points but the number of decreasing codes was more than twice the number of increasing codes.The stock market is flooded with red.
======
In the early afternoon, the stock market suddenly came under strong selling pressure.Bluechips dropped deeply, causing VN30-Index to lose 8 points.VIC, PNJ, SSI dropped deeply by ~2%.
=====
The morning session ended in a fairly sustainable green color in banking stocks.After the news that Fitch Ratings upgraded the credit rating of a series of Vietnamese banks, investors' confidence in bank stocks was strengthened, helping to increase presence on a large scale.VCB replaced TPB as the banking stock with the strongest increase in the group at the end of this morning's session.At the end of the morning session, only 4 banking stocks decreased slightly in price, of which EIB lost 0.9%.
The VN30 group is still under strong selling pressure.SSI is under great pressure to take profits as this stock has increased strongly over the past year and today is down nearly 2%.GAS, PNJ, VIC also decreased by over 1%.
Today's session, quite a few stocks "rolling from the top of the pine tree" have reduced the situation of falling to a white floor on the buying side.IDI increased nearly 5% after a series of 8 consecutive sessions of falling to the floor;TNI still dropped deeply but was no longer gray at the end of the morning session...
======
Opening this morning's trading session, many banking stocks increased strongly, in contrast to the selling situation that occurred in many other large stocks.TPB, BID, VCB, CTG...all increased strongly.
The strong rebound in banking stocks has made the stock market brush off worries when the international financial market was quite turbulent yesterday.At 10am, TPB increased by 3.5%;VCB increased by 3.1%;BID increased by 2.6%...
The VN30 group is still quite tense when PNJ, VIC, and GAS adjusted down quite deeply.Currently, nearly half of the codes in the VN30 group are still under strong selling pressure.
The group of food stocks today continued to make a breakthrough.HNG increased 4.5% with liquidity of nearly 18 million shares after just over 1 hour of trading.VHC and SSN also increased strongly with high liquidity.Many stocks in this group are hitting the ceiling but have low liquidity such as BSL, BLF, ICF...

title: There are 39 businesses with a capitalization of over 1 billion USD trading on HoSE, VIC, VHM, VCB and HPG alone have exceeded the 10 billion USD mark.
sapo: Stock market liquidity in September with average session value and trading volume reached about 20,898 billion VND and 710.18 million shares, respectively, down 9.28% in value and up 0.97% in volume compared to the previous month.
content:
Statistics from Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE), at the end of the last trading session of September 2021, the VN-Index reached compared to the beginning of the year.
Industry indexes recording high growth this month include: consumer goods industry (VNCOND) increased by 11.84%, energy industry (VNENE) increased by 8.82% and raw materials industry (VNMAT) increased by 5.76% compared to the previous month.Industry indexes that decreased compared to the previous month included the real estate industry (VNREAL) down 2.80% and the health care industry (VNHEAL) down 8.99%.
Stock market liquidity in September with average session value and trading volume reached about 20,898 billion VND and 710.18 million shares, respectively, down 9.28% in value and up 0.97% in volume compared to the previous month.Thus, in the first 9 months of 2021, the average trading value reached over 19,543 billion VND/session with an average trading volume of 682.42 million shares, corresponding to an increase of 294.93% in value and an increase of 138.29% in volume compared to the same period in 2020.
During the month, the total value and volume of stock transactions reached about 417,958 billion VND and 14.2 billion shares, respectively, down 17.52% in value and 8.21% in volume compared to August. In the first 9 months of the year, the total trading value reached over 3.59 million billion VND and the total trading volume reached over 125.56 billion shares, corresponding to an increase.290.69% in value and an increase of 135.73% in volume compared to the same period in 2020.
Trading stocks of foreign investors, the total trading value of foreign investors in the month reached over 66,229 billion VND, accounting for 7.92% of the total trading value of both buying and selling sides of the entire market;Foreign investors made net sales during the month with a value of nearly 7,910 billion VND.Since the beginning of the year until now, foreign investors have net sold nearly VND 44,680 billion.
In the first 9 months of 2021, the total value and trading volume of foreign investors reached 592,308 billion VND and 12.6 billion shares, respectively.
Market scale on HoSE as of September 30, 2021, there are 488 trading stock codes, including: 401 stock codes, 2 closed-end fund certificate codes, 07 ETF fund certificate codes, 57 guaranteed warrant codes and 21 bond codes.The total volume of listed shares reached over 111.3 billion shares.Listed capitalization value reached more than 5.13 million billion VND, an increase of 2.30% compared to the previous month, reaching about 81.59% of GDP in 2020 (GDP at current prices).
Currently, on HoSE there are 39 enterprises with a capitalization of more than 1 billion USD, including 4 enterprises with a capitalization of over 10 billion USD, including: Vingroup (VIC), Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (VCB), Vinhomes (VHM) and Hoa Phat Group (HPG).

title: Nearly 423 million VIC shares will be additionally traded from September 24
sapo: Market developments, VIC's market price closed on September 20 at 86,700 VND/share, corresponding to a decrease of nearly 17% within the past month.
content:

content:
The trading week September 13 - September 17 witnessed VN-Index's efforts to conquer the strong resistance level of 1,350 points.The market still continues the accumulation trend. Although the indexes at one time excitedly increased sharply by up to 10 points, the rapidly increasing selling pressure caused the market to "cool down".The weekend session recorded that VN-Index successfully surpassed the 1,350 point barrier and remained above this point range until the end of the trading week.VN-Index ended the September 17 session at 1,352.64 points, a slight increase of 0.5% compared to the previous week.
The week's average market liquidity decreased slightly compared to the previous week, down to 26,845 billion VND/session, of which the average transaction value of foreign investors reached 4,833 billion VND/session, accounting for 9% of the total market proportion.Foreign trading value increased by nearly 1,200 billion VND/session this week when 3 ETFs implemented portfolio restructuring: FTSE Vietnam ETF, VNM ETF and Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF.
According to the latest update, FTSE Vietnam ETF added KDH and VCI;VNM ETF added 9 new Vietnamese stocks, including THD, SAB, DGC, KDC, DIG, VND, DPM, PVS, SHS;while Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF added HSG, VND and VCI while removing PHR and PPC from the portfolio.
Returning to foreign transactions last week, this is still a big minus point because they continued to net sell 3,336 billion VND, equivalent to a volume of more than 82 million shares last week.More specifically, last week on the matching order channel, foreign investors net sold 2,953 billion VND on all 3 exchanges;while net selling was 383 billion VND through the agreement.
On September 15, foreign investors suddenly returned to net buying in the entire market, but the net buying value was insignificant compared to the net selling level of the remaining days.In particular, the two sessions of September 16-17 simultaneously recorded net selling exceeding VND 1,200 billion.
Foreign investors' selling force continued to focus strongly on VIC, FUEVFVNF - Vietnam's largest domestic ETF certificate DCVFM VNDiamond ETF and other large-cap stocks such as HPG, VCB, SSI, NVL;On the contrary, net buying focused on stocks THD, VND, SAB, QNS, DIG, PVS... Most of the top net bought stocks are on the new list of ETFs.
On HoSE, foreign investors continued to maintain a net selling streak with a strong increase in value to VND 4,220 billion, of which VND 3,837 billion was traded through order matching on the floor, and the remaining VND 383 billion was net sold through agreement transactions.
The focus of this week's trading was on VIC shares when suddenly foreign investors net sold up to 1,553 billion VND, even in the session on September 16, the net sale was up to approximately 13 million units.Based on the structure of foreign shareholders at VIC, organizations that can sell such a large amount of shares include SK Investment Vina II Pte.Ltd (owns 200 million shares) and Credit Suisse (owns 48.3 million shares).The sudden pressure from foreign investors to sell goods caused VIC's market price to drop nearly 5% last week to 86,800 VND/share, creating the biggest pressure on VN-Index.
Besides, FUEVFVND internal fund certificates were also net sold 366 billion VND.ETFs do not hold these certificates, so this will be the activity of foreign investors.Statistics show that the majority of capital withdrawn from FUEVFVND recently came from Pyn Elite Fund.
Other stocks that were net sold over 200 billion VND during the week included HPG (294 billion VND), VCB (271 billion VND), SSI (249 billion VND), NVL (245 billion VND), STB (236 billion VND)...
On the buying side, VND - a stock in the new addition list of both VNM ETF and Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF this week has been net bought the most with 175 billion VND.Data closed on September 17 showed that Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF is holding 1.32 million VND shares.In addition, the net buying list also includes other new stocks of VNM ETF such as SAB (132 billion VND), DIG (97 billion VND, DGC (76 billion VND)...
Top net buying/selling on HoSE in the week of September 13-17
Bright spot on HNX with foreign investors returning to net buy 737 billion VND in the entire market.Mainly transactions came from the order matching channel with a net buying value of approximately 737 billion VND, while net buying was 1 billion VND on the put-through channel.
The driving force for foreign investors' net buying momentum is the addition of new stocks to the portfolio by ETFs.Among them, the highlight is the sudden net buying value of THD stock with 2.6 million units equivalent to 600 billion VND right from the first days of the week - leading the top buying on the entire market last week.The majority of this transaction comes from VNM ETF.
In addition, two other HNX stocks newly added to the VNM ETF, PVS and SHS, were also net bought by foreign investors of VND 91 billion and VND 54 billion, respectively.Some other stocks with net investment from foreign investors include CEO, EID, DL1, VCS...
There was nothing noteworthy in the selling afternoon trade as no stock code was net sold over 10 billion VND last week.PLC was the stock that foreign investors net sold the most with a value of 6 billion VND, foreign investors also net sold API codes (5 billion VND).BII (4 billion VND), VNR (3 billion VND), NVB (3 billion VND), CDN (3 billion VND)...
Top net buying/selling on HNX in the week of September 13-17
On UPCoM, foreign investors recorded a net purchase value of 147 billion VND, notably the stock code QNS with a net injection of 108 billion VND.
Not only did QNS leaders increase their ownership, foreign investors also strongly net bought QNS shares when QNS's market price was increasing quite strongly.On the market, closing the session on September 17, QNS shares continued to increase to 54,000 VND/share, an increase of more than 30% after 2 months of trading.In addition, foreign capital flows still find ACV shares with a net injection value of 31 billion VND.ACV is one of the airline stocks that has increased in price recently thanks to information about its plan to re-operate regular domestic passenger routes.
On the contrary, the overall net selling value on UPCoM recorded a significant decrease.HPP shares were the most net sold this week with a net selling value of 4 billion VND, besides, VEA and VGI both recorded a net selling value of about 3 billion VND.Some stocks that were net sold from foreign investors last week on UPCoM include MML, LTG, AMS, DDV, MCH...

title: Vinpearl successfully mobilized 425 million USD in bonds that can be converted into VIC shares
sapo: Bonds mature in 2026, interest rate 3.25%/year.
content:
On September 15, Vinpearl successfully offered 425 million USD of international bonds with the option to receive VIC shares.Bonds mature in 2026, interest rate 3.25%/year.
This is the first sustainable bond in the Asian market and has recorded registrations from investors nearly double the size of the bond issued.Proceeds are used to restructure debt, finance current projects or other purposes.
According to the terms of the agreement, the bonds can be converted into common shares of Vingroup Corporation (HoSE: VIC).The conversion price is 109,680 VND, 20% higher than the closing price on September 15.
Credit Suisse, Hong Kong Shanghai Bank (HSBC) and BNP Paribas are the co-underwriting banks for the transaction.HSBC is a sustainable development consulting bank for transactions.
VIC shares closed on September 16 at the price of 87,800 VND/share, down 31% since mid-April. Vinpearl owns 87.5 million VIC shares, equivalent to 2.3% of Vingroup capital.In contrast, Vingroup owns 98.2% of Vinpearl's capital as of June 30.
In June 2018, Vinpearl also issued convertible bonds to Credit Suisse and Deutsche Bank AG worth 450 million USD, with a term of 5 years.This bond has no collateral and has a fixed interest rate of 3.5%/year, and can be converted to VIC shares.This loan has been fully repaid.
Vinpearl is the largest resort hotel chain in Vietnam with nearly 17,000 hotel rooms and villas in 43 establishments nationwide.Last year, Vinpearl launched the VinHolidays brand line in the hotel sector at the Phu Quoc United Center complex.In the entertainment field, Vinpearl repositioned its brand, changing the name Vinpearl Land to VinWonders.
In 2020, Vinpearl's business activities were greatly affected by the Covid-19 pandemic.Consolidated net revenue reached 4,900 billion VND, down 65% compared to 2019. The company's loss after tax was 9,576 billion VND, in 2019 the loss was 4,754 billion VND.
In the first half of this year, Vingroup's hotel, tourism, entertainment and related services business continued to record a loss of VND 4,927 billion, an increase of VND 700 billion compared to the same period last year.
Vingroup, after mobilizing VND 2,600 billion in bonds in July, is expected to use all the proceeds to increase capital for Vinpearl.In addition, in April this year, the group also successfully mobilized 500 million USD in international bonds with the option to receive VHM shares of Vinhomes.
The above international bond has a term of 5 years, matures in 2026 and has a nominal interest rate of 3%/year.The exercise price of the option to receive shares at the issuance date is 123,000 VND/share, determined by 120% of the closing price of VHM shares on April 13.

title: SSI issued 16 new warrants in August, focusing on large capitalization groups such as HPG, VIC, MSN, MWG, VHM...
sapo: In August 2021, SSI Securities announced the issuance of 16 additional covered warrant codes (Covered Warrant – CW), equivalent to 170 million warrants to the market.Of which, 122 million warrants will be officially listed on August 27, 2021.The amount of warrants issued in August also recorded one of SSI's largest primary issuances ever.
content:
In detail, SSI Securities has had 2 warrant issuances, with 16 new warrant codes based on the underlying stock codes including the Group of manufacturing and service companies (HPG, VIC, VRE, MSN, FPT, MWG, PNJ, VHM, VJC, VNM, NVL, KDH) and the Group of banks (VPB, MBB, TCB, STB).All have a term of 5 months.
Accordingly, on August 6, 2021, SSI issued 10 new codes equivalent to 122 million warrants.Currently, these 10 warrants have received a listing decision from the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange and will trade for the first session on this floor on August 27, 2021.
Meanwhile, SSI's 6 warrants issued in the second phase of August 2021 are also being urgently supported by management agencies to complete related procedures to soon be traded in the secondary market.
Details of 10 warrant codes issued Phase 1 - officially listed on the exchange from August 27, 2021
During the initial distribution (IPO), investors can buy CW issued by SSI at all trading locations nationwide, buy Online on SSI's online trading system, or register to buy online at the company's website.After listing, investors can buy and sell CW on the secondary market on HOSE, paying according to the T+2 cycle similar to stocks and fund certificates.If the investor holds the warrant to maturity, the difference will be paid in cash in case the warrant matures in a profitable state.
Details of 6 warrant codes issued in Phase 2 of SSI.
After more than 2 years since the covered warrant product was launched in Vietnam, the warrant market has continuously grown in terms of trading codes and liquidity.Regarding the scale of liquidity, SSI's warrants in particular have had a major breakthrough, from an average trading level of about 100,000 CW units/session in 2019 and 2020, to approximately 200,000 CW units/session by the first half of 2021.
After the last two new issuances in August 2021, SSI also added 16 new warrant codes to the market (currently the market is recording transactions of 48 warrant codes from 5 issuers) with a total scale of 170 million warrant units, and returned to the top of the market in terms of issuance volume.
Talking about the volume and warrants issued this time, SSI representative, Mr. Nguyen Duc Thong - Director of Derivatives Trading - SSI Securities Joint Stock Company said that the company has carefully observed the potential of the underlying stocks as well as listened to investors' needs for warrants issued by SSI.
With the first primary issuance in August 2021, the company focuses more on the group of stocks of manufacturing and service companies, selecting companies with basic fundamentals and good price increase potential to launch corresponding warrant products to help investors have more attractive options.After only one day of initial distribution, FPT, HPG and VHM warrants received a lot of attention from investors with the actual selling ratio/total offered amount reaching 78.08%, 49.02%, 38.97% respectively.
After that, in order to meet the diverse needs of the market, SSI Securities continued to organize the second primary distribution of warrants in August, mainly on the underlying assets of bank stocks.This offering was also very positively received by investors, as shown by the ratio of actual sales/total offering for bank stock warrant codes reaching 24% or more.
SSI representative also expressed his opinion that, in the context of macro factors still supporting economic growth, the biggest risk is that the Covid-19 epidemic situation has become complicated since the end of April until now, investors should use additional investment tools besides underlying securities to simulate risks as well as allocate assets.In particular, after the correction in July, the stock market has not yet determined a clear trend, so investors can use Buy Warrants as a speculative tool with low fees but with the potential to bring high profits.Mr. Thong also recommended that holding CW to maturity may not be the optimal method for investors at this stage but should prioritize short-term trading according to indicators.
For example, with 20 CW codes issued by SSI that mature in 2021, only 2 codes CHPG2014 and CVPB2016 have a holding return that is also the maximum profit (max return) investors can achieve, while the remaining 18 CW codes all have a max return greater than holding return, meaning these CWs all give investors a better and earlier time to take profits thanwith holding until maturity.In particular, there are 3 warrants: CVNM2010, CVRE2014, CVRE2013 that were profitable during the listing period and investors who take profits at the right time can achieve profits from 39% to 116%, while investors holding these warrants until maturity are at risk of losing the entire initial investment capital.
With its outstanding advantage in individual customer base, strong financial potential, quality brokerage team, and modern technology system, SSI always has the advantage in bringing a variety of superior financial products to customers, helping investors have many options to optimize their investments in all market fluctuations.
SSI's capital adequacy criteria are always high, ensuring the ability to pay for warrants for investors, meeting the needs of investors to buy or resell warrants in large quantities, and the system automatically performs market creation operations to ensure warrant liquidity.
