title: Vingroup (VIC) closed the list of shareholders issuing nearly 423 million shares to pay dividends
sapo: The issuance rate is nearly 12.5%.
content:
On August 18, Vingroup (stock code VIC) will finalize the list of shareholders to issue more than 422.8 million shares to pay dividends to shareholders.The release rate is approximately 12.5%.Issuance value at par value is 4,228 billion VND.Issuance capital comes from accumulated undistributed after-tax profits as of December 31, 2020.
Business results, in 2020 Vingroup achieved VND 11,490 billion in revenue, down 15% compared to the previous year.Profit after tax decreased by 41%, to 4,546 billion VND, of which profit after tax recorded for parent company shareholders reached 5,465 billion VND.
As of December 31, 2020, Vingroup had 4,360 billion VND in undistributed after-tax profits.In addition, the company also has 35,411 billion VND of equity surplus, 7,235 billion VND of other owner's capital and nearly 68 billion VND in other funds belonging to owner's equity.
In the first 6 months of 2021, Vingroup achieved VND 61,746 billion in revenue, an increase of 59.4% over the same period.Profit after tax increased by 2.2% to 1,433 billion VND, of which profit after tax belonging to parent company shareholders reached over 3,300 billion VND.
On the market, VIC shares are currently trading around 114,000 VND/share.
author: Nguyen Phuong

title: VIC increased sharply, the value of shares held by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong reached approximately 220,000 billion VND
sapo: At the price of 114,500 VND/share, VinGroup's market capitalization reached nearly 387,300 billion VND, equivalent to 16.7 billion USD and is the largest capitalized enterprise in the Vietnamese stock market.
content:
The August 3 trading session recorded a strong breakthrough in the Vietnamese stock market when the VN-Index closed up 18.22 points (1.39%) to 1,332.44 points.An important contribution to the market's increase was VinGroup (VIC) stock, which increased by 7,000 VND (+6.5%) to 114,500 VND, and VIC is also the stock with the most positive impact on the general market.
At the price of 114,500 VND/share, VinGroup's market capitalization reached nearly 387,300 billion VND, equivalent to 16.7 billion USD and is the largest capitalized enterprise in the Vietnamese stock market.
The sharp increase in VinGroup stock price also means that Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong's assets on the stock exchange continue to increase.
Currently, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong holds about 1.9 billion VIC shares, equivalent to approximately 220,000 billion VND (about 9.5 billion USD).The sharp increase in VIC stock price in the August 3 session alone helped Mr. Vuong's stock value increase by about 13,400 billion VND.
Meanwhile, according to Forbes data, Mr. Vuong's assets are currently about 7.8 billion USD and is the 342nd richest person in the world.
The value of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's assets on the stock exchange alone has now surpassed the capitalization of many large Vietnamese enterprises such as Hoa Phat, Vinamilk, Techcombank, Novaland...
According to the newly published financial report, VinGroup's total consolidated revenue in the second quarter reached VND38,451 billion - an increase of 65% over the same period last year, with most business sectors growing, especially the Real Estate and Industry sectors with increases of 62% and 53%, respectively.Accumulated for 6 months, Vingroup's consolidated net revenue reached 61,770 billion VND, an increase of 59% over the same period last year.
Pre-tax profit in the second quarter of 2021 reached VND 3,618 billion, up 34% over the same period;Accumulated 6 months reached 6,403 billion VND, up 4.6% over the same period last year.
Profit after tax in the second quarter reached 565.5 billion VND, down 36.9% over the same period in 2020, cumulative 6 months reached 1,433 billion VND, a slight increase compared to the same period in 2020.
Profit after tax of parent company shareholders in the second quarter reached 1,211 billion VND, down 40.8% over the same period in 2020, cumulative 6 months reached 3,305 billion VND, up 33% over the same period in 2020.

title: Session 7/23: Foreign investors net sold for the 5th consecutive session on HoSE, still diligently "discharging" VIC, KDH
sapo: Today's session, after many unsuccessful breakthroughs when facing the strong resistance zone of 1,295 points, VN-Index has retreated to below the threshold of 1,270 points.
content:
In the trading session on July 23, red dominated right from the opening, pushing the indexes back below the reference mark.Right after that, thanks to the support from some bluechips, the VN-Index at one point rebounded to the green price zone.
However, the green color did not last long as the index's downward momentum continued to widen towards the end of the afternoon session.VN-Index, after many failed breakthroughs when facing a strong resistance area of ​​1,295 points, finally retreated to below the threshold of 1,270 points.Red covered the general market with 282 codes decreasing on the HOSE, while only 97 codes increased and 38 codes remained unchanged at the reference price.
The sellers also became dominant in the VN30 basket with 26 stocks simultaneously decreasing in price, completely overwhelming the 4 increasing codes, recording a decrease of 26.95 points in score.The sharpest decrease was VRE with a decrease of 4.3%.Followed by VPB, TCH, VCB, MSN, SSI, TCB, VHM, HPG and CTG with a decrease above the 3% threshold.On the contrary, pillar codes such as VNM, FPT, POW, STB are still trying to support the index, in which STB is the most active code with an increase of 2.5%, even reaching the ceiling at times.
On the other hand, on HoSE, there are still some codes that are stronger than the general market, rising to the ceiling such as CSV, DAH, HOT, ILB, PGI, SII, TCD, CIG...
Market liquidity still does not have many significant signs, the transaction value on HoSE is only over 19,300 billion VND.It seems that stock holders are expecting a strong increase while money holders have not yet found market confirmation to decide to invest.
At the end of the session, VN-Index decreased 24.84 points (1.92%) to 1,268.83 points, HNX-Index decreased 1.37% to 301.77 points, UpCOM-Index decreased 1.4% to 84.37 points.
One of the major negative points of the stock market recently is the heavy net selling pressure from foreign investors.In the last 3 sessions, they have turned around to net sell hundreds to trillions of dong in each session across the market.Today's session still recorded a net sale of 172 billion VND from foreign investors.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold 204 billion VND.
Regarding specific value, they continued to be the strongest net sellers of VIC with a value of nearly 188 billion VND.Following is still the code KDH with a net withdrawal of 75 billion VND.Some other stocks that recorded a discharge of over 30 billion VND were HPG (41 billion VND), STB (40 billion VND), SSI (39 billion VND), HSG (37 billion VND), PTB (34 billion VND).
On the contrary, the two codes attracting the strongest foreign cash flow are MSB (129 billion VND) and VNM (107 billion VND).Foreign capital flows also came to DGC (78 billion VND), NLG (31 million VND), VCB (23 billion VND).FUEVFVND fund certificates also received a net inflow of 13 billion VND.
HNX recorded the 5th consecutive net buying session of foreign investors, today's net buying value reached more than 14 billion VND.
They still have the strongest collection of DXS with nearly 7 billion VND.Some codes that recorded transactions in the same direction include MSB (6 billion VND), BSI (4 billion VND), BVS (3.7 billion VND), THD (1 billion VND)...
On the selling side, codes with strong net withdrawal were VND (3.7 billion VND), SHB (1.2 billion VND), ART (1 billion VND).Following, foreign investors also dumped VCS (992 million VND), CEO (880 million VND), INN (575 million VND), EID (350 million VND)...
Statistics on UPCoM, foreign investors net bought more than 17.5 billion VND in today's session.
There are 3 stock codes with a net investment of over 1 billion VND in foreign capital, of which the strongest is CTR with more than 7 billion VND in net buying, VEA (5.4 billion VND), VTP (3.4 billion VND).
On the opposite side, DCS code had the strongest net discharge with a value of approximately 590 million VND.The net selling list also includes BVB, QNS, MML, SCL, NTC, NS3...
author: Phuong Linh

title: Session July 21: Foreign investors net sold 1,390 billion VND, focusing on selling 11.4 million VIC shares
sapo: At the end of the session, VN-Index decreased 2.5 points (0.2%) to 1,270.79 points, HNX-Index decreased 0.1% to 300.8 points, only UpCOM-Index increased slightly 0.72% to 84.3 points.
content:
The increase in yesterday's trading day helped the indexes open the July 21 session with a more positive sentiment.However, after an initial increase when buyers dominated, the market returned to struggling continuously around strong support and resistance levels.During most of the other session, every time the VN-Index reached near the threshold of 1,280 points, it would retreat a beat.
In the afternoon session, the market traded in a more gloomy tone.The indexes simultaneously lost their green color in the middle of the session, at one point the VN-Index fell nearly 7 points when the pressure to place sell orders increased sharply. Immediately afterwards, reciprocal demand appeared to bring the market back to a state of balance, not closing at the lowest decrease level.
Poor trading combined with the clear differentiation of banking, securities, and steel groups at the end of the session caused the market to lose its support and sink into the red at the end of the session.VCB, CTG, STB, HDB, HCM, SSI, HPG, TLH... all dropped in today's session.
In the VN30 basket, the sellers completely overwhelmed the buyers with 21 discount codes, only 9 codes recorded a green color, the VN-30 index also closed the session down 4.48 points.The group of Vin stocks today traded quite actively, becoming a pillar of support to narrow the decline of the VN-Index with an increase margin of over 1%.
Cash flow still appears not ready to return, liquidity on HoSE alone today is just over 16,000 billion VND.
At the end of the session, VN-Index decreased 2.5 points (0.2%) to 1,270.79 points, HNX-Index decreased 0.1% to 300.8 points, only UpCOM-Index increased slightly 0.72% to 84.3 points.
The minus point today is foreign investors as they sold a record net of 1,392 billion VND across the market.Notably, VIC shares were net withdrawn by foreign investors of nearly VND 1,180 billion with a volume of more than 11.4 million shares, mainly through agreement transactions.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold 1,391.52 billion VND in today's session.In particular, in addition to code VIC, foreign investors also focused on net selling in banking stocks such as MSB (136.5 billion VND), CTG (73.8 billion VND), HDB (45.9 billion VND), STB (32.3 billion VND).Stock codes also recorded net selling such as VCI (13.7 billion VND), HCM (12.3 billion VND), SSI (12.2 billion VND).
On the contrary, two other Vin codes, VHM and VRE, were bright spots with a net withdrawal of nearly 76.5 billion VND and 57.8 billion VND respectively in today's down session. The net injection of foreign investors helped this stock close in the green.Behind are HSG, HPG, VCB, VJC, DGW...
On the HNX, foreign investors net bought nearly 9.66 billion VND
In terms of specific value, they were the strongest net sellers of BVS with 1.4 billion VND.Some other stocks that recorded a discharge of less than 1 billion VND were NBC, DXP, VCS, SHB, PMC...
On the contrary, the two codes attracting the strongest foreign cash flow are DXS (7.6 billion VND) and THD (2.6 billion VND).Foreign capital flows also came to VND (985 million VND), VNR (464 million VND), BAX (392 million VND)...
Statistics in the UPCoM market show that the selling force appeared stronger than yesterday's session when foreign investors sold a net of 9.71 billion VND.
They still sold the most VEA with 11.4 billion VND, QNS (2.5 billion VND),  ABI (1.6 billion VND), ACV (1 billion VND).NHT, WSB, and CTR also saw slight net withdrawals in today's session.
On the buying side, the strong net absorber code is VTP (5.5 billion VND).Following, foreign investors also lightly bought MCH (291 million VND), TCI (266 million VND), VAB (232 million VND), SAS (154 million VND)...
author: Phuong Linh

title: Session July 20: Foreign investors net sold 325 billion VND on HoSE, focusing on selling MSB, VIC, NVL
sapo: Notably, on HNX, foreign investors strongly net bought more than 341 billion VND of PVI shares. This net purchase has caused foreign cash flow to reverse to a positive value.
content:
The stock market opened on July 20 with green returning to the indexes after evaporating nearly 56 points yesterday.However, the bull traps did not last long, the buying force was not enough with massive selling pressure, the indexes quickly turned down and were in the red for most of the morning session.At the end of the session, the VnIndex once dropped deeply by 17 points but immediately recovered slightly, only dropping 12 points.
In the afternoon session, the market suddenly changed direction when rising demand pulled many stocks back to recovery.Transactions flourished in most industry groups.The trio "bank, securities, steel" all regained their green color after wiping the floor yesterday, some stocks even rose to the ceiling and closed the session in purple such as AGR, SSI, ART, HSG, VAB.
Support pillars lead the market's upward momentum.The VN30 basket recorded 28/30 stocks gaining points, of which SSI was in the ceiling purple.Yesterday's swallow wing was KDH and VRE stocks, which were the only two codes that decreased in the basket.
Closing today's session, the whole exchange recorded 588 codes increasing, 231 codes decreasing and 866 codes unchanged at reference price.As for HoSE, the number of increasing codes was completely overwhelming with 281 codes while only 94 codes decreased and 40 codes remained unchanged at the reference price.
Closing the trading session on July 20, VN-Index made a spectacular comeback, increasing 29.78 points (2.39%) to 1,273.29 points, HNX-Index increased 2.69% to 299.91 points, UpCOM-Index increased 1.33% to 83.69 points.
Foreign investors' trading today was a bright spot when they returned to a slight net buying of nearly 17 billion VND.Notably, on HNX, foreign investors strongly net bought more than 341 billion VND of PVI shares. This net purchase has caused foreign cash flow to reverse to a positive value.Besides, at HoSE and UpCOm, foreign investors continued to sell goods strongly in today's session.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold 325.17 billion VND.In particular, cash flow focused out of banking stocks such as MSB (120.76 billion VND), VCB (39.3 billion VND), CTG (25.3 billion VND).Following are VIC, NVL, VRE, KDH, VHM.
On the contrary, STB continued to be a bright spot with a net absorption of nearly 70.7 billion VND in today's rising session.In addition, foreign investors also strongly net bought steel codes such as HPG with a net purchase value of more than 57.5 billion VND, HSG was also injected with an additional 50.1 billion VND.
On HNX, thanks to the amount of money poured into PVI, the trading value of foreign investors recorded a net purchase of 343.3 billion VND.
In addition to PVI, VND was also net bought approximately 12 billion VND.The list of slight net purchases also includes SHB (617 million VND), VNR (355 million VND), HLC (285 million VND)...
Meanwhile, on the selling side, three stock codes recorded strong net sales: PVS (6 billion VND), SHS (2.3 billion VND), THD (1.1 billion VND).Besides, BVS, BSI, DXS, HHC, DNM and BII also saw net withdrawals during the session.
At UPCom, foreign investors had a lighter net sale than yesterday's session, the recorded value reached 1.2 billion VND. There were 4 stocks with foreign capital withdrawing over 1 billion VND: VEA (5.2 billion VND), QNS (2.6 billion VND), ABI (1.8 billion VND), ACV (1.2 billion VND).
On the contrary, VTP received a net injection of more than 6 billion VND from foreign investors, and SBS also attracted a positive cash flow of 1.7 billion VND.The net buying list also includes BSR, OIL, BVB, PGB.
author: Phuong Linh

title: Session July 16: Foreign investors continued to buy net, focusing on "gathering" NVL and VIC
sapo: On the opposite side, the discharge force of foreign investors continued to be strong in banking stocks such as CTG (64.4 billion VND), VCB (39.3 billion VND), STB (19 billion VND), HDB (17.1 billion VND).
content:
Continuing the upward momentum gained from the end of today's session, the market on July 16 opened with a widespread green color that was maintained throughout the day.The increasingly strong selling pressure gradually narrowed the upward momentum of Vn-Index and then the trading situation became tense.The struggle in the market is clearly shown with 816 codes remaining unchanged, 491 codes increasing and 389 codes decreasing on both exchanges.
Liquidity is still quite weak with the total market transaction value reaching 18,836 billion VND.On HoSE alone, the transaction value only reached 15,458 billion VND, significantly lower than the average liquidity in the past 1 month.At HNX it is 2,326 billion VND and UpCOM is about 1,050 billion VND
The VN30 basket ended the session with 19 increasing codes, 10 decreasing codes and 1 unchanged code.MSN led the increase by exceeding 4.8%, while VIC and PDR also increased by more than 3.7% and 3.4%, respectively.On the contrary, red codes mainly decreased slightly.
Banking stocks such as VPB, HDB, MSB closed at green prices with an increase of 1%, a decline was recorded in large capitalization codes in the VN30 basket such as CTG down 1%, STB down 1.2% or BID down 0.5%, VCB stood at reference.
The remaining industries also have differentiated transactions such as real estate, construction, oil and gas...
In the real estate industry, HDC, NTB, and SZC all increased to the ceiling.Many codes on this day also had quite impressive increases such as VIC(3.7%), VNI (10%).
Closing the trading day on July 16, VN-Index increased 5.39 points (0.42%) to 1,299.31 points, HNX-Index increased 0.48% to 307.76 points, UpCOM-Index increased 0.41% to 85.33 points.
Foreign trading today continued to be a bright spot, recording a net purchase of 65.07 billion VND on all 3 exchanges.NVL is the stock with the strongest net attraction with a value of nearly 89.7 billion VND.Followed by VIC with more than 83.7 billion VND of net buying value.Notably, CTR stock today suddenly received a net injection of about 5.2 billion VND from foreign investors.
On HoSE, foreign investors net bought 66.89 billion VND in today's session.Up to 11 stocks recorded a net injection of over 10 billion VND.Consumer goods stocks are quite popular with MSN (58.8 billion VND), VNM (44.8 billion VND), SBT (7 billion VND).Two certificates, FUEVFVND and E1VFVN30, were also net bought for VND 40.2 billion and VND 12.4 billion, respectively.
On the opposite side, the discharge force continued to be strong in banking stocks such as CTG (64.4 billion VND), VCB (39.3 billion VND), STB (19 billion VND), HDB (17.1 billion VND).VHM and VCI codes were also net sold with a value of about 35-39 billion VND.
Only at HNX, foreign investors sold a net of 5.32 billion VND, of which VND and SHB were the strongest net sellers with values ​​of 3.6 billion VND and 2.5 billion VND, respectively.The list of net withdrawals today also includes NDN, BSI, DXS, BVS.
The buying power was very weak as no code recorded a net purchase of over 1 billion VND, TDN led with a net absorption value of over 850 million.
At UpCOM, foreign investors net bought 3.5 billion VND. In addition to CTR, QNS continued to net buy more than 4.6 billion VND.Strong net absorbers also include VTP (3.2 billion VND), ACV (2 billion VND), besides HPP, SGB, SBS, SCG.
In the opposite direction, VEA suddenly had a net sale of 10.6 billion VND in the put-through session, completely overwhelming the net selling volume in other stocks such as BSR, ABI, MML, DHD.

title: VnIndex decreased slightly at the end of the session, VCB, MSN, VIC increased sharply, "weighing" CTG, TCB
sapo: A large amount of money that the parties lowered margin in the recent period is waiting for tomorrow's session, so continuously monitoring the market to adapt quickly is what investors should do now.
content:
Although the two "big guys" CTG and TCB adjusted down quite deeply today, in return, the trio of VCB, MSN, and VIC increased strongly, helping the market balance.At the end of the session, VnIndex decreased slightly by 1.5 points and ended the NAV closing period for the second quarter of 2021 quite brilliantly with a strong increase of all indices compared to the end of the previous quarter.It is expected that securities companies will soon have a period of brilliant business results reports when the market ends the session without a deep correction like today.
The current stock market liquidity is not too high because the fear of the peak area still exists.Although the buying side still dominated most of the trading session, the cash flow probably waited for the NAV closing session to end to assess the second quarter business results of the "money trading kings" before pushing forward.According to the opinions of securities companies that we reported earlier, on the NAV closing day, many parties usually have to lower their proportions, but after the NAV closing period ends, the cash flow returns to hunting for valuable assets.Current stocks are still attractive compared to other investment channels, so the market still has high expectations.
With the indexes not falling deeply today amid a lot of positive macro information, investors need to prepare scenarios for tomorrow's session to avoid being left out of the market if the market overheats or be ready to improvise if a deep adjustment to attract demand takes place.No matter what, a large amount of money that the parties lowered margin in the recent period is waiting for tomorrow's session, so monitoring developments to adapt quickly is what investors should do now.
===================
Although the buying side was weak at the end of the morning session, the selling side was still very determined to maintain confidence in the market.VnIndex was only "red" for a moment and then recovered.Currently, MWG is increasing very well above $4;MSN increased sharply by 2.8% and VCB increased by 1.8%, helping the market clearly balance between buyers/sellers.The market is always changing roles between stocks.
============
During the morning session, VnIndex increased quite steadily at +7 to +9 points.However, the market is lacking the attraction to increase stronger.For more than an hour, many stocks remained at their morning increase to "welcome passengers" who wanted to board the train.However, buyers also seem to be very afraid of entering new markets at this high price base.By the end of the morning session, sellers seemed to have lost patience, VnIndex "fell" slightly to only increase 5 points.
Unlike the stable increase from morning until now on HoSE, HNX has adjusted down throughout the trading session.The red color that dominated the HNX for most of the morning session was also a barrier that made investors who had not yet "boarded" VnIndex 1,400 points more cautious in deciding to enter the market.
=================
Opening today's trading session, investors are still surprised by the sudden increase in momentum and continue to be left far behind by the stock market.Many people do not believe that stocks can increase strongly without corrective sessions to gain momentum and that assumption is wrong, they are abandoned by the strong increase of nearly 40 points in just a few sessions.
Right from the opening moment, a series of stocks were "balanced" by supply and demand at green prices.VnIndex increased by 6 points, VN30-Index increased by 10 points at 9:30 a.m.HNX-Index is also trading in green!
According to our observations, the stock leading the market's increase is VIC.After the general meeting of shareholders, "VIC" stocks all increased quite dramatically.Along with that increasing momentum, banking stocks increased strongly, leaving those who were waiting for an opportunity to adjust to buy stocks to be left far behind.
After yesterday's announcement of GDP information, investor psychology is more excited than ever.Cash flow seems to have dismissed many concerns and returned to the market one after another.In just 30 minutes of trading, HoSE reached nearly 2 trillion in liquidity.Although compared to boom sessions, this liquidity is still quite low, but the general level shows that investors are still choosing the stock market as a channel to attract capital.
According to many securities companies, the market's upward momentum may not stop yet when HoSE's new trading system is put into operation and the cash flow will no longer encounter the barrier of overload error.
author: Phuong Chi

title: The times when the indicator "went underground" of the stock investment teacher who owns a YouTube channel with nearly 600,000 subs: When he caught the bottom of the oil price, oil dropped another 60%, patiently waited for VnIndex to decrease then it suddenly increased again, calling VIC Vincom?
sapo: T. Pham has been repeatedly pointed out by investors for contradictions in words, in addition to being a "reverse indicator" of the market.However, there are also opinions that investors should take responsibility for their own investment decisions instead of listening and blaming others.
content:
Recently, the investor community has been buzzing with comments about a character who specializes in selling enrichment courses, investment courses and self-help books in Vietnam.This character is T. Pham, who has a Marketing background, currently owns a YouTube channel with nearly 600,000 subscribers and a community of more than 70,000 students and investors.
Sparking the controversy was T.N.N - who has 60,000 followers on Facebook, when he posted a photo comparing billionaire Warren Buffett with T. Pham along with the comment: "There is a paradox that rich people never sell enrichment courses. And those who sell enrichment courses are rich from the money from selling enrichment courses, not already rich."
The article sparked controversy about the character T. Pham.
Right below the article, many Facebook accounts also commented and reflected on T. Pham's inaccurate market analysis and judgment.Worth mentioning, despite being a seller of courses, books on how to get rich, and teaching about stock investment methods, T. Pham has been "called out" many times in investment groups for the same reason.
For example, in mid-May 2019, when the gold price was at 1,300 USD/tael, T. Pham predicted: "Looking at the Ichimoku chart (graph - PV), Gold (gold - PV) will not go up."By early September 2019, in his student community, when the price of gold had reached 1,500 USD/tael, this character continued to analyze: "Gold has peaked in distribution for 2 weeks, basically the possibility of gold dying is very high."
T. Pham's indicator in May 2019...
... and September 2019 was saved and shared by an investor.
Yet in May 2020, T. Pham "turned face", boasting of buying gold from 1,300 USD: "We have determined with each other, in the group of brothers, that now we only trade in the uptrend direction, following the increase in gold prices. When buying, the leverage is very large, of course the right trend and combined with psoriasis and Ichimoku, we can earn quite a lot of money."
It is not known how to analyze right and wrong, but the contradictions in T. Pham's words at times have made many investors confused.
Furthermore, the teacher who teaches how to get rich also analyzes and forecasts oil prices.In June 2019, T. Pham predicted that oil prices had bottomed and "tell the truth, do the truth", he shared with students in class that he had accumulated PVS shares to "catch the bottom".But unfortunately, after that, oil prices continued to fall from 51 USD/barrel to 19 USD/barrel (a decrease of more than 60%), while PVS still remained in the price range of 20,000-23,000 VND/share.
Oil price movements go against T. Pham's analysis and forecast
Or in a live video broadcast on the occasion of VnIndex surpassing 1,200 points on April 1, 2021, T. Pham spent more than an hour paying attention to investors, including the paragraph: "Sentiment shows that the 1,200 mark is nothing. Because if there is only one code, VIC, this Vincom code is very good, when the market is difficult, it accounts for a large weight (more than 10% of the weight).VnIndex), when it increases, it greatly affects market psychology.Vincom... actually, Mr. Vuong is someone we respect very much... The news of Vincom raising international capital and launching electric cars is just the catalyst that makes VIC become the "Trieu Tu Long" version in the past 4 sessions, alone pulling the market up.But if Vincom alone is not enough, there must be more consensus from other stocks."
In the above sharing, many people realized that T. Pham mistakenly called the VIC stock code Vincom, when in fact this is the stock code of Vingroup Corporation, and Vincom Retail's code is VRE.It's worth mentioning that this character said the wrong thing not once but 3 times.
Another time, in a video analyzing recession and economic crisis, posted on March 25 on his YouTube channel with nearly 600,000 subscribers, T. Pham analyzed the US Dow Jones index: "After pushing the US economy to 29,000 points, the last 2 months have been haunted (decreasing),... The US market has started to enter a bear market, it cannot recover."
However, contrary to T. Pham's "unrecoverable" prediction, the Dow Jones index then continuously rebounded, increasing by 7,000 points to return to the 27,000 point mark.
Dow Jones increased after T. Pham's "unrecoverable" forecast
Also in that video, T. Pham advised investors that "cash is king", should not fish for the bottom but patiently wait for VnIndex to continue to decline.Yet from the very next day, this index not only did not decrease but also went straight from 650 points to 865 points.
VnIndex increased sharply after T. Pham's advice to wait longer to catch the bottom.
Faced with many "reverse indicators", many investors believe that T. Pham does not have enough knowledge and skills to teach others.However, there are also supportive opinions, stating that selling the course is a good buy and sell, and at the same time believing that investors should take responsibility for their own investment decisions instead of listening and blaming others.
Some comments from investors:
- "I think Mr. T.Pham sells useful knowledge. He doesn't cheat anyone."
- "I don't judge the issue of not being able to teach if you have to be rich. Society is multi-dimensional, anyone who has any knowledge can teach and impart it to others and learning a little or a lot depends a lot, especially on the learner. As for going to school, you have to pay a fee, it's convenient to buy and sell, and most people who go to school are happy with the knowledge they receive. T. Pham shares for free on Facebook, YouTube, the web a lot of good knowledge for the community and many people, but few people can do this. AiIt's true what the OP said, society is not good, because everyone wants to get free food.
- "... Mr. T. Pham, you don't have any knowledge about stocks, you still set up to teach people 10 million VND/course, are you proud of the few coins you earned? You called the market to crash from 650 to 1300, you still called it to crash. Gold you called because Biden rose, it stuck. Most recently, Oil (oil) you called to 53 then it shot up again..."

title: Not holding HPG and VIC, Pyn Elite Fund portfolio performance is far behind VN-Index in April
sapo: At the end of April, the size of the Pyn Elite Fund portfolio reached 638.1 million Euro (about 772 million USD).Among them, VHM continues to be the stock with the largest proportion with 13.6%.VN Diamond ETF certificates account for the second largest proportion with 10.3%.During the month, VN Diamond ETF was also the stock with the strongest increase in the fund portfolio.
content:
Pyn Elite Fund has just released its April operating report with many notable points.According to the report, in April, the performance of the Pyn Elite Fund portfolio increased slightly by 0.65%, supported by VN Diamond ETF (+10%), MBB (+8%), HDB (+3%).Meanwhile, VN-Index increased by 4% led by NVL (+63%), VIC (+11%), HPG (+24%).
Among the largest holdings of the Pyn Elite Fund, VEA fell 7.5% month-on-month due to a slow recovery in auto sales, while banks underperformed the Index.The fund also does not own VIC shares or cyclical stocks like HPG, names that have had a big impact on the VN-Index.This is an important reason why the performance of the Pyn Elite Fund portfolio is worse than the VN-Index.
At the end of April, the size of the Pyn Elite Fund portfolio reached 638.1 million Euro (about 772 million USD).Among them, VHM continues to be the stock with the largest proportion with 13.6%.VN Diamond ETF certificates account for the second largest proportion with 10.3%.During the month, VN Diamond ETF was also the stock with the strongest increase in the fund portfolio.
Banking stocks also account for a large proportion in the fund portfolio with names such as MBB (9.6%), HDB (9.3%), TPB (8.9%), CTG (8.7%).
Top 10 largest investments of Pyn Elite Fund
With VRE, Pyn Elite Fund said visitation and retail sales have recovered quickly after the pandemic thanks to effective marketing strategies and tenant support policies.In Q1/2021, VRE announced stronger-than-expected net profit growth of 59% YoY.VRE plans to expand its rental space by 2.5 times by 2026. Pyn Elite Fund believes that the application of IFRS financial reporting standards expected in 2023 - 2024 will help VRE's net profit increase sharply and then VRE's valuation will become attractive.VRE is currently the 8th largest stock in the Pyn Elite Fund portfolio with a proportion of 8%.
Also according to Pyn Elite Fund, Vietnam's macro situation in April continued to show stability.PMI increased for the third consecutive month to 54.7 points, showing strong improvement in the manufacturing sector since November 2018.Retail sales increased by 30.9% over the same period last year, CPI increased by 1.27% from the beginning of the year, public investment disbursement increased by 23.9% over the same period last year.Registered FDI capital in the first 4 months of the year reached 12.3 billion USD (+0.7% compared to the same period in 2020).
Although the Covid-19 epidemic once again returned to Vietnam in April, the Government acted quickly to stabilize the situation.

title: VIC shares set a new peak, VinGroup's capitalization is equal to the total of BIDV, Vietinbank and Techcombank combined
sapo: Meanwhile, the value of VIC shares held by Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong also reached more than 270,000 billion VND (11.7 billion USD), even larger than the capitalization of the 4th largest company in Vietnam's stock market, Vinamilk (207,115 billion VND).
content:
The trading session on April 15 was not very positive with red dominating the market and the VN-Index closed down 8.62 points (0.69%) to 1,247.25 points.Although the general market situation is not really favorable, VinGroup (VIC) stock continues to be a bright spot as it goes up 900 VND (+0.64%) to 140,900 VND.
VIC continues to set new highs
With a closing price of 140,900 VND, VIC continued to set a new peak since its listing on the stock exchange (calculated according to adjusted price).At this price, VinGroup's capitalization is up to 476,584 billion VND (20.7 billion USD), far ahead of the next names such as Vietcombank (361,616 billion VND), VinHomes (338,971 billion VND), Vinamilk (207,115 billion VND), Hoa Phat (180,574 billion VND)... Even, VinGroup's capitalization at this time is equal to the total capitalization of 3 major banks BIDV(173,148 billion VND), Vietinbank (157,128 billion VND) and Techcombank (143,351 billion VND) combined.
Meanwhile, the value of VIC shares held by Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong also reached more than 270,000 billion VND (11.7 billion USD), even larger than the capitalization of the 4th largest company in Vietnam's stock market, Vinamilk (207,115 billion VND).
According to Forbes' latest update, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong currently has assets of 9.6 billion USD and is the 236th richest person in the world, up 108 places compared to the beginning of the year.
The 2020 business results report said that VinGroup achieved revenue of 110,490 billion VND and pre-tax profit of 13,943 billion VND.Of which, real estate transfer revenue is the largest with 72,167 billion VND, while revenue from manufacturing activities (including VinFast, VinSmart) ranked second with 17,415 billion VND.
Recently, Bloomberg reported on VinFast's IPO in the US, expected to raise about 2 billion USD and expecting a valuation of at least 50 billion USD after listing.Responding to this issue, VinGroup said the company regularly considers options to mobilize capital and invest in VinFast.Typically, capital raising opportunities include direct capital investment in the company, issuance of new shares, merger with a special purpose acquisition company, or other transactions.The implementation of capital mobilization transactions depends on market conditions and the company's actual capital needs.The Company will disclose information according to regulations when deciding to implement the transaction.

title: HPG, VJC, VIC increased sharply, VnIndex only decreased slightly at the end of the session
sapo: Selling pressure weighs heavily on the stock market.Investors began to panic and act without thinking.Caution in transactions is necessary at this time.
content:
At the end of the trading session, the stock market continued to surprise when it suddenly recovered strongly.VnIndex at the end of the session only decreased slightly thanks to HPG, VJC, and VIC increasing in price.
==============
In less than 10 minutes of afternoon trading, investors quickly entered orders to avoid order congestion.Fast and strong demand created momentum to help VnIndex recover very strongly to only -6 points.
===========
At the end of the morning session, VnIndex recovered 11 points compared to the time of deep decline.From -25 points, VnIndex "quickly" reversed to -14 points and ended the morning session in the joy of investors who caught the bottom and traded goods and the fear of those who had just finished selling when the stock skyrocketed.
We always recommend that investors need to manage their portfolio and investment psychology.If investors continue to "jump ahead" with the market, the only thing investors will create is to help securities companies earn a lot of fees!
Closing the morning session, HPG, VIC, VJC were 3 rare stocks with a green increase in price in the VN30 group.27 stocks are in the red, of which SBT, VRE, and PDR are currently the ones with the deepest decline.
Foreign selling force is still very strong in the market so investors need to be very cautious.Profit taking is currently happening on a large scale in many markets, especially internationally.
-----------------
At about 10:15 a.m., the stock market began to receive heavy selling pressure from foreign investors.This strong selling pressure pushed a series of stocks down and created psychological dominoes for investors, causing them to be shaken and act chaotically.
-------------
While filled with hope that the stock market would make a strong breakthrough after surpassing 1,200 points, investors were "dumped with cold water" when overwhelming selling pressure from foreign investors pushed a series of stocks to lose value throughout the past week.VnIndex returned to the 1,160 point threshold and is currently not showing a clear trend.
This morning's trading session, many bluechips such as HPG, VIC, VJC increased in price, but the increase of a few individual stocks was not enough to help the stock market go green.VnIndex rotates around red and green, but red is still overwhelming when losing 3 points.
On the downside, SBT, VRE, and KDH fell quite deeply.In particular, SBT dropped sharply by 2.5% and this stock has had a long series of strong declines, pushing the stock price from ~24,000 VND to the current ~21,000 VND range.
FLC is still "alone" as it increases continuously from the current price range of ~6,500 to ~10,500 VND.
The VN30 index derivative futures contract, VN30F, expiring on April 15, is currently increasing quite strongly by more than 5 points, pushing a deviation of +3.3 points compared to the Vn30-Index.

title: VHM, VIC, VPB hit the ceiling, investors massively bought shares, pushing VnIndex up 40 points
sapo: The VN30 stock group is being purchased more by investors, pushing prices higher than the general market increase.This is the first time in history that the Vn30-Index surpassed the VnIndex.
content:
At the end of the trading session on February 2, the stock market closed with a series of stocks hitting the ceiling, VnIndex skyrocketed 40 points to 1,075 points.Cautious and skeptical investors were overwhelmed by strong buying forces that pushed stock prices much higher than the bottom in just a blink of an eye.
VN30-Index today increased 50 points, higher than the increase of VnIndex.That is, the VN30 stock group is being bought more by investors, pushing the price higher than the general increase of the market.This is the first time in history that the Vn30-Index surpassed the VnIndex.
In the VN30 group, VHM, VIC, VPB REE, SBT increased to the ceiling and were close to the ceiling.Other stocks such as STB, VRE, MBB, CTG, VCB, HPG, TCB all increased over 5% to near the ceiling price.No stocks in the VN30 group decreased today!
Although stock market liquidity did not reach a very high level as in recent times, it still reached more than 13,160 billion on HoSE.After a period of margin calls for many investors in the previous round, purchasing power has not yet "bounced" back, so today's liquidity level can be considered a high level of the market.
The HNX floor was no less exciting than HoSE, closing the day with an increase of more than 3% to 215.36 points.On this exchange, SHB and SHS are a notable duo with a strong increase of 8-9% and abundant liquidity.
==========
The reversal signal appeared, strong cash flow immediately poured into the stock market.A series of stocks increased strongly.VIC, VHM, VPB are currently trading close to the ceiling price.VnIndex soared 33 points, causing many cautious people to aggressively catch the wave, afraid of being left out of the big wave that experts still predict.
==========
In the early morning, investors were still afraid of the recent bull traps.However, after 10 a.m., the fear quickly disappeared when many investors realized that the force of selling at low prices was gradually weakening.Demand quickly poured into the stock market, pushing the prices of many stocks - especially bluechips - up.
At 11:05 a.m., VnIndex increased strongly by 17 points.HoSE floor reached nearly 6,000 billion VND in transactions.The VN30-Index group increased much stronger than the market, jumping up 27 points.
Currently, VHM and VIC are the stocks leading the market's uptrend, increasing sharply by 4-5%.Many other large capitalization stocks such as VPB, STB, HPG... are also increasing strongly.
=========
Green quickly covered the stock market as investors realized that the pressure to sell at much cheaper prices than before was less.The fear of missing out on a big wave when the market has adjusted deeply makes investors quickly pour money into stocks.Just 30 minutes after the 10 a.m. "milestone", the HoSE floor received an additional 1,500 billion transactions.
The VN30 group is increasing very strongly, the VN30-Index increased by more than 9 points - higher than the increase of the general market.Banking stocks are taking the lead in leading the increase as VCB, STB, VPB, CTG... are all racing to increase strongly.
=========
Bottom-fishing investors today have faltered after many consecutive failures last week.Catching a falling knife has caused many investors to incur losses, so when the market signaled a strong increase this morning, bottom-fishers were not in a hurry to race the price.
Market liquidity as of 10am was quite sluggish compared to the stock market scene in recent months with more than 3,000 billion transactions on HoSE and less than 500 billion on HNX.
In fact, this is a very good challenging period for the market when less experienced investors have been "taught" carefully in buying/selling.Any uncontrolled buying/selling will cost them dearly.And, as we said before, investors who used high margin without reason have been continuously "hit" by the market for more than a week when they had to sell call margin and then return to full margin when the bull trap
Returning to the stock market, we notice that many stocks have returned to very low prices compared to before.This price is reasonable for investors who are not determined to hold by force margin, the selling force is quite weak.The market has probably had enough time to shake off those who use margin excessively.The only thing is, after clearing a large amount of margin, whether or not the market will have the strength to break out depends on the factor of new cash flow.However, the new cash flow seems a bit hesitant as the long holiday is approaching and the outbreak of the Covid epidemic is causing them to consider.
At 10:05 a.m., we noticed that many stocks in the VN30 group are maintaining their strength even in the context of the market's decline in recent sessions such as VCB, CTG, VIC, VHM, STB...
Investors seem to be quite impatient.Staying out or joining in is a big question for them.With being "beaten" in the days leading up to Tet, investors seem to no longer have high profits as expected and waiting for a clear trend to enter is what is happening.

title: HoSE: Foreign investors net bought strongly in VJC, VRE, VCB, VIC and HSG codes in November
sapo: Foreign investors were net sellers with a value of more than 15.58 trillion VND.The total transaction value of foreign investors reached more than 34.18 trillion VND, accounting for 9.54% of the total transaction value of the entire market.
content:
At the end of the last trading session of the month, HoSE's stock indices continued to record growth.VN-Index reached 1003.08 points, up 8.39% compared to the end of October and up 4.38% compared to the beginning of 2020;VNAllshare reached 926.85 points, up 8.32% compared to the end of October and up 9.61% compared to the beginning of the year;VN30 reached 965.89 points, up 8.22% compared to the end of October and up 9.88% compared to the beginning of 2020. Industry indexes that increased the most include: raw materials industry (VNMAT) increased by 15.50%, industry (VNIND) increased by 13.96%, utility goods industry (VNUTI) increased by 12.69%.
The transaction value in November increased approximately 1.5 times compared to the average transaction value of the first 11 months of the year.
Market liquidity continues to grow steadily.The average session trading volume reached 397.2 million shares - down 3.69%, corresponding to an average session trading value of more than 8.52 trillion VND - up 3.57% compared to the previous month and 48.62% higher than the average trading value of the first 11 months of 2020.
Foreign investors were net sellers with a value of more than 15.58 trillion VND.The total transaction value of foreign investors reached more than 34.18 trillion VND, accounting for 9.54% of the total transaction value of the entire market.
As of November 30, 2020, the total number of stock codes traded on HoSE was: 388 stocks, 3 closed fund certificates, 6 ETF fund certificates, 128 guaranteed warrants and 39 listed bonds.The total volume of listed stocks reached more than 94.93 billion shares, the listed capitalization value reached more than 3.6 million billion VND, an increase of 9.76% compared to the previous month and reached about 47.11% of GDP in 2019 (GDP at current prices).
On the other hand, covered warrants continue to maintain a steady increase: average session trading volume reached nearly 24 million CW, average session trading value reached about 54.43 billion VND, an increase of 27.25% and 49.16% respectively compared to the previous month.In particular, the transaction volume and average transaction value in November impressed with rates of 145.67% and 261.07% respectively compared to the average of the first 11 months of 2020.
Regarding new listing activities, in November, HoSE had 2 new stock codes listed and traded, including LPB shares of Lien Viet Post Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Lienvietpostbank) with the first trading session reference price of 11,800 VND/share;VIB shares of Vietnam International Commercial Joint Stock Bank with the first trading session reference price of 32,300 VND/share.
This month, there were also 16 new CW codes traded, the total new listing volume reached 56 million CW.After more than a year of implementation, there have been 275 CW codes on 23 underlying stocks of 8 issuers listed and traded.

title: VIC, MSN broke out strongly, VN-Index maintained its green color in the last session of the week
sapo: The breakthrough of Bluechips, especially MSN, VIC, BHN, PNJ, is the main factor that helps VN-Index maintain the green color during the session, even though many large stocks such as MWG, VRE, TCB, BVH, GAS... are in the red.
content:
At the beginning of the afternoon session, selling pressure increased throughout the market and the VN-Index sometimes lost more than 3 points.However, bottom-fishing demand at low price levels is always present, causing the correction period to not last too long and the indexes quickly recovered at the end of the session.
The breakthrough of Bluechips, especially MSN, VIC, BHN, PNJ, is the main factor that helps VN-Index maintain the green color during the session, even though many large stocks such as MWG, VRE, TCB, BVH, GAS... are in the red.
Real estate and construction groups also attracted quite good cash flow with many increasing stocks such as DIG, DXG, FCN, HBC, HDC, HDG, NBB, DPG, G36... Besides, "FLC family" also made waves when all stocks increased, even FLC and KLF increased to the ceiling.
Industrial park and rubber stocks also had a positive trading session with many gainers such as NTC, PHR, GVR, D2D, SIP, BCM, IDC, SZL...
An Phat Holdings' APH had a pretty good trading session, increasing by 200 VND (+0.27%) to 74,200 VND, with a trading volume of approximately 390 thousand units.Recently, IFC announced an investment of 20 million USD in An Phat Holdings to support the implementation of Southeast Asia's largest composting material factory in the form of a 7-year convertible loan that can be converted into APH shares.
With this project, APH will proactively source raw materials, reduce product costs, create competitive advantages, and make environmentally friendly products popular in domestic and international markets.
The project has a budget of 82 million USD, expected to start construction in early 2021 in Hai Phong, construction in about 18 months, completed at the end of 2022, capacity 20,000 tons / year.When the project is completed in 2022, APH is expected to reduce production costs for its subsidiaries by 20-30% while the parent company still enjoys a gross profit margin of 25-30% of this project.APH targets that by 2023, compostable products will contribute 40-50% of the Group's packaging revenue.
The consolidated report for the third quarter of 2020 said that APH achieved 66.1 billion VND in profit after tax, an increase of 22% over the same period last year.
Closing the session, the VN-Index increased slightly by 0.54 points (0.06%) to 938.29 points;HNX-Index increased 0.73% to 139.31 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.28% to 63.49 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the trading value of 3 exchanges reaching 6,200 billion VND.
After yesterday's net buying session, foreign investors returned to their familiar net selling trend, selling nearly 150 billion VND across the market.Selling force focuses on Bluechips such as MSN, VRE, HPG, MBB, VPB...
================================================
The morning trading session was quite cautious and the VN-Index continuously reversed around the reference mark.Many large stocks such as BVH, GAS, VCB, VNM, SAB, HVN, PLX, VRE, POW... all fell, negatively impacting the market.
On the contrary, no major stocks could maintain their green color, prominent among them was PNJ with an increase of 2.2% to 74,200 VND.PNJ was bought quite strongly by foreign investors this morning.In addition, FPT, HPG, VIC, and BCM also increased, helping the market not fall too much, although the increase in these stocks was not too much.
Marketable stock groups such as stocks, real estate, construction, oil and gas... are trading quite fluctuating and the red color is somewhat dominant.
Meanwhile, the Industrial Park and Rubber Groups traded more actively with many gainers such as NTC, GVR, SZL, D2D, SIP, BCM...
Pausing the morning session, the VN-Index decreased 1.24 points (0.13%) to 936.51 points;while HNX-Index increased slightly by 0.02% to 138.33 points and UPCom-Index increased by 0.12% to 63.39 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the transaction value of 3 exchanges reaching 3,000 billion VND.
Foreign investors are currently net buying nearly 50 billion VND on HoSE, the buying force focuses on VIC, VNM, HSG...
========================================================
The first few minutes of the trading session were quite cautious as investors waited for developments from the US presidential election.The VN-Index sometimes increased beyond the 940 point mark, but demand was not strong enough to maintain it, causing the index to quickly "cool down".
In the Bluechips group, GAS, MSN, VCB, HVN, PLX, VPB, VRE, NVL are the names that dropped, but the overall decline is not much.On the contrary, many large stocks such as FPT, HPG, VIC, VNM, PNJ, TCB, BCM,... maintained the green color to help VN-Index maintain its upward momentum.
Market-oriented stock groups such as stocks, real estate, construction, oil and gas, etc., have strongly differentiated transactions, reflecting the cautious psychology of investors.Meanwhile, the Industrial and Rubber Park group had more positive developments with many increasing codes such as NTC, GVR, SZL, SIP, SZC, IDC, BCM...
At 10:00 a.m., the VN-Index increased slightly by 1.67 points (0.18%) to 939.42 points;HNX-Index increased 0.33% to 138.76 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.1% to 63.37 points.The entire market liquidity is at an average level with the transaction value of 3 exchanges reaching 1,200 billion VND.
Foreign investors, after net buying yesterday, returned to net selling more than 16 billion VND on HoSE.On the derivatives market, futures contracts are maintaining a positive basis, showing that investors are still quite optimistic about the medium-term trend of the market.
=======================================
In the newly published report, Rong Viet Securities Company (VDSC) said that the market may accumulate in November when there is a lack of information related to corporate and macro business results.
However, the recovery of Vietnam's economy is predictable based on good growth momentum in the third quarter. The current concern is short-term global market fluctuations in the context of the US election.Therefore, VDSC believes that the VN-Index may fluctuate between 910 and 960 points in November.

title: VICTower has been "immobile" for 10 years, where have more than 300 customers gone?
sapo: There was a decision to approve the bidding results for investor selection since 2010. After many ups and downs, the VIC Tower project (Cau Giay district, Hanoi) has remained motionless until now.
content:
On October 6, 2010, the People's Committee of Cau Giay district issued a Decision approving the bidding results to select investors for a project using land in part of plot C, land plot D4, Cau Giay new urban area for the joint venture of Phu My An - Hanoi Co., Ltd. and Mountainous Construction Support Trading Co., Ltd. to carry out an investment project to build commercial, service or mixed-use works without housing.
By June 2011, this project had the Department of Planning and Architecture locally adjusted the plot planning, adding housing functions at a rate of no more than 50% of the total floor area.
After changing names many times, the VIC Tower project has not yet scheduled a re-construction date
Also since this time, the joint venture of Phu My An - Hanoi Co., Ltd. and Mountainous Construction Support Trading Co., Ltd. have constructed the foundation of the project and mobilized capital from customers.
The project is built on an area of ​​3,203m2, with a scale of 21 floors, 3 basements, including 6 floors of commercial center, office, 14 floors of luxury apartments and penthouse floors.The project is named Sky View luxury apartment building, the investor commits to handing over the house in the fourth quarter of 2014.
However, in August 2014, the Cau Giay District Construction Inspection Team discovered that the project was being constructed without a construction permit.Accordingly, Phu My An investor imposed an administrative fine and requested a temporary halt to construction.
In 2018, customers of this project were startled when a series of advertising information outside the project was changed, the Sky View project suddenly turned into VIC Tower with a scale of up to 33 floors.Phu My An investor continues to use capital contribution contracts to mobilize capital from customers.This investor continues to commit to handing over the house by the end of 2018.
Worth mentioning, in October 2017, information from the Asset Management Company (VAMC) said that the Sky View Tran Thai Tong project is collateral for 2 debts at Vietnam Prosperity Bank (VPBank).
When converted into bad debt, VPBank sold these two debts to VAMC.Based on that, VAMC has authorized VPBank itself to restructure these two debts.Accordingly, Phu My An Company does not have any rights, including the right to sell this property.
Customers who contribute capital to the Sky View project (now the VIC Tower project) stretch out banners demanding benefits from investors.
Besides, according to Mr. Pham Van Loi - Team Leader of Cau Giay Construction Order Management Team, as of October 2019, the VIC Tower project has not yet been granted a construction permit and construction has been suspended.
Talking to DDDN reporters, many project customers said they had paid 800 million VND to the project, some more than 1 billion VND, 8 years ago.However, the project name was changed and the customer did not know. The investor promised to resume construction from quarter to quarter, but so far there has been "no news".
Faced with the project being behind schedule and not being able to hand over the house on time, more than 300 customers buying apartments here have repeatedly requested dialogue with the investor.However, the situation still has not improved.
Frustrated when the project was behind schedule for too long, the investor again promised but did not keep it, customers contributed money to buy apartments at the project and sent a petition to the authorities of Cau Giay district and the City People's Committee.Hanoi... However, up to now, no authorities have intervened to resolve the rights of the people.
According to actual records, the project is still "silent" with no signs of construction, construction materials are piled up, rusting over time.Meanwhile, a corner of the project is being used as an iced tea shop.The first floor of the building has been built and the basement is being turned into a parking lot day and night.
Below are some images captured by reporters at the project:
The project has now reached the 6th floor on the golden land of Cau Giay district
The construction site had no workers in sight
A corner of the project is being used as an iced tea shop, next to it are scattered materials
The first floor of the 6-storey building is being used as a motorbike parking lot day and night

title: Foreign investors returned to net selling of VND 186 billion in the first week of July, with extraordinary agreements with AGG, SAB and VIC
sapo: Only in terms of order-matching transactions, foreign investors on HoSE still net bought up to 148 billion VND in the week from August 3-7. Foreign investors on HoSE were the strongest net sellers of AGG code with a value of nearly 119 billion VND, most of which was done through the agreement method.
content:
The stock market in the first week of July 2020 had a significant recovery after 2 consecutive weeks of decline.At the end of the trading week, VN-Index increased 43.07 points (5.4%) to 841.46 points;HNX-Index increased 5,268 points (4.9%) to 112.78 points.Liquidity decreased compared to the previous week and was lower than the 20-week average with more than 4,800 billion VND traded per session on the two listed exchanges.
Foreign investors returned to net selling with about more than 186 billion VND on all three exchanges HoSE, HNX and UPCoM (the last week of July net bought 763 billion VND), corresponding to a net selling volume of 3.5 million shares.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold more than 155 billion VND while last week they still net bought up to 700 billion VND.However, this off-exchange capital flow was net sold mainly through agreement with 304 billion VND.Thus, only counting order matching transactions, foreign investors still bought a net of 148 billion VND.
Foreign investors on HoSE were the strongest net sellers of AGG code with a value of nearly 119 billion VND, most of which was done through agreement.Following that, NVL was also net sold for more than 107 billion VND.SAB and VIC were net sold VND 81 billion and VND 75 billion respectively.Notably, foreign investors net sold SAB and VIC mainly through agreements.
On the contrary, HPG topped the list of foreign net buyers with 74 billion VND.CTD and VNM are behind with net buying values ​​of 55 billion VND and 52 billion VND, respectively.
On the HNX, foreign investors net bought slightly with 6 billion VND, down 52% compared to the previous week, but in terms of volume of foreign capital flows, this net sold back to more than 1 billion VND.
PVS and VCS share the two leading positions in net buying value of foreign investors on HNX with 5.3 billion VND and 5.2 billion VND respectively.Besides, TAR and PVB were both net bought more than 1 billion VND.Meanwhile, SHB topped the list of net sellers on HNX but the value was only over 1.7 billion VND.SHS, IDC, and HUT were also net sold for more than 1 billion VND.
On UPCoM, foreign investors net sold again 36.5 billion VND, equivalent to 169,067 shares.VEA had the strongest net purchase by foreign investors on UPCoM with 11.4 billion VND, far ahead of the code behind OIL with only 1.4 billion VND.On the contrary, VTP was net sold the most with 25.4 billion VND.MCH and ACV were both net sold over 10 billion VND.
author: According to Hai Trieu

title: VIC, VHM supported the market in the VN30 restructuring session, Vn-Index still dropped nearly 3 points
sapo: In the derivatives market, today's trading volume exploded with 346,000 contracts, open volume (OI) reached 35,939 contracts, the value of derivative transactions on the floor today was about more than 25,200 billion VND.
content:
On the morning of July 31, 45 new cases of COVID-19 were recorded.All 45 cases of COVID-19 announced on the morning of July 31 are being quarantined at Da Nang medical facilities.These are not community infections.Yesterday, the US announced that Q2 GDP decreased by 32.9% compared to the previous year, while analysts previously expected a decrease of 34.7%.US futures indexes recovered significantly this morning in Asian time.
Closing the session, Vn-Index decreased 2.74 points although VIC increased 2.8%, VHM increased 1.4%.Today is the day to restructure the VN30 portfolio, so there was a large demand to buy VIC and VHM in the ATC session, matching orders of more than 300,000 shares.
The two codes that were removed from the VN30 list, CTD and BVH, both decreased, while BVH only decreased slightly by 0.5%, CTD at the beginning of the ATC session was sold to the floor, then the handshake demand increased sharply, causing this code to close down 2.1% to 66,800 VND/share.
Liquidity in the weekend session decreased sharply compared to the fluctuating sessions during the week, HOSE matched orders of 3,900 billion while HNX and Upcom traded 375 billion and 238 billion respectively.
In general, investor psychology is quite stable in response to information about Covid infection cases in Da Nang.Some stocks in the Vn30 portfolio also increased points such as MSN, MWG, NVL, PNJ, other codes such as GAS, REE, PLX kept the reference price.Perhaps some experience was learned in the early stages, so the sell-off was too deep and did not happen.
Among steel stocks, HPG decreased 1.8% to 21,700 VND/share while HSG decreased 4.3% to 9,500 VND/share.Due to the request of the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City to avoid large gatherings, we realized that the current stock market developments and HSG stock price do not accurately reflect the company's operating situation and are not consistent with the construction and implementation of the issuance plan, so HSG temporarily postponed the 2019-2020 Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders.
Some notable stocks include APH (up 6%), HND of Hai Phong Thermal Power (up 3%), RAL (up 2%), HAG, VGC, QNS, DGC, NHH, CTR increased.
In the derivatives market, today's trading volume exploded with 346,000 contracts, open volume (OI) reached 35,939 contracts. If calculated by original transaction value, the value of derivative transactions on the floor today is about more than 25,200 billion VND.
At 2:15 p.m., Vn-Index decreased 3 points to 798 points, a decrease of 0.37%.Two Vingroup stocks, VHM and VIC, both increased by 0.5%, keeping pace with the market, MSN, PLX increased slightly, some midcaps had notable price increases such as VGC (up 3%), VIB, PNJ, QNS, DGC...
APH continued to attract attention when it increased 6% to 60,300 VND/share, this was the fourth increase session of this stock after listing, an increase of 45% in less than 1 week.
Today is the day to restructure the portfolio of index funds modeled after Vn30, the new portfolio will take effect next Monday (August 3).Accordingly, VN30 Index will remove CTD (0.45%) and BVH (0.51%), two new stocks KDH and TCH will be added with respective weights of 1.25% and 0.67%.
VN100 Index will exclude BVH, CTI, FCN, PAC, SJD, VSC and add BIC, GEG, IMP, KOS, PME and TLG.
VN FIN Lead Index and VN FIN Select Index also excluded BVH because this stock was removed from the VNAllshare Index list.
The VN Diamond Index and VNX50 Index keep the component stock portfolio unchanged and will restructure the proportion with updated data.
Regarding these indexes, on the market there are currently VFM VN30 funds (VND 5,383 billion), VFM VN Diamond ETF (VND 1,500 billion), SSIAM VNFIN Lead (VND 660 billion) and SSIAM VNX50 ETF (VND 161 billion), Vinacapital VN100 ETF (VND 55 billion) will carry out portfolio restructuring this period.
10:30: The market reversed in the surprise of investors.It is clear that investor psychology is much stronger than during the first Covid wave. Investors did not sell off in response to infection information, and were even willing to buy at high prices in some codes.
Bluechips this morning, BVH, CTG, MSN, VIC led the uptrend.
In the Midcap group, AnPhat Holding's APH went up to the ceiling continuously, currently trading at 60,000 VND/share (up 5.4%), DGC increased 2.3% after listing but still decreased 15% compared to when trading on the Hanoi floor, DBC, BWE increased in price, VIB, VPB, VCI stocks in the banking and finance industry increased again.
In the Vietnamese stock market, the VN-Index at the beginning of the session sometimes dropped more than 13 points, but at 9:45 a.m., the Vn-Index was only down 2.62 points.Yesterday session, the market increased more than 10 points thanks to strong increases in two stocks VHM and VNM.This morning VIC, MSN increased by more than 2% to keep the market's fall from being too deep, banking stocks such as BID, CTG, EIB, MBB, STB, VCB, TCB, VPB all decreased, stocks affecting the index such as GAS, SAB, VNM, HPG decreased by more than 1%.Today is the day the stocks in the Tuesday trading session arrived at investors' accounts. This is the day the market increased strongly after a drop of more than 40 points on Monday. Market trends showed that there were not many moves to cut losses on a large scale, investors were quite calm before the information about Covid in Da Nang.
Some midcap stocks increased such as APH, NVT, HND, QNS, RAL, DGC, VCI, oil and gas stocks such as BRS, OIL kept the reference price, these codes all decreased by 10-15% compared to June.
DNM shares of Danameco Medical Joint Stock Company have increased to the ceiling for 5 consecutive sessions and is the 7th increasing session since the discovery of the first Covid case in Da Nang.Danameco is a medical supplies company headquartered in Quang Nam - Da Nang, producing medical supplies including masks.Currently, this stock in the past 10 sessions has increased from 38,000 VND/share to 66,500 VND/share.
author: Chau Cao

title: Stocks increased sharply at the end of the week, VIC broke out, pushing VnIndex up to nearly 870 points
sapo: In the VN30 group, VIC suddenly increased to the ceiling with a ceiling buying surplus of more than 500 thousand shares.
content:
In the afternoon session, the stock market continued to surge strongly.VnIndex increased more than 13 points to 868.56 points and HNX-Index increased 2.56 points to 115.36 points.
Not only did penny stocks stir, but near the end of the session, many large-cap stocks that had been suppressed for a long time also broke out strongly.In the VN30 group, VIC suddenly increased to the ceiling with a ceiling buying surplus of more than 500 thousand shares.
Many stocks in the financial sector such as STB, BVH, BID, VPB, and CTG increased sharply, also contributing greatly to pushing the stock market to its current high.
In the midcap stocks group, we saw AAA increase nearly 2% to 12,900 VND.AAA is currently one of the stocks that investors are interested in when its ambition to become a leading household plastic corporation has been announced by the company's president.AAA has also just announced that the company's maximum foreign ownership ratio can reach 100%.The expansion of foreign room to 100% is one of the highlights that investors pay attention to.
=============
The highlight of the stock market during the morning trading session was the group of small and medium capitalization stocks.Although this group of stocks does not have a major impact on the overall market score, the high volatility and large liquidity of this group of stocks are often factors that have a strong impact on investor psychology.
==============
Opening this morning's trading session, green color spread across the stock market but not many stocks increased strongly.VnIndex hovers around with an increase of less than 5 points.
At nearly 10 a.m., the stock market was suddenly activated when many penny stocks suddenly reversed and increased rapidly.After about a week of adjustment, many stocks rebounded, creating excitement in the stock market.Although penny stocks do not have much impact on the increase of VnIndex, the reactivation of penny stocks makes investor psychology excited.
The most notable session this morning was ITA.In the early morning, ITA was still under orders to sell more than 24 million shares at a ceiling price, but in just a few minutes around 10:00 a.m., strong demand quickly absorbed the entire amount of shares mentioned above and in the end, ITA's price skyrocketed from the floor to the ceiling.Currently, ITA is trading close to its ceiling price.
FIT continues to have a ceiling overbought surplus and FIT stock price has increased very strongly in recent trading months.
PVX returned to the stock market with strong upward momentum.Trading stocks on UpCOM but this stock suddenly broke out by 20% to 1,200 VND.Previously, when still trading on HNX, PVX shares stood at a price of less than 1,000 VND/share for a long time.
