title: Why did Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's company sell 500,000 VIC shares?
sapo: SHS sold 500,000 VIC shares that Vietnam Investment Group lent to Tan Hoang Minh as collateral because the debt had not been fully paid.Transaction worth about 49 billion VND.
content:
Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company announced that it sold 500,000 Vingroup shares (HoSE: VIC) through order matching method on May 11.After the transaction, Vingroup's largest shareholder still owns more than 1.12 billion shares, equivalent to 32.67% of charter capital.
In the May 11 session, VIC shares matched nearly 1.36 million shares with a closing price of 97,500 VND.Temporarily calculated at this price, Vietnam Investment Group can earn nearly 49 billion VND.
According to information from Vietnam Investment Group, these 500,000 VIC shares were sold from the account of Saigon - Hanoi Securities (SHS).These shares were loaned by Vietnam Investment Group to Tan Hoang Minh Group as collateral for a loan from its subsidiary at SHB bank.However, because Tan Hoang Minh has not paid all the debt, SHB has handled the collateral.
A representative of Vietnam Investment Group said that on May 8, the company received an official dispatch from SHS Securities signed on May 7 announcing that it would sell the VIC shares that Tan Hoang Minh mortgaged if the debt was not paid.This official dispatch does not specify the deadline for mortgage sale.However, by May 11, SHS had processed the collateral.
Vietnam Investment Group is a private company owned by the family of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup.This company was established in 2007, currently with General Director Phan Thanh Long as the legal representative, and has just registered to change its headquarters to Vinhomes Riverside urban area, Long Bien district, Hanoi from February 24.Charter capital by the end of 2019 is nearly 11,815 billion VND.
Currently, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong also owns more than 876 million VIC shares and Ms. Pham Thu Huong (Mr. Vuong's wife) has more than 151 million shares.The total ownership of these 3 shareholders is 2.147 billion shares, 62.4% of capital.The total number of shares currently has a market value of 206,000 billion VND.
In its first quarter business report, Vingroup recorded a 30% decrease in net revenue to VND 15,368 billion, mainly because it no longer recorded revenue from retail activities.Profit after tax for shareholders of the parent company is 438 billion VND, down 58% because most fields are greatly affected by Covid-19.
author: According to Thu Hang

title: Foreign investors net sold more than 1,200 billion VND in the week of March 30 - April 3, the focus of MSN and VIC
sapo: Foreign investors net sold for 10 consecutive weeks on both HoSE and HNX with a total value of VND 11,360 billion and VND 1,242 billion, respectively. MSN continued to be the stock with the strongest net sale by foreign investors in the trading week of March 30 - April 3. SVC and VHL were both net sold by foreign investors but most of it came from agreement transactions.
content:
Closing the trading week of March 30 - April 3, the indexes had strong fluctuations.In the first session of the week, many stocks plummeted, causing VN-Index to lose 4.86%, investors panicked and sold off stocks, while the following sessions saw a strong recovery, led by securities, banking and oil and gas stocks.Accordingly, VN-Index stopped at 701.8 points, up 0.8% compared to last week.HNX-Index increased 0.5% to 97.84 points.
Foreign investors' trading activities were not very positive as they continued to be net sellers on all three exchanges, HoSE, HNX and UPCoM, but the pressure has decreased significantly.This week alone, foreign investors bought nearly 71.6 million shares, worth more than 1,776 billion VND, while selling more than 134.6 million shares, worth more than 2,980.6 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached more than 63 million shares, corresponding to a net selling value of more than VND 1,200 billion, down 20.7% compared to last week.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold more than 1,051 billion VND, down 25.3% compared to last week, corresponding to a net selling volume of more than 52.5 million shares.In particular, this is the 10th consecutive week of net selling by foreign investors after the Lunar New Year holiday, with the total net selling value reaching nearly 11,360 billion VND.
Topping the list of net buyers on HoSE is E1VFVN30 with nearly 10 billion VND.Next are PLX and NVL with values ​​of VND 8.9 billion and VND 8.8 billion, respectively.
Foreign investors were the strongest net sellers of MSN on HoSE with a value of more than 187.5 billion VND.This is the 9th consecutive week that foreign investors have strongly sold MSN with a total value of more than 1,795 billion VND.Followed by VIC and SVC with values ​​of 142.7 billion VND and 86.6 billion VND, respectively, of which SVC mostly comes from agreement transactions.VRE was also net sold more than 52 billion VND this week.
Similar to HoSE, HNX was also net sold by foreign investors for the 10th consecutive week with a total value of more than 1,242 billion VND.This week alone, foreign investors net sold more than 125 billion VND (up 22.4% compared to last week), corresponding to a net selling volume of more than 8.6 billion VND.
VCS received the strongest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX with a value of nearly 1.6 billion VND.Right behind is TIG with a value of just over 550 million VND.
On the contrary, foreign investors were the strongest net sellers of VHL with a value of more than 77 billion VND, most of which were through negotiated transactions.PVS continued to be net sold by foreign investors for more than 38.5 billion VND.
On UPCoM, foreign investors also net sold more than 28 billion VND, 2.9 times more than last week.VTP received the highest net purchase by foreign investors with a value of more than 7.3 billion VND.QNS and LPB were also net bought with values ​​of 1.2 billion VND and 1 billion VND respectively.Meanwhile, ACV was net sold the most with more than 15.7 billion VND, VEA and BSR were both net sold over 6.8 billion VND.
author: According to Hai Trieu

title: In the "green on the skin, red on the inside" market, VN-Index increased nearly 2 points with traction from VIC
sapo: On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts closed with a negative basis from 27.23 to nearly 35 points, showing that investor sentiment is quite pessimistic towards the market.
content:
The afternoon trading session took place with strong vibrations.Most stocks on the market are in a downtrend, but strong fluctuations in some Bluechips cause the Index to continuously reverse.
The strong breakthrough of some Bluechips such as MSN, VIC, SAB, VRE, CTG is the main factor helping the market maintain the green color today, in which VIC is the stock with the most positive impact when increasing by more than 6%.
On the contrary, a series of large stocks such as BVH, FPT, GAS, HPG, REE, VJC, VPB, PNJ, MWG, HDB, MBB, BID,... dropped, making the market quite gloomy, even though the Index increased.Among them, MWG, FRT, HDB are notable names that have dropped to the floor.
Closing the session, the VN-Index increased slightly by 1.85 points (0.27%) to 696.06 points;while HNX-Index decreased 0.69% to 97.14 points and UPCom-Index decreased 0.36% to 48.38 points.The number of declining codes on the 3 exchanges was completely overwhelming with 426, while the number of increasing codes was only 243.
Market liquidity still remains quite good with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching about 3,500 billion VND.The bright spot in the session came from foreign investors' transactions when they returned to net buying 30 billion VND after a series of 33 consecutive net selling sessions.
On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts closed with a negative basis from 27.23 to nearly 35 points, showing that investor sentiment is quite pessimistic towards the market.
=======================================================
After the "green on the skin, red on the inside" situation in the morning, selling pressure increased significantly in the afternoon session.Many Bluechips dropped deeply, in which MWG even reduced the "buy side" floor to 63,300 VND, negatively affecting the market.
The efforts of some stocks such as VIC, MSN, VCB, HVN, SAB, VCB are helping VN-Index not fall too deeply in terms of score.
At 2:10 p.m., the VN-Index turned down slightly by 0.07 points (0.01%) to 694.14 points;HNX-Index and UPCom-Index also decreased.The positive point right now is that foreign investors are net buying more than 50 billion VND in the entire market.
=================================
Market movements at the end of the morning session were quite positive with the recovery of many large stocks.VIC increased by 6.7% to 87,300 VND, the stock that had the strongest impact on the market.In addition, MSN, VCB, VNM, SAB also increased sharply, which was the main driving force to help the market break out.
However, this morning's market movements are somewhat "green on the outside, red on the inside" when, in addition to the strong stocks, most stocks are still falling, including Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, GAS, HPG, REE, VJC, PLX, PNJ, VRE, MWG...
Pausing the morning session, the VN-Index increased 7.57 points (1.09%) to 701.78 points;HNX-Index increased 0.28% to 98.09 points;UPCom-Index increased 0.27% to 49.14 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching about 1,500 billion VND.The number of decreasing codes on the 3 exchanges was overwhelming with 330 codes, while the number of increasing codes was only 233 codes.
The positive point at this time is that foreign investors are currently net buying nearly 20 billion VND in the entire market, focusing on Bluechips such as VNM, VIC, VCB, E1VFVN30, VHM...
======================================
After a few minutes of deep decline at the beginning of the session, investor psychology gradually stabilized and bottom-fishing demand appeared in many large stocks.Bluechips such as CTG, DPH, DHG, GAS, MSN, VCB, VIC, VNM, POW... all increased points, helping the Index reverse to increase.
On the downside, VPB, VJC, VRE, FPT, REE or retail stocks MWG, PNJ, FRT are the names holding back the market.
At 10:55 a.m., the VN-Index increased 4.2 points (0.61%) to 698.41 points;HNX-Index increased 0.08% to 97.89 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.14% to 49.07 points.
Foreign investors are still net buyers of more than 5 billion VND in the entire market, which is quite positive after a series of extremely strong net sales recently.
================================
Contrary to the excitement of many Asian stock markets, the Vietnamese market opened the weekend trading session quite cautiously with red covering the indexes right from the opening minutes.A series of Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, GAS, MSN, VCB, VNM, VIC, VHM, VRE... all fell deeply, negatively impacting the market and at one point the VN-Index lost more than 10 points.
Retail stocks MWG, PNJ, and FRT were also negatively affected in the context of many retail stores being closed in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
In the group of large stocks, CTG, DHG, and VTP are rare names that increased, but the increase was not significant.
At 9:40 a.m., the VN-Index decreased 6.13 points (0.88%) to 686.08 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.33% to 97.49 points and UPCom-Index decreased 0.17% to 48.92 points.
The positive point right now is that foreign investors are returning to net buying on all 3 exchanges with a total value of 20 billion VND.Although the buying force is not too large, it is an important support factor after foreign investors have had a series of 33 consecutive net selling sessions.
author: Minh Anh

title: Stocks were "green" at the end of the session, VnIndex decreased slightly due to VIC, VHM, VRE and SAB
sapo: A series of stocks have received support from bottom-fishing cash flow and recovered strongly from prices close to the floor to reference, and many stocks even increased.
content:
At the end of the March 17 trading session, the psychological pressure on the whole market was suddenly lifted when the index quickly reversed to green before the ATC session.The ATC session also took place quite similar to the scenario investors expected when weighing orders mostly at green prices.However, the trio VIC-VHM-VRE dropped deeply by 4.3%;2.6%, 6.8% and SAB decreased by 5.9%, causing VnIndex to not be in the green.
On HoSE, at the end of the trading session, there were 211 codes increasing compared to 154 codes decreasing.This proves that the consensus of large-scale bottom-fishing cash flow has effectively promoted investor psychology and stimulated stronger bottom-fishing cash flow.
At the end of the trading session, the VN30 group had PLX and SSI reaching "purple" prices.PLX achieved a large ceiling bid surplus thanks to a series of good related information.
Although REE and CTD did not have the purple color, the increase of over 6% was enough to help these two stocks pass the old price threshold quite well.
Although PNJ was not in the green, this stock closed at the highest price of the day - reaching 57,000 VND.
We expect that the efforts of countries in general and Vietnam in particular in "saving" the economy will be effective.But, every trading day is a very new day with very strong fluctuations, so during this period, investors should pay close attention to avoid being psychologically affected when trading.
=========
Close to the ATC session, a series of large stocks reversed quickly.BVH suddenly reversed and increased by nearly 4%.A series of stocks in the VN30 group also increased sharply, pushing the VN30-Index into green.VnIndex still decreased slightly.
PLX, NTL, HCM currently have ceiling buying surplus.
======
In the early afternoon, selling pressure increased quite high compared to the morning session.We would like to reiterate that during this period, the stock market is very sensitive.With just a little impact from market psychology, investors can be quite clearly affected and buying and selling activities become very complicated.Investors participating in transactions need to be alert, not be shaken by the market's slight blows or completely stay out of the market to avoid losses.
==========
The morning trading session ended with a strong recovery of VnIndex.At the end of the session, VnIndex only dropped less than 7 points, recovering strongly compared to the decrease of 25 points at the beginning of the session.HoSE liquidity is up to 2,320 billion VND.
A series of stocks have received support from bottom-fishing cash flow and recovered strongly from prices close to the floor to reference, and many stocks even increased.
In the VN30 group, the most notable is PLX.After a period of deep decline, PLX issued a resolution to buy back treasury shares and prepare to finalize the right to pay cash dividends at a rate of 20%.A flood of supportive news helped PLX increase sharply by 4.1% to 38,300 VND/share.
SBT also recovered strongly with an increase of 3% to 15,250 VND.
FPT recovered slightly thanks to the push from foreign capital flows.This morning, foreign investors net bought 118 thousand FPT shares, pushing this stock price up 0.7%.
==========
We almost couldn't take our eyes off the price list when the stock market was moving so quickly.Just -24 points, bottom-catching demand pushed VnIndex quickly to -16 points.As of 9:50 a.m., HoSE matched 1,028 billion VND and HNX reached 186 billion VND.
==========
This morning's trading session, due to the psychological influence of quite negative developments in the world stock market, the Vietnamese stock market still dropped quite sharply despite the strong rise in bottom-fishing demand.
At the current price level, most stocks have reached their lowest price range for many years.Even for businesses with normal and good business operations during the epidemic, the decline in stock prices has reached -25, -30% compared to before Tet.Because the stock is currently too low compared to its valuation, bottom-fishing demand has risen strongly.As of 9:40 a.m., after only 40 minutes of trading, HoSE had traded 880 billion VND, HNX reached 142.3 billion VND.
We do not dare to recommend that investors buy or sell on this occasion because the market exists in parallel with many factors at the same time: Up-Down continuously with strong amplitude, so investors who love risk can still make money even when the market is down trend and the market is sensitive due to a lot of information from international to domestic.Depending on their investment taste, investors can consider taking action.However, we recommend that investors, no matter what action they choose, must be very calm and avoid herd mentality.
Returning to the stock market, after losing 24 points at the opening session, the market became more stable when the decrease level fell back to -20 points.Many large stocks have recovered strongly such as VNM, MSN, HPG, BID... The downward momentum continues to narrow rapidly.By the 47th minute of trading, the decrease was only -18 points.
FLC stocks are still going against the market, many stocks are in the ceiling increase group such as HAI, AMD, ART...
author: Phuong Chi

title: Set 3VIC, VHM, VRE recovered strongly in the ATC session, VN-Index narrowed the decline to 26 points
sapo: The trio of VIC, VHM, and VRE all recovered to (close to) the reference, contributing to significantly narrowing the market decline.
content:
In the last minutes of the session, market developments were somewhat more positive with traction from Bluechips.The trio of VIC, VHM, and VRE all recovered to (close to) the reference, contributing to significantly narrowing the market decline.
On the Hanoi floor, SHB was also an impressive name in the afternoon session when it suddenly increased its ceiling to 11,100 VND.
On the contrary, many large stocks still fell deeply, even hitting the floor such as GAS, STB, VJC, VPB, PNJ, BID, SSI, MWG, TCB, HCM, FRT, CTD...
Real estate, securities, banking, construction, oil and gas stocks... in general were sold quite strongly and many of them fell to the floor.
In today's session, the "FLC group" also attracted attention when HAI, KLF, and AMD closed at ceiling prices.
Closing the session, the VN-Index decreased 26.15 points (3.12%) to 811.35 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.64% to 105.52 points and UPCom-Index decreased 1.65% to 52.53 points.Market liquidity continues to be high with transaction value (including agreements) on 3 exchanges reaching more than 6,000 billion VND.
Foreign investors continued to net sell on all 3 exchanges but the pressure was somewhat "cooled down" compared to recent sessions with a net selling value of 260 billion VND.
However, on the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts closed with a negative basis from 7.56 points to 13.16 points, showing that investor psychology is still quite cautious with the current market trend.
==========================================================
Update: At 13:11, the VN-Index decreased 40 points (4.78%) to 797.5 points.
===============
Selling pressure continued to increase sharply right from the opening minutes of the afternoon session, causing the indexes to continue to decline deeply.The information that a Dien May Xanh employee tested positive for Covid-19 caused retail stocks such as MWG, PNJ, FRT, and VRE to fall to the floor.
Regarding the aviation industry, VJC also fell to the floor, while HVN is currently only down slightly by 1.3%.
At 13:60, the VN-Index decreased 33.12 points (3.95%) to 804.38 points;HNX-Index decreased 2.61% to 103.42 points and UPCom-Index decreased 1.19% to 52.77 points.
======================================
The selling pressure increased more and more towards the end of the morning session, causing the market to sink deeply into the red.In the Bluechips group, only VNM, SAB, BHN can maintain the green color, while most other big names such as BCH, CTG, FPT, GAS, HPG, MSN, VIC, VHM, VRE, VCB, MWG... all dropped sharply.
The decline is not only concentrated in the Bluechips group but has spread to many industry groups such as securities, banking, real estate, construction, oil and gas, textiles,...
YEG continued to be sold to the floor at 66,800 VND and this was also the 3rd consecutive floor sale session.Meanwhile, SHB, after two consecutive sessions of falling to the floor, recovered this morning with an increase of 200 VND.
This morning, Viettel stocks also traded more positively than the general market with CTR, VGI, and VTP increasing.Besides, the "FLC group" also attracted quite strong cash flow with HAI, KLF, and AMD hitting the ceiling.
Pausing the morning session, the VN-Index decreased 16.15 points (1.93%) to 821.35 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.86% to 105.29 points and UPCom-Index decreased 0.39% to 53.21 points.Market liquidity was low compared to the previous session, reaching VND 2,300 billion.
Foreign investors are currently net sellers on all 3 exchanges with a total value of 150 billion VND.On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts are currently maintaining a negative basis from 1.38 to 6.58 points, showing that investor psychology is quite cautious.
===================================
After the "bulltrap" minutes at the beginning of the session, market movements are becoming quite bad with a sharp increase in the number of declining stocks.Bluechips FPT, MSN, VCB, VIC, VJC, PLX, VRE, VHM,... all fell sharply, causing the market to lose its support.The efforts of GAS, VNM, and SAB were not enough to help the market avoid a deep decline.
The decline spread to many industry groups such as securities, banking, oil and gas, real estate, construction, textiles, etc.
Meanwhile, the "FLC group" is attracting quite good cash flow with HAI, KLF, and AMD increasing to the ceiling.
At 10:35 a.m., the VN-Index decreased 8.83 points (1.05%) to 828.67 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.2% to 105.99 points.
=======================================================
The first minutes of the session were quite positive and the VN-Index sometimes increased 7 points.However, the complicated developments of the Covid-19 epidemic have significantly affected investor psychology, causing selling pressure to quickly increase, leading to a reversal of the index.
Bluechips such as HPG, VCB, VIC, VJC, VRE, PNJ, VHM, NVL... all dropped, negatively affecting the market.On the contrary, BVH, CTG, FPT, GAS, VNM, SAB, MBB are notable gainers.
"FLC group" is attracting quite strong cash flow with a series of increasing stocks such as ROS, FLC, HAI, KLF, AMD, ART, of which HAI, KLF, AMD even increased to the ceiling.
At 9:50 a.m., the VN-Index decreased slightly by 2.54 points (0.3%) to 834.96 points;while HNX-Index increased 0.59% to 106.82 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.43% to 53.64 points.
Foreign investors are currently net sellers on all 3 exchanges with a total value of 15 billion VND, focusing on HPG, NVL, VJC, E1VFVN30...
author: Minh Anh

title: Stocks suddenly increased brilliantly in the afternoon session, VIC increased sharply by nearly 5%
sapo: HoSE liquidity reached 3,300 billion VND today.
content:
In the afternoon trading session, stocks suddenly broke out strongly.VIC suddenly reversed and increased by nearly 5% to 110,000 VND.In previous sessions, the drop in VIC stock price had a significant impact on VnIndex.Today's session, VIC's strong increase also helped VnIndex increase by more than 9 points, to 938.13 points.
================
At the end of the morning session, VnIndex only increased by 3 points compared to nearly 9 points at the beginning of the hour.In fact, this period is a testing period for the market's trend as the market has recovered quite a bit since the "corona bottom session" but is still quite far from the score achieved before Tet.
Both buyers and sellers are patiently waiting, not in a hurry as the stock market story at this time is influenced by a lot of information such as the evolution of the epidemic in China, the response of other countries in the world to the epidemic, response to the post-epidemic economic situation... Cash flow from foreign investors is, after all, a big factor in stock market fluctuations, so how foreign investors act is noteworthy.
In the VN30 group, POW increased sharply by 2.4%.On the world market, oil prices are increasing sharply, so the effect is quite good on the price of oil and gas stocks.
VPB is "replacing" CTG in the banking stocks group.While CTG reversed to decrease, VPB increased by 1.4%.
==================
At the beginning of today's trading session, the world stock market received information that the number of new infected people in China decreased sharply compared to yesterday, making market psychology more optimistic and at the same time, investment cash flow was activated when the epidemic control situation in Vietnam was very positive, with no new cases appearing for several consecutive days.
At 9:30 a.m., VnIndex increased sharply by more than 7 points.The number of increasing codes reached 195 while the number of codes still in the red was only 50.
Strong cash flow poured into the market, so in just 30 minutes of trading, the trading value on HoSE reached 480 billion VND.
On HoSE, the most notable are CTG and MBB.CTG today increased 1.1% with quite high liquidity, in just 30 minutes of trading, 2.23 million shares changed hands.MBB also achieved good liquidity with 1.7 million shares traded and the stock is currently up 1%.
Although banking stocks are not increasing strongly, they are increasing steadily as a whole group.Currently, in addition to EVNfinance's EVF stock, which decreased slightly after a series of hot increases, the remaining banking stocks all increased.
On the downside, we note the case of GTN stock.GTN today suddenly dropped quite deeply by 5.2% even though the merger story was "in place".Previously, when the information that Ms. Mai Kieu Lien was appointed as president of GTNfoods and Moc Chau Milk was announced, GTN stock price increased sharply.
author: Phuong Chi

title: Stock VISDI Swap has been trading since February 24
sapo: VIC shares closed on February 19 at the price of 105,000 VND/share, down from the price range of 115,000 VND/share in the past week.The total number of VIC securities after the listing change reached more than 3.38 billion shares.
content:
According to the announcement of the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE), nearly 13.86 million shares of Vingroup (HoSE: VIC) issued to swap shares of Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Company (SDI) will be traded from February 24.The total number of VIC securities after the listing change reached more than 3.38 billion shares.
At the end of last year, Vingroup merged with Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Company at a ratio of 1.1:1 (1.1 VIC shares for 1 SDI share).At the time of the swap information, SDI stock price was more than 90,000 VND/share while Vingroup stock price was nearly 120,000 VND.
After the swap, Vingroup became the parent company holding 100% of Sai Dong's capital.Previously, Sai Dong was a subsidiary of Vingroup with 89.5% ownership.The company was established in 2009, specializing in investing in projects in Hanoi such as Vinhomes Riverside project, Vinhomes Gardenia, Mai Dich lake park, Vinhomes Skylake and Cau Giay lake park.
SDI shares stopped trading on UPCoM from December 26, 2019 at the price of 115,000 VND/share.Meanwhile, VIC shares closed on February 19 at a price of 105,000 VND/share, down from the price range of 115,000 VND/share in the past week.
Source: VNDirect
author: According to Thuy Yen

title: CTG and VIC simultaneously dropped points, VN-Index failed before the 940 point mark
sapo: The weakness of a few large stocks, typically CTG reversing and decreasing by 550 VND (-2%), VIC decreasing by 1,400 VND or BID retreating to reference, has caused the market's upward momentum to narrow significantly.
content:
In the afternoon session, there was a time when the VN-Index broke out 8 points.However, the weakness of a few large stocks, typically CTG reversing and decreasing by 550 VND (-2%), VIC decreasing by 1,400 VND or BID retreating to reference, has caused the market's upward momentum to narrow significantly.
Positive developments of FPT, MSN, GAS, HVN, MWG... have helped the market maintain its green color, although the upward momentum is not too strong.POW also attracted attention in today's session when it increased to the ceiling to 10,550 VND.
Meanwhile, real estate, construction, oil and gas stocks or "Viettel group" in general had a quite positive trading session with the green color dominating.
FLC group also attracted attention when they simultaneously increased sharply, even ROS, HAI, KLF, AMD, and ART also increased to the ceiling.
Closing the session, the VN-Index increased 3.01 points (0.32%) to 937.68 points;HNX-Index increased 3.57% to 108.51 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.4% to 55.89 points.The entire market's matching value reached about VND 3,600 billion.
Foreign investors' transactions were not really positive as they sold net on all 3 exchanges with a total value of 53 billion VND.On the Derivatives market, the F2002 futures contract closed with a negative basis of 6.63 points, showing that investor sentiment is still quite cautious at this time.
======================================
Pausing the morning session, the VN-Index increased 5.19 points (0.56%) to 939.86 points;HNX-Index increased 2.5% to 107.4 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.25% to 55.81 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the matched order value on 3 exchanges of about 1,700 billion VND.
Foreign investors net bought 26 billion VND in the whole market, of which E1VFVN30 alone was net bought 25.6 billion VND.
This morning, TCB issued an order to "exchange" more than 14 million shares among foreign investors at a ceiling price of 23,700 VND/share, equivalent to a size of 333.34 billion VND.
Leading the market's increase this morning was the group of banking stocks with many strong breakthrough codes such as ACB, CTG, MBB, VCB, HDB, TCB... Besides, many Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, MWG, PNJ, VNM... also increased well, helping the green color of the market to be consolidated.
The market's upward momentum also spread to many other industry groups such as real estate, construction, and oil and gas.Viettel stocks such as CTR, VGI, VTP, VTK also attracted cash flow and increased quite well this morning.
=================================
The trading session on February 12 was quite positive with green color present on the indices right from the opening minutes.Bank stocks ACB, BID, CTG, MBB, VPB, TCB,... traded quite well and were the main driving force to help the market increase.
Besides, Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, GAS, HPG, MSN, VNM, PLX, MWG, VHM... also increased, helping the market's green color to strengthen.Real estate and construction groups also recorded many gainers such as CII, DXG, DIG, HBC, HDC, TDH, NLG, NTC, DPG...
On UPCom, "Viettel" stocks such as CTR, VGI, VTP, and VTK also attracted cash flow and increased quite well.
At 9:55 a.m., the VN-Index increased 4.64 points (0.5%) to 939.31 points;HNX-Index increased 2.04% to 106.91 points and UPCom-Index increased 0.01% to 55.67 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with the matched value of 3 exchanges about 750 billion VND.
The positive point right now is that foreign investors are net buying 40 billion VND in the whole market, the buying force is focused on E1VFVN30 (23 billion VND), HPG (10 billion VND)...
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors net sold nearly 700 billion VND in the first week of February, focusing on 'discharging' VIC
sapo: Topping the list of net buying by foreign investors on HoSE in the first week of February is HDB with a value of more than 112 billion VND. In contrast to two stocks with the same "Vin" family name, VRE and VHM, VIC was net sold very strongly by foreign investors and amounted to 192 billion VND.
content:
After two sell-off sessions in early spring, the market started February with a recovery and stability.At the end of the last trading session of the first week of February, VN-Index stood at 940.75 points, equivalent to an increase of 0.4% compared to the previous week.Similarly, HNX-Index also increased 2.5% to 104.92 points.
Despite a certain recovery, the negative point of the market last week was that foreign investors were still quite strong net sellers.Overall for all three exchanges, foreign investors bought 119 million shares, worth VND 4,429 billion, while selling 145 million shares, worth VND 5,123 billion.The total net selling volume reached 26.4 million shares, corresponding to a net selling value of nearly 694 billion VND.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold 627 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 21.8 million shares.
Topping the list of net purchases of foreign investors on HoSE in the first week of February is HDB with a value of more than 112 billion VND.Domestic CCQ ETF still received significant attention from foreign investors with a net purchase of 90.7 billion VND.The duo of "Vin" stocks, VRE and VHM, were net bought VND 41 billion and VND 36 billion, respectively.
Meanwhile, another "Vin" stock, VIC, was strongly sold by foreign investors, amounting to 192 billion VND.NVL also saw a net sale of 112 billion VND last week.DXG and MSN were net sold 99 billion VND and 92 billion VND respectively.
On the HNX, foreign investors also sold a net of 90.6 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 7.7 million shares.
Foreign investors on HNX focused on net buying of 3 codes VCS, AMV and TIG but the values ​​were all modest at less than 10 billion VND.Meanwhile, PVS was sold the most with a value of 52.5 billion VND.SHB was also net sold 21 billion VND.In addition, foreign investors on HNX also sold relatively strong net stocks such as NTP, SHS or NDN...
On UPCoM, foreign investors slightly net bought 24 billion VND, corresponding to a net buying volume of 3 million shares.
BSR was the strongest net buy by foreign investors on UPCoM with a value of 17 billion VND.VEA also received a net purchase of more than 10.4 billion VND.Meanwhile, CTR was the strongest net seller on this exchange with 9.5 billion VND.ACV was also net sold 6.2 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: Foreign investors net bought for the 3rd consecutive year on HoSE with 6,700 billion VND, VIC and CCQ E1VFVN30 are the focus
sapo: Foreign investors on HoSE net bought for 3 consecutive years with a total value of nearly 76,000 billion VND. Foreign investors on HNX net sold up to 3,070 billion VND after the past 3 years.VIC in 2019 was net bought by foreign investors for VND 5,300 billion, while previously it was net sold for 5 consecutive years with a total value of VND 21,600 billion.
content:
At the end of 2019, VN-Index stood at 960.99 points, equivalent to an increase of 68.45 points (7.67%) compared to the end of 2018. Meanwhile, HNX-Index decreased 1.71 points (-1.65%) to 102.51 points.UPCoM-Index increased 3.73 points (7.06%) to 56.56 points.
The market only focused on increasing points in the first 2 months of the year then fell into a state of struggle.Around November, the market adjusted very strongly not long after the VN-Index surpassed the 1,000 point mark.On November 6 session, VN-Index reached its 2019 peak at 1,024.91 points.
Foreign investors continued to make important contributions to the path of market indices in 2019. Specifically, foreign investors were still net buyers on the HoSE and UPCoM exchanges, while net sellers were strong on the HNX floor.Calculated on the stock and fund certificate market (CCQ), foreign investors bought 4.4 billion shares, worth 175,031 billion VND, while selling 4.5 billion shares, worth 167,731 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached 92 million shares, but in terms of value, they still net bought 7,300 billion VND.
On HoSE, foreign investors had the third consecutive year of net buying but the value decreased by 84.5% compared to 2018 to 6,700 billion VND. However, in terms of volume, they net sold back to 37.3 million shares.Thus, in the past 3 years, foreign investors on HoSE have net bought a total of nearly 76,000 billion VND.
Net buying (selling) value of foreign investors on HoSE since 2013.
Since 2013 until now, foreign investors on HoSE have only net sold in 2016 (VND 7,828 billion).The total net buying value since then is 78,602 billion VND.
VIC in 2019 was net bought by foreign investors for VND 5,300 billion, while previously it was net sold for 5 consecutive years with a total value of VND 21,600 billion.However, VIC's net buying volume last year mainly came from agreement transactions.Specifically, foreign investors net bought up to VND 5,900 billion of VIC shares through agreement.Foreign investors continued to strongly net buy CCQ domestic ETF E1VFVN30 with a value of 2,430 billion VND.The strong net buying of VIC by foreign investors came from the deal on May 16, when Vingroup and SK Group officially signed a strategic cooperation agreement.In particular, SK registered to buy 154.3 million shares issued under the private offering plan from Vingroup and bought back 51.4 million secondary shares from VinCommerce, with an average price of 113,000 VND/share.Total transaction value is about 23,300 billion VND, equivalent to 1 billion USD.
Similar to VIC, CCQ E1VFVN30 was also net purchased by foreign investors for more than 1,800 billion VND through agreement.Two shares, PLX and VCB, were net purchased for VND 2,100 billion and VND 1,750 billion, respectively.
On the contrary, VJC rose to the top of the net selling list of foreign investors on HoSE with a value of nearly 2,500 billion VND.VHM, VNM and HDB stocks all have a net selling value of over 1,000 billion VND.
In contrast to HoSE, foreign investors on HNX sold net for the third consecutive year, with the value decreasing by 61% compared to 2018 and reaching 776 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 40 million shares.In total, foreign investors on HNX net sold up to 3,070 billion VND after the past 3 years.
Net buying (selling) value of foreign investors on HNX since 2013.
PVI is the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX with 532 billion VND.CDN was also net bought 402 billion VND.Notably, both PVI and CDN were mainly strongly net bought by foreign investors through agreements.Two bank stocks on HNX, NVB and SHB, were net bought by foreign investors for VND 180 billion and VND 97 billion, respectively.
On the contrary, VGC was net sold by foreign investors up to 1,100 billion VND.Around February, Dragon Capital fund group divested nearly 10% of VGC capital to domestic investors.The total transfer value of the agreement is estimated at more than 887 billion VND.Meanwhile, Gelex Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd. announced to buy 27 million VGC shares on February 26 to hold more than 6% of capital.Gelex Electrical Equipment is a wholly owned subsidiary of Vietnam Electrical Equipment Joint Stock Corporation (Gelex - HoSE: GEX).NET and CEO were net sold by foreign investors for VND 208 billion and VND 137 billion, respectively.
On UPCoM, foreign investors continued to net buy 1,409 billion VND (down 46.7% compared to last year's net selling value), but in terms of volume, they net sold back to 14.7 million shares.
QNS was the strongest net buy by foreign investors on UPCoM with a value of 607 billion VND.VTP and MPC were net bought VND 520 billion and VND 489 billion respectively.Meanwhile, IDC was sold the most with a net sale of 632 billion VND.BSR continued to be net sold 337 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: Foreign investors net sold more than 86 billion VND in the week of two ETF transactions, focusing on 'discharging' VIC
sapo: MBB and VNM are the two stocks with the strongest net buying by foreign investors.CCQ domestic ETF E1VFVN30 was also net bought up to more than 102 billion VND.
content:
The market continued to have shaky movements in the week of December 16-20.The group of pillar stocks has not really recovered, so the pressure on the general market is still quite large.At the end of the trading week, VN-Index decreased 1% compared to the previous week and stopped at 956.41 points.HNX-Index also decreased 0.5% to 102.42 points.
Because this week is the time when both ETF funds, FTSE and V.N.M, are trading together to complete the fourth quarter investment portfolio restructuring, trading developments on the market are a bit chaotic, especially foreign transactions.
For the whole market, foreign investors bought 110.6 million shares, worth 3,914 billion VND, while selling 112.7 million shares, worth 4,000 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached more than 2 million shares, corresponding to a net selling value of 86.5 billion VND.
Foreign investors on HoSE had the third consecutive week of net selling, but the value decreased by 77% compared to the previous week and reached more than 94.5 billion VND, but in terms of volume, foreign investors on this floor bought a slight net of 992,330 shares.
Topping the list of net purchases of foreign investors on HoSE last week was MBB shares with a value of 184 billion VND.The above transaction of foreign investors was carried out in the session of December 16 right when MBB opened foreign 'room' due to the issuance of shares under the employee option program (ESOP).VNM was boosted by foreign investors to net buy more than 181 billion VND.CCQ domestic ETF E1VFVN30 was also net bought up to more than 102 billion VND.This is also the 5th consecutive week that this CCQ is on the list of stocks/CCQs with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors.
On the contrary, VIC was net sold the most by foreign investors with a value of more than 233.5 billion VND.VJC and MSN are behind with net selling values ​​of VND 90.7 billion and VND 86.4 billion, respectively.With the FTSE ETF being removed from its investment portfolio this period, GEX was net sold by foreign investors for more than 48 billion VND last week.
On HNX, foreign investors slightly net sold 15.6 billion VND (down 89% compared to last week's net selling value), corresponding to a net selling volume of 2.5 million shares.
Foreign investors on HNX are still the strongest net buyers of VCS code with a value of more than 4.4 billion VND.The two codes IDV and TIG were both net bought over 1 billion VND.Meanwhile, SHB suffered the strongest net selling of 11.8 billion VND.PVS and VNR were net sold 4.5 billion VND and 1.9 billion VND respectively.
On UPCoM, foreign investors continued to net buy 23.6 billion VND (up 32.5% compared to last week), however, if calculated in terms of volume, they net sold back to 675,676 shares.
ACV is the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors on UPCoM with 28.3 billion VND.VTP and QNS were net bought VND 7.8 billion and VND 4.2 billion respectively.Meanwhile, SDI had the strongest net selling of 7.9 billion VND.BSR was also net sold for more than 6 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: SDI canceled its trading registration on UPCom on December 27, 2019 to swap VIC shares
sapo: After the stock exchange, Vingroup will become the sole owner owning 100% of SDI's charter capital.
content:
VinGroup (VIC) has just announced the issuance of shares to the public to exchange all shares for shareholders of Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Joint Stock Company (SDI), except shareholder VinGroup.
Accordingly, VinGroup will issue nearly 13.86 million shares for swap, corresponding to a swap ratio of 1:1.1 (1 SDI share will be exchanged for 1.1 VIC shares).After this issuance, VinGroup's charter capital will increase to 34,438 billion VND.
The closing date for the list of shareholders performing stock swaps is December 30, 2019 and the date of canceling SDI transaction registration on UPCom is December 27, 2019.
After the stock exchange, Vingroup will become the sole owner owning 100% of SDI's charter capital.Accordingly, Sai Dong Urban Development and Investment Joint Stock Company will be registered to convert its business type into a one-member LLC.
On the stock exchange, SDI shares ended the December 11, 2019 trading session at 110,500 VND/share, while VIC's market price was 115,900 VND/share.

title: Forecast of ETFs portfolio at the end of 2019: VIB will have its weight increased, GEX may be removed from the portfolio
sapo: FTSE Vietnam Index will announce the index on the afternoon of December 6 (Friday), MVIS Vietnam Index will announce the index later on the morning of December 14 (Saturday).After that, the two funds VNM ETF and FTSE Vietnam ETF will complete their portfolio structure on December 20 (Friday).
content:
As scheduled, in December there will be a portfolio restructuring period for the two indexes MVIS Vietnam Index and FTSE Vietnam Index, the base index of the two funds Vaneck Vectors Vietnam ETF (VNM ETF) and FTSE Vietnam ETF.
Currently, the size of the VNM ETF portfolio is up to 462 million USD, while the FTSE Vietnam ETF has a size of 292 million USD and these are also the two leading large-scale ETF funds in the Vietnamese market.Therefore, the portfolio restructuring activities of these two funds will have a significant impact on market fluctuations.
FTSE Vietnam Index will announce the index on the afternoon of December 6 (Friday), MVIS Vietnam Index will announce the index later on the morning of December 14 (Saturday).After that, the two funds VNM ETF and FTSE Vietnam ETF will complete their portfolio structure on December 20 (Friday).
Recently, the Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BSC) Securities Company has made a forecast for the portfolio restructuring of 2 indexes as well as 2 VNM ETF funds, FTSE Vietnam ETF in the final restructuring phase in 2019.
With FTSE Vietnam Index: Based on data on November 15, BSC forecasts that this index will not change stocks during the portfolio review in December.
However, in the case of GEX, it has low liquidity of 433 thousand USD/session (compared to a requirement of more than 500 thousand USD/session) and is likely to be eliminated if trading does not improve in the second half of November.
The FTSE Vietnam Index portfolio is expected to follow two scenarios as follows: (1) Maintain the portfolio;(2) Type GEX if liquidity does not improve beyond 500 thousand USD/session.
In both scenarios BSC proposed, stocks with reduced proportions include VHM, VJC, SSI, POW, STB, PDR... On the contrary, notable stocks with increased proportions include VIC, VRE, MSN, SBT, PLX...
FTSE Vietnam ETF portfolio forecast
With MVIS Vietnam Index (base index of VNM ETF): BSC forecasts that this index will not change the portfolio.If MVIS Vietnam Index continues to keep the proportion of Vietnamese stocks at 72.05%, it is likely that VNM ETF will buy an additional 110 billion VND of Vietnamese stocks.
The stocks with notable weight increases include VIC, VNM, NVL, BVH, POW... On the other hand, SBT, VJC, HPG, VHM, VCB... will be the stocks with notable weight drops.

title: The set of 3VIC, VHM, VRE contributed nearly 11 points to the VN-Index increase, the capitalization of the "VinGroup group" increased by nearly 37 trillion VND in the first session of November
sapo: Stock capitalization on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE) ended the trading session in early November up to nearly 3.44 million billion VND, an increase of 56,786 billion VND (2.45 billion USD) compared to the previous trading session, of which, the capitalization of "VinGroup group" increased by a total of 36,786 billion VND.
content:
The trading session in early November was explosive when the VN-Index closed at 1,015.59 points, corresponding to an increase of 16.77 points (1.68%).This is also the strongest increasing session of VN-Index since March 12 until now (nearly 8 months).
The market's impressive upward momentum has a major contribution from the "VinGroup" group of stocks, including VIC, VHM, and VRE.Of which, VHM increased by 6,200 VND (ceiling increase) after information that VinHomes was preparing to buy a maximum of 60 million treasury shares, equivalent to 1.79% of capital.Similarly, VRE also increased by 1,850 VND (5.6%) after information that Vincom Retail wanted to buy a maximum of 56.5 million treasury shares, equivalent to 2.426%.
Meanwhile, VIC, as the largest shareholder in VHM and VRE, also broke out in today's session with an increase of 3,500 VND (2.9%) to 122,500 VND.
According to our calculations, in the November 1 session, VHM was the stock that contributed the most to the increase in VN-Index with 6.02 points, followed by VIC (3.4 points), VRE (1.25 points), VNM (1.21 points), VCB (1.18 points).
Thus, "VinGroup" alone contributed a total of 10.67 points out of a total of 16.77 points of the VN-Index in the November 1 session (contributing nearly 2/3 of the score).
Stock capitalization on the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HoSE) ended the trading session in early November up to nearly 3.44 million billion VND, an increase of 56,786 billion VND (2.45 billion USD) compared to the previous trading session, of which, the capitalization of "VinGroup group" increased by a total of 36,786 billion VND.
At the closing price of November 1, VinGroup's capitalization was equivalent to 409,877 billion VND (17.7 billion USD).The value of shares held by Chairman Pham Nhat Vuong is up to 228,485 billion VND (9.85 billion USD).Meanwhile, according to the Forbes list, Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong's net worth is currently about 7.9 billion USD and is the 212th richest person in the world.
Top 10 stocks with largest market capitalization as of November 1
In the first 9 months of the year, VinGroup achieved system-wide consolidated revenue of 92,600 billion VND;Pre-tax profit reached VND 9,400 billion, an increase of 12%.
Regarding revenue structure, except for the real estate business segment, which recorded a decrease in revenue - from 57,000 to 49,500 billion VND - due to a reduction in the number of handovers, other business segments all grew by double digits over the same period.
The strongest growth was in the retail segment with an increase of over 70%, from VND 12,900 billion to VND 21,900 billion, contributing 24% of total revenue.This significant growth partly comes from the fact that Vingroup has acquired a number of large businesses such as Vien Thong A and Fivimart as well as promoting the opening of new Vinmart/Vinmart+ systems.
The manufacturing segment - including VinSmart phones and VinFast cars and motorbikes - reached VND 4,300 billion in revenue while the same period had no revenue.The revenue of this segment in the third quarter alone is nearly equivalent to the revenue of the first half of the year.

title: Thong Nhat Matches has only sold matches for 58 years, Siam Brothers "pocketed" 130 billion just by selling rope and VICPartners Fund Founder Hung Dinh's concern with young startup CEOs: Do a small thing, make it big!
sapo: The 3-hour debate between Founder of VIC Partners fund and CEO of DesignBold Hung Dinh and the young CEO revolved around Mr. Hung trying to convince the CEO to focus on one product and having to know how to flatly refuse when customers ask to make other products.The CEO's view is the opposite: After providing a product, try to sell a few more products to retain customers...
content:
Regarding the strategy of developing a startup, Mr. Hung Dinh, CEO of DesignBold, and founder of VIC Partners - a venture capital fund focusing on supporting early-stage startups in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, has invested in many startups such as TopCV, ColorMe, HappySkin, WisePass... has an interesting article sharing about the development strategy of early-stage startups, we would like to share with readers.
Yesterday, after sitting with a young CEO in a meeting for nearly 3 hours but yielding no results, I almost didn't sleep all night.I was restless because I failed to convince that startup to change the company's key product strategy in the near future.
This afternoon I have a second meeting, afraid it will still fail.I had to share these lines to express my condolences to that startup.But before sending it, I would like to receive more opinions from friends, especially those who have started a business like me.
First of all, I tell everyone a few stories, let's call it "doing a small thing, making it big".
1. JA Purity
One of my first successes was the startup JoomlArt.And very few people know that success has a huge contribution from a small project - making it big;It's a JA Purity product.JA Purity reached about 50 million downloads within 5 years.This small product took us 1 month to make, 6 months to campaign for marketing to make it an integral part of Joomla, it is the company's most successful marketing strategy for 10 years.
A product with less than 500 lines of code, used by 50 million people, making us the largest Joomla company in the world, an example of "doing something small, making it big".
2. Unified Matches
Photo: Dan Viet.
From the time I was born until now, every time I see a matchbox at a roadside stand or at a 5-star restaurant, I have never seen a brand other than "Thong Nhat Matches".This startup was established in 1956 in Duc Giang, Gia Lam;steadfastly only making matches and matches, it was not until 2014 (that is, after 58 years) that the startup started producing lighters.
Producing lighters is not difficult, but I believe the founder is also someone who likes to "make a small thing big".The startup later successfully IPO'd. Every year, the company sells over 100 million matchboxes, with revenue in 2018 being 118.1 billion VND.
3. Tiki Books
Tiki is the only "made in Vietnam" e-commerce platform that has the strength to withstand countless foreign giants.In the first 2-3 years, Tiki did one thing extremely well, which was "selling books online" and sold almost nothing else.Nowadays, when shopping online, we have dozens of choices, but if it's a book, perhaps many people agree with me that they will always think of Tiki.
2 months ago, I placed an order of 7 sundries on Tiki, worth nearly 2 million VND.But nearly 3 weeks later, the only item I received was 2 towels worth 80,000 VND.It seems that nearly 2 million was not refunded to the card. It's a bit sad. I'm not sure I will buy other things at Tiki anymore, but if it's books, I will always be loyal to Tiki.The result of Tiki "doing a small thing really big" in the early days.
4. Rope
Siam Brothers Vietnam is the largest startup specializing in "rope" in Vietnam.In 2017, the startup profited exactly 130 billion VND just from producing and selling rope, the startup successfully IPO'd in May 2017.
Production technology and investment in a raw rope making line to start with will probably only cost around a few billion.The Siam brothers company probably doesn't need to hire an engineer with a monthly salary of 5,000 USD to do programming.Customers are farmers, have to buy rope, and probably don't have time to play with smartphones and surf Facebook, so startups certainly don't need to spend too much budget on advertising activities like businesses do today.
Obviously, the technology to "do small things super big" is common and doesn't require big tools.
5. TopCV
When deciding to accompany Tran Trung Hieu - CEO of TopCV, in addition to Hieu's maturity and admiration for his talent, there is one factor I really like when Hieu works with 300% concentration, which is CV.When interviewing personnel for my company, out of every 10 people, I discovered that at least 2 to 3 of them used CVs printed from TopCV.That is a sign that TopCV has done a small thing big: Helping students make CVs.After 2 years, TOPCV now has more than 2 million users, the company's valuation has increased more than 15 times since we joined.
6. Shopee
Photo: Shopee.
Less noisy than other e-commerce companies, Shopee does not spend hundreds of millions of dollars on advertising and communication.Shopee spends hundreds of millions for only one thing: "free shipping" for merchants participating in activities on the Shopee platform.I really admire this strategy of Shoppee.Delivery is a small thing among the countless things an e-commerce platform must do, but a "small strategy" of this startup.Shopee grows rapidly with a single strategy, but plays the biggest.There are no exact figures, but I bet Shopee has successfully sold hundreds of millions of "free shipping" products to make Shopee as strong as it is today.
Above are 6 stories of "doing a small thing, making it big" that make startups successful that I know, are my own life lessons, and living proof of important strategies that I often share when advising young startups.
Back to my story with the young CEO.The debate revolved around me trying to convince the director to focus on one product and to know how to flatly refuse when customers asked to make other products.The CEO's view is the opposite: After providing a product, try to sell a few more products to retain customers.Only then can we increase the customer return rate and contribute to increased sales.
It's not that the CEO is unreasonable, but clearly, this is not the mindset of a breakthrough startup, but the traditional mindset of a traditional business.If development is achieved, the startup will spread out horizontally to grow gradually, but if you expect "speedy" development, you need to have the courage to focus on a single strategy, or a single product, packaging carefully, standardizing and formulating to optimize operations, only then will the startup grow (scaling) to achieve the magical realm (hypergrowth) - the dream realm of any company.Which company?
Remember, if you start a business, start with "a small, big thing"...

Foreign investors on the market traded more actively than the previous week, buying 62.4 million shares, worth 3,065.7 billion VND, while selling 71.3 million shares, worth 2,517.6 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached 8.9 million shares, but in terms of value, foreign investors this time net bought again 548 billion VND.
On HoSE, foreign investors net bought again 610.6 billion VND and ended the previous series of 3 consecutive weeks of net selling, but in terms of volume, they still net sold 5.5 million shares.However, the sudden strong net buying by foreign investors last week came from 'huge' agreement transactions, so it could not help improve the overall market.Only in agreement transactions alone, foreign investors on this exchange net bought up to 1,136 billion VND, corresponding to a volume of 8.1 million shares.Thus, excluding negotiated transactions, foreign investors still sold a net of 525 billion VND.
VIC and CMG are the two stocks with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors with values ​​of 998 billion VND and 203.5 billion VND, respectively, of which foreign investors mainly trade these two stocks through the agreement method with net purchase values ​​of 936 billion VND and 200 billion VND, respectively.Two codes, VNM and VHM, were also net bought by foreign investors for VND 71 billion and VND 62 billion, respectively.
On the contrary, VJC was sold the most with a value of 343.5 billion VND.HPG and VRE were both net sold over 110 billion VND.CCQ domestic ETF E1VFVN30 continued to be strongly net sold with a value of 61.8 billion VND.
On the HNX, foreign investors continued to net sell nearly 97 billion VND (2.13 times the net selling value of last week), corresponding to a volume of 4.8 million shares. This is also the 6th consecutive week of net selling by foreign investors on the HNX with a total value of 414 billion VND.
Foreign investors on HNX strongly net sold ACB with a value of 40 billion VND.PVS and VCS were net sold 26 billion VND and 15 billion VND respectively.Meanwhile, their net purchases focused on two codes HDA and PVI with values ​​reaching 4.2 billion VND and 2.4 billion VND respectively.
On UPCoM, foreign investors still maintained their positivity with a net purchase of 34.4 billion VND, equivalent to a volume of 1.4 million shares.Thus, foreign investors on UPCoM have been net buyers for 12 consecutive weeks with a total value of 523 billion VND.
QNS continued to be strongly net bought by foreign investors with 28 billion VND.ACV's net purchase was 8 billion VND again.Meanwhile, MCH topped the net selling list of foreign investors on UPCoM with 4.4 billion VND.CTR was also net sold 3.2 billion VND.

title: VIRecovering at the end of the session, VN-Index only dropped nearly 9 points
sapo: Stocks such as BCM, SIP, SZC, BAX, GVR, VRG, D2D... continued to increase strongly, many of which even hit the ceiling.Even the duo ITA and KBC simultaneously increased to the ceiling in today's session.
content:
The afternoon trading session continued with strong selling pressure throughout the market.However, some Bluechips such as MWG, PNJ, VIC, BHN, EIB, GMD increased at the end of the session, helping the market narrow the decline.
Cash flow continues to pour heavily into the Industrial Park stocks group with the expectation of benefiting from the FDI shift wave.Stocks such as BCM, SIP, SZC, BAX, GVR, VRG, D2D... continued to increase strongly, many of which even hit the ceiling.Even the duo ITA and KBC simultaneously increased to the ceiling in today's session.
Meanwhile, securities, banking, real estate, oil and gas, construction, textile and garment groups... in general all dropped sharply.
The group of "Viettel" stocks also had strong profit-taking pressure, in which CTR was the most prominent name when it dropped sharply from the highest level of 63,000 VND/share to 55,000 VND/share, at one point CTR was even at 50,000 VND/share.
Closing the session, the VN-Index decreased 8.54 points (0.88%) to 964.61 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.99% to 101.89 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.11% to 58.31 points.The liquidity of the whole market increased quite strongly with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching 3,200 billion VND.
Foreign transactions are a minus point when they net sold more than 280 billion VND in the entire market.The promotion of net selling by foreign investors has significantly affected investor psychology.
However, on the derivatives market, all four futures contracts still closed with a positive basis from 1.87 to 12.77 points, showing that investors expect a short-term recovery of the market.
======================
After a few minutes of sharp decline in the early morning session, the Vietnamese market is gradually narrowing its decline in the context of regional markets such as Japan and Korea gradually recovering.
The fact that Bluechips such as VRE, PNJ, SAB, BHN, DPM regained the green color, while VIC, VCB, MWG, MSN... gradually narrowed the decline has had a positive impact on the market.
This morning, cash flow continued to focus on industrial park groups (SZL, SNZ, SZC, BCM, TIP, KBC...), Viettel (CTR, VGI, VTK, VTP) helping most of these stocks increase sharply.
Pausing the morning session, VN-Index only decreased 9.19 points (0.94%) to 963.96 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.83% to 102.06 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.04% to 58.35 points.Market liquidity is quite high with the matched order value of more than 2,000 billion VND on 3 exchanges.
The minus point at this time is that foreign selling pressure is still quite strong.Overall this morning, foreign investors net sold 175 billion VND across the market.
However, on the derivatives market, all four futures contracts still maintain a positive basis, showing that investor sentiment is expecting a market recovery.
=================================
Fears that the trade war will continue to escalate after the CNY exchange rate depreciated has caused regional stock markets to plummet and the Vietnamese market is no exception.
Immediately after opening, selling pressure poured in throughout the market, causing the indexes to fall deeply and VN-Index quickly lost the psychological mark of 960 points.The decline was not only concentrated in the Bluechips group but spread throughout the market with a series of groups with deep declines such as stocks, banks, oil and gas, real estate, construction, textiles...
Meanwhile, industrial park stocks NTC, SZL, SZC, BCM, SIP, GVR... still increased very strongly thanks to benefiting from the shift of FDI to Vietnam.Besides, "Viettel" stocks such as CTR, VGI, and VTK also continued to increase strongly.
At 10:50, the VN-Index decreased 13.79 points (1.42%) to 959.36 points;HNX-Index decreased 1.4% to 101.46 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.59% to 58.03 points.The matching value of the 3 exchanges is quite high at 1,100 billion VND.

On the Derivatives market, all four futures contracts fell sharply, but are currently maintaining a positive basis from 3 to 10.5 points, showing that the market is expecting a possible recovery.

title: Taking strong profits from oil and gas groups, Vn-Index increased more than 4 points with traction from the duo VIC and VHM

title: First week of April: Self-trading Securities companies go against foreign investors, focusing on selling MSN and VIC

content:

title: Vietnam's largest traditional taxi alliance was born, gathering all "talented people" VIC, Open99, Thanh Nga..., owning 4,000 vehicles in Hanoi, ready to challenge Grab
sapo: If the G7 alliance only includes Thanh Cong, Ba Sao, Sao Hanoi, the new traditional taxi alliance will gather 17 Vietnamese taxi companies nationwide such as Thanh Nga, Van Xuan, Thang Long... VIC, Open99 (new brand of Mai Linh Dong Do) will join in December, bringing the number of vehicles in Hanoi to 4,000 vehicles.The alliance representative commits that customers will be connected to the driver in 1 - 2 minutes, and there will be no increase in rush hour prices.
content:
"If you want to go fast, go alone, if you want to go far, go together," Mr. Le Vinh Quang, vice president of the Vietnam Taxi Alliance, shared at the official launch event on the morning of December 10.
According to Mr. Quang, the Vietnamese Taxi Alliance is an association and cooperation between traditional taxi companies to create a new passenger transport market with fairer competition, bringing the best service to customers.
The alliance was born under the sponsorship of the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry VCCI, operating on the Emddi technology platform, researched and developed by scientists from Hanoi National University.This is a connection platform between transportation units and does not participate in business operations like Grab.
"We commit that customers will be connected to the driver within 1 to 2 minutes and will not increase prices during rush hours," Mr. Quang said.
As of early November 2018, there were 17 companies across the country participating in the Vietnamese Taxi Alliance with nearly 12,000 vehicles.In Hanoi, the alliance has the participation of 6 major companies: Thanh Nga, Van Xuan, Thang Long, Sao Mai, Long Bien and Que Lua.In December, it is planned that taxi companies Open99 and VIC will join, bringing the number of vehicles in Hanoi to 4,000 vehicles.
In 2019, the alliance plans to increase its coverage to 63 provinces and cities, and at the same time enroll members to have over 20,000 vehicles in operation.With the signing of cooperation agreements with Viettel, Momo, VN Pay, Vietnam Taxi Alliance is expected to deploy online payment activities in the near future.
Sharing at the official launch event of the alliance, Mr. Vu Tien Loc, Chairman of VCCI, said that previously there was a campaign "Vietnamese people use Vietnamese goods", but now it is time for "Vietnamese people to take Vietnamese taxis".However, to be able to conquer users, Mr. Loc emphasized that it is important that taxi companies create better service quality, link up, and apply sharing economy and digital technology.
"Emddi is not inferior to any digital technology platform, plus the solidarity between all parties, I believe the Vietnamese Taxi Alliance will succeed and win in the taxi market," VCCI Chairman optimistically predicted.

title: November: Foreign investors continued to net buy VND 1,338 billion, still selling strongly VIC
sapo: Foreign investors on HoSE still maintained their net buying status thanks to MSN's agreement transactions.
content:
In November, alternating increases and decreases are the main trend of the Vietnamese stock market.The group of large-cap stocks has had a period of strong fluctuations.The market lacks a group of leading stocks and liquidity continues to remain low.At the end of the last trading session of November, VN-Index stood at 926.54 points, up 1.29% compared to October. HNX-Index also decreased slightly by 0.5% to 104.82 points.
Foreign investors in the trading market were much gloomier than last month. They bought 318.9 million shares, worth 13,693 billion VND, while selling 326.4 million shares, worth 12,351 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached 7.5 million shares, but in terms of value, foreign investors still bought a net of 1,338.5 billion VND.
On HoSE, foreign investors had the third consecutive month of net buying with a decrease in value of 85% and reaching 1,412 billion VND, corresponding to a net buying volume of 10.4 million shares.Thus, in the past 3 months, foreign investors on this floor have net bought 10,855 billion VND and after 11 months, the net buying number of foreign investors on HoSE has reached 42,337.6 billion VND.
The fact that foreign investors maintained their net buying status in November was largely thanks to MSN's put-through transactions.This stock was purchased by foreign investors by agreement with 27.88 million shares, worth 2,312 billion VND.Thus, if this transaction is excluded, foreign investors on HoSE have net sold 900 billion VND.If including order matching transactions, foreign investors net bought 2,433.3 billion VND of MSN shares in November.
Meanwhile, VNM was net bought by foreign investors for 478.7 billion VND.GMD also unexpectedly received a strong net purchase of VND 325.2 billion by foreign investors.
On the contrary, VIC was net sold by foreign investors up to 1,443 billion VND, this is also the 8th consecutive month that this stock was net sold by foreign investors with a total value of 12,738 billion VND.GAS is behind VIC with a net selling value of 252.6 billion VND.
On the HNX, foreign investors boosted net selling of 280.3 billion VND (9.2 million times more shares), corresponding to a net selling volume of 19.9 million shares and this was also the third consecutive month of net selling by foreign investors on this floor.
VC3 was unexpectedly the name with the strongest net buying by foreign investors on HNX with 20 billion VND.CEO and TNG were net bought VND 7.7 billion and VND 3.3 billion respectively.
Meanwhile, VCG topped the net selling list of foreign investors on this exchange with a value of up to 185.7 billion VND.In November, VCG locked its foreign room to 0% and perhaps this is the reason why foreign investors have net sold this stock recently.
Two shares, MSC and VGC, were also net sold by foreign investors for VND 49.4 billion and VND 42 billion, respectively.
On UPCoM, foreign investors net bought again 206.7 billion VND, corresponding to a volume of 1.95 million shares.
VEA rose to the top of the net buying list of foreign investors on UPCoM with a value of 103.5 billion VND.Even though 'rookie' VTP only traded at UPCoM for a few sessions at the end of November, it received a strong net purchase of 80.5 billion VND by foreign investors.Two airline stocks, HVN and ACV, were also strongly bought by foreign investors.
Meanwhile, BSR returned to its familiar position in the net selling list of foreign investors on UPCoM with a value of 66 billion VND, far ahead of the code behind QNS with a value of only 6.8 billion VND.
