title: VIC shares increased to the ceiling for the first time in 9 months, VinGroup's capitalization exceeded VND 300,000 billion, equivalent to Vinamilk and BIDV combined
sapo: At the price of 96,400 VND, VinGroup's market capitalization reached 307,672 billion VND, equivalent to 13.3 billion USD and is the enterprise with the largest capitalization in the Vietnamese stock market.VinGroup's capitalization is currently equivalent to the capitalization of Vinamilk and BIDV combined.
content:
The trading session on November 19 was quite positive when the Vn-Index increased 17.87 points (1.99%) to 916.06 points, the strongest increase since the beginning of the month until now.The positive market performance had a significant contribution from VinGroup (VIC) shares, which increased to the ceiling of VND 96,400.
VIC's increase to the ceiling contributed 6.26 points (0.7%) to the increase of Vn-Index, equivalent to more than 1/3 of the increase of the whole market.VIC shares rarely rise to the ceiling.The last time VIC increased to the ceiling was more than 9 months ago (February 12 session).
At the price of 96,400 VND, VinGroup's market capitalization reached 307,672 billion VND, equivalent to 13.3 billion USD and is the enterprise with the largest capitalization in the Vietnamese stock market.VinGroup's capitalization is currently equivalent to the capitalization of Vinamilk and BIDV combined.
VinGroup's capitalization exceeded VND 300,000 billion in the November 19 session.Source: HoSE
According to the published business results report, in the first 9 months of 2018, VinGroup's total consolidated net revenue reached 84,148 billion VND, an increase of 47.2% over the same period in 2017. Accounting profit before tax reached 8,825 billion VND, accounting profit after tax reached 3,295 billion VND, an increase of 72.1% and 11.2% over the same period in 2017.
The Group's business fields have continuously expanded strongly in recent times.Regarding real estate, Vinhomes has launched the VinCity Ocean Park mega-urban project in Hanoi - the first project under the VinCity brand - with a scale of 420 hectares including more than 44,000 apartments and nearly 2,400 villas, developed according to Singapore's modern and civilized urban model.
In the third quarter, the retail real estate leasing sector Vincom Retail opened 9 more shopping centers ("TMs"), bringing the total number of currently operating shopping centers to 60 out of 34 provinces and cities nationwide.Meanwhile, Vinpearl opened an additional hotel product line with 4 new hotel facilities in Hue, Quang Binh, Thanh Hoa, Lang Son and Vinpearl condotel of the Discovery product line in Nha Trang.
In the retail segment, VinCommerce has acquired the entire Fivimart supermarket system with 25 supermarkets, bringing the total number of supermarkets in the entire system to exceed 100 supermarkets.
In early October, VinFast had an extremely impressive launch ceremony with two SUV and sedan models at the Paris Motorshow 2018. The VinFast Fadil will make its first appearance on November 20, next to the two car models presented at the Paris Motor Show, along with the Klara electric motorbike.
Recently, VinGroup also established Vietnam Grand Prix company with capital of 1,000 billion VND to organize F1 racing in Vietnam.
Not stopping yet, VinGroup recently completed the acquisition of the Telecommunications A retail chain. This is considered a move to pave the way for Vsmart distribution, although Vinsmart previously announced that it would sell phones through VinMart supermarket chains and VinPro electronics supermarkets.In addition, the Group also began entering the pharmaceutical retail segment with the VinFa pharmacy chain.
author: Minh Anh

title: FLC suddenly increased sharply after a "huge" match order session, Vn-Index still increased nearly 18 points thanks to VIC and VPB pillars
sapo: On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts are lower than the Vn30 Index by 6 to nearly 9 points, showing the cautious psychology of investors, despite the strong increase in the market.
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite explosive as the indexes simultaneously increased sharply.VIC and VPB simultaneously increased to the ceiling "white selling side" are the two locomotives pulling the market up sharply this afternoon.
Besides, the prosperity of Bluechips such as BVH, GAS, FPT, HPG, MSN, VJC, PLX, VHM, PNJ... or banking stocks ACB, MBB, CTG, VCB, HDB, TCB, TPB... are the main factors helping the market break out.
In addition, it is impossible not to mention the positive developments of real estate and construction groups such as CEO, CTD, DIG, DXG, FCN, HBC, NDN, PC1, VPI, VGC... also helping the market become more vibrant.
FLC suddenly increased sharply after yesterday's "huge" match order session.Investors have rekindled their expectations for stocks to increase sharply again after several days of deep decline.
Closing the session, Vn-Index increased 17.87 points (1.99%) to 916.06 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.93 points (0.91%) to 103.95 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.57% to 52.31 points.
However, market liquidity is still quite low with the matched order value of 3 exchanges being about 3,500 billion VND.Foreign investors also sold a net of more than 100 billion in the entire market.On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts are lower than the Vn30 Index by 6 to nearly 9 points, showing the cautious psychology of investors, despite the strong increase in the market.
=================================
In this morning's session, VIC traded quite positively, increasing by 3,800 VND to 93,900 VND and was the stock with the strongest impact on the market.Besides, the increasing momentum of Bluechips GAS, MSN, PNJ, VJC, PLX... or banking stocks ACB, CTG, VCB, HDB, VPB, TCB, TPB (VPB increased to the ceiling) helped the market's green color to be firmly consolidated.
Besides, real estate, construction stocks CTD, CEO, DXG, FCN, HBC, LDG, KDH, PC1... also increased quite positively.
However, stock groups that are cash flow drivers such as oil and gas, seafood, textiles, and securities are generally seeing strong profit taking.
Pausing the morning session, Vn-Index increased 9.32 points (1.04%) to 907.51 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.66 points (0.64%) to 103.67 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.11 points (0.21%) to 52.12 points.Market liquidity is quite low with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching only 1,700 billion VND.
Foreign investors continued to net sell on all 3 exchanges with a value of 35 billion VND, which is also a negative factor for the market at this time.On the Derivatives market, all 4 futures contracts are 6-7 points lower than the VN30 Index, showing that investor psychology is still quite cautious despite the market's sharp increase in scores.
===========================================
The green color of Asian stock markets in the early morning of the week brought positive signals to Vietnam's stock market and the indexes simultaneously increased points right after the opening minutes, even at one point Vn-Index increased more than 7 points.
However, investor psychology is still quite cautious.The stock holders always sell at high price ranges, while the buying force is quite weak, causing the indexes to gradually narrow their decline.Besides, foreign investors are still slightly net sellers, causing the market to lack support.
At 10:50, Vn-Index increased slightly by 3.03 points (0.34%) to 901.22 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.74% to 103.78 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.42% to 52.23 points.However, market liquidity is still quite low with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching 700 billion VND.
Oil and gas groups GAS, PVS, PVD, PVB, PXS... continue to attract quite good cash flow and are the group with the most active transactions at the moment.The banking group also maintained its upward momentum with ACB, CTG, VCB, VPB, HDB, TCB, TPB... gaining points, in which HDB, VPB continued to be the most prominent names, even VPB increased to the ceiling.
After a recent period of "hot" growth, the seafood and textile groups are being profit-taken.Stocks such as VHC, MPC, GIL, TNG... are currently decreasing slightly.In the Bluechips group, BVH, DPM, VHM, MWG are names with notable declines.
author: Minh Anh

title: Week 12-16/11: Foreign investors boosted net selling of VND 876 billion, focusing strongly on VIC
sapo: VIC is still the focus when foreign investors net sold 653 billion VND and a large amount was traded by this sector through agreement.
content:

Foreign investors in the market contributed significantly to the market shaking during the week.Overall, on all three exchanges, foreign investors bought 62.8 million shares, worth 2,122.9 billion VND, while selling 80.7 million shares, worth nearly 3,000 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached 17.8 million shares, corresponding to a net selling value of 875.6 billion VND.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold up to nearly 800 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 11.4 million shares.
The market continued to trade difficult in the week from November 12-16 and the VN-Index lost the 900 point mark.At the end of the trading week, VN-Index decreased 1.76 months compared to last week to 898.19 points.HNX-Index moved sideways and still maintained the same point level as at the end of last week at 103.01 points.
VIC is still the focus when foreign investors net sold 653 billion VND and a large amount was traded by this sector through agreement.Thus, VIC has been net sold by foreign investors for 9 consecutive weeks, with a total value of VND 1,926 billion.Following that, HPG was also strongly net sold with a value of 97 billion VND.The three codes VCB, NVL and HDB were all net sold over 30 billion VND.
On the contrary, GMD was bought the most, with a value of 9.5 billion VND.BID and VNM are behind with net buying values ​​of VND 40.8 billion and VND 35.4 billion, respectively.
The market continued to trade difficult in the week from November 12-16 and the VN-Index lost the 900 point mark.At the end of the trading week, VN-Index decreased 1.76 months compared to last week to 898.19 points.HNX-Index moved sideways and still maintained the same point level as at the end of last week at 103.01 points.
On the HNX, foreign investors boosted net selling of 98 billion VND (3 times the net selling value of the previous week), corresponding to a volume of 6.7 million shares.
The market continued to trade difficult in the week from November 12-16 and the VN-Index lost the 900 point mark.At the end of the trading week, VN-Index decreased 1.76 months compared to last week to 898.19 points.HNX-Index moved sideways and still maintained the same point level as at the end of last week at 103.01 points.
Foreign investors on HNX focused on selling a very strong net of VCG code, with 139.5 billion VND and most of the foreign investors' selling was done in the session on November 15, 2018 (6.8 million shares, worth 118.6 billion VND).Ranked second in the list of net sellers on HNX is VGC but the value is only 14 billion VND.
On the contrary, PVS had the strongest net purchase and reached 39.5 billion VND, far ahead of the code behind CEO with 8.5 billion VND.
In contrast to the two listed exchanges, foreign investors still slightly net bought on UPCoM, with a value of 21.5 billion VND, equivalent to 239,530 shares.

VEA topped the list of net purchases of foreign investors on UPCoM with 13.7 billion VND.MCH was also net bought more than 9.7 billion VND.Meanwhile, BSR continued to be strongly net sold with 11.8 billion VND.QNS ranks second on this list with a net selling value of 2 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: Selling pressure increased sharply at the end of the session, Vn-Index still maintained the 970 point mark thanks to the efforts of VIC, BVH, PLX
sapo: The green color of the market today is maintained thanks to great efforts from Bluechips such as BVH, GAS, VIC, VNM, SAB, PLX, VRE.Among them, VIC increased by 2,100 VND to 99,300 VND and was the stock with the most positive impact on the market.
content:
Towards the end of the trading session, profit-taking pressure across the market increased significantly, causing the market's upward momentum to narrow significantly.However, the positive point is that Vn-Index still maintains the 970 point mark.
Closing the session, Vn-Index increased slightly by 1.44 points (0.15%) to 970.34 points, while HNX-Index decreased by 0.88 points (0.79%) to 110.82 points.Upcom-Index increased slightly by 0.08% to 51.04 points.
Market liquidity was equivalent to the previous session with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching nearly 4,000 billion VND.Foreign investors had a quite positive trading session with a net buying value of nearly 100 billion VND.
In this afternoon's session, the groups of stocks that increased sharply in the morning, including banks and oil and gas, were sold strongly and most returned to reference or decreased slightly.As for the banking group, many stocks fell quite deeply such as ACB, VPB, and CTG.
The green color of the market today is maintained thanks to great efforts from Bluechips such as BVH, GAS, VIC, VNM, SAB, PLX, VRE.Among them, VIC increased by 2,100 VND to 99,300 VND and was the stock with the most positive impact on the market.
============================================
Towards the end of the morning, market movements became even more positive as cash flow continued to pour in strongly, helping the indexes break out.Pausing the morning session, Vn-Index increased 5.24 points (0.54%) to 974.14 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.04 points (0.04%) to 111.74 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.08 points (0.15%) to 51.08 points.
Besides the oil and gas groups GAS, PVS, PVD, PVC, PVB, PXS, PVT, BSR, PLX... which broke out from the beginning of the session, the market also received additional "support" with BVH, VIC, VHM, PNJ, VJC... all increasing in points, helping the green color to solidify.Among them, VIC had quite notable transactions with an increase of nearly 3,000 VND.
Market liquidity is at an average level with the matched value of 3 exchanges reaching 2,000 billion VND.Foreign investors traded quite actively with a net purchase of more than 10 billion VND this morning.
The group of financial stocks, after struggling at the beginning of the session, showed more signs of improvement when HDB, TCB, TPB, BID, STB, VCB, and VND all increased.
In the real estate and construction group, DXG is the most prominent name with an increase of 300 VND to 28,000 VND.
============================================
The market opened a new trading week with quite tense developments.Last week's strong recovery session did not seem to be enough to help investors become less cautious.
At 10:00 a.m., Vn-Index increased slightly by 1.17 points (0.12%) to 970.07 points;while Hnx-Index is still fluctuating around the reference area.
The green color of Bluechips such as BVH, GAS, HSG, PLX, VJC, HDB is the driving force helping the market increase.On the contrary, HPG, MSN, VCB, CTG, HPG, MSN, BID are Bluechips with notable declines.
The oil and gas group, after several accumulated trading sessions, exploded this morning with GAS, PVS, PVD, PVB, PXS, BSR, POW, OIL... all rising sharply.
Meanwhile, highly marketable stocks such as stocks, real estate, and construction are still trading quite fluctuating.
The "hot" stock SRA continues to be sold quite strongly and is currently falling to the "buy side" floor to 56,400 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: ROS increased 8% in 3 sessions, Vn-Index maintained its green color thanks to traction from VIC, MSN
sapo: The reversal in large-cap stocks helped Vn-Index have another gaining session.Another positive point is that foreign investors net bought about 26 billion VND in today's session.
content:
At the end of the trading session, Vn-Index increased 0.23 points (0.02%) to 978.27 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.01 points to 51.63 points while Hnx-Index decreased 0.68 points (0.61%) to 109.79 points.The total transaction value on all 3 exchanges reached more than 4,400 billion VND.Foreign investors continued to be net buyers today with a value of about 26 billion VND on all 3 exchanges.
In this afternoon's session, MSN and VIC had a reversal to join VNM and MWG as the index's biggest supports in today's session.In the VN30 group, "rookie" PNJ is the stock with the largest increase, increasing by 4.6% and closing at the highest level.After 2 months of price decline, this stock has returned to the 3-digit price range.Logistics groups (GMD, VSC), aviation groups (VJC, HVN, AST) are other stock groups actively trading during the day.
ROS stock suddenly had another rising session, reaching nearly 44,000 VND/share.Thus, ROS has increased ~8% in just 3 consecutive increasing sessions.
On the contrary, the banking group is the main factor taking away points from the market.VCB, BID, CTG, MBB on HoSE or ACB, SHB on HNX are the codes that have the most negative impact on the indices.GAS shares, as well as oil and gas stocks such as PLX, PVD, and PVB, also adjusted after increasing sharply in recent times.
======================================
Closing the morning session, Vn-Index decreased 2.86 points (0.29%) to 975.18 points;HNX decreased 0.24 points (0.22%) to 110.22 points, Upcom-Index also reversed, down 0.12 points to 51.51.The total matched value on all 3 exchanges reached nearly 2,600 billion VND.
VNM, VHM, VPB are codes that contribute a lot to the index.Retail stocks MWG, VRE, PNJ still remain positive, PNJ has returned to the price of 100,000 VND/share after 2 months of falling from this mark.HPG, BHN and FPT are other bluechips that increased in price this morning.
The price increase of VNM and VHM was not enough to help Vn-Index have another session of price increase when GAS, VCB, CTG, and BID adjusted this morning.VIC continued to be sold by foreign investors and put pressure on the index.VIC has dropped nearly 10% after surpassing its all-time peak in early August. The P series stocks (PLX, PVS, PVD, PVC) also adjusted according to the general market.
-------------------------------
The market opened with excitement that continued from yesterday's session.Right in the ATC session, cash flow poured into banking stocks with good price increases in recent times such as CTG, BID, and MBB.However, the selling force was boosted immediately afterward, causing the index to no longer increase as strongly as when it opened.
As of 10:00 a.m., Vn-Index decreased slightly by 0.35 points to 977.69 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.08 points to 51.71 points while Hnx-Index decreased 0.17 points to 110.30 points.Market liquidity continued to be maintained at a high level when the total matched order value on all 3 exchanges reached 1,330 billion VND.
VNM continued to have another recovery session and became the market's leading puller.Yesterday, Vinamilk announced an advance dividend for 2018 with 20% cash and a further 20% bonus share payment.Retail stocks such as MWG, PNJ, VRE all increased sharply in the morning session and are also stocks that contributed a lot to the market's increase.Two "hot" stocks recently, FLC and HAG, are also trading at rising prices.
On the contrary, after a sharp increase in prices yesterday, the banking group simultaneously adjusted this morning's session.VCB, TCB, CTG, BID, MBB all dropped in price and together with VIC, MSN, SAB, the index is currently temporarily decreasing.Oil and gas stocks (PVS, PVD, PVC) are also trading at red prices.
author: Mai Ngoc

title: Session August 6: Foreign investors continued to net sell nearly 400 billion VND on HoSE, focusing on "discharging" VIC, VNM, GTN
sapo: Foreign investors' transactions are notable when they net sold 388 billion VND on HoSE, but net bought nearly 50 billion VND on HNX and Upcom.
content:
The trading session at the beginning of the week was quite tense when the Vn-Index continuously reversed around the 960 point threshold.Although under significant profit-taking pressure at the end of the session, support from some Bluechips helped Vn-Index increase slightly by 0.63 points (0.07%) to 960.23 points.
Foreign investors' transactions are notable when they net sold 388 billion VND on HoSE, but net bought nearly 50 billion VND on HNX and Upcom.
On HoSE, foreign investors net sold quite strongly with 9.01 million shares, equivalent to 388.21 billion VND and this was also the 6th consecutive net selling session.
GAS was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 36.63 billion VND.Closing the session, GAS increased by 2,500 VND (2.7%) to 96,100 VND and was the stock with the most positive impact on the market.
The next stocks in the top net buying also include MSN (14.28 billion VND), HDB (12.56 billion VND), SSI (12.53 billion VND), HPG (11.03 billion VND).
On the other hand, VIC topped the foreign net selling list with 258.77 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are VNM (73.95 billion VND), GTN (70.94 billion VND), DHG (24.48 billion VND), VHM (14.67 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors had a quite positive net buying session with 2.17 million shares, equivalent to a value of 25.77 billion VND.
Foreign investors' net buying power on HNX focused mainly on PVS (13.56 billion VND) and SHB (10.48 billion VND).Closing the trading session, both of these stocks decreased slightly by 100 VND.
In contrast, foreign investors did not net sell any shares of more than 1 billion VND.The stock with the highest net sale was DGC with only 0.37 billion VND.
On Upcom, foreign investors also had a quite positive net buying session with 190 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 21.75 billion VND.
VEA continues to be the stock "acquired" the most by foreign investors in Upcom with 28.27 billion VND.Closing the session, VEA increased by 500 VND to 23,800 VND.
Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include ACV (5.76 billion VND), QNS (3.18 billion VND), HVN (2.7 billion VND), POW (0.38 billion VND).
On the contrary, net selling pressure focused mainly on BSR (12.31 billion VND) and VGT (5.48 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: More than half a billion VIC shares of Vingroup were additionally listed
sapo: With this decision, the total number of securities after listing of Vingroup is 3.19 billion shares, equivalent to a par value of 31,916 billion VND.
content:
Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange announced the Decision approving VINGROUP Group - Joint Stock Company (stock code: VIC) to change its listing.
Accordingly, HoSE approved VINGROUP Group - a listed Joint Stock Company to add nearly 554 million shares, equivalent to a par value of nearly 5,540 billion VND.With this decision, the total number of securities after listing of Vingroup is 3.19 billion shares, equivalent to a par value of 31,916 billion VND.
If calculated according to the current market price of 106,000 VND/share, VIC stock capitalization is up to 333.2 trillion VND, equivalent to more than 14.3 billion USD and is the enterprise with the largest market capitalization in the stock market.Ranked 2nd in terms of capitalization is also a Vingroup "family" stock, VHM of Vinhomes.
The effective date of the listing change is July 26, 2018.
Currently, HoSE has not announced the additional trading date for the above shares, but usually the additional trading will be carried out not long after the additional listing decision.
author: Phuong Chi

title: Foreign investors continued to be net sellers in the weekend session, focusing on VIC and IDC
sapo: Foreign investors today still net sold more than 350 billion VND in the entire market.However, if we exclude some sudden transactions at VIC and IDC, this is a quite positive trading session for foreign investors.
content:
The weekend trading session took place with surprising developments.Although Vn-Index closed down 10.58 points (1.12%) to 933.39 points, the overall market was quite positive, especially banking and securities stocks.
Foreign investors today still net sold more than 350 billion VND in the entire market.However, if we exclude some sudden transactions at VIC and IDC, this is a quite positive trading session for foreign investors.
On the HSX, foreign investors continued to net sell 1.57 million shares, equivalent to a value of 208.28 billion VND.
MSN was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 31.77 billion VND.Next in the top net buying are VCB (22.62 billion VND), VNM (22.11 billion VND), SSI (10.52 billion VND), VRE (9.71 billion VND).Among them, SSI was the only stock that increased with an increase of 250 VND (0.9%) to 29,150 VND.
On the contrary, net selling pressure focused mainly on the duo VIC (275.58 billion VND) and VHM (25.13 billion VND).Other stocks in the top net selling of foreign investors include HPG (16.45 billion VND), SAB (7.24 billion VND), DXG (6.06 billion VND).In particular, SAB suddenly dropped to the floor, which is the reason why Vn-Index dropped more than 10 points today.
On HNX, foreign investors returned to net buy 326 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 8.14 billion VND.
VGC and SHS are the two stocks that foreign investors bought the most on HNX with values ​​of 10.91 billion VND and 4.39 billion VND, respectively.Closing the trading session, both stocks increased positively with increases of 2.9% and 4.3% respectively.
On the net selling side, the pressure focused mainly on SD9 (3.63 billion VND) and MAS (1.32 billion VND).Other stocks were net sold insignificantly, only a few hundred million each.
On Upcom, foreign investors had a strong net selling session with 7.18 million shares, equivalent to a net selling value of 142.18 billion VND.
POW is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in Upcom with 6.91 billion VND.Closing the session, POW increased by 200 VND (1.6%) to 12,900 VND.
On the contrary, the net selling pressure focused mainly on IDC with 140 billion VND, however this transaction was carried out via agreement.
author: Minh Anh

title: VPB, TCB dropped to the floor "clearing the buying side", VIC went upstream to increase points to help Vn-Index not fall too deeply
sapo: Besides the industry groups that fell sharply, the market also had many upstream stocks with notable increases such as VHC, HNG, FRT, PVT, VGC...
content:
In the final minutes of the session, selling pressure continued to increase, especially in the banking and securities groups, causing many stocks to fall deeply, even hitting the floor such as TCB, VPB, and HCM.Real estate and construction groups are also in a similar situation with many codes falling deeply or hitting the floor like HBC.
However, Vn-Index closed down only nearly 18 points (1.97%) to 893.16 points thanks to VIC's sudden reversal, increasing by 1,500 VND.Meanwhile, the two indexes Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index still dropped quite sharply, 3.29% and 1.39% respectively.
Market liquidity also improved with matched order value of VND 3,700 billion.Foreign investors returning to net buy more than 100 billion VND in today's session is also a positive point.
Besides the industry groups that fell sharply, the market also had many upstream stocks with notable increases such as VHC, HNG, FRT, PVT, VGC...
=======================================
After less positive developments in the morning, stock holders seemed to be gradually losing patience and selling pressure skyrocketed in the early afternoon.
At 13:40, Vn-Index decreased 24.79 points (2.72%) to 886.33 points;Hnx-Index decreased 3.43 points (3.37%) to 97.99 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.72 points (1.44%) to 48.84 points.
Bank stocks are leading the decline.TCB and VPB had a time when they fell to the floor, other stocks such as VCB, BID, CTG, MBB, HDB... also fell very deeply.
=======================================
Pausing the morning trading session, Vn-Index only decreased 16.66 points (1.83%) to 894.46 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.22 points (2.19%) to 99.4 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.55 points (1.11%) to 49 points.
The entire market's matching value improved but was still at a low level of more than 1,800 billion VND.Foreign investors were slight net sellers on HoSE but net buyers on HNX and Upcom.The number of decreasing codes on the three exchanges is currently up to 327 codes, while the number of increasing codes is only 104.
On the Derivatives market, the July contract is currently down 22.2 points to 866.8 points.Meanwhile, the Vn30 index stopped the morning session at 882.11 points.
In general, the morning session did not have many notable points as selling pressure was still overwhelming.Less positive developments in the regional market as well as trade war fears are negatively affecting Vietnam's stock market.
================================================
Selling pressure is increasing strongly.As of 10:20 a.m., Vn-Index decreased 19.5 points (2.14%) to 891.62 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.59 points (2.55%) to 99.03 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.64 points (1.27%) to 48.92 points.
Market liquidity has improved with matching value currently reaching VND 2,200 billion.Foreign investors continue to be net sellers, but the pressure has decreased and is currently only about 14 billion VND on HoSE.
Bluechips are currently falling quite sharply.The most notable upstream stock is only BVH with an increase of 500 VND.
===================================
Last night, the US continued to announce a list of additional tariffs of 200 billion USD on Chinese goods.This information caused Asian financial markets to sink into the red this morning and Vietnam is no exception.
As of 9:30 a.m., Vn-Index decreased 12.43 points (1.36%) to 898.69 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.14 points (2.11%) to 99.48 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.56 points (1.13%) to 48.99 points.
Most stock industry groups decreased.Bluechips such as VHM, VIC, PNJ, MSN, FPT, GAS... as well as bank stocks VCB, VPB, BID, CTG, MBB... all fell sharply, causing the market to lack support.Bright spot: BVH, SAB, BHN, VNM increased but not enough to help the market avoid a deep decline.
Asian markets fell sharply on the morning of July 11
Highly marketable stock groups such as real estate, construction, stocks, oil and gas... were also sold strongly and most of them decreased.
DXG stock continues to be under strong selling pressure and has now breached the psychological support mark of 20,000 VND.Another stock that was also sold strongly in recent days, VGC, also decreased by 400 VND to 15,800 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: First week of July: Foreign investors on HOSE net sold again 1,171 billion VND, VHM and VIC are the focus
sapo: VIC has been net sold by foreign investors for 15 consecutive weeks, with a value of up to 8,470.5 billion VND.
content:
Vietnam's stock market continues to have a down week.Large capitalization stocks continued to be sold strongly, the selling force at low prices maintained continuously throughout the sessions.Although there was a very strong recovery at the end of the week, for the whole week, VN-Index still decreased 4.5% to 917.51 ​​points.HNX-Index also decreased 5.2% to 100.7 points.
After a week of strong net buying by foreign investors thanks to put-through transactions of some stocks, in the first week of July they net sold very strongly.
Specifically, on all three exchanges, foreign investors bought 86.7 million shares, worth 3,584 billion VND, while selling more than 112.8 million shares, worth 4,749 billion VND.The total net selling volume reached more than 26 million shares, corresponding to a net selling value of 1,164.8 billion VND.
On HOSE, foreign investors net sold again 1,171 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 23.4 million shares.
Foreign investors on HOSE last week focused on selling very strongly the pair of stocks VIC and VNM.Among them, VIC was net sold the most with 566.3 billion VND.Notably, this is also the 15th consecutive week that VIC has been net sold by foreign investors with a total value of up to 8,470.5 billion VND.
Meanwhile, VHM was pushed by foreign investors to net sell more than 214 billion VND.Standing in third place in terms of net selling value is MSN with 178.9 billion VND.
On the contrary, VCB was boosted by foreign investors to net buy more than 128 billion VND.GAS ranked second with a net purchase value of 58 billion VND.After that, VIS was net bought nearly 56 billion VND.Notably, most of foreign investors' net purchases of VIS were carried out during the weekend session and through agreement.
On the HNX, foreign investors' trading was still gloomy and only bought a mere 1.6 billion VND.Previously, foreign investors on this exchange had 6 consecutive weeks of net selling.
Foreign investors on HNX net bought mainly VCG code, reaching more than 29.5 billion VND.The two codes behind are TV2 and TNG but the net buying value only reached over 1 billion VND.
Meanwhile, the name with the strongest net sale is still VGC, with 18.6 billion VND.Thus, the net selling chain of foreign investors towards VGC has increased to 16 consecutive weeks, reaching a total of 1,038 billion VND.
The second and third positions in net selling value on HNX are PVS and SHB, reaching VND 7.9 billion and VND 2.9 billion respectively.
On UPCoM, foreign investors only net bought nearly 4.5 billion VND.
Rookie VEA was suddenly strongly bought by foreign investors with a net purchase of 49 billion VND.MCH and SCS were net bought VND 16.2 billion and VND 12.6 billion respectively.
Meanwhile, BSR had the 11th consecutive week of being net sold by foreign investors with 60 billion VND.Thus, after the past 11 weeks, BSR has been net sold up to 277.8 billion VND.KDF was also suddenly net sold more than 17.4 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: "Swallow wings" VIC, VHM are not enough to create "spring", Vn-Index breached the 900 point mark
sapo: Quite a few stocks in today's session fell to the floor, including GAS, TCM, DXG, NKG, CVT, VGC, PDR, DGW,... In which, DXG's floor price was related to the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City asking the police to clarify the sale of public land to Dat Xanh Group.
content:
After breaching the 900 point mark, bottom-fishing demand "entered" to help the market recover slightly from 2:00 p.m.However, demand is not too strong, while supply is always ready to sell, causing the market to quickly return to a downward trend.
At the end of the trading session, Vn-Index decreased 15.59 points (1.7%) to 899.4 points;Hnx-Index decreased 3.7 points (3.7%) to 96.3 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.76 points (1.51%) to 49.25 points.
Market liquidity did not improve much, the matched value on the three exchanges only reached a mere 3,800 billion VND.The number of declining codes was completely overwhelming with 384 codes, while the number of increasing codes was only 156.
The Vn30 Index ended the session down 17.12 points to 883.77 points.On the Derivatives market, the July contract was also sold strongly and fell to 866 points, a difference of nearly 20 points.
In today's session, if there was no support from VIC (up 1,500 VND), VHM (up 3,200 VND), DHG (up 5,300 VND), the market would probably fall much deeper.
Quite a few stocks in today's session fell to the floor, including GAS, TCM, DXG, NKG, CVT, VGC, PDR, DGW,... In which, DXG's floor price was related to the People's Committee of Ho Chi Minh City asking the police to clarify the sale of public land to Dat Xanh Group.
===================================
As of 1:50 p.m., Vn-Index decreased 16.8 points (1.84%) to 898.19 points.Thus, the psychological support threshold that many investors expected was penetrated quite easily.
================================
Right from the beginning of the afternoon, the selling pressure continued to intensify, causing the indexes to continue to sink deeply into the red.At 1:45 p.m., Vn-Index "fell" 14.54 points (1.59%) to 900.45 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.57 points (2.57%) to 97.42 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.63 points (1.28%) to 49.37 points.
Most industry groups in the market are falling sharply at this time.On the contrary, the efforts of VHM (increased by nearly 2,000 VND), DHG, and BVH were not enough to help the market avoid a deep decline.
Foreign investors are currently net sellers of more than 120 billion VND, making the market even more gloomy.
=================================
Towards the end of the morning, market movements became quite bad as selling pressure gradually increased, causing the indexes to reverse.
Pausing the morning session, Vn-Index decreased 2.39 points (0.26%) to 912.6 points;Hnx-Index decreased 1.54 points (1.54%) to 98.45 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.31 points (0.63%) to 49.7 points.
Market liquidity is very low with a matched order value of only VND 1,300 billion, showing that investors are not interested in participating at this time.Foreign investors also net sold 100 billion VND this morning, making the market even more gloomy.
The Vn30 index is currently down 0.72% to 894.4 points.On the derivatives market, the July contract also dropped sharply to 878.8 points.
In the Bluechips group, currently only VHM, BVH, DHG, PNJ, TCB, TPB have a notable increase, while other stocks such as VRE, PLX, VJC, FPT, GAS, HPG, MSN... as well as banking and securities stocks... have all decreased.
Stocks in the real estate and construction industries are not much better as most of them dropped, even DXG was sold quite strongly and is falling to the floor "clearing the buying side".
===========================================
After the first few minutes of a cautious opening, the cash flow quickly "entered" from 9:30 a.m., bringing the green color back to the market.
At 9:45 a.m., Vn-Index increased 6.07 points (0.66%) to 921.06 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.09% to 100.08 points and only Upcom-Index decreased slightly by 0.12%.
VHM is the driving force leading the market's upward momentum with a breakthrough of nearly 4,000 VND.Besides, other Bluechips such as BVH, DHG, GAS, VJC, PNJ, TCB, PLX... also traded quite actively, helping the market's green color to be more firmly consolidated.
The banking group is strongly differentiated.TCB increased to the ceiling on the day of bonus distribution at 2:1 ratio, TPB and HDB also increased well.On the contrary, ACB, VCB, BID, VPB, CTG are still slightly decreasing or fluctuating around the reference mark.
Real estate and construction stocks such as CEO, DIG, FCN, LDG, SCR... also recovered after recent corrections.Meanwhile, DXG is still down 200 VND.
Yeah1 stock (YEG) continued to fall to the "buying side" price floor to 238,800 VND and this was also the 5th consecutive floor price drop.
author: Minh Anh

title: Selling strongly at the end of the session, VN-Index dropped more than 11 points despite VIC's efforts
sapo: The market had a session that fluctuated in a strong range when at one point it was close to the reference but then turned around and dropped sharply.PNJ, LDG, VGC hit the floor with large volume.
content:
Opening the afternoon session, strong cash flow poured into the banking group, causing the index to regain the points it lost in the morning session.Industry-leading stocks such as VCB and CTG with strong purchasing power reversed and increased in price, causing VN-Index to return close to the reference mark.However, selling pressure returned at the end of the session, causing all indexes to close at reduced prices.
At the end of the trading session, the VN-Index decreased 11.56 points (1.19%) to 957.35 points;HNX-Index decreased 2.6 points (2.38%) to 107.06 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.31 points to 51.65 points.Market liquidity has improved compared to yesterday's session (if YEG's put-through transactions are excluded) when the total trading volume reached 220 million units, corresponding to a total transaction value of VND 5,216 billion (including VND 1,080 billion in put-through transactions.
On HOSE, VNM was the leading code pulling down the index when it dropped by 5,000 VND/share in today's session.Banking codes such as VCB, BID, CTG, TCB are still the codes pulling the market down although the decline has narrowed compared to the morning session.MSN, VJC, SAB, HPG are other bluechips that also decreased in price.Notably, in today's session PNJ and LDG hit the floor with large liquidity.
On the contrary, VIC, YEG, NLG are rising stocks that help support the market.
On the HNX, the most notable in today's trading session was VGC shares of Viglacera Corporation when they fell to the floor with a total selling surplus of nearly 750 thousand units.In addition, the total surplus sold at all prices is up to 75 million units, so it is possible that the Ministry of Construction's divestment offering at this company was not successful.Besides, ACB and VCG stocks also dropped sharply, VCS continued to search for the bottom, which is the reason why HNX-Index dropped deeply today.
================================================
Ending the morning session, VN-Index decreased 8.26 points (0.85%) to 960.65 points;HNX-Index decreased 1.69 points (1.54%) to 107.98 points while Upcom-Index decreased 0.33 points to 51.63 points.The total matched volume on all 3 exchanges reached 120 million units, equivalent to a total value of 2,680 billion VND (of which put-through transactions reached 682 billion VND).
Selling pressure increased sharply at the end of the morning session when there were 350 codes decreasing in price and only 130 codes increasing in price.Banking stocks are still the factor causing the market to fall the most, and spread to other industry groups such as securities, construction, building materials, and consumption.In the VN30 stock group, only 3 stocks increased in price.
VIC, GAS and BMP are bluechips that help keep the market from falling deeply.Newly listed shares of Yeah1 (YEG) continued to have a ceiling session and were bought by foreign investors up to 61 billion VND this morning.At this price, YEG's market capitalization has reached over 8,700 billion VND and contributed significantly to the index.
On the HNX, the largest capitalization stocks continued to disappoint as ACB, VCS, VGC, VCG, DL1, and SHB all dropped in price while the contribution of the gainers was insignificant, causing the HNX-Index to continue to fall deeply.
The market opened in pessimism when world stocks recorded another session of decline.Investor anxiety is not only expressed in scores but also in market liquidity.
As of 10:00 a.m., VN-Index decreased 7.78 points (0.8%) to 961.13 points;HNX-Index decreased 1.18 points (1.08%) to 108.47 points and Upcom-Index also decreased slightly 0.17 points to 51.79 points.Market liquidity decreased sharply when the total matched value was less than 1,000 billion VND.The market recorded 125 codes increasing in price while there were 278 codes decreasing.
Banking industry stocks continued to have a session that pulled the market back when stocks of major banks simultaneously decreased in price (VCB, ACB, CTG, BID, TCB...) only KLB and BAB kept the reference price.Food and consumer groups (VNM, SAB, MSN) or securities groups (HCM, SSI, VCI), construction groups (CTD, HBC) also dropped in this morning's session.
On the contrary, VIC is increasing strongly in the ex-rights session to pay stock dividends at a rate of 21%.GAS also increased slightly in price with buying power from foreign investors.Last night, world oil prices continued to increase for the fourth consecutive session, with WTI oil prices approaching 72 USD/barrel.
Notably, the July derivatives contract is currently trading at an increased price compared to yesterday even though the underlying market is still decreasing.BBT shares had their 13th consecutive ceiling session since returning to the market.
author: Mai Ngoc

title: The trio of VHM, VRE, VIC and VJC broke out, VnIndex increased nearly 22 points in the weekend session
sapo: VJC continued to be the "flagship" leading the market to a breakthrough when it increased its ceiling to 159,200 VND.Besides, the trio of stocks VIC, VRE, VHM also broke out strongly, firmly consolidating the upward momentum.
content:
The afternoon trading session was somewhat shaky as the VnIndex headed towards the 1,000 point mark.However, strong demand at the end of the session helped the market close near the session's highest price.Accordingly, VnIndex increased 21.62 points (2.23%) to 992.87 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.83 points (0.73%) to 115.75 points and Upcom-Index increased slightly 0.13%.
Market liquidity continued to improve with 261 million shares traded, equivalent to a value of VND 6,740 billion.Foreign investors at the end of the session reduced their net buying and selling of some stocks, but overall they still net bought more than 30 billion VND in the entire market today.
VJC continued to be the "flagship" leading the market to a breakthrough when it increased its ceiling to 159,200 VND.Besides, the trio of stocks VIC, VRE, VHM also broke out strongly, firmly consolidating the upward momentum.
Banking and securities groups VCB, BID, CTG, VPB, HDB, ACB, SSI, HCM, VCI... also attracted quite good cash flow and increased in points.Besides, real estate and construction stocks such as VPI, NVL, ROS, DIG, DXG, FCN, CTD,... also increased, helping the market become more exciting.
Although AAA did not close at the highest price of the session, it still increased by 900 VND (4.5%) to 21,100 VND.Stock liquidity also improved significantly with nearly 2 million shares matched.
Penny stocks also had an exciting trading session with many stocks hitting the ceiling such as HAI, HAR, KLF, TSC, AMD...
======================================
Pausing the morning session, VnIndex increased 22.41 points (2.31%) to 993.66 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.01 points (0.88%) to 115.92 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.24 points (0.46%) to 53 points.Market liquidity improved positively with 157 million units, equivalent to nearly 4,000 billion VND.
The sharp increase in market liquidity not only comes from domestic investors who "missed the boat" in recent sessions but also from foreign investors when they net bought 130 billion VND in this morning's session.
VJC continues to maintain its upward momentum at the ceiling "white on the buying side".HSG also increased to the ceiling.In addition, BVH, FPT, HPG, MSN, PLX, PNJ, VHM... as well as bank stocks VCB, BID, CTG, ACB... strong breakthroughs have had a positive impact on the general market.
AAA also attracted attention this morning when it increased by 500 VND to 20,700 VND.The matching volume is currently quite high at 1.2 million shares.
Cash flow is also finding penny stocks and many stocks have hit the ceiling such as KDM, ITA, HQC, AMD, HAI, HAR, KLF...
======================================
Towards the end of the morning, market movements became more positive.As of 10:55 a.m., VnIndex increased 21.95 points (2.26%) to 993.2 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.63 points (1.42%) to 116.54 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.16 points (0.3%) to 52.92 points.
Market liquidity has improved significantly with transaction value currently reaching about VND 2,800 billion.Foreign investors also "participated" quite strongly this morning with a net buying value of 90 billion VND.The entire market currently has 284 increasing codes, while the number of decreasing codes is only 168.
VJC has now increased to the ceiling and has no surplus.This is also the stock that has the most positive impact on the Index at this time.
================================
Continuing the recent excitement, the weekend trading session is taking place quite positively with green covering the market right from the opening minutes.The increasing momentum is not only concentrated in a few stocks but is spread throughout all industry groups, showing that investor excitement is returning.
At 10am, VnIndex increased 5.75 points (0.59%) to 977 points;Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index also increased slightly.Market liquidity reached nearly 1,500 billion VND, of which foreign investors are currently net buyers of about 50 billion VND.
Bluechips BVH, GAS, HPG, MSN, VRE, VJC, PLX... as well as banking stocks VCB, HDB, BID, CTG... are the main driving force leading the market to increase.
Besides, securities stocks (SSI, VND, VCI...), real estate, construction (DXG, FCN, HDG, SCR, VGC, NVL, VPI...) are also traded quite actively, helping the market become more exciting.
AAA is attracting attention as it increased by 400 VND to 20,600 VND.In recent trading sessions, AAA stock performance has been quite good as it continuously increased, even when the market encountered difficulties at the end of May.
author: Minh Anh

title: The duo VIC and VHM supported the market, Vn Index ended the session only down nearly 4 points
sapo: The fact that the market did not fall too deeply in today's session was contributed by the duo VIC and VHM when they simultaneously increased at the end of the session, despite being strongly sold by foreign investors.Besides, the sharp increase in BVH, HPG, ROS as well as banking stocks VPB, HDB, and VCB are also factors supporting the market.In addition, DXG, SSI, FCN, VCI are also notable gainers.
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite gloomy with struggles between both buyers and sellers.The seller does not want to sell cheap, while the buyer also does not want to buy at a high price, making the transaction relatively "sleepy".
Closing the session, VnIndex decreased 3.68 points (0.39%) to 948.5 points;Hnx-Index decreased 1.19 points (1.05%) to 111.7 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.06 points (0.12%) to 52.27 points.
Market liquidity is at a low level of 190 million units, equivalent to a value of 5,160 billion VND, showing that investors are still quite cautious with the current market trend.The fact that the market decreased slightly with reduced liquidity can be considered a good sign, at least showing that the sellers are not too aggressive.
Foreign investors' transactions were also notable as they net sold nearly 400 billion VND in the entire market, after "stopping selling" in the previous 2 sessions.
The fact that the market did not fall too deeply in today's session was contributed by the duo VIC and VHM when they simultaneously increased at the end of the session, despite being strongly sold by foreign investors.Besides, the sharp increase in BVH, HPG, ROS as well as banking stocks VPB, HDB, and VCB are also factors supporting the market.In addition, DXG, SSI, FCN, VCI are also notable gainers.
On the contrary, GAS fell to the floor, as well as Bluechips PNJ, VJC, PLX, FPT, VNM... all fell deeply, significantly affecting today's market developments.
=======================================================
Towards the end of the morning, market movements became more positive when VnIndex returned close to the reference mark from a decrease of nearly 20 points.Even the two indexes Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index regained their green color and increased.
Liquidity in this morning's session was not too high with a matching value of about 2,200 billion VND.This is an acceptable level in the context of very cautious investor sentiment after a series of deep declines, as well as negative fluctuations from regional stock markets.
In general, the selling pressure this morning was not too strong and only concentrated on a few Bluechips such as GAS, FPT, MSN, VJC, PLX, VHM, VRE, VIC...
On the contrary, securities, real estate, and banking stock groups traded quite well and maintained an upward momentum for most of the morning. Even when VnIndex lost nearly 20 points, many stocks still appeared.In particular, the banking group with VCB, BID, CTG, ACB, VPB, HDB, MBB,... is the main driving force helping the market recover.
========================================
Foreign investors' transactions were not too active as they net sold 180 billion in the entire market, focusing mainly on HDB, VHM, GAS, VIC, VSC... On the net buying side, the concentrated purchasing power mainly came from agreements at VCI.
After yesterday's explosive session, the May 30 trading session returned to familiar caution.This is not too surprising as investor sentiment has been severely damaged after the recent series of deep corrections, as well as negative fluctuations from stock markets around the world after the political crisis in Italy.
As of 9:45 a.m., VnIndex decreased 10.62 points (1.12%) to 941.56 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.59 points (0.52%) to 112.3 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.1 points (0.2%) to 52.23 points.
Despite a sharp drop in points, trading is showing many positive points as selling pressure is quite weak and demand is always supporting prices.Besides, banking stock groups (BID, VPB, VCB, BVH, HDB...), as well as stocks (SSI, HCM, BVS...) still remained in green, making trading not too gloomy.
Similarly, the real estate and construction groups also had many increasing codes such as VPH, ROS, VGC, SJS, CTD, DXG, FCN, HDG, LCG, NBB...
The sharp decline in the market at this time is mainly due to the decline of some Bluechips, thereby affecting the indexes such as MSN, FPT, VJC, PLX, HPG, VHM, VRE...
author: Minh Anh

title: 135 codes fell to the floor across the market, VnIndex continued to lose more than 32 points despite VIC's efforts
sapo: The number of codes that dropped today was completely overwhelming with 473 codes, of which 135 codes dropped to the floor.The number of codes gaining points was only 92 codes.A series of Bluechips such as CTD, FPT, GAS, HAG, HSG, STB, VJC, VPB, PNJ, MWG, BID... all decreased in amplitude, causing the market to lack support and fall deeply.
content:
Towards the end of the trading session, market developments became worse.Although bottom-fishing demand is quite good, the selling pressure is even greater and it is likely that mortgage settlement activities have taken place strongly today.
Closing the session, VnIndex decreased 32.15 points (3.34%) to 931.75 points;Hnx-Index decreased 7.03 points (6.14%) to 107.46 points and Upcom-Index decreased 2.14 points (4.03%) to 50.99 points.
Market liquidity increased significantly thanks to bottom-fishing demand with 292 million shares traded, equivalent to a value of 7,090 billion VND.The highlight in today's session is that foreign investors stopped selling and for the whole market, they even net bought about 20 billion VND.
The number of codes that dropped today was completely overwhelming with 473 codes, of which 135 codes dropped to the floor.The number of codes gaining points was only 92 codes.A series of Bluechips such as CTD, FPT, GAS, HAG, HSG, STB, VJC, VPB, PNJ, MWG, BID... all decreased in amplitude, causing the market to lack support and fall deeply.
On the other hand, VIC had a pretty good trading session, increasing by 4,000 VND and closing at the session's highest price of 111,000 VND.However, VIC's efforts alone were not enough on a day when the market was sold off.
===================================
The afternoon session continued with intense selling pressure.As of 1:30 p.m., VnIndex had "flyed" 31.86 points (3.31%) to 932.04 points;Hnx-Index decreased 5.72 points (5%) to 108.86 points and Upcom-Index decreased 1.51 points (2.85%) to 51.62 points.
Market liquidity is increasing significantly and the entire market matched value reached about VND 3,800 billion.
The number of declining codes is currently completely overwhelming with 431 codes, of which 90 codes have fallen to the floor.The number of codes gaining points was only 91 codes.
Notable stocks that fell to the floor include GAS, HAG, HSG, VPB, VJC, HCM, PVD, PVS, HNG, DIG, LDG, ROS, FLC, NKG...
========================================
Towards the end of the morning, the selling pressure became stronger, causing the indexes to continue to sink.The efforts of the duo VIC (up 3,000 VND) and VHM (reference) were not enough when a series of other Bluechips dropped deeply, even hitting the floor.Notable stocks that fell to the floor include GAS, HSG, VJC, ROS, NLG, LDG, SCR, DIG, HCM...
Besides, a series of large stocks such as PNJ, MWG, FRT, VPB, BVH, FPT, HPG, MSN, VCB, SSI... also dropped deeply, making the market even more gloomy.
Pausing the morning session, VnIndex decreased 24.24 points (2.51%) to 939.66 points;Hnx-Index decreased 4.44 points (3.88%) to 110.04 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.92 points (1.72%) to 52.22 points.
Overall on the 3 exchanges, the number of declining codes is currently up to 375, of which up to 48 codes have fallen to the floor, completely overwhelming the 113 gaining codes.Liquidity in the entire market reached VND 3,390 billion, significantly improved compared to recent sessions, showing that bottom-fishing cash flow is gradually entering the market.
============================================
The selling pressure in the morning session was still quite strong, but the constant bottom-fishing demand at the low price range helped the market no longer fall too deeply.
As of 11am, VnIndex only decreased 15.97 points (1.66%) to 947.93 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.88 points (2.52%) to 111.6 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.63 points (1.18%) to 52.5 points.
VIC is a bright spot in the market when it increased by 3,200 VND to 110,200 VND, thereby helping the market not fall too much.VHM also recovered strongly and is currently at the reference mark of 117,500 VND.
Foreign investors reduced their selling this morning and the net selling value is now just over 40 billion VND.This is also a positive signal for the market.
======================
Right from the opening minutes, intense selling pressure appeared, causing the indexes to sink deeply.At 9:25 a.m., VnIndex decreased 27.17 points (2.82%) to 936.73 points;HNX-Index decreased 2.3 points (2.01%) to 112.18 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.33 points (0.62%) to 52.81 points.
The oil and gas group continues to be the focus of "discharging goods" with GAS, PVD, and PVS falling to the floor.Meanwhile, other Bluechips such as VIC, VHM, PNJ, VJC, PLX, FPT, MSN, MWG... as well as banking stocks, securities... were also "trampled" mercilessly, causing the market to lack support.
BVH, HAG, DPM are the Bluechips with the most active transactions while still maintaining the reference mark.
Despite the deep decline, market liquidity is still very low, showing that investors are not really excited to catch the bottom.The total matched value on the 3 exchanges currently only reaches 400 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Week 21-25/5: Foreign investors net sold nearly 3,400 billion VND, the focus was VIC, VHM and VRE
sapo: The trio of stocks VIC, VHM and VRE were strongly net sold by foreign investors last week.
content:
The stock market has gone through a forgettable trading week, the market continuously experienced wobbly sessions, and market indices continuously plummeted.VN-Index fell to its lowest level since the beginning of 2018. At the end of the weekend trading session, VN-Index stood at 963.9 points, corresponding to a decrease of 7.4% compared to the previous week.HNX-Index also decreased 5.59% to only 114.49 points.UPCoM-Index decreased 3.82% to 53.13 points.
Cash flow still shows no signs of returning due to recent unpredictable market developments, market liquidity continuously remains at a very low level.
Not only the domestic sector but also foreign investors (foreign investors) also contributed greatly to 'sinking' the market.
On HOSE, after last week's sudden net buying session due to the influence of VHM's agreement, foreign investors net sold again to over 2,395 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of 40.4 million shares.
The most notable point in foreign transactions on HOSE is still the trio of stocks VIC, VHM and VRE.This week, all three of these stocks were strongly net sold by foreign investors.In particular, VIC was pushed to net sell more than 1,000 billion VND.Meanwhile, VHM, after a sudden net buying session at the end of last week, suddenly saw a net selling of nearly 529 billion VND this week.VRE was also strongly net sold with 211.7 billion VND.The strong net selling of the above trio by foreign investors is what surprised many investors with the positive expectations when VHM went up to trade on HOSE.
Besides, a very notable couple is VJC and HDB.These two stocks were net sold by foreign investors for 140 billion VND and 105 billion VND respectively.
On the contrary, domestic CCQ ETF E1VFVN30 was boosted by foreign investors to net buy more than 112 billion VND.Meanwhile, VCB was strongly net bought by foreign investors with 59 billion VND, but this could not help VCB escape the chain of strong decline.FRT also saw a net sale of more than 52.5 billion VND during the week.
On the HNX, foreign investors net sold slightly less than 3.4 billion VND, but in terms of volume, they net bought back 855,354 shares.
Foreign investors on HNX last week sold a strong net of VGC code, reaching nearly 63 billion VND, far surpassing the second code, PVS, with only 5.7 billion VND.Meanwhile, CEO received the strongest net purchase with 27 billion VND.SHS was net bought 24.6 billion VND.The two codes VPI and VCG were both net bought more than 11 billion VND.
On UPCoM, foreign investors suddenly net bought more than 56 billion VND, corresponding to a volume of nearly 2 million shares.
Foreign investors on UPCoM suddenly bought a very strong net of POW code, with 34.5 billion VND.Next are SCS and MCH with 10 billion VND and 9.8 billion VND respectively.In the opposite direction, VGT leads the net selling list with 8.7 billion VND.BSR was also net sold over 7.2 billion VND.
author: According to Binh An

title: VIC, VRE, SAB exploded, VnIndex broke out more than 22 points in the first session of the week
sapo: More marketable stock groups such as stocks, banks, real estate, and construction also increased quite well, helping the market become more vibrant.
content:
Towards the end of the trading session, the market became more positive with green color spreading evenly across the 3 exchanges.Closing the session, VnIndex increased 22.13 points (2.12%) to 1,066.98 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.51 points (0.42%) to 123.28 points and only Upcom-Index decreased 0.29 points (0.52%) to 55.79 points.
The number of increasing codes in the entire market was completely overwhelming with 305 codes, while the number of decreasing codes was only 224. Although market breadth has improved, liquidity is still a weakness at a fairly low level.The total transaction value in the entire market reached just over 4,700 billion VND.
The market explosion today had important contributions from the duo VIC (up 8,000 VND) and VRE (up to ceiling).In addition, SAB, BVH, FPT, GAS, HPG, MSN, VJC, PLX, PNJ... also helped the Index make an impressive breakthrough.Another notable stock, BMP, also increased to the ceiling after news that Nawaplastic registered to buy more shares.
More marketable stock groups such as stocks, banks, real estate, and construction also increased quite well, helping the market become more vibrant.
However, VND continued to be sold strongly and fell to the floor.Although VPB is no longer at the floor price, this stock also decreased by nearly 2,000 VND in today's session after the scandals related to FE Credit.
========================
The first few minutes of the afternoon session are taking place quite excitingly.The explosion of the duo VIC, VRE, as well as Bluechips VJC, PLX, GAS, FPT... has helped the market break out.
As of 1:55 p.m., VnIndex increased 8.29 points (0.79%) to 1,053.14 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.1 points (0.08%) to 122.87 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.38 points (0.67%) to 55.7 points.Market liquidity has improved slightly but is still at a low level of more than 3,700 billion VND.
=======================
The morning trading session took place with quite strong vibrations.There was a time when VnIndex increased nearly 10 points, but at other times it reversed and decreased.
However, developments at the end of the morning gradually stabilized and the VnIndex ended the morning session up 4.46 points (0.43%) to 1,049.31 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.05 points (0.04%) to 122.82 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.32 points (0.57%) to 55.76 points.Overall market liquidity is still low with 96 million units, equivalent to a value of 2,617 billion VND.
VPB was the focus of the session when this stock sometimes dropped to the floor to 48,100 VND after controversial information about FE Credit.However, strong bottom-fishing demand helped VPB escape the floor price and is currently down nearly 2,000 VND with a matching volume of approximately 7 million shares.Another notable stock, VND, was also sold strongly and is currently down more than 1,000 VND.
On the contrary, the green color at BVH, FPT, MSN, VIC, VJC, PLX, VRE, PNJ... as well as oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVS, PVB, BSR... are helping the market maintain its upward momentum.
Marketable stock groups such as stocks, real estate, and construction also had many gainers, helping the market to ease the gloom.
========================================
Continuing the positive sentiment from last weekend, the market opened the new week with a green color present right from the first minutes of the session, with VnIndex even increasing nearly 10 points at times.
However, demand is not willing to chase the price, while selling pressure is always constant, causing the market's upward momentum to quickly narrow.As of 9:45 a.m., VnIndex only increased 2.92 points (0.28%) to 1,047.77 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.21 points (0.17%) to 122.98 points and only Upcom-Index decreased slightly by 0.3%.
The efforts of BVH, FPT, VJC, VIC, VRE... are the driving force to help the market maintain its green color.Besides, oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVB, PVC, PVS, PVT, PXS, BSR... also increased quite well thanks to benefiting from the recovery of oil prices.
The banking group, after a strong increase in the first few minutes of the session, was under pressure to correct and many stocks came close to the reference, even dropping points such as VPB, VIB, VCB.
VND after the ceiling increase last week continued to be sold strongly and this stock is currently down more than 1,000 VND.Other stocks such as SSI, HCM, SHS... still increased, but the increase was quite weak.
GTN shares also rebounded after falling in the first few hours of the day.The company has planned its business with 3 key segments that bring high gross profit margins: Milk, Tea, and Wine for 2018.
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC traded nearly 1,100 billion VND, oil and gas stocks supported the market
sapo: VIC became the stock with the largest volume on HOSE today, trading value reached nearly 1,100 billion VND - accounting for 17% of trading value on HOSE.Foreign investors sold up to 4.45 million of these shares.
content:
During the afternoon session, the market did not experience any fluctuations but maintained a stable increase of about 3 - 5 points.However, just a few minutes before the ATC session started, selling pressure began to increase strongly and pushed the index down to the red.While major stocks narrowed their green color or reversed to decrease, BVH went against the flow, sometimes increased to the ceiling and when closing, it returned to the 100,000 VND mark.At times, HDB was sold so strongly that it fell to the floor.
When the ATC session started, selling orders were full while buying volume was very sparse.This pushed some high liquidity stocks such as SCR and HDB to the floor price.However, at the end of the session, SCR's 1.4 million ATC shares were matched, and the stock decreased to 2.7%.HDB also recovered slightly, down only 3.4%.
VIC is still the mainstay of the market with an increase of more than 3% and matching 8.7 million shares.VIC became the stock with the largest volume on HOSE today, trading value reached nearly 1,100 billion VND - accounting for 17% of trading value on HOSE.Foreign investors sold up to 4.45 million of these shares.
The stock group plummeted with VND falling to the floor.SSI decreased 4.3%, HCM decreased 3.9% and VCI decreased 3.1%.
BID is the strongest stock in the banking group, sometimes rising to 31,700 VND during the session and still up 3.5% at the close.
Oil and gas group increased sharply.GAS increased by 3.3%, a significant driving force for the index.PVD increased 2.5% and PVS increased 3.6%.
====================
VIC and VRE flared into green, VN-Index reversed as quickly as it did, increasing nearly 5 points
VIC increased by 3.1%.VRE increased by 6.2%.GAS increased by 1.8%.Banking and real estate stocks reversed and flared into green.At the end of the morning session, VN-Index reversed quickly, increasing nearly 5 points.However, the trading volume was not too outstanding, reaching 101 million units, equivalent to 3,200 billion VND.
As for the real estate - construction group, HBC shares, which were falling to the floor, also escaped the green and fell nearly 5%.Meanwhile, QCG and NLG are still at floor prices.
Oil and gas stocks increased early before the market recovered. By the end of the morning session, PVD increased 3.3% and PVS increased more than 4%.
GTN increased for the 4th consecutive session despite strong fluctuations in the general market.On April 21, GTN held a shareholders' meeting with the participation of leaders of subsidiaries Vinatea and Moc Chau Milk and finalized the plan for strong revenue and profit growth for 2018.
======================
"Hero squad" appeared, VN-Index narrowed the decrease to 7 points
The heroic team that returns to "save" the market is none other than large-cap stocks from the financial group and the duo VIC and VRE.After a while of turmoil, until nearly 10:30, when VIC started to return to the reference price and then turned slightly green, along with the banking codes BID, MBB, BVH and GAS all reversing, the VN-Index narrowed down to only nearly 7 points.In which, VNM decreased by 3%, "pulling" the index.HNX-Index rebounded.
However, market liquidity is still very low.Foreign investors net sold more than 100 billion on HOSE, focusing on HPG, VCB, VJC, VIC...
========================
Unable to "stop the bleeding", VN-Index continues to plummet, foreign investors strongly buy E1VFVN30 fund certificates
Following yesterday's terrible plunge, the Vietnamese stock market opened the morning session with a similar sell-off, pushing more than 200 stocks down and the VN-Index lost nearly 27 points after half an hour of trading.A few minutes later, the index shortened to a decrease of 23 points.
Leading this decline were large-cap stocks as MSN fell 4.2%, PLX fell 5.6%, ROS fell 5.4%, VIC fell 3.3% and all banking stocks were dyed red.The stock that started the sell-off yesterday was VPB, which continued to fall 5.3% today.STB and MBB led the volume on HOSE but only matched orders of around 1.5 million shares.
As for real estate stocks, HBC and NLG continued to fall to the floor.
Foreign investors bought nearly 1.4 million E1VFVN30 fund certificates.This block also actively buys HDB and SSI.
author: Tu Linh

title: Session April 17: Foreign investors net sold more than 230 billion across the market, focusing on "discharging" VNM and VIC
sapo: VNM is a stock that foreign investors net sold quite strongly with 88.83 billion VND.In today's session, VNM continued to fall deeply by 5,500 VND (2.9%) to 184,500 VND.
content:
After a series of gloomy trading days, trading session 174 took place full of excitement with green covering all 3 exchanges.Closing the session, VnIndex increased 4.79 points (0.42%) to 1,153.28 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.86 points (0.65%) to 134.17 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.16 points (0.27%) to 59.19 points.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a strong net selling session with 3.67 million shares, equivalent to a value of 277.21 billion VND.This is also the second consecutive net selling session of foreign investors on the HSX.
HDB continued to be the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 36.76 billion VND.However, in today's session HDB decreased slightly by 200 VND to 50,800 VND.
Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include DXG (27.67 billion VND), BVH (23.08 billion VND), AST (16.68 billion VND), DHG (15.41 billion VND).Among them, DXG had the most outstanding transaction when it increased by 1,900 VND (5.5%) to 36,300 VND.
On the contrary, VNM was net sold quite strongly by foreign investors with 88.83 billion VND.In today's session, VNM continued to fall deeply by 5,500 VND (2.9%) to 184,500 VND.
The top 5 foreign stocks with the most net selling also include VIC (80.43 billion VND), HPG (32 billion VND), VJC (31.44 billion VND), MSN (30.54 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors had the third consecutive net buying session with 1.41 million shares, equivalent to a value of 21.7 billion VND.
The two stocks with the highest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX were SHB (24.9 billion VND) and PVS (21.95 billion VND).However, the movements of these two stocks are quite opposite when SHB increased slightly by 100 VND, while PVS decreased by 300 VND after several recent positive increasing sessions.
On the net selling side, NDN topped the foreign net selling list with 7.7 billion VND.Next ranked are VGC (7.58 billion VND), VCG (4.56 billion VND), DBC (1.83 billion VND), VPI (0.99 billion VND).
On Upcom, foreign investors had the 5th consecutive net buying session with 336 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 21.42 billion VND.
The net buying force on Upcom focused mainly on MCH (11.82 billion VND).Closing the session, MCH increased by 5,000 VND (5.1%) to 103,500 VND.Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include HVN (4.64 billion VND), ACV (1.63 billion VND), BCM (1.41 billion VND)...
On the contrary, no stock was net sold by foreign investors for more than 1 billion VND in today's session.The stock with the highest net sale was BSR, only 0.8 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session April 12: Foreign investors net sold more than 60 billion on HoSE, focusing on "discharging" VIC, VCB
sapo: VIC topped the foreign net selling list with 171.91 billion VND.However, this stock still had a pretty good trading session, increasing by 1,000 VND to 127,000 VND.
content:
After yesterday's strong correction, the market had a pretty good recovery session today.Accordingly, VnIndex closed up 5.91 points (0.51%) to 1,173.02 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.89 points (1.41%) to 135.63 points and only Upcom-Index decreased 0.19 points (0.31%) to 59.67 points.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 1.62 million shares, equivalent to 62.75 billion VND in today's session.
HSB continued to be "consolidated" by foreign investors quite strongly in today's session with a net buying value of 68.49 billion VND.However, HDB had a not really positive trading session when it dropped 1,000 VND to 49,100 VND, near the lowest level of the session.
Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include SSI (65.1 billion VND), HPG (50.29 billion VND), VNM (36.51 billion VND), DHG (25.89 billion VND).Closing the trading session, all four stocks increased.
On the other hand, VIC topped the foreign net selling list with 171.91 billion VND.However, this stock still had a pretty good trading session, increasing by 1,000 VND to 127,000 VND.
The top 5 foreign stocks with the most net selling also include VCB (77 billion VND), VJC (44.79 billion VND), KBC (32.13 billion VND), GAS (23.45 billion VND).Among them, GAS is the most prominent name with an increase of 4,000 VND (3.2%) to 130,500 VND thanks to the strong recovery of world oil prices.
On HNX, foreign investors had a light net selling session with 389 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 3.26 billion VND, ending a series of 3 consecutive net buying sessions.
PVS topped the list of foreign net buyers on HNX with 15.43 billion VND.Closing the trading session, PVS increased by 1,500 VND (7.2%) to 22,400 VND thanks to investors' expectations about oil prices.
The duo SHB and SHS ranked next on the net buying list with values ​​of 14.41 billion VND and 4.02 billion VND respectively.Of which, SHS closed up 600 VND (2.8%) to 22,400 VND.
On the net selling side, VGC topped the list with 18.72 billion VND.Next ranked are NDN (4.95 billion VND), VCG (3.94 billion VND), HUT (3.64 billion VND), EBS (2.74 billion VND).
On Upcom, foreign investors had the second consecutive net buying session with 255 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 13.2 billion VND.
SCS topped the foreign net buying list on Upcom with 4.72 billion VND.Next ranked are QNS (3.72 billion VND), BCM (2.46 billion VND), POW (1.16 billion VND), LTG (0.91 billion VND).Closing the session, SCS was the most actively traded stock with an increase of 2,900 VND (1.5%) to 198,000 VND.
On the contrary, foreign investors did not net sell any shares of more than 1 billion on Upcom.The stock with the strongest net sale was IDC with only 0.67 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: VN-Index surpasses the "divine" mark of 1,170 thanks to GAS, VIC, MSN, foreign investors continue to buy more than 2 million HDB shares
sapo: ROS continued to fall to the floor and recovered slightly.During the session, ROS fell to 99,700 VND, losing the market price mark of 100,000 VND, but at the end of the session recovered slightly and closed at the round figure of 100,000 VND.
content:
The group of large-cap stocks increased again in the last minutes of the session, helping VN-Index increase nearly 6 points, conquering the "divine" mark of 1,170 points again.Making a major contribution to this number is none other than GAS.Increasing 4,000 VND, GAS increased to over 130,000 VND.Along with that, PVD increased to the ceiling.PVS increased by more than 7%.Political tensions in the Middle East have sent oil prices soaring, and that supports stocks in this group more than any other factor.
MSN also increased by 4,000 VND, returning to the market price club of 100,000 VND.VIC increased by 1,000 VND and MWG increased by 3,700 VND to 103,500 VND.
ROS continued to fall to the floor and recovered slightly.During the session, ROS fell to 99,700 VND, losing the market price mark of 100,000 VND, but at the end of the session recovered slightly and closed at the round figure of 100,000 VND.
While the number of increasing codes in the VN30 was more than the decreasing ones, the group of banking stocks - which accounted for the largest number, did not increase.ACB was the most positive with an increase of 2.3% and VPB increased slightly by 0.5%.The stock group was stronger, most of them closed up with the strongest codes being VND, MBS and SHS.Real estate is also green on a large scale.HDG hit the ceiling at one point but then closed up 6%.DIG increased 3.5%, other stocks increased slightly.
One of the stocks that has received a lot of attention and dropped very sharply in recent sessions is SCR.Before the ex-rights date of the additional issuance (April 13), SCR encountered strong selling pressure.However, in today's session, SCR only matched nearly 6.4 million shares.Price dropped below 13,000 VND.
Foreign investors estimated a net sale of more than 75 billion VND on the 2 exchanges.With strong net buying by foreign investors, HPG increased 2% to 61,700 VND.HDB continued to receive a net purchase of more than 2 million shares by foreign investors.
---------------------------------------
