Fluctuations were dizzying throughout the morning session, at one point the VN-Index increased more than 3 points, then reversed and dropped 2 points.The index slowed down at the end of the session.At the end, VN-Index only decreased 0.82 points but the volume of shares traded was less than 100 million units and the value was less than 3,000 billion VND.
Many large stocks have recovered and increased in price such as CTG, VIC, FPT, MSN, MWG, VNM, BMP... The most prominent are MSN and MWG when these two stocks lost the 100,000 VND mark yesterday and today rebounded strongly to return to this market price level.MSN, along with VIC and VRE, are the stocks that best support the index.
The recovery also took place on a large scale, helping the market breadth narrow.There were 128 green codes/135 red codes on HOSE and on HNX, there were 81 green codes/72 red codes.Foreign investors are net selling about 150 billion VND, focusing on VCB, VJC and VIC while net buying VRE.
STB is the stock with the largest volume on HOSE with 6 million shares.
-------------------------------
After being sold off at the beginning of the session, calm has returned to the Vietnamese stock market.Although VN-Index has not yet been able to return to the 1,170 point mark, the sprint from a decrease of 10 points to just over 1 point at 9:45 am is considered a positive move.In the latest development on concerns about political tensions, Mr. Trump tweeted again that: US-Russia relations are at the worst stage ever and this is not advisable.President Trump emphasized the need for countries to cooperate and stop the arms race.
However, the market could not stabilize and after 9:45 am, the VN-Index was pulled down again, down nearly 8 points.
In the group of large-cap stocks, the green color in GAS, VRE, MSN, SAB, VCB is the main driving force supporting the index.Meanwhile, VIC, ROS, and BVH decreased in price, which was the main factor causing the index to decline.BVH had a strong increase the week before, and today's session decreased by 4.5% to 102,000 VND.The ongoing struggle in VNM caused this stock to turn green and then be pulled back to reference.
Except for oil and gas, there is no group of stocks that are all green.PVS increased by 3.3% to 21,600 VND, PVD increased by 2.4%, GAS increased by 1.4%... PVB, PXS... increased quite positively.
The real estate group has a number of leading rising stocks such as VRE (more than 2%), NRC (up close to the ceiling), DIG (up 3.5%), SJS (Up 1%)...
author: Tu Linh

title: Stock buying and selling signals: Notable signals at VIC, MSN, VJC, MWG, HDB
sapo: Sectors and stocks stronger than the market: Technology (FPT +1.6%, DGW +5.4%), Banking (BID +2.5%, HDB +3.9%), Fisheries (MPC +5.7%, SEA +0.6%).
content:
The securities company's recommendations are for reference only and are exempted from liability.
BSC Securities Company
BUY signal: 4 stocks BMP, DHG, QNS, TCH
BUY position: 53 stocks AAA, ACB, ASM, BID, CEO, CTG, CTI, DCM, DGW, DHG, DXG, FTM, FPT, GEX, GTN, HCM, HDG, HDC, HNG, HPG, HUT, IDI, KBC, KDH, KSB, LDG, LHG, LPB, MBB, MBS, NLG, NT2, NVL, PAN, PHC,REE, SAM, SCR, SHB, SHN, SHS, SSI, STB, TDH, TLH, TTB, VCB, VCI, VIB, VIC , VIS, VND, VRE
Sectors and stocks stronger than the market: Technology (FPT +1.6%, DGW +5.4%), Banking (BID +2.5%, HDB +3.9%), Fisheries (MPC +5.7%, SEA +0.6%).
-  Sectors and stocks weaker than the market: Construction (ROS -7.0%, HBC -3.7%);Construction materials (VCS -6.0%, VGC -3.2%) and Real estate (VIC -2.9%, DIG -5.0%).
- VN30 decreased 0.82%: 9 stocks increased, 2 reference stocks and 19 stocks decreased.
HDTL index
Facing strong selling pressure on Bluechips in the second half of the morning, the indexes could not maintain the increase at the opening time and gradually weakened.However, futures contracts decreased less than VN30, thereby widening the positive price difference with VN30 to 0.5%, 1%, 1.5% and 2.8% respectively.Liquidity increased by 40% at 1,845 billion;Open interest increased by 12%, to 9,319.Total volume equals total selling volume;Contracts/buy orders and contracts/sell orders are 2.7 and 3.2 respectively.
The two indexes VN-Index and VN30 had a shaky session with increased trading volume and could no longer maintain the psychological zone of 1,200 points and 1,170 points.Stocks in the Real Estate and Construction sectors adjusted after a bullish period, leading to a slowdown in the index.However, the upward trend has not been affected. On the other hand, market psychology is still quite positive, helping futures contracts maintain prices.Investors can buy at the price range of 1,170 points with futures contract at 1,804 for short-term adjustment.
TCBS Securities Company
VN-Index's MACD line has crossed below the signal line, so the index's technical signal was lowered from BUY to HOLD.HNX-Index decreased 0.8% to 136.68 mainly because ACB was profit-taking and decreased 1.2% to 50.5.As mentioned in last week's newsletter, the two indexes have touched above the Bollinger Band line, so there is a possibility of a short-term correction, so today's session is a technical correction session.The two indexes remain above their 10 to 200 day moving averages.The market trend remains positive in the medium and long term.
After 9 sessions with the RSI indicator reaching overbought levels, VIC was heavily profit-taken and fell 3,900, and trading volume soared to nearly 4.5 million.VIC's selling force was quite strong in the April 10 session.VIC no longer has an overbought RSI indicator.
MSN and VJC continued the downward trend from last week.The MACD lines of the two stocks crossed below the signal line.MSN and VJC prices fell below the 10-day MA.Technical signals of two stocks being downgraded to HOLD.
PNJ affirmed that it was not related to the Dong A Bank case, so PNJ's price recovered very well after 5 sessions of strong selling.PNJ increased 4.3% to 193 and the white candle covered the black candle of the April 9 session.
With positive business results in the first quarter of 2018, F PT price increased 1.6% to 64.4 and the BUY signal returned.FPT is recommended to buy on September 25, 2017 at the price of 49.45 and increase the proportion on October 13, 2018.FPT is not a stock for short-term surfing because FPT's price increase is lower than VN index from 1 to 12 months.FPT is suitable for long-term holding investors because FPT price has increased steadily over the past 5 years and FPT price fluctuations are not large.
NKG and MWG continue to signal SELL as recommended SELL by NKG on February 27, 2018 and MWG on March 29, 2018.The short-term trend of the two stocks is still negative.
Stocks increased in purchasing proportion
HDB increased by 10% from the recommended buy price of 46 on March 29, 2018.HDB announced impressive profits for the first quarter of 2018 with pre-tax profit of 1,045 billion, an increase of 3 times compared to the same period in 2017. HDB price is in a short-term rising wave thanks to catalytic information from the expectation of outstanding profit growth in 2018. Investors consider increasing the proportion of HDB holdings.
author: Japanese Affairs

title: VIC dropped nearly 4,000 VND, VN-Index only decreased 0.5% thanks to the team of banks, BVH and SAB, HOSE matched orders of nearly 8,000 billion VND
sapo: HDB was actively bought by foreign investors with a net purchase volume of nearly 4 million units.The stock rose nearly 4%.
content:
For most of the afternoon, VN-Index traded in the red with a decrease of about 6 points.The recovery that started after 2 hours pulled the index down slightly, but at the end of the ATC session, VIC's drop of nearly 3% pulled the VN-Index back down to a loss of more than 6 points, equivalent to 0.5%.
The "midwife" for the index is the group of banking stocks.BID increased by 2.5%, VCB increased by 0.9%, HDB increased by 3.9%.HDB alone was actively bought by foreign investors with a net purchase volume of nearly 4 million units.
BVH continued to increase strongly, closing at 107,900 VND - an increase of 2.3%.Last week, BVH was the strongest rising stock with an increase of nearly 14%.
SAB also increased back to 230,000 VND, equivalent to an increase of 2.2%.
Meanwhile, the real estate group suffered strong profit taking.A series of stocks decreased by over 3%, for example HBC decreased by 3.7% to 48,800 VND with net selling from foreign investors.ROS decreased by 6.2%.TDH, VPH, DXG, DPG, PDR... all decreased sharply.
Some other stocks of interest such as VCS decreased by 6%, to 120,000 VND, VHC decreased by 3.6% to 67,000 VND, and PNJ recovered spectacularly after 6 consecutive sessions of decline, increasing by 4.3% to 193,000 VND.
Agreement transactions on HOSE today reached 1,300 billion VND and contributed to increasing the trading value of this floor to 9,234 billion VND.The matched order value alone reached nearly 8,000 billion VND - the highest within the past 2 months.VIC leads in transaction value with more than 600 billion VND, HDB nearly 460 billion VND, VCB 375 billion VND and MBB 315 billion VND.
The trading value on HNX also reached 1,145 billion VND and this index decreased 0.8% to 136.68 points.
---------------------------------
Ending the morning session, VN-Index decreased 2.84 points.HNX-Index decreased 0.95 points.Liquidity on HOSE increased rapidly and reached more than 5,000 billion VND, of which agreement transactions only accounted for nearly 270 billion VND.
Similar to the general state of the market with most stocks in the red, 17 stocks in the VN30 group decreased in price.ROS fell to the floor again and rebounded.VIC reversed and decreased slightly.SSI has reversed from a slight increase to decrease by 2%.BID increased sharply by 3.3 to a new peak.
Real estate stocks sank deep into the red.
-------------------------------------
After 10:45, after a period of hesitation, the selling pressure suddenly increased sharply, causing the index to drop very quickly, nearly 10 points.Meanwhile, foreign investors increased their net buying position to nearly 100 billion VND and the VN-Index was pushed up, only slightly decreasing.The stocks that are bought a lot are SSI, HDB, VIC, HPG.
Banking stocks remained green at VCB, BID, MBB, VIB, SHB and LPB.
---------------------------------------
The banking line continued the emotional momentum at the end of the past session, today playing the role of leading the market.All banking stocks increased in price, although not too strongly.LPB increased the most with an increase of 2.8%.
Meanwhile, other stock lines have differentiation.In the securities group, CTS increased nearly 5% after announcing record profits for the first quarter of 2018.Other stocks such as HCM, SHS, MBS, AGR increased but only slightly, the rest all decreased in price.However, the decrease in SSI, VND, BVS... is not large.
In the real estate - construction line, red is taking up a large proportion.HBC, after many consecutive increasing sessions, after announcing dividend information with a total rate of 55%, today encountered selling pressure at the beginning of the session and fell below the 50,000 VND mark.NRC continued to increase to the ceiling in the 4th session after going public.
VN30-Index fluctuated between green and red when VNM and ROS dropped sharply and were pulled up by banking stocks and VIC, GAS, BVH.BVH today increased the best in this group with an increase of over 3.5%.10 matched stocks at the price of 226,800 VND are pulling SAB up 0.8%.
One stock that is of interest is PNJ.After 6 consecutive sessions of decline, PNJ started the 7th session in the red but then recovered and quickly increased by nearly 4% to over 190,000 VND.
The market is still proceeding cautiously, money is coming in slowly and until 9:45 am, there was only 1,200 billion VND traded on HOSE and less than 190 billion VND traded on HNX.Foreign investors only net bought about 10 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: VIC, VRE broke out without stopping, VnIndex increased sharply but still lost the 1,200 point mark in the "90th minute"
sapo: Real estate and construction groups also had a prosperous trading session with many stocks increasing strongly such as CTD, DIG, DXG, FCN, HBC, LDG, LCG, NDN, QCG, VIC, VNE, NLG...
content:
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 6.79 points (0.57%) to 1,199.96 points.Not being able to conquer 1,200 points is quite a pity as VnIndex has surpassed this psychological milestone many times in today's session.
However, the overall developments in the weekend session were still quite positive with increasing momentum spreading throughout the market.HNX-Index closed up nearly 1% to 138.08 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.36% to 60.64 points.
The entire market liquidity was equivalent to the previous session with 342 million units, equivalent to a value of 8,880 billion VND.The number of increasing codes in the whole market was 327, slightly higher than 248 decreasing codes.
Leading the increase in today's session is the duo VIC and VRE, in which VRE increased close to the ceiling and VIC closed close to the session's highest price of 132,400 VND.
Besides, positive signals from BVH, HPG, PLX as well as bank stocks ACB, STB, VPB... have helped the market's green color to be firmly consolidated.
Real estate and construction groups also had a prosperous trading session with many stocks increasing strongly such as CTD, DIG, DXG, FCN, HBC, LDG, LCG, NDN, QCG, VIC, VNE, NLG...
On the other hand, PNJ, after a series of impressive price increases, had strong profit taking and closed at 194,000 VND, the lowest level of the session.Another retail stock, MWG, also closed the session down 100 VND.
=================================
The afternoon trading session continued with very positive developments.Cash flow spread evenly across industry groups, helping the indexes break out strongly.
As of 1:35 p.m., VnIndex increased 7.26 points (0.61%) to 1,200.43 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.6 points (1.17%) to 138.35 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.11 points (0.18%) to 60.53 points.
VRE has now increased to the ceiling, while VIC also increased by 1,000 VND, these are the 2 stocks that have the most positive impact on the Index.In addition, the boom of VNM, BVH, HPG, SAB, as well as banking and securities stocks also helped the market's green color to maintain.
======================
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 5.99 points (0.5%) to 1,199.16 points;HNX-Index increased 0.87 points (0.64%) to 137.63 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.18 points (0.3%) to 60.6 points.
Market liquidity remained at a good level with 191 million units, equivalent to a value of 4,717 billion VND.The number of increasing codes on the 3 exchanges was slightly higher with 286 codes, while the number of decreasing codes was only 223.
At the end of the morning, VIC was somewhat sagging with an increase of only 600 VND, however VRE broke out strongly (up 3,000 VND), along with BVH, VNM, FPT, HPG, MSN... as well as bank stocks ACB, BID, CTG, EIB, VPB... helped the market break out.
In the securities group, HCM after recent impressive breakthrough days has turned around and slightly decreased by 200 VND.Meanwhile, VND, SSI, VCI are increasing quite strongly.Similarly, real estate and construction stocks also attracted quite good cash flow with many stocks gaining points such as CII, CTD, DXG, FCN, NBB, QCG, KDH, VCG, VIC, NLG...
============================================
The market opened the weekend trading session with information that President Trump "threatened" to bid 100 billion USD on Chinese goods.However, such information no longer seems to have much impact on investor psychology and stock indexes simultaneously increased sharply right from the opening minutes.There was even a time when VnIndex surpassed the psychological mark of 1,200 points.
At 9:50 a.m., VnIndex increased 3.95 points (0.33%) to 1,197.12 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.75 points (0.55%) to 137.5 points and only Upcom-Index decreased slightly by 0.03%.
Leading the increase at this time are still familiar names such as BVH, VIC, MSN, FPT, VNM,... as well as bank stocks ACB, EIB, MBB, STB, VCB, VPB, LPB... Among them, VIC, BVH continue to set new peaks.
The real estate group also maintained quite good demand as what has happened recently and stocks such as DXG, FCN, CTD, CII, LDG, KDH, VIC, VPH, NTL... all increased sharply.
Meanwhile, the group of securities stocks traded quite quietly when stocks such as HCM, SSI, VND, SHS... mostly struggled around the reference mark.VCI is the most prominent name when at one point it increased by nearly 3,000 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: VCSC: VIC's real estate and retail space leasing will drive growth
sapo: VCSC expects that VinCity is expected to implement in the second quarter with 4 projects with hundreds of hectares that will support the value of VIC's 2018 real estate sales contracts to reach 89,000 billion VND, an increase of 22% compared to 2017.
content:
According to a report by Viet Capital Securities Company (VCSC), the real estate development and retail space leasing segment of VINGROUP Group - Joint Stock Company (HOSE: VIC) will lead growth.VCSC estimates the value of VIC's newly signed real estate contracts to reach VND 73,000 billion, down 12% over the same period last year.
However, with an estimated number of contracts waiting to be deployed at VND 100,000 billion by the end of 2017, VCSC forecasts that pre-tax profit growth in the real estate segment in 2018 will reach 36%.VCSC also forecasts a 27% profit growth from business activities in the retail space leasing segment in 2018 thanks to the expansion of 20-30 new commercial centers.These developments will partly compensate for current difficulties in the consumer retail and hotel - resort segments.
VinCity is preparing to exploit the affordable and mid-range housing segment.The first phase of implementing VinCity projects is expected to be implemented in the second quarter of 2018, including 4 projects with hundreds of hectares.
VCSC expects this development to support VIC's 2018 real estate sales contract value reaching VND 89 trillion (22% compared to 2017).Vinhomes' transaction can help the market revalue VIC.VIC is currently considering strategic offering options for Vinhomes (VHO), including offering on the capital market and listing, or other transactions.No details have been announced yet.VHO currently owns 87% of VIC's 188 million square meter land fund, much higher than its closest competitor.In addition, in the third quarter - fourth quarter of 2017, VRE's successful initial equity offering also created positive market sentiment, leading to a strong price increase of VIC shares.In VCSC's view, the VHO deal will likely have a similar impact.
Vinfast is on track to deploy its first car model in 2019-2020.The low car ownership rate in Vietnam (2%) along with strong car sales growth (CAGR for the period 2016-2020 is 20%) brings great opportunities for Vietnamese car manufacturers.
Up to now, VIC has established a mechanical and mechatronics training center and reached cooperation agreements with international designers and suppliers.However, VCSC is currently only recording the book value of this business segment in the valuation model, because there is no other detailed information yet.
author: According to Le Hai

title: VIC, BVH continue to "break peaks" helping VnIndex maintain its green color, cash flow focuses on real estate stocks
sapo: The banking group has quite strong differentiation, while LPB, MBB, ACB increased quite well, "hot" stocks such as BID, CTG, VPB... fell quite deeply.
content:
The afternoon session was somewhat more positive with a clear increase in the number of gainers.The explosion of VIC (up 3,500 VND), BVH (up close to the ceiling), as well as the excitement of a few Bluechips such as FPT, DHG, SAB,... has led to the excitement spreading throughout the market.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 1.63 points (0.14%) to 1,193.17 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.29 points (0.95%) to 136.61 points and only Upcom-Index decreased slightly by 0.07% to 60.42 points.The number of increasing codes in the whole market was 300, while the number of decreasing codes was only 264.
Liquidity in the entire market continued to remain at a good level with 305 million units, equivalent to a value of 9,015 billion VND, down slightly compared to the previous session.
This afternoon, the real estate and construction groups continued to attract quite good cash flow with many gainers such as CEO, CII, DXG, DRH, FCN, HBC, LDG, NVL, NLG, VNE... Similarly, the securities group also attracted quite good cash flow with HCM, CTS, VND, VCI gaining points.
================================
The banking group has quite strong differentiation, while LPB, MBB, ACB increased quite well, "hot" stocks such as BID, CTG, VPB... fell quite deeply.
The general market is still quite cautious and only a few shining faces such as CII, CEE and NBB increased to the ceiling.Newly listed real estate stocks NRC also increased to the ceiling by 30% on the listing day.NT2 also increased to the ceiling.
VIC still maintains its form with an increase of 2.4%.
ROS continues the phase from green, falls to the floor and then returns to red.
Ending the morning session, VN-Index decreased 2.63 points to 1,188.9 points and the transaction value reached 3,727 billion VND.HNX-Index increased 0.34 points and traded nearly 762 billion VND.
GTN (a clean food company with the brands Moc Chau Milk, Vinatea Tea and Da Lat Wine) increased close to the ceiling price after a series of days of deep decline, liquidity skyrocketed to nearly 1.4 million shares.
-------------------------------
Gradually fading and after 10am, the index reversed to decrease when the number of red codes increased and overwhelmed the number of green codes.In the VN30 group, the number of discount codes has also increased rapidly and there are only a few different faces such as NT2 hitting the ceiling, BVH up 4%, CII up more than 6%...
-------------------------
The number of increasing codes overwhelmed the number of decreasing codes in the whole market, but the index still increased mainly thanks to VIC while money entering the market was very weak.With the information that Vinhomes is about to go public, VIC continued to increase by 3.2% to over 131,000 VND.VJC, MSN, GAS, BVH all increased, helping the green color strengthen and the VN-Index increased by around 4 points.
The differentiation took place in the banking group with major banking stocks such as VCB, CTG, BID, VPB all decreasing while MBB, VIB, ACB, SHB increased slightly.The securities group also did not have the same excitement as the previous two days but was mainly trading in the red.
More positive is the group of real estate stocks with widespread green color.Construction stocks HBC, LCG, CTD... all increased and there were many stocks increased by over 3%.CII and NBB increased sharply.
author: Tu Linh

title: VIC and VHM "saved" the market, VnIndex had difficulty facing the psychological resistance of 1,200 points
sapo: In this afternoon's session, the "hot" stock groups such as stocks and banks were under strong adjustment pressure and most of them decreased.The notable gainers include HDB, LPB, VDS, MBS...
content:
The afternoon trading session took place with strong selling pressure, causing the market's upward momentum to weaken significantly.Closing the session, VnIndex only increased 3.25 points (0.27%) to 1,191.54 points thanks to the great support of VIC (up 5,200 VND), VNM (up 6,300 VND).
Meanwhile, Hnx-Index could not maintain its green color and closed down 0.29 points (0.21%) to 135.34 points.As for Upcom-Index, this index only increased slightly by 0.03 points (0.05%) to 60.48 points.
Overall market liquidity is still quite high with nearly 330 million units, equivalent to approximately VND 10,200 billion.
In this afternoon's session, the "hot" stock groups such as stocks and banks were under strong adjustment pressure and most of them decreased.The notable gainers include HDB, LPB, VDS, MBS...
The real estate and construction groups still attract quite good cash flow and are not affected much by the market.Stocks such as PHC, ITC, PC1, ROS, NLG, VNE, VIC, SJS, CEO, CII, DXG, HBC, LDG, HUT... all closed with increases, many of which even increased to the ceiling.
PNJ in today's session was under strong selling pressure for most of the trading period.However, this stock recovered quite well and closed near the reference mark.As for MWG, after a series of recent gloomy trading sessions, this stock increased 1,900 VND to 104,900 VND.
=======================================================
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 7.88 points (0.66%) to 1,196.17 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.48 points (0.35%) to 136.1 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.06 points (0.1%) to 60.51 points.
VIC is currently the brightest star in the market with an increase of 5,200 VND to 127,500 VND and is the stock with the most positive impact on the market.This morning, VIC at one point reached nearly 129,000 VND and was a record level for the stock.
Along with VIC, Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, GAS, VNM are still growing quite well and are the pillars supporting the market.
Meanwhile, banking stocks (VCB, BID, CTG, VPB, HDB, MBB, ACB...), securities (SSI, HCM, VND, SHS, MBS...) have weakened significantly compared to the beginning of the morning session and only increased slightly due to profit-taking pressure.
Real estate and construction groups are currently trading more actively with many stocks gaining points such as CEO, DXG, HUT, KBC, KDH, LDG, NBB, SJS, PHC, NLG...
======================
After yesterday's correction, Vietnam's stock market recovered strongly right from the opening minutes of the April 4 session and at one point VnIndex surpassed the 1,200 point threshold.The recovery momentum was also influenced by the positive developments of the World stock market when last night, the Dow Jones index increased sharply, leading to a green color in many Asian stock markets this morning.
At 9:50 a.m., VnIndex increased 10.9 points (0.92%) to 1,199.12 points;Hnx-Index increased 1.15 points (0.85%) to 136.78 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.14 points (0.23%) to 60.59 points.
Leading the market's increase at this time is the familiar Bluechips group such as BVH, FPT, GAS, VNM, VJC, MSN, VIC,... as well as banking stocks ACB, BID, CTG, VCB, VPB, MBB, HDB...
The securities stocks group also attracted cash flow and increased quite well with a series of strong increasing codes such as SSI, VND, MBS, SHS, CTS... Meanwhile, HCM decreased slightly after 2 recent hot rising sessions and in addition, the news of falling brokerage market share in the first quarter partly put this stock under pressure to correct.
Besides, market cash flow also spread strongly to real estate and construction stocks such as PHC, NVL, NLG, ROS, NBB, CEO, DIG, DXG...
author: Minh Anh

title: Real estate stocks attract money, VIC, MSN both set new peaks, helping VnIndex increase more than 7 points
sapo: However, finance and banking stocks such as VPB, BID, CTG, VCB, HDB... mostly dropped.The notable gainers include ACB, as well as stocks in the securities industry VND, MBS, HCM...
content:
Market developments at the end of the trading session were quite positive as the cash flow spread more widely across industry groups, instead of just focusing on a few Bluechips.The real estate and construction groups have many rising stocks such as CTD, ROS, NVL, NLG, VPH, SCR, FCN, HBC, HDG, VIC, HUT...
Besides, Bluechips stocks such as VIC, MSN, BVH, FPT, GAS, VJC, PLX, PNJ, VRE, BSR, POW, OIL, VHC... also increased points to help the market's green color maintain.Among them, VIC, PNJ, and MSN are the stocks that reached new peaks today.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 7.43 points (0.64%) to 1,174.46 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.42 points (0.32%) to 132.3 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.46 points (0.76%) to 60.66 points.
However, finance and banking stocks such as VPB, BID, CTG, VCB, HDB... mostly dropped.The notable gainers include ACB, as well as stocks in the securities industry VND, MBS, HCM...
================================================
The market became quite exciting right from the first minutes of the afternoon session.The explosion of Bluechips such as BVH, DHG, FPT, MSN, VIC, VJC, PLX, PNJ, BSR, POW... has led to a flood of green throughout the market.
As of 1:35 p.m., VnIndex increased 5.13 points (0.44%) to 1,172.16 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.17 points (0.13%) to 131.71 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.24 points (0.41%) to 60.45 points.
===================================
After the quiet minutes at the beginning of the session, towards the end of the morning, trading became more and more exciting.After a few minutes of strong selling, VnIndex fell more than 6 points, attracting strong bottom-fishing demand, pushing the index up more than 1 point.
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 1.1 points (0.09%) to 1,168.13 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.23 points (0.17%) to 131.65 points and Upcom-Index stopped at the reference mark of 60.21 points.Market liquidity reached 144 million units, equivalent to a value of 4,086 billion VND.
Bluechips stocks such as VIC, MSN, PNJ, POW, OIL, BSR, VRE, VJC, PLX, GAS, DHG... all increased sharply, causing the market to recover and become quite exciting.
Real estate and construction stocks such as NVL, ROS, VNE, VPH, CEO, DIG, DXG, FCN, HDG, HUT, PDR... also attracted good cash flow and increased points.
On the contrary, the securities and banking groups traded quite gloomy and mostly decreased slightly.
================================
The market opened the weekend trading session with certain caution.This can be seen through low liquidity, as well as the rather slow order matching speed.
At 9:55 a.m., VnIndex decreased slightly by 0.27 points (0.02%) to 1,166.76 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.05 points (0.04%) to 131.83 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.2 points (0.33%) to 60.01 points.
Most Bluechips such as BVH, FPT, HPG, GAS, MSN, VIC, VJC, PLX, PNJ... as well as banking stocks BID, CTG, VCB, VPB, ACB... are all struggling around the reference mark, causing the market to lack the motivation to break out.
The real estate and construction transaction groups were somewhat more prosperous with NVL, VGC, ROS, VNE, D2D, SCR, CEO, CTD, DRH, FCN, FLC... gaining points.In particular, CTD, after a series of 6 consecutive deep declines, has recovered and is currently up more than 4,000 VND.
APC, despite the information that President Vo Thuy Duong registered to buy 500,000 shares, was still sold quite strongly and is currently down more than 1,000 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors returned to net buying more than 150 billion in the March 28 session, focusing on "collecting goods" VHC, VIC
sapo: VHC was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 67.98 billion VND.In today's session, VHC traded quite positively, increasing by 1,300 VND (2%) to 64,800 VND.
content:
The March 28 trading session ended with mixed movements of the indices.While VnIndex increased 0.51 points (0.04%) to 1,172.24 points, Hnx-Index decreased 0.55% and Upcom-Index decreased 0.87%.However, the positive point is that foreign investors have returned to the market with a total net purchase of more than 150 billion VND in today's session.
On the HSX, after 2 consecutive net selling sessions, foreign investors returned to net buying 1.15 million shares, equivalent to a value of 82.25 billion VND.
VHC was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 67.98 billion VND.In today's session, VHC traded quite positively, increasing by 1,300 VND (2%) to 64,800 VND.
The top 5 stocks with the most net buying by foreign investors also include VIC (46.18 billion VND), VNM (36.5 billion VND), HDB (28.58 billion VND), AAA (26.4 billion VND).
On the net selling side, NVL topped the net selling list with 67.36 billion VND.However, this stock still had a pretty good increase (1.7%) to 66,100 VND.
Other stocks in the top net sellers also include E1VFVN30 (39.84 billion VND), CTD (30.98 billion VND), DHG (22.87 billion VND), VRE (10 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors had the third consecutive net selling session with 302 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 5.82 billion VND.
SHS was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 1.93 billion VND.Next are VCS (1.58 billion VND), VCG (1.09 billion VND), APS (0.58 billion VND), VMC (0.23 billion VND).Of which, VCS increased by 9,800 VND (4%) to 257,600 VND and was the stock that had the most positive impact on HNX.
On the contrary, VGC topped the net selling list with 4.15 billion VND.Next are PGS (3.64 billion VND), DBC (1.49 billion VND), VIX (1.16 billion VND), SHB (0.64 billion VND).
On Upcom, foreign investors net bought 2.49 million shares, equivalent to 73.62 billion VND and this is also the 5th consecutive net buying session.
The net buying force on Upcom focused mainly on ACV with 41.8 billion VND.In today's session, ACV traded quite well, increasing by 1,400 VND (1.5%) to 96,000 VND.
Top 5 foreign stocks with the most net buying in Upcom also include POW (12.8 billion VND), BCM (7.53 billion VND), QNS (3.92 billion VND), LTG (1.8 billion VND).
In contrast, foreign investors did not net sell any shares of more than 1 billion VND on Upcom today.The stock that was sold the most was HIG for less than 200 million VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: VN-Index increased more than 17 points thanks to VIC, BID, MSN, ROS
sapo: Notable surge transactions include VGT with very large put-through transactions.Foreign investors bought 50 million VGT shares.
content:
Right at the beginning of the afternoon session, the market's ecstasy broke out with the sublimation of the group of pillar stocks led by MSN and VIC.MSN quickly increased to the ceiling to 109,100 VND and was net bought by foreign investors.VIC sometimes turned purple but when it closed, it cooled down, only increasing by 3.9%.A series of large codes such as SAB increased by 3.7%, ROS increased by 5.1%, VJC increased by 4.6%, BVH increased by 6%... and not to mention the banking group.
As the stock that fell the most in the weekend session, BID gained momentum and then rebounded strongly in the ATC session, ending the session at 44,900 VND - an increase of 6%, the highest increase in this group.VCB, CTG, SHB, ACB all increased around 3%, only EIB and STB decreased.In which, EIB, before the newly announced arrests, decreased by 4.4%.
The most tragic is the oil and gas group.PVD and PVS both fell to the white floor on the buying side.GAS was "beaten" at the end of the session when this stock kept a good green color for most of the trading time but was sold strongly during the ATC session, sometimes pushed down to the floor price but then the demand rebalanced, ending the session only down 1%.
Notable surge transactions include VGT with very large put-through transactions.Foreign investors bought 50 million VGT shares.
At the end of the session, VN-Index increased 17.63 points to 1,171 with a volume of nearly 212 million shares, equivalent to 7,438 billion VND.HNX-Index increased 1.79 points to 133.67 points, matching nearly 62 million units.
---------------------------------------------
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 9.3 points (0.81%) to 1,162.89 points thanks to support from VIC (up 3,500 VND), MSN (up 5,000 VND), SAB (up 6,600 VND), VJC (up 7,100 VND)... along with the breakthrough of many other Bluechips such as BVH, GAS, FPT,PNJ... Meanwhile, Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index are still "on fire".
Market liquidity is at an average level with 135 million units, equivalent to a value of 4,143 billion VND.
In the banking group, positive signals also gradually appeared at BID and HDB.While other stocks such as VPB, ACB, CTG, VCB... are trading quite fluctuating.Similarly, the securities group also traded quite cautiously, except for VND which increased by 1,000 VND.
For the oil and gas group, although oil prices have increased sharply in recent days, PVS, PVD, PVC, PVB... are still on fire, only GAS and PVT still maintain a positive upward momentum.
==========================================
After a few minutes of strong "twitching" in the early morning, the upward momentum was firmly consolidated when large stocks such as VIC, MSN, SAB, VJC... simultaneously broke out strongly, helping VnIndex increase by more than 6 points.However, HNX-Index and Upcom-Index are still in the red.
In the banking group, BID is the most notable name with an increase of 600 VND.Meanwhile, other stocks such as HDB, VPB, ACB, MBB, CTG... are struggling around the reference mark.
======================
Concerns about the trade war and the adjustment of the global stock market did not have too much impact on Vietnam's stock market as all indexes increased sharply right from the opening minute and at one point VnIndex increased nearly 10 points.
VIC, after the "shining" session last weekend, continued to maintain its strong upward momentum and is currently up more than 2,000 VND, this is also the stock with the most positive impact on the market.Along with VIC, other Bluechips such as VJC, PNJ, BVH, DHG, GAS, VNM... as well as the recovery of banking stocks BID, ACB, CTG, VPB... are the driving force to help the market increase.
However, selling pressure is always present, causing the market's upward momentum to quickly narrow.As of 9:45 a.m., VnIndex only increased 1.78 points (0.15%) to 1,155.37 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.2 points (0.15%) to 132.07 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.16 points (0.27%) to 59.75 points.
NBB shares had their second consecutive floor price drop after the Carina apartment building caught fire.Similarly, APC continues to decrease to the "buying side" floor and the market price is currently only 35,250 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: The banking group is still strongly sold, VICxanh and VHC increased to the ceiling, both conquering new price peaks
sapo: The banking group is still facing strong profit taking.BID decreased by 4.4%, falling to 42,350 VND.Other stocks also fell around 3%.
content:
VIC maintained its performance until the end of the session and ended at 109,500 VND - an increase of 1.4%.DHG also increased by 5.5% to 115,000 VND thanks to information announced at the meeting of shareholders and analysts today.Accordingly, the leaders of Hau Giang Pharmaceutical said they will expand foreign room this year.To do this, the company has a plan to merge two subsidiaries into DHG, DHG Packaging Company Limited 1 and DHG Pharmaceutical Company Limited, expected to be completed no later than July 1, 2018.
SAB also increased by 1.9% to VND 235,400.
Those are the only 3 codes that increased in price in the VN30 group.There was also only one ROS that decreased to the floor.
With the "Vingroup family", SDI increased by 4% to 104,300 VND while VRE decreased by 3.7% and fell below 50,000 VND.
The banking group is still facing strong profit taking.BID decreased by 4.4%, falling to 42,350 VND.Other stocks also fell around 3%.
The oil and gas group surprised PVS by closing slightly higher while other stocks fell.
The flow of seafood stocks today also attracted attention with the contrast at VHC and ASM.While VHC increased to the ceiling to 61,400 VND - conquering a historic peak, ASM fell to the floor.IDI is also close to the floor.Along with East Sea, Vinh Hoan is an enterprise that retains the anti-dumping tax rate in the US at 0%.
With 230 red codes on HOSE and 117 down codes on HNX, Vn-Index decreased 18.77 points and liquidity improved compared to previous sessions when reaching 7,760 billion VND, including more than 700 billion VND in agreements.HNX-Index decreased 2.17 points and volume reached 89 million shares, equivalent to 1,536 billion VND.
----------------------------------
The afternoon session continued to be deeply in the red.But after 1:30 p.m., money started pouring in very quickly.In addition to VIC playing the leading role in increasing prices to new peaks, a number of strong stocks also quickly followed the uprising.In the same VN30 group, SAB increased by 6,000 VND, DHG increased by 5,500 VND.These stocks pulled the index straight up and the red color gradually narrowed.
As soon as it returned to the reference price, PVS went upstream with buy orders rising very quickly.Stocks with the highest liquidity in the oil and gas group reversed up 1.5%.The green color of PVS followed the recovery of PVD.
------------------------------------
In the middle of the trading session, VIC and SAB competed to support prices, causing the general market to narrow its downward momentum.At one point, VnIndex only lost 16 points.However, VIC and SAB's efforts to go against the general market were not sustainable as they retreated to the reference price near the end of the morning session.VnIndex lost more than 28 points.
Other stocks are still in the red.On the entire HoSE floor, there were 238 codes that decreased while less than 50 codes increased.
Cash flow went to many stocks in the hope of a recovery at the end of the session, so the whole market's liquidity was still quite high, over 4,600 billion on HoSE and 868 billion on HNX.
------------------------------------
VIC "opened fire" with SAB, dragging VN-Index down only 16 points
VIC is the first stock in the VN30 to turn green.Despite being pushed down many times, until 10am, this stock maintained a very good green color.SAB also agreed to increase by 1,500 - 2,000 VND and effectively supported VN-Index to narrow the red color from a decrease of more than 26 points to 16 points.
Meanwhile, ROS decreased to the floor.
Banking stocks also gradually shrank with a decrease of 1-2%.This group is still the stock in the top liquidity with STB leading the HOSE (7 million shares), CTG (5.5 million shares), MBB (4.3 million shares).Among the notable liquidity top, HNG increased by over 4%.
Despite the sharp decline, market liquidity is still low.HOSE until 10:20 a.m. only matched 94 million shares, equivalent to nearly 2,830 billion VND.Hanoi Exchange traded more than 35 million shares, equivalent to nearly 580 billion VND.
------------------------------------------------
Welcoming the "cataclysm" from US stocks, VN-Index dropped nearly 30 points
"Eye-opening", a series of banking, securities, real estate, and oil and gas stocks hit the floor during the ATO session with the effect of a massive sell-off on the US stock exchange last night.Dow Jones fell more than 700 points amid concerns that a trade war could be sparked when Mr. Trump's government instructed the US Trade Representative's office to create a list of tariffs on imported Chinese products of up to 60 billion USD.
In fact, VN-Index has increased for 9 consecutive sessions and officially surpassed the historical peak of 1,170 points yesterday (March 22).This puts the market under inevitable profit-taking pressure.Resonating with the effect from the international market, the deep correction of VN-Index is something that has been predicted by experts.
At the end of the opening price determination session, VN-Index dropped more than 18 points and just a few minutes later increased the decrease to more than 28 points, pushing the index back below 1,150 points.The most positive point is that although HOSE has 170 discount codes, there are almost no green stocks on the floor.Demand increased rapidly in banking stocks (CTG, BID, MBB, VCB, VPB) and securities (SSI) when prices dropped sharply.
All VN30 stocks are bright red.MSN fell the most with a decrease of 4% and fell below the 100,000 VND mark.
In the midst of intense market fluctuations, APC remained steadfast with its floor price.This stock fell to the floor again for the 4th consecutive session.At the same time, SPP went against the market, increasing to the ceiling for the 4th session.
author: Tu Linh

title: VnIndex lost the historic mark of 1,170 points in the final minutes of the session, despite breakthrough efforts from VIC, GAS, BVH, ROS...
sapo: The banking group, after a series of booming days, has leveled off and only MBB, BID, CTG, and STB have notable increases.Meanwhile, ACB, VCB, VPB, LPB, HDB all decreased quite sharply.
content:
At the end of the session, trading was still quite tense and the upward momentum focused mainly on the Bluechips group.VIC, GAS, BVH, HPG, BID, MSN, ROS, PNJ... are the stocks that have the most positive impact on the market.In particular, ROS increased to the ceiling at the end of the session and was also the third consecutive ceiling increase session.
The banking group, after a series of booming days, has leveled off and only MBB, BID, CTG, and STB have notable increases.Meanwhile, ACB, VCB, VPB, LPB, HDB all decreased quite sharply.
Meanwhile, oil and gas stocks GAS, PVS, PVD, PXS... still maintain their upward momentum thanks to support from international oil prices.
Real estate and construction stocks also had a quite positive trading session with many stocks increasing strongly such as CTD, DRH, FCN, DIG, CEO, HLD, KBC, VIC, NLG, ROS, PC1...
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 9.97 points (0.86%) to 1,169.36 points;while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index both decreased.The transaction value of the entire market reached VND 8,700 billion.
=================================
The first minutes of the afternoon session were very positive when VnIndex increased past 1,172 points.However, strong selling pressure at the historic peak caused the market to quickly "cool down".
As of 2:10 p.m., VnIndex increased 7.5 points (0.65%) to 1,166.89 points;while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index both decreased.On all 3 exchanges, the number of declining codes is more than the number of increasing codes.Market liquidity in general is quite low with 260 million units, equivalent to a value of 6,925 billion VND.
VIC continues to play a leading role in the market's increase, this stock currently increased by 3,600 VND to 107,800 VND.
================================================
After reaching the threshold of 1,170 points, the profit-taking pressure gradually increased, causing the market to gradually "cool down".Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex only increased 8.75 points (0.75%) to 1,168.14 points;while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index both decreased.
Liquidity in the entire market is not too high, only reaching 179 million shares, equivalent to a value of 4,571 billion VND.The number of increasing codes on 3 exchanges reached 275 codes, not too overwhelming compared to 240 decreasing codes.
The increase in the morning session mainly came from the Bluechips group, typically VIC (up nearly 3,000 VND).In addition, banking stocks such as VCB, BID, CTG, and VPB also supported the market's upward momentum quite well.On the contrary, names like VRE, VJC, SAB, REE dropped, causing the market to lack consensus.
Real estate and construction stocks are currently attracting quite good cash flow with many stocks gaining points such as CTD, CEO, DIG, DRH, FCN, HUT, VIC,... Meanwhile, securities stocks are trading quite fluctuating.
================================================
By 10:47 a.m., VnIndex had exceeded 1,170 points, this is a historic milestone that Vietnam's stock market has achieved after 11 years.
Bluechips BVH, FPT, GAS, VIC, HPG, PNJ, MWG,... as well as banking stocks BID, CTG, VCB, VPB, MBB, HDB... are important driving forces helping the market surpass the 1,170 point mark.
===========================================================
The March 21 trading session opened with excitement right from the first minutes.The green color in the US market last night, as well as the sharp increase in oil prices, had a positive impact on the Vietnamese market.
At 9:50 a.m., VnIndex increased 7.51 points (0.65%) to 1,166.9 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.36 points (0.27%) to 135.64 points and only Upcom-Index decreased slightly.
Bluechips stocks PLX, BVH, FPT, GAS, HPG, MSN, VIC, VNM, MWG... as well as banking stocks VPB, CTG, BID, VCB, MBB,... are the driving force pushing the market to break out.ROS after yesterday's ceiling increase has adjusted quite strongly and is currently down nearly 8,000 VND.
In the securities group, HCM, SSI, VCI, VDS... also attract quite good cash flow and are increasing.Real estate and construction stocks such as VCG, VIC, CTD, DIG, DXG, FCN, CTI... are trading quite actively.In particular, VIC is currently climbing to 106,000 VND and is the new peak of the stock.
Besides, oil and gas groups GAS, PVS, PVD, PVB, PVC, PXS... also increased in points thanks to the recovery of world oil prices.
APC, after 2 recovery sessions, continues to be "discharged" mercilessly and is currently falling to the floor "clearing buyers".Similarly, SLS was also sold quite strongly and had its third consecutive floor price drop.
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors continue to be net buyers on HoSE, focusing on "consolidating" VIC and VRE in the March 15 session
sapo: The duo VRE and VIC continued to be "consolidated" by foreign investors quite strongly with 76.37 billion VND and 56.14 billion VND.Closing the trading session, both of these stocks fell sharply and this prevented the market from breaking out.
content:
The March 15 trading session ended with quite positive signals as the market increased on all 3 exchanges with the leadership of banking, real estate, and securities stocks.Accordingly, VnIndex closed up 0.67 points (0.06%) to 1,138.76 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.86 points (0.66%) to 131.29 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.29 points (0.47%) to 61.58 points.
On the HSX, after yesterday's net selling session, foreign investors returned to net buying 1.22 million shares, equivalent to a value of 10.1 billion VND.
The duo VRE and VIC continued to be "consolidated" by foreign investors quite strongly with 76.37 billion VND and 56.14 billion VND.Closing the trading session, both of these stocks fell sharply and this prevented the market from breaking out.
The top 5 stocks with the strongest net buying by foreign investors in the session also include HPG (29.03 billion VND), GAS (21.23 billion VND), PVT (16.58 billion VND).
On the net selling side, CTD topped the list with 61.64 billion VND.Next ranked are VNM (45.35 billion VND), VCB (34.5 billion VND), VJC (27.64 billion VND), DIG (18.79 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors were net sellers for the 4th consecutive session with 267 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 11.09 billion VND.
PVS is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX with 7.11 billion VND.Next are SHB (1.92 billion VND), HMH (0.43 billion VND), KVC (0.22 billion VND), and IDV (0.21 billion VND).In particular, PVS and SHB traded quite positively as they both increased by 2.3% in today's session.
On the contrary, net selling pressure focused mainly on VGC with 20 billion VND.Closing the session, VGC increased by 300 VND (1.3%) to 24,200 VND.Besides VGC, foreign investors did not net sell any shares of more than 1 billion on HNX.
On Upcom, foreign investors also net sold 1.05 million shares, equivalent to 17.14 billion VND in today's session.
QNS is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in Upcom with 7.26 billion VND.Next are KDF (2.07 billion VND), MCH (1.66 billion VND), POW (1.48 billion VND), SCS (0.43 billion VND).
On the net selling side, the pressure focused mainly on BSR (14 billion VND) and VGT (13.85 billion VND).Closing the session, BSR increased 1.5% to 27,000 VND;while VGT skyrocketed 9.6% to 16,000 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session March 14: Foreign investors turned to net sell more than 270 billion VND, taking advantage of "consolidating goods" VIC, VRE
sapo: The duo VIC and VRE continued to be "aggregated" by foreign investors quite aggressively with net buying values ​​reaching 110.94 billion VND and 36.34 billion VND respectively.However, both of these stocks closed down.
content:
Continuing the excitement after surpassing the 1,130 point threshold, Vietnam's stock market continued to break out in the March 14 trading session.Accordingly, VnIndex closed up 4.78 points (0.42%) to 1,138.09 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.77 points (0.59%) to 130.43 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.04 points (0.06%) to 61.29 points.
On the HSX, after 2 consecutive strong net buying sessions, foreign investors net sold 2.5 million shares, equivalent to 216 billion VND in today's session.
The duo VIC and VRE continued to be "aggregated" by foreign investors quite aggressively with net buying values ​​reaching 110.94 billion VND and 36.34 billion VND respectively.However, both of these stocks closed down.
The top 5 foreign stocks with the most net buying in the session also include GAS (25.66 billion VND), PVD (18.67 billion VND), DPM (13.28 billion VND).Closing the trading session, all three stocks increased quite strongly, DPM even increased by 4%.
On the net selling side, VNM topped the list with 103.51 billion VND.In today's session, VNM traded quite well, increasing by 3,000 VND (1.4%) to 213,000 VND and is one of the stocks with the most positive impact on the market.
Other stocks in the top net sellers also include HDB (99.91 billion VND), DHG (60.67 billion VND), VJC (37.49 billion VND), VCB (36.76 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors had the third consecutive net selling session with a value of 15.65 billion VND.
The duo SHB and SHS continue to be the two stocks with the most net purchases by foreign investors in HNX with values ​​of 4.45 billion VND and 2.44 billion VND respectively.Closing the session, SHB increased 2.4% to 13,000 VND, while SHS jumped 5.8% to 23,700 VND.
On the contrary, net selling pressure focused mainly on VGC with 21.36 billion VND.However, VGC is still trading quite actively and increased by 800 VND (3.5%) to 23,900 VND.
On Upcom, foreign investors also net sold quite strongly with 1.52 million shares, equivalent to a value of 38.66 billion VND in today's session.
POW is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in Upcom with 19.1 billion VND.On the contrary, net selling pressure focused mainly on BSR with 52.54 billion VND.At the end of the trading session, both stocks mentioned above were in the red with a decrease of 1.2% and 5.4% respectively.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session 9/3: Foreign investors continued to be net sellers, focusing on "consolidating goods" VIC, VRE
sapo: VNM topped the foreign net selling list with 98.78 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are NSC (68.4 billion VND), VCB (63 billion VND), SJD (27.47 billion VND), BID (27.21 billion VND).
content:
The weekend trading session ended with mixed movements of the indices.While VnIndex slightly decreased by 0.74 points (0.07%) to 1,123.41 points due to increased selling pressure at the resistance area of ​​1,130 points, Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index still closed in green with an increase.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 2.1 million shares, equivalent to 101 billion VND and was the second consecutive net selling session.
The duo VIC and VRE continued to be "aggregated" by foreign investors quite aggressively with net buying values ​​reaching 90.3 billion VND and 58.64 billion VND respectively.Closing the session, VIC increased slightly by 0.3% to 103,500 VND, while VRE stopped at the reference mark.
The top 5 stocks with the highest net buying by foreign investors also include HPG (34.12 billion VND), VSC (26.72 billion VND), VJC (21.36 billion VND).
On the net selling side, VNM topped the list with 98.78 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are NSC (68.4 billion VND), VCB (63 billion VND), SJD (27.47 billion VND), BID (27.21 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors net bought 363 thousand shares, equivalent to 2.4 billion VND in today's session.
PVS is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX with 21.69 billion VND.Next ranked are SHB (8.85 billion VND), SHS (1.66 billion VND), NHA (0.36 billion VND), NTP (0.16 billion VND).Among them, SHB, SHS, NTP are the stocks that kept the green color and gained points.
On the contrary, VGC topped the net selling list with 24.28 billion VND.Next in line are DNP (1.97 billion VND), MAS (1.07 billion VND), VCS (0.81 billion VND), and BVS (0.71 billion VND).In particular, VCS had quite outstanding trading when it increased by 8,000 VND (3.3%) to 248,000 VND, this is also the third consecutive increasing session of the stock.
On Upcom, foreign investors also made a net purchase of 1.26 million shares, equivalent to a value of 32.89 billion VND.
Foreign investors' net buying power on Upcom focused mainly on POW (29.84 billion VND) and KDF (21.47 billion VND).Closing the session, POW and KDF both increased with an increase of 2.3% and 3%, respectively.
On the net selling side, BSR topped the list with 14.62 billion VND.Next are VGT (4.76 billion VND), LTG (4.44 billion VND), SAS (1.83 billion VND), ABI (0.22 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: Session 8/3: Foreign investors net sold nearly 70 billion, focusing on "consolidating goods" VIC, VRE, POW
sapo: Foreign investors net sold GMD (38.36 billion VND), VCB (37.55 billion VND), DIG (34.91 billion VND), SSI (32.17 billion VND).
content:
The March 8 trading session ended with very positive developments when green covered all 3 exchanges.Accordingly, VnIndex closed up 11.89 points (1.07%) to 1,124.15 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.54 points (0.43%) to 126.14 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.36 points (0.6%) to 60.84 points.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 3.11 million shares, equivalent to 114.24 billion VND in today's session.
The duo VIC and VRE were the most net bought by foreign investors in the session with values ​​of 66.89 billion VND and 51.63 billion VND respectively.Closing the trading session, both of these stocks increased quite strongly, of which VIC increased nearly 5% to 103,200 VND - a record price since listing.
The top 5 stocks with the highest net buying by foreign investors also include DXG (34.21 billion VND), HPG (12.31 billion VND), BVH (11.23 billion VND).
The net sellers were GMD (38.36 billion VND), VCB (37.55 billion VND), DIG (34.91 billion VND), and SSI (32.17 billion VND).Closing the trading session, none of the stocks in the top net sellers of foreign investors increased.
On HNX, foreign investors had a light net buying session with 170 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 1.09 billion VND.
PVS was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 15.73 billion VND.Next ranked are SHB (8.66 billion VND), VPI (1.4 billion VND), KLF (0.25 billion VND), VNR (0.21 billion VND).
On the contrary, VGC topped the net selling list with 17.09 billion VND.Next ranked are PVI (3.89 billion VND), CMS (1.29 billion VND), DNP (1.1 billion VND), PLC (0.73 billion VND).
On Upcom, foreign investors had a strong net buying session with 3.15 million shares, equivalent to a value of 43.2 billion VND.
POW, after being net sold by foreign investors yesterday, was net bought again quite strongly with 61.77 billion VND.However, at the end of the trading session, POW only stopped at the reference mark of 17,200 VND.
On the net selling side, HVN topped the list with 13.74 billion VND.Closing the session, HVN decreased by 1,800 VND (3.3%) to 52,200 VND.
Top 5 foreign stocks with the most net selling in Upcom also include KDF (8.32 billion VND), VGT (4.75 billion VND), LTG (3.09 billion VND), SAS (0.33 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC, VPB set new peaks, VnIndex increased nearly 12 points on March 8
sapo: In the securities group, the two "hottest" names recently, VND and SSI, have "temporarily stopped" when they simultaneously dropped.Meanwhile, MBS attracted attention with a sudden order matching session of 9.5 million units.MBS had a time when it fell near the floor but at the end of the session it increased to the ceiling.HCM also had a pretty good recovery session when it increased 800 VND to 75,400 VND.
content:
Towards the end of the transaction, market movements became more positive with the leadership of Bluechips such as VIC, VPB, VNM, MSN, PLX... In which, VIC and VPB were the two stocks that had the most positive impact on the market and both stocks set new peaks in today's session.
Banking stocks ACB, CTG, VCB, MBB, VIB... after being under strong selling pressure for most of the trading time, also increased positively towards the end of the trading session, thereby contributing to helping the market's green color maintain.
In the securities group, the two "hottest" names recently, VND and SSI, have "temporarily stopped" when they simultaneously dropped.Meanwhile, MBS attracted attention with a sudden order matching session of 9.5 million units.MBS had a time when it fell near the floor but at the end of the session it increased to the ceiling.HCM also had a pretty good recovery session when it increased 800 VND to 75,400 VND.
HNG continued to maintain its upward momentum this afternoon and increased to the ceiling for the 3rd consecutive session.On the contrary, HAG decreased slightly by nearly 100 VND.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 11.89 points (1.07%) to 1,124.15 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.54 points (0.43%) to 126.14 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.36 points (0.6%) to 60.84 points.Market liquidity reached 274 million shares, equivalent to nearly 7,000 billion VND.
================================
Right from the beginning of the afternoon session, the market broke out quite strongly with VIC leading the way with an increase of 5,000 VND.Besides, a series of Bluechips such as VRE, PNJ, PLX, MSN, HPG, VPB... simultaneously broke out, helping the green color to be firmly consolidated.
As of 1:35 p.m., VnIndex increased 12.91 points (1.16%) to 1,125.17 points;HNX-Index increased 0.43 points (0.34%) to 126.03 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.43 points (0.71%) to 60.92 points.
=======================================
After 9:30 a.m., the market became more positive when Bluechips stocks such as MSN, VIC, BVH, VNM, PNJ, VRE, VPB... all increased sharply, leading to the market's increase and at one point VnIndex increased by more than 6 points.
However, cautious psychology still dominates the market, causing cash flow to not pour heavily into the market, leading to an unstable increase and the VnIndex continuously fluctuating.
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 2.45 points (0.22%) to 1,114.71 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.32 points (0.25%) to 125.92 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.43 points (0.71%) to 60.9 points.The trading value on the 3 exchanges reached just over 3,600 billion VND, quite low compared to recent sessions.
Bluechips stocks are still the driving force helping the market break out.Meanwhile, "hot" stock groups in recent times such as stocks, banks, and real estate are trading quite fluctuating.
HNG continued to increase to the ceiling with a buying surplus of more than 350 thousand shares.On the contrary, HAG has not yet been able to make a breakthrough and is stopping at the reference mark.
GTN shares of GTNfoods had a strong increase for the second session after a long series of deep declines.During this morning's session, GTN sometimes reached 11,500 VND/share.
Speculative stocks such as FLC, HAI, AMD, KLF, FIT, TSC... are under strong selling pressure and narrowing their upward momentum compared to the beginning of the session.
===================================
After the previous sharp decline, the market opened the March 8 trading session with a rather cautious sentiment.However, green is still slightly better on the market.Today, the CPTPP agreement will be officially signed and is the most notable information.
At 9:50 a.m., VnIndex increased slightly by 0.89 points (0.08%) to 1,113.15 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.19 points (0.15%) to 125.79 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.3 points (0.5%) to 60.78 points.
Bluechips such as VNM, VIC, VPB, HPG, MSN, BVH, PNJ... are the main driving force driving the market up.The banking group is currently struggling around the reference mark, except for VPB, VIB, and HDB with more outstanding transactions.
The trio of newly listed oil and gas stocks, including BSR, POW, and OIL, are under strong selling pressure and are simultaneously falling.The pair of stocks HAG and HNG are trading quite mixed.While HNG increased to the ceiling, HAG decreased slightly.
Highly marketable stocks such as stocks and real estate are struggling around the reference mark.Even stocks that have been quite "hard" in recent sessions such as SSI, VND, DXG, and DIG are currently falling.
Some highly speculative stocks such as HAI, FLC, AMD, TSC, FIT... are currently attracting cash flow and gaining quite well.
author: Minh Anh

title: Strong breakthrough, VIC shares exceeded the price threshold of 100,000 VND
sapo: Vingroup is currently raising many ambitions in the fields of automobiles and higher education.
content:
This afternoon's trading session, VIC shares of Vingroup Corporation exceeded the threshold of 100,000 VND after many unsuccessful attempts to break out.
Immediately after surpassing the threshold of 100,000 VND, VIC shares broke out strongly to 104,400 VND - 1,100 VND away from the ceiling price.
In 2017, VinGroup achieved net revenue of 90,355 billion VND - an increase of 57%;Profit after tax is 5,440 billion VND - an increase of 55% compared to the previous year.Earnings per share (EPS) in 2017 reached 1,729 VND.
In addition to the old systems that many people already know, Vingroup is currently raising many ambitions in the fields of cars and higher education.
With a strong breakthrough, VIC stock not only continuously broke through the old peak but also helped investors accompanying this business make big profits.From the beginning of 2017 until now, VIC shares have increased ~150% from just over 40,000 VND.
author: Hai An

title: Violent shaking in the afternoon session, VNM, MSN, VIC, VPB...helped VnIndex drop only 8 points
sapo: The duo HAG and HNG maintained a positive upward momentum, with HNG even having a surplus of nearly 4 million shares.Highly speculative stocks such as HAI, AMD, TSC, FIT, KLF, FLC... also increased to the ceiling.
content:
The afternoon trading session was dramatic when the index's fluctuations were quite large, causing investors to lose direction in the market.At one point, VnIndex dropped more than 15 points but the positive thing is that the selling pressure was not too strong.As soon as the market fell deeply, bottom-fishing cash flow immediately helped the market narrow its decline.However, demand is quite cautious and not ready to push the market to high levels.
At the end of the trading session, some Bluechips such as VPB, SAB, BHN, VIC, VNM, MSN, ROS... regained the green color and increased, helping VnIndex close down only 8.03 points (0.72%) to 1,112.26 points.Among them, VNM is the stock that had the most positive impact on the market when it increased by more than 4,000 VND.
HNX-Index also decreased 1.73 points (1.36%) to 125.6 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.54 points (0.89%) to 60.47 points.Market liquidity reached 363 million units, equivalent to a value of 9,114 billion VND.
In this afternoon's session, the group of securities stocks still attracted quite good cash flow with MBS, VND, SSI, BVS, BSI, FTS... increasing sharply.Similarly, mid-sized banking stocks such as VPB, VIB, LPB, and KLB also attracted cash flow and increased quite well.
The duo HAG and HNG maintained a positive upward momentum, with HNG even having a surplus of nearly 4 million shares.Highly speculative stocks such as HAI, AMD, TSC, FIT, KLF, FLC... also increased to the ceiling.
=================================
Towards the end of the morning, corrective pressure increased throughout the market, causing the indexes to quickly reverse.Bluechips stocks such as VJC, VIC, HPG, BVH, GAS,... as well as banking stocks VCB, BID, CTG... all fell, or only increased very weakly compared to the beginning of the morning session.
On the first day of being granted margin, VPB traded very well and is currently up 600 VND.In this morning's session, foreign investors internally negotiated 2 million VPB shares, mainly at the ceiling price of 66,100 VND.
OIL continues to maintain a good upward momentum with an increase of more than 5,000 VND.Meanwhile, BSR and POW are quite struggling around the reference mark.
HNG continued to impress this morning session when it increased to the ceiling to 7,450 VND with a ceiling buying surplus of 4.3 million units.HAG also increased nearly 5% to 7,090 VND.
Highly speculative stocks such as the "FLC family" with ROS, FLC AMD, KLF, HAI... or the "FIT family" with FIT, TSC are attracting quite strong cash flow with a series of stocks hitting the ceiling.
Pausing the morning session, VnIndex decreased 0.38 points (0.03%) to 1,119.91 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.54 points (0.43%) to 126.79 points and Upcom-Index decreased 0.25 points (0.41%) to 60.77 points.
================================
The market opened the March 7 trading session with quite excited psychology and the green color was present on the 3 exchanges right from the first minutes.Bluechips stocks VIC, VRE, MSN, PNJ, VJC, GAS, BVH... as well as banking stocks BID, CTG, VCB, VPB, ACB... are the driving force leading the market's upward momentum.
In particular, VIC at one point reached a record of 100,000 VND.VPB increased by more than 1,000 VND after the information about being granted margin.On the contrary, HPG continues to be under strong selling pressure and is decreasing.
Today is the first trading day of PV Oil (OIL) and this stock has increased sharply by more than 7,000 VND to 27,500 VND in the first minutes of the session.However, the pressure to take profits is quite strong, causing OIL to currently only increase by more than 5,000 VND.
Recently listed major stocks in the oil and gas industry such as POW and BSR are also fluctuating around the reference mark.
The group of securities stocks, typically SSI and VND, are attracting quite good cash flow and increasing quite positively.Similarly, the group of "FLC family" stocks such as ROS, FLC, HAI, AMD, and KLF also increased sharply and most of them hit the ceiling.
At 9:45 a.m., VnIndex increased 5.29 points (0.47%) to 1,125.58 points;HNX-Index increased 0.2 points (0.15%) to 127.53 points.
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors "rioted" at the ATC session, VnIndex still maintained its green color with traction from VIC, PLX and banking and oil and gas groups
sapo: In this afternoon's session, securities stocks also attracted attention when HCM, SSI, VND, CTS... all increased in points.Similarly, oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVS, PVT, PXS... also attracted cash flow and increased quite well.
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite positive as the cash flow spread evenly across industry groups in the market.However, when entering the ATC session, strong selling force from foreign investors caused some Bluechips such as VRE, VJC, VNM, SAB, BVH, MSN, ROS... to fall deeply, pulling back the market's upward momentum.
The positive point is that some Bluechips such as PLX, VIC, GAS, HPG, as well as bank stocks VCB, BID, CTG, MBB, ACB, VPB... increased sharply, helping the market's green color to maintain.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 1.93 points (0.17%) to 1,121.54 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.76 points (0.6%) to 128.05 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.02 points (0.03%) to 60.09 points.Market liquidity improved significantly with 308 million units, equivalent to a value of 9,055 billion VND.
In this afternoon's session, securities stocks also attracted attention when HCM, SSI, VND, CTS... all increased in points.Similarly, oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVS, PVT, PXS... also attracted cash flow and increased quite well.
======================
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 4.81 points (0.43%) to 1,124.42 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.46 points (0.36%) to 127.74 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.22 points (0.36%) to 60.29 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with 158 million units, equivalent to a value of 4,360 billion VND.
Regarding foreign transactions, they net sold more than 100 billion VND across the market this morning, focusing on BID, HPG, GAS...
Banking stocks are the focus of cash flow this morning with ACB, VCB, BID, CTG, VPB... breaking out strongly.In addition, the prosperity of VIC, PLX, BHN,... also contributed significantly to the market's increase.
For the oil and gas group, PVD, PVS, PVT, PXS... are notable names, while GAS is currently down 1,000 VND.
=======================================================
After a few minutes of struggle at the beginning of the session, the market has increased sharply again since 10:30 a.m.The prosperity of banking groups VCB, BID, CTG, ACB, VPB, MBB... as well as Bluechips VIC, HPG, BHN, PLX, VRE... regaining the green color has helped the market make a breakthrough.
As of 11am, VnIndex increased 8.36 points (0.75%) to 1,127.97 points;HNX-Index increased 0.87 points (0.68%) to 128.15 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.52 points (0.86%) to 60.59 points.
======================================
Last night, the US stock market dropped quite sharply with concerns that the FED would raise interest rates four times in 2018, negatively impacting many Asian stock markets this morning, including Vietnam.Right from the opening minutes, selling pressure skyrocketed, causing VnIndex to lose nearly 10 points at one point.
However, the sharp decline in the market immediately attracted bottom-fishing cash flow and the index gradually recovered.As of 10:00 a.m., VnIndex only decreased 5.58 points (0.5%) to 1,114.03 points;while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index still increased slightly.
Banking groups CTG, ACB, VIB are the highlight in the market as the market upstream increases sharply.Other banking stocks such as BID, VCB, VPB, MBB... have also increased again.
Along with the banking group, oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVS, PXS, PVT... also attracted quite good cash flow and did not fall too deeply.These are also the two most active trading groups at the moment.
Bluechips stocks such as VIC, VRE, MSN, VNM, VJC, PLX, HPG... mostly decreased.In contrast, BMP is currently increasing by nearly 2,000 VND with the expectation that SCIC will soon conduct divestment.
GTN shares increased sharply, sometimes reaching the ceiling price after a series of deep declines in recent times.According to GTN leaders, the company's business operations are normal and the unusual stock price fluctuations in recent times may be due to predictions related to ETF selling capital at GTN at this time.
author: Minh Anh

title: Taking strong profits at the end of the session, VnIndex still increased nearly 12 points thanks to traction from PLX, VIC, VRE, HPG
sapo: Bluechips group VRE, PLX, VJC, VIC, SAB, BHN, BVH, GAS, HPG... continue to increase strongly and are the driving force driving the market to breakthrough.
content:
Towards the end of the trading session, especially after 2:00 p.m., selling pressure increased, causing the indexes to significantly narrow their breakthrough momentum.Accordingly, VnIndex ended the session only up 11.68 points (1.06%) to 1,114.53 points;Hnx-Index slightly decreased 0.06 points (0.05%) to 126.18 points and only Upcom-Index increased 0.18 points (0.31%) to 59.74 points.The whole market liquidity is at a good level with 320 million units, equivalent to a value of 9,025 billion VND.
Bluechips group VRE, PLX, VJC, VIC, SAB, BHN, BVH, GAS, HPG... continue to increase strongly and are the driving force pushing the market forward.
Meanwhile, the banking group was heavily profit-taking and some stocks such as MBB, SHB, VPB turned down, while ACB, VCB, CTG, and BID had their upward momentum significantly narrowed.
In the securities group, VND is the most notable name when it increased by 1,550 VND to 31,500 VND.While names like HCM, SSI, SHS... traded quite struggling around the reference mark.
======================================
PNJ, after a series of hot rising days, also suffered strong profit taking and ended the session down more than 5,000 VND.
After the excitement at the end of the morning session and the beginning of the afternoon session, stocks cooled down, and even many bluechips turned down.And accordingly, VN-Index also narrowed the green color, from an increase of 20 points to 11.68 points.Liquidity reached over 233 million shares, equivalent to 7,377 billion VND.
In the banking group, only VCB, CTG, BID, ACB, and VIB increased in price.The top 3 major stocks in the industry, VCB, CTG, and BID, all narrowed their increases, with the best increase being BID with 2.7%.Oil and gas groups also cooled down and fell close to the lowest price of the session.
----------------------------------
Towards the end of the morning, trading became more and more exciting as money flowed into the market, helping the indexes break out strongly.Not only banking stocks BID, CTG, VCB, ACB, VPB... but also oil and gas stocks PLX, GAS, PVS, PVD... also broke out strongly, helping the upward momentum solidify.In particular, PLX currently increased to the ceiling to 88,700 VND with the expectation of entering the basket of ETFs.
Bluechips stocks such as VIC, VRE, BHN, BVH, FPT, MSN, HPG... are also names that attracted quite strong cash flow this morning.
Meanwhile, real estate and construction stocks are seeing strong profit taking and most of them are down.PNJ, after the recent series of hot increases, was also sold strongly and is currently down nearly 4,000 VND.
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 20.36 points (1.85%) to 1,123.23 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.71 points (0.56%) to 126.96 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.53 points (0.89%) to 60.09 points.
Market liquidity improved significantly with 195 million shares, equivalent to a value of 5,383 billion VND.
===========================================
The market opened a new trading week with very positive developments right from the first minutes of the session.Forecasts about the ETF portfolio in the review period of the first quarter of 2018 are helping PLX and VRE make a strong breakthrough.
Besides, the excitement of Bluechips stocks such as VIC, VJC, BHN, GAS, HPG, BVH, MWG, as well as banking stocks CTG, BID, VCB, VPB, SHB, ACB... are helping the market maintain a steady upward momentum.
After recent explosive sessions, PNJ has been under strong profit-taking pressure and is currently down nearly 3,000 VND despite a strong increase at the beginning of the session.
As of 10:00 a.m., VnIndex increased 17.18 points (1.56%) to 1,120.03 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.58 points (0.46%) to 126.82 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.56 points (0.93%) to 60.12 points.
The whole market liquidity is at a good level with 73 million shares, equivalent to a value of 2,100 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Securities company commented on the market February 26: If you accept high risks, short-term transactions at VCB, CTG, BID, ACB, VPB, VIC, PLX, VNM, BVH
sapo: A group of leading stocks with a large enough capitalization to pull the Tet holiday cash flow back into the market is the most necessary factor at this time so that the market can surpass the old peak and go further at this time.
content:
KB Securities Vietnam – KBSV: If you accept high risks, trade short-term with stocks in the leading group
