With the high concentration of cash flow in a small group of large-cap stocks, causing a very strong impact on the main indexes, the total market risk continues to be high, which can cause unusual fluctuations that are difficult to predict.
Proposal: keep 2 options unchanged (1): Temporarily continue to stay out of the market until the range of score fluctuations stabilizes again.
(2) Accept high risks, short-term trading with stocks in the leading groups: VCB, CTG, BID, ACB, VPB, VIC, PLX, VNM, BVH (HDB, VJC types)
VPBS Securities: Profit-taking selling pressure seems to be completely absent in the weekend session
The selling pressure to take profits seemed to be completely absent in the weekend session, replaced by only hesitation in the morning session.Foreign investors continuously reduced the size of transactions on the selling side, the oil and gas group recovered, new information about State capital divestment is a highlight and new development and can help the market continue to increase and recover to the old peak of 1,130 points.
However, a group of leading stocks with a large enough capitalization to pull the Tet holiday cash flow back to the market is the most necessary factor at this time for the market to be able to surpass the old peak and go further at this time.
Trading strategy: Short-term investors can continue to monitor the reaction of the market and leading groups at the old peak of 1,130 points while medium and long-term investors can consider disbursement in specific stocks that have achieved short-term balance.
Investors in the temporary derivatives market should prioritize the short-term Long strategy with the expectation of closing short-term positions at the old peak of 1,120 points.
Ban Viet Securities Company: The overcoming of resistance has strengthened the recovery trend of the two indexes
Demand concentrated on stocks in the VN30 basket, causing this index and VN-Index to have clearer upward movements than other indexes such as HNX-Index, VNMidcap and VNSmallcap.The overcoming of resistance has strengthened the recovery trend of these two key indexes on HOSE, and at the same time sent a signal to continue increasing to the nearest peak area of ​​VN-Index and VN30 located at 1130 and 1115 points.
FPT Joint Stock Company – FPTS: Short-term investors can consider taking profits
Opportunities to find short-term profits may be more difficult next week, especially when the index fluctuates in the short-term peak area and leading stocks in the financial group are all at quite high prices.
Accordingly, short-term investors can consider taking profits if the stock has reached the expected profit level and wait to buy back when the market corrects.
With longer-term strategies, we reserve the opinion of holding, stabilizing the portfolio and waiting for trend signals after VN-Index tests the resistance level.
BSC Securities: VN-Index is in the process of conquering the 1,130 point mark
The weekend's trading session had positive developments thanks to the VN30 stocks all increasing, notably PLX, VCB, BVH, and CTG.Oil and Gas group increased well again, supported by news of oil price recovery.Along with the Oil and Gas group, Banking stocks are the main driving force pushing the index beyond the 1,100 mark.The upward momentum spread throughout the market with a slight increase in liquidity, showing that the cautious sentiment after yesterday's correction was gradually pushed back.
BSC believes that VN-Index is in the process of conquering the 1,130 point mark.Investors can consider increasing the proportion of stocks in key groups when these groups are concentrating their cash flow.
author: Japanese Affairs

title: "Lonely" CTG and VIC supported the index, VN-Index plummeted, dropping more than 11 points in the afternoon session
sapo: GAS fell quickly and fell 5.4%, closing at a session low of 106,000 VND.This is the stock that has the most negative impact on the index and lost 2.33 points of VN-Index.
content:
Falling rapidly in the afternoon session,  Vn-Index dropped 9 points at the beginning of the ATC session and at the end, the index dropped more than 11 points.The trading volume reached more than 200 million shares with a corresponding value of 6,121 billion VND, including 849 billion VND from the agreement.
The rapid decline of VN-Index came from large stocks.Although trading was not too negative during the morning session, in the afternoon session, only CTG, VCB and VIC tried to support the index, the remaining 21 codes in the VN30 decreased.GAS fell quickly and fell 5.4%, closing at a session low of 106,000 VND.This is the stock that has the most negative impact on the index and lost 2.33 points of VN-Index.
Even BID - one of the 2 strongest stocks in the banking group also decreased 1.6% to 36,800 VND.
In general, banking stocks are still the group that attracts the most money and attracts market concentration.CTG matched more than 18 million shares, 2.5 times higher than the average trading volume of the last 10 sessions, but STB is still the stock with the largest volume on the floor, reaching 18.5 million units.The 3 stocks in the top are all bank stocks: STB, CTG and MBB.On the Hanoi floor, SHB and ACB are also two stocks in the top 3.
Other stocks of interest such as PVD and PVS all fell sharply.PVD sometimes drops to the floor.
HPG was still strongly sold by foreign investors, although less than the previous session.This stock decreased by 1.8% and matched nearly 5 million units, foreign investors sold more than 1.9 million shares.Going against the general decline of the steel industry group were HSG with an increase of 1.4% and VGS with an increase of 2.1%.
-------------------------------------
The market has not changed much compared to before when money was still concentrated only in the banking group.At the end of the morning session, Vn-index decreased 3.25 points, equivalent to 0.3%, with a volume of 117 million shares, equivalent to nearly 3,500 billion VND.Hnx-index decreased 0.53 points with a volume of 29 million shares, equivalent to nearly 490 billion VND.
--------------------------------
Bank stocks demonstrated the strength of the leading group when they simultaneously reversed and increased in price after 9:30 am.CTG and BID are the two strongest stocks in this group because when they decline, they decrease the least and when they reverse, they rebound the fastest.The increase of CTG and BID reached over 2%.CTG is also the stock with the largest trading volume on HOSE.
Some bank stocks that are still falling in price are VIB, EIB, LPB.BAB and HDB.Foreign investors handed over 500,000 MBB in the form of an agreement at the price of 33,900 VND.
The recovery of banking stocks is the main factor pulling the VN-Index from a decline of nearly 9 points to the green.Meanwhile, other stock groups have not had such a simultaneous recovery.Some large stocks in the VN30 group also increased in price and contributed positively to the green color of the index such as VIC (increased slightly and maintained the mark of 90,000 VND), BVH increased to nearly 83,000 VND.Most of the rest are discounted.
And when the number of large stocks falling in price increased due to short-term profit-taking pressure due to the amount of cheap goods before Tet arriving in the account, the index quickly reversed to the red.
Oil and gas stocks still seem unable to recover.GAS decreased by 2.2% to 109,500 VND, PVD and PVS both decreased by over 2%.PVB and PVC decreased by over 3% while PVT decreased by 1.4%.PXS decreased by more than 4%.
As of 9:40 a.m., VN-Index still dropped more than 4 points with a volume of 30.5 million units, equivalent to more than 1,000 billion VND.HNX-Index also decreased 0.21 points with a volume of more than 12 million units, equivalent to 215 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: Domestic ETF fund VFMVN30 attracted 78 million new USD in January, pouring money to buy HPG, VIC and VNM
sapo: By the end of January 2018, the largest proportion in this fund's portfolio was HPG of Hoa Phat Group with more than 8.1 million shares, equivalent to 10.28%.
content:
In January 2018, the domestic ETF fund VFMVN30 (code: E1VFVN30) established by the fund management company Vietfund Management (VFM) attracted great attention from investors when this fund attracted a huge amount of money from foreign investors.If from the year of establishment (2014) to 2017, the fund's net asset value did not change much, then within the first month of 2018, the fund's total assets increased to nearly 5,000 billion VND.
According to the latest report as of January 31, 2018, VFMVN30's net assets were 4,908 billion VND - an increase of 2,160 billion in last January.Of which, the additional asset value due to the increase in the value of the Vn30 stock portfolio is 375 billion VND, the remaining 1,783 billion VND (78 million USD) is newly attracted money.The report also said that 96% of VFMVN30 fund certificates are held by foreign investors.
In the past month, with PVD and KBC removed from the VN30 portfolio, the VFMVN30 fund sold more than 1.1 million PVD shares and 2 million KBC shares to buy 1 million PLX shares and 1.7 million VJC shares.
By the end of January 2018, the largest proportion in this fund's portfolio was HPG of Hoa Phat Group with more than 8.1 million shares, equivalent to 10.28%.VIC is the second largest stock with 9.52% and the third is VNM with 9.17%.
author: Mai Linh

title: Taking strong profits from oil and gas stocks, VnIndex maintained the 1,050 point mark in the weekend session thanks to VIC, VRE, HDB, MSN
sapo: In the Bluechips group, HDB continued to impress when it increased to the ceiling to 45,450 VND.Foreign investors also net bought more than 300 billion VND of HDB in today's session and this contributed significantly to the stock's breakthrough.
content:
The afternoon trading session took place with selling pressure skyrocketing throughout the market.The oil and gas group, after a series of impressive increases, saw strong profit taking and names such as PVS, PVD, GAS, PVC, PVB, PXS... were all in the red.
Although the securities group attracted quite good demand, it was also under general adjustment pressure from the market and only SSI and VND had notable increases.
However, the sharp increase in large-cap stocks such as ROS, HDB, VJC, MSN, HPG, VIC, and VRE helped the market maintain a rising session, despite the overwhelming number of falling codes.In the Bluechips group, HDB continued to impress when it increased to the ceiling to 45,450 VND.Foreign investors also net bought more than 300 billion VND of HDB in today's session and this contributed significantly to the stock's breakthrough.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 1.94 points (0.19%) to 1,050.11 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.5 points (0.87%) to 58.11 points and only Hnx-Index decreased 1.7% to 120.76 points.
Market liquidity today continued at a very high level with 500 million units, corresponding to a transaction value of 11,837 billion VND.Foreign investors in today's session continued to be quite active with more than VND 800 billion of net buying in the entire market.
=======================================
After minutes of excitement in the oil session, selling pressure has increased strongly since 10:30, causing the indexes to narrow their breakthrough momentum.Pausing the trading session, VnIndex only increased 3.52 points (0.34%) to 1,051.69 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.47 points (0.81%) to 58.08 points and Hnx-Index even decreased 0.2 points (0.16%) to 122.64 points.
Liquidity in the morning session continued to be at a very high level with 300 million units, equivalent to a value of 6,904 billion VND.The number of declining codes on the 3 exchanges increased significantly to 296 codes, while the number of increasing codes was only 225.
Although the securities stocks group attracted quite good cash flow, they were also under general market adjustment pressure and most stocks only increased slightly.
Meanwhile, the oil and gas group was taking profits quite strongly after a series of "hot" increases and stocks such as GAS, PVS, PVD, PXS, PVC... were all in the red.
The support for the market this morning mainly came from Bluechips such as MSN
================================================================
The market opened the weekend trading session with a quite familiar scenario as cash flow continued to pour in strongly, helping the indexes increase sharply right from the opening minutes of the session.
The focus of the market right now is the group of securities stocks with a series of sharply increasing stocks such as VND, SHS, SSI, HCM, CTS... The recent sharp increase in the market is causing investors to place high expectations on this group of stocks.
In the banking group, trading is taking place quite fragmented when "leading" stocks such as VCB, BID, CTG, STB, EIB, ACB are "cooling down" after a series of breakthrough days.Meanwhile, names like MBB, SHB, HDB, LPB... are attracting money quite well. HDB in particular continues to make a strong breakthrough and has a net purchase of more than 2 million shares by foreign investors.
The oil and gas group, after recent breakthrough sessions, also showed signs of taking a break and trading in general was quite tense, except for PVS and PVD which were gaining points.On the contrary, natural rubber stocks DPR, PHR, TRC are trading quite actively.Similarly, steel stocks HPG, NKG, POM, TLH, VGS,... are currently attracting quite good cash flow.
At 10:10 a.m., VnIndex increased 3.62 points (0.35%) to 1,051.79 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.58 points (0.47%) to 123.42 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.71 points (1.23%) to 58.32 points.Market liquidity continues to be high at VND 3,185 billion.
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC, SAB, PLX all exploded, helping VnIndex increase nearly 6 points, CMG increased to the ceiling after a series of 6 consecutive sessions of falling to the floor.
sapo: In this afternoon's session, although the oil and gas group was heavily profit-taking, there were still many stocks that increased positively, including PVS, PVD, GAS, PVT, PXS... Similarly, the airline group with NCT, ACV, VJC, SCS increased.
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite cautious, this can be clearly seen through the market liquidity, as well as the decrease in order matching speed.However, the market still had a strong increase thanks to the support of Bluechips, typically SAB (up 13,600 VND), VIC (up 2,400 VND), PLX (up 2,900 VND), VCB (up 600 VND), BVH (up 3,800 VND)... These stocks have well compensated for the decline in CTG, EIB, HAG, HPG, VPB...
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 5.99 points (0.63%) to 958.31 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.2 points (0.18%) to 113.23 points and only Upcom-Index decreased 0.41 points (0.74%) to 54.29 points.Liquidity on the 3 exchanges reached 214 million units, equivalent to a value of 4,864 billion VND.In particular, foreign investors sold more than 2 million NVL shares with a total value of 168 billion VND.
In this afternoon's session, although the oil and gas group was heavily profit-taking, there were still many stocks that increased positively, including PVS, PVD, GAS, PVT, PXS... Similarly, the airline group with NCT, ACV, VJC, SCS increased.
Stock stocks, after the morning's excitement, also suffered the same corrective pressure and only SSI, VND, BSI, and CTS remained in green.
CMG, after a series of 6 consecutive sessions of falling to the floor, attracted strong bottom-fishing demand and increased its ceiling to 34,000 VND in today's session.
VNM shares decreased by 2,900 VND to the round threshold of 200,000 VND/share.Another dairy industry stock, GTN, stood at 15,300 VND.
PNJ stock, after achieving an impressive increase at the beginning of the session, cooled down following the general market momentum, ending the session at 131,000 VND/share.
================================
At the end of the morning session, VN-index increased 2.37 points thanks to the recovery of SAB and the green color of some large stocks such as PLX, GAS, BVH.The majority of stocks on the floor are sinking in the red.The trading volume on HOSE reached nearly 99 million shares, equivalent to 2,230 billion VND.Trading developments were no different from the beginning of the session.
Leading in liquidity on HOSE currently is FLC with more than 3.4 million shares and FIT with nearly 3.4 million units.
--------------------------------
The first trading session of the week was quite positive right from the opening minutes.The recovery of SAB (up 6,000 VND), along with the green color in Bluechips such as VIC, VJC, FPT, BVH, VCB as well as some oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVS... are the main driving forces driving the market up.
However, investor psychology in general is still quite cautious, this is reflected in the relatively low trading volume (as of 10am, the trading value had only reached 1,165 billion VND on 3 exchanges).In addition, the fact that MSN, DHG, HPG, HAG, REE, VPB, BHN, VNM... all fell all at once made the market not so booming.
At 10:10 a.m., VnIndex increased 1.75 points (0.18%) to 954.03 points, while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index both decreased.
The group of oil and gas stocks, after the excitement at the beginning of the session, has now slowed down, but overall is still positive.The aviation stocks group is currently attracting quite good cash flow with NCT, MAS, ACV, HVN, VJC... gaining points.
Stock stocks SSI, HCM, VND, SHS, CTS... after recent fluctuating sessions are trading quite well and simultaneously increasing in points.
CMG, after the first minutes of the session falling to the floor, attracted strong bottom-fishing cash flow and this stock is currently down only 700 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: VCB, VIC, GAS all broke out to help the market "sublimate" in the afternoon session, VnIndex ended the week exceeding 950 points
sapo: Some stocks with good fundamentals that have increased quite recently such as APC, PNJ, NCT, CVT, PC1... were sold strongly at the end of the session and simultaneously fell deeply.
content:
Towards the end of the trading session, the market became even more prosperous as cash flow poured into the market, helping VnIndex close up 6.26 points (0.66%) to 952.32 points.Bluechips such as SAB, BHN, VIC, VCB, MWG, BVH, FPT, GAS, MSN,... all increased in points, which was the main driving force for the market's increase.On the contrary, Hnx-Index closed down 0.53 points (0.47%) to 113.03 points.
In this afternoon's session, the oil and gas stocks group also had other positive signals with many codes regaining the green color and gaining points such as GAS, PGD, PVB, PVC, PVD, PVE despite losing most of the trading time.This also contributed to helping the market increase sharply at the end of the session.
The group of securities stocks, after recent prosperous sessions, has been under pressure to correct and most of them decreased, except for VND 1, MBS which increased significantly.Similar developments, real estate and construction stocks also traded relatively fluctuating.
Some stocks with good fundamentals that have increased quite recently such as APC, PNJ, NCT, CVT, PC1... were sold strongly at the end of the session and simultaneously fell deeply.
GTN stock today had 450,000 shares traded in agreement at the price of 15,500 VND while closing the trading session at 15,300 VND - a decrease of 200 VND compared to the reference price.
CMG continued to be "discharged" mercilessly and this stock had a series of 6 consecutive sessions of falling to the floor.
======================================
The morning trading session was quite tense as the market continuously "wobbled" according to SAB.By the end of the morning session, SAB only increased by 3,800 VND, although at one time this stock increased by nearly 13,000 VND.
With the support of SAB, VIC, MWG, PVD, VCB, HPG, VRE, BHN, FPT..., VnIndex increased 1.56 points (0.16%) to 947.62 points, while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index still decreased.Liquidity in the entire market reached 145 million units, equivalent to a value of 6,053 billion VND, including a sudden agreement of 16.6 million VNM shares, equivalent to a value of 3,376 billion VND.
In this morning's session, foreign investors continued to net buy with a value of about 130 billion VND in the entire market.
Oil and gas stocks, after a recent period of strong growth, were under pressure to take profits and most of them dropped, except for PVD, which increased by 350 VND.
Meanwhile, highly marketable stock groups such as stocks, real estate, and construction mostly dropped, reflecting the caution of investors in the last days of the year.
====================
After yesterday's strong correction, the market opened the weekend session with a familiar green color.The driving force to help the market increase came from SAB when this stock was "bottom-fished" quite strongly and at one point increased by more than 13,000 VND.
Along with SAB, other large-cap stocks such as VIC, MSN recovered after the previous unexpected drop, as well as BHN, HPG, HSG, VRE, MWG... all increased to help the market maintain the green color, despite the adjustment of oil and gas groups (GAS, PVS, PVD, PVC, PVB...).
At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex increased 1.14 points (0.12%) to 947.2 points;while Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index both decreased.
Highly marketable stocks such as stocks (SSI, HCM, VND, SHS...), real estate, construction (DIG, DXG, KBC, LDG, SCR, TDH, VGC, PC1, PHC, NLG...) mostly dropped, reflecting a certain caution of investors in the last days of the year.
VNM milk shares adjusted slightly down when exceeding the threshold of 200,000 VND and GTN shares of GTNfoods also decreased by 150 VND to 15,350 VND/share.
Aviation stocks VJC, HVN, ACV, NCT, NCS... after a recent impressive breakthrough are also under pressure to correct.
The "hot" stock CMG continued to be sold strongly and fell to the "buy side" floor for the 6th consecutive session.
author: Minh Anh

title: "Pedaling" VIC, MSN, BID... in the ATC session, VN-Index dropped more than 7 points, oil and gas stocks cooled down
sapo: It is very possible that this is a move to lock in the NAV of an investment fund.
content:
While the index was still in a fluctuating state like during most of the trading time on December 21, suddenly in the ATC session, a number of large orders "hit" the seller side, pushing large-cap stocks such as VIC, BID, MSN, MWG down very sharply, in which VIC and BID sometimes fell to the floor.At the end, MSN fell 3.8%, BID fell 1.2%, MWG fell 2.6% and VIC recovered the best, down only 0.7%.
It is very possible that this is a move to lock in the NAV of an investment fund.
Along with that, SAB's decrease of VND 18,300, ROS's decrease of VND 7,200 and the narrowing of GAS's increase (only an increase of VND 300) caused the VN-Index to decrease by 7.45 points, closing at 946.06 points.Trading volume reached 213.6 million shares, equivalent to 5,840 billion VND.
All indicators are red.
Except for GAS, PVS and PXS, oil and gas stocks have cooled down.PVD decreased by 3.8%.PGS, PVX, PVG, PVT, PXT... pulled back to reference and PVB, PVC dropped in price.Meanwhile, protein stocks DPM increased and DCM increased to the ceiling.
Most banking stocks decreased in price, similarly the group of securities stocks except HCM increased and conquered a new peak of 57,900 VND.
DXG leads in liquidity on HOSE with 6.3 million shares and decreased by 100 VND, but the stock ranked 2nd - HPG - is a notable face as it continues to increase by 100 VND to a new peak and in particular, foreign investors bought up to 3.6 million shares, accounting for more than half of HPG's total trading volume today.
With the developments of VN-Index as well as Vn30-Index, derivative contracts all decreased.VN30F1712 decreased 11.2 points to 937.8 - quite close to the closing price of VN30-Index today which is 936.53 points when the expiration date is near.
-----------------------------
VN-Index ended the morning session with an increase of 0.82 points, volume of 97.2 million shares equivalent to 2,665 billion VND.HNX-Index increased 0.36 points and matched nearly 700 billion VND.The green color of VN-Index was supported by VIC, VRE and GAS in the context of SAB still falling sharply but liquidity increased suddenly, reaching more than 414,000 shares at the end of the morning session.
In the oil and gas group, GAS still increased firmly by 2.1% to 94,000 VND.PVS increased 1.4%, PXS increased 1.3% while PVD corrected slightly.Major stocks in the banking industry corrected when VCB decreased 0.3%, BID decreased 0.6% and CTG temporarily stood at the reference price.In the securities group, stocks simultaneously adjusted.The remaining green color was in HCM (Up 1.8%) and VCI (up 1.2%).
In the real estate group, red is also the main color.Some prominent faces such as VRE increased by 4.7%, VIC increased by 1.9% or QCG increased by 4.3%.DXG increased 1.2% and led HOSE in volume with 4.9 million units.Top liquidity also includes MBB and HPG.In particular, HPG continued to receive a net purchase of nearly 1.5 million shares by foreign investors.
One of the stocks that attracted attention today was VNS when it hit the ceiling with a ceiling buying surplus of more than 80,000 units.Meanwhile, CMG dropped to the floor at 34,150 VND.
-----------------------------------
Oil and gas stocks continued to increase well, even at PVS with a large volume (14 million shares) arriving in the account after T3.GAS increased by 2.5% to reach 95,000 VND/share.PVD increased 1.1% and PVS increased 2.7%.The following stocks increased even stronger such as PGS increased by 9.6%, PXS increased by 5.7%, PVT increased by 3%...
Meanwhile, banking stocks traded less enthusiastically.VCB, BID, STB trade at gold price.CTG, MBB, SHB, ACB increased slightly.Securities stocks are also in a similar situation with green in SSI, HCM, SHS and red in VND, CTS, AGR.
On the steel group side, HPG continued to rise to a new peak, approaching the price of 45,000 VND with strong buying power from foreign investors.Recently, foreign investors have strongly bought this stock and created momentum for HPG to increase continuously.
Large capitalization stocks that have been hot in recent sessions have also changed.SAB no longer fell to the floor, but still decreased by 5.4%.ROS no longer increased to the ceiling but decreased by 4.3% and is leading in volume on HOSE with nearly 1.8 million shares.VIC increased nearly 2% but has not yet reached its old peak.VNM increased slightly to nearly 203,000 VND.
As of 9:55 a.m., VN-Index increased slightly with a volume of more than 35 million units, equivalent to 1,120 billion VND.HNX-Index increased slightly with a volume of nearly 17 million shares, equivalent to 254 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: VIC, VNM recovered strongly after a series of deep declines, VnIndex regained the milestone of 940 points in the weekend session
sapo: In the securities group, HCM, CTS, and SSI were the most prominent stocks at the end of the session with increases.Meanwhile, the real estate and construction groups also have many notable names such as NVL, IDV, PHC, ROS, VIC, VRC, DIG, FCN, DRH...
content:
The weekend trading session ended with positive developments as the market ended a series of 3 consecutive losing sessions.Accordingly, VnIndex closed up 1.51 points (0.16%) to 940.16 points;Upcom-Index increased 0.21 points (0.39%) to 54.47 points and only Hnx-Index decreased 0.72 points (0.63%) to 113.81 points.
Liquidity in the entire market was lower than in recent sessions, reaching only 245 million units, corresponding to a transaction value of 5,695 billion VND.Of which, VNM agreed for nearly 300 billion, VIC agreed for nearly 400 billion...
In this afternoon's session, although GAS weakened a bit, the efforts of VJC, PLX, VNM, VIC, BVH, MSN... helped VnIndex regain its green color.In particular, VIC and VNM ended the series of deep declines, MSN and MSR soared thanks to information surrounding the Nui Phao mine.
In the securities group, HCM, CTS, and SSI were the most prominent stocks at the end of the session with increases.Meanwhile, the real estate and construction groups also have many notable names such as NVL, IDV, PHC, ROS, VIC, VRC, DIG, FCN, DRH...
VCG, after the news of being "sold" in SCIC's auction, was sold strongly with a floor/ATC selling surplus of nearly 7 million units.Similarly, stocks in the State capital divestment list such as BMP, NTP, DMC, FPT, VGC, BHN, SAB also dropped sharply.
On the contrary, CMG continues to be a "hot" name in the market when it increased to the ceiling to 38,150 VND.Similarly, TCH also continued its streak of impressive increases with an increase of 1,150 VND to 21,650 VND.
===========================================================
After a few minutes of strong selling in the early morning, bottom-fishing cash flow strongly participated in helping the market quickly reverse.As of 11:30 a.m., VnIndex increased by 4.41 points (0.47%) to 943.06 points with the number of increasing codes reaching 138, while the number of decreasing codes was only 100.
The fact that Bluechips such as GAS, MSN, BVH, VJC, VPB, VNM... all increased sharply, while VIC regained the reference mark helped the market break out.
The excitement of large capitalization stocks has led to highly marketable stock groups such as stocks, real estate, construction... to make a strong breakthrough.Accordingly, in the securities group, VND, SSI, HCM, SHS, FTS, VCI increased.As for real estate and construction, we can mention ROS, PHC, NVL, DXG, DIG, LCG, HBC, KBC...
This morning, the duo MSN and MSR traded quite actively, MSR even increased to the "white selling" ceiling.
On the contrary, the group of stocks divested from the State such as BMP, NTP, VCG, DMC, FPT, VGC, SAB, BHN continued to be sold strongly.In particular, VCG continued to fall to the floor "white on the buying side".
=======================================================
The December 8 trading session opened with selling pressure increasing sharply right from the opening minutes.The information that there were only more than 5 million VCG shares in SCIC's auction had a strong impact on the group of stocks divested from the State such as BMP, VCG, DMC, FPT, VGC, SAB, BHN... In which, VCG fell to the floor "white on the buying side", SAB fell by more than 11,000 VND...
Besides, VIC also traded not really actively and at one point breached the 70,000 VND mark which also had a negative impact on the market and at one point VnIndex retreated to 930 points.
However, the recent sharp decline in the market has triggered bottom-fishing cash flow and helped the indexes quickly narrow their decline.

title: Excluding the influence of VIC, VRE, ROS and SAB, the Vietnamese stock market turns out to be... still cheap
sapo: The above four stocks account for 24% of HoSE's capitalization but only contribute 6% of total profit, so they accidentally pulled the market's P/E level higher than normal.
content:
According to Bloomberg data, as of November 21, VN-Index's P/E level was up to 18 times - a very high level since 2012 until now.Rong Viet Securities commented that compared with other markets in the region and with the PE of frontier markets, and even emerging markets, VnIndex's current P/E is probably past the time of "cheapest in the region".
The fact that the market P/E has reached such a high level is a consequence of the fact that the VN-Index has increased by 38% from the beginning of the year until now.The upward momentum is mainly led by stocks that always have a P/E much higher than the average such as Vingroup (VIC), FLC Faros (ROS), Sabeco (SAB) and most recently the appearance of Vincom Retail (VRE) stock sought after by many domestic and foreign investors.
In the group of stocks with the largest capitalization, which means accounting for the largest proportion in the VN-Index, these four stocks also have the highest P/E.According to our data, VIC and ROS currently have three-digit P/Es, 218 times and 105 times, respectively.VRE is 78 times and SAB is 42 times.
These four stocks account for 24% of HoSE's capitalization but only contribute 6% of total profit, so they accidentally pulled the market's P/E level higher than normal.
For Vingroup and Vincom Retail, P/E is partly due to current low profits because many large projects are in the process of partial investment, showing great expectations for future growth.
The beer industry duo Sabeco and Habeco also have the highest P/E in the market and much higher than Vinamilk because investors are expecting the upcoming state divestment.However, these two beer stocks have very low liquidity.
According to our calculations, if we temporarily ignore the above 4 stocks, the whole market P/E drops significantly to only 14.7 times.
Considering the 30 largest capitalization stocks alone - accounting for 82% of capitalization and 68% of HoSE's profits - the weighted average P/E is currently at 21.8 times and if excluding the above 4 stocks, it is 17 times.

title: VIC and VNM helped VN-Index maintain the 860 point mark, KSA dropped to the floor after information about abandoned headquarters

VietJetAir's VJC continued to increase sharply for the second consecutive session after yesterday's "huge" trading session.
Futures contracts all increased in price.VN30F1711 matched more than 11,500 contracts, an increase of 3,300 VND.
-------------------------
VN-Index continued to increase and surpassed 860 points thanks to VIC.This stock increased 4.6% to 68,500 VND.In the opposite direction, ROS decreased by 3.7% to 180,000 VND, which was the factor pulling the index down.VNM also hesitated around the reference price, SAB decreased 0.5% and GAS decreased 0.5% along with the adjustment of the "hottest" oil and gas stocks in recent days such as PVD and PVS because oil prices have turned down.

author: Tu Linh

title: HBC, HII, HAR, FIT, QCG... fell to the floor, VnIndex still maintained its green color thanks to ROS, SAB, VIC, GAS
sapo: In this afternoon's session, most highly marketable industry groups such as stocks, real estate, and construction all dropped, even HBC and QCG fell to the floor "white on the buying side".
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite negative.Although VnIndex ended the session still up 4.83 points (0.57%) to 845.2 points thanks to the support of ROS (ceiling increase), SAB (up 6,500 VND), VIC, GAS and a few banking stocks such as BID, VPB, but most of the market dropped.

Although the oil and gas group traded quite well thanks to the news of oil price recovery, at the end of the session there were only a few gainers such as GAS, PVB, PVD, PVS.

author: Tu Linh

title: VIC – Vingroup: Is the period of long-term price acceleration beginning?
sapo: VIC caused surprise when its market price increased the most since the beginning of the year.
content:
Vietnam's stock market had its second consecutive week of increase after a short-term peak period since August 11, 2017 thanks to the guidance from real estate stocks, and the keeping pace of large-cap stocks in the banking and consumer groups... Vingroup's VIC stock is one of the outstanding stocks typical for creating a recovery effect in the general market up to the present time since creating a bottom on August 11, 2017.August 21, 2017 this stock generated a performance of up to 15.15%.
VIC bottomed about 2 trading sessions before the market and along with other real estate stocks such as FLC and DXG created a spillover effect on the stock market, causing speculative cash flow to re-enter because the prices of many stocks have become more attractive.VIC's price increase in the short term will not be remarkable if one does not look back at the history from the beginning of the year until now because VIC's price increases are not attractive enough for the majority of investors when the average price mainly fluctuates around 43,000 VND.The high and low levels at this stage are only 46,000 VND and 40,000 VND respectively.
Calculated at the adjusted price, it took VIC about 6 years to increase about 2.5 times since the lowest bottom at the end of 2011. If this increase is compared with many other leading stocks in the market such as MWG, VNM, VCS, TLG... it seems that VIC is classified as "slow growth".And is it possible that with the recent short-term spike, VIC has the ability to create long-term price acceleration?
Expected business results and new stories
The proportion of revenue and profit coming from VIC's real estate business accounts for nearly 70% this year.VIC's revenue in the second quarter of 2017 grew by 109.35% over the same period and the after-tax profit of parent company shareholders increased by 16%.
With real estate projects falling into the revenue recognition cycle, it is possible that revenue and profits recognized in the last 6 months of the year may be accelerated even more than at the beginning of the year.In addition, the total profit in the third and fourth quarters of 2016 is only about 600 billion, so growth is almost by default.Even throughout the year, business results still grew in parallel with both revenue and profit.
According to estimates by HSC Securities, revenue in the first 6 months of the year came from projects such as:
• Vinhomes Central Park (5.8 trillion VND) (down 18.3% over the same period).
• Vinhomes Park Hill (3.5 trillion VND) (no revenue recorded in the same period last year).
• Vinhomes Gardenia (2.1 trillion VND) (not allowed to record revenue in the same period last year).
• Beach villas and townhouse products (111.8 trillion VND) (up 211% over the same period).
• And other projects (600 billion VND).
The value of house sales contracts in the first 6 months of the year is nearly 30 trillion VND (down 25% over the same period) while the number of houses sold is 5,500 units (down 21% over the same period).In the first 6 months of the year, VIC only introduced 3 new projects, including Vinhomes Green Bay, Vinhomes Harmony and Vinhomes Imperia.All three of these projects are in the North.The southern real estate market is still in oversupply, especially in the mid and high-end segments, so VIC is quite cautious in this market.And this will certainly affect the business results of the next two years.However, HSC believes that VinCity affordable housing projects introduced in the last 6 months of the year may help reverse the situation.
A new story that many people are interested in is Vingroup starting construction on the VINFAST automobile production complex in Cat Hai Economic Zone - Hai Phong.Previously, in June 2017, Vingroup established VinFast Production and Trading Company Limited to implement this project.VinFast Company currently has a charter capital of VND 5,250 billion, 100% owned by Vingroup.
With current reputation and financial potential, information about building the Vinfast complex to produce Vietnamese brand cars has also had a positive impact on investors' expectations recently.In addition, Vietnam is still a potential car consumption market in the region and the world when the car ownership rate is very low at only about 23 cars per 1000 people, while this rate in Indonesia, Thailand and the US is 55/1000, 204/1000 and 790/1000 respectively.
In the short term, it is the story of Vincom Retail's initial stock offering at the end of the year
Information in the press that Vincom Retail is planning to conduct an initial public offering of shares in the domestic market with a raised amount of up to 600 million USD, is having a strong impact on short-term investors.
Historically, information related to acquisitions, mergers, sales to strategic partners at high prices... has always been quite attractive to short-term investors. Short-term trends are often formed when the news begins to be rumored and ends when the rumors become announced facts or never happen.
HSC Securities believes that Vincom Retail's IPO plan, if officially announced, will be enthusiastically received when in reality there are not many investment options with listed stocks in the retail industry.
Investment idea: Continue to hold.
New strategies have the potential to make VIC better in the future, and with the prediction that revenue and profit in the last 6 months of the year will grow strongly over the same period, the idea of ​​holding VIC for at least the end of this year will probably be chosen by many investors.
Support and resistance milestones need to be noted
The ideal price for VIC by the end of the year at about 60,000 VND is established based on the Fibonanci extension tool, and in case the price adjusts, the 46,000 VND mark will act as strong support for the price line.
author: Tu Pham

title: [Stock market hot spots week August 28 - September 3] Vietnamese stocks exploded with VIC and BID, the world stock market recovered cautiously
sapo: The world stock market last week was gradually recovering despite some mid-week fluctuations surrounding North Korea's missile launch in northern Japan while the Vietnamese stock market experienced a rather "positive" trading week as banking groups and bluechips continued to lead the market forward.
content:
Vietnam's stock market had a positive increase last week
Last week, what happened on the electricity board showed that the cash flow situation was returning to be more positive in the banking stock groups and many large capitalization codes, in addition, it also remained positive in the steel group and there was good circulation in the real estate group.VN-Index and VN30-Index show that they have both successfully tested short-term resistance at 785 and 772-773 points respectively.
Closing the week, VN-Index closed at 788.73 points, up 17.1 points (+2.21%) and HNX-Index closed at 103.81 points, up 1.17 points (+1.1%) compared to the previous week.This recovery pace shows that the VN-Index seems to be continuing to increase and approaching the peak from the beginning of the year.VN-Index increased thanks to blue-chip codes in the banking sector, beer and wine and some codes with special stories.It was these codes that helped the market close the weekend session above the psychological mark of 780 points.
Especially during the week, it is impossible not to mention the surprise that somewhat "shocked" investors from the ATC session on the first day of the week, August 29.Entering the trading session, selling pressure increased from the beginning of the session and throughout the end of the session.With strong sell orders placed during the ATC session, the "culprit" is believed to come from an ETF, possibly VanEck Vectors Vietnam ETF (V.N.M ETF), because the stocks sold during the ATC session all belong to this ETF's portfolio.The reason is due to information that this fund is currently withdrawing its fund certificates and has been trading at a continuous discount.The withdrawal of CCQ may also be partly influenced by the political tension in some countries around the world.The strong ATC sell orders appearing in blue-chip codes such as HPG, SSI, STB, VCG, MSN at one time caused the VN-Index to fall deeply, but after being "balanced" by the buyers, at the end of the session, the VN-Index only decreased by 3.23 points.
A notable point last week was that foreign investors pushed up the price of VIC (Vingroup) shares, bringing VIC to the highest price since its listing. During the explosive session on August 30, this stock received sudden demand from foreign investors with more than 800 thousand units, while the total matched volume of the entire session was only 1.6 million.Thanks to that, VIC jumped more than 6.8% to 49,200 VND/share, this is the highest price of this stock since its listing.Closing the week, this stock closed at 49,400 VND/share.
The banking group has had positive recovery developments from the trading sessions near the end of the week onwards, but the cash flow of BID shares pushing up to the ceiling price is still a big surprise of the August 31 session.The explanation for the phenomenon that BIDV is attracting the market's attention may have to be mentioned that investors are currently speculating that this bank will sell shares to Korean partners in the near future.
Besides, the closing session of the weekend of September 1 also showed that cash flow is pouring into the bluechips group, with foreign investors net buying statistics of up to 114 billion VND.It seems that foreign investors are focusing their cash flow on large capitalization stocks such as VNM, HPG, VIC, BID and GAS on HOSE.On HNX, activity is still quite small, buyers focus on 3 main stocks: HUT, SHB and VCG.
For the derivatives market, 4 contracts all had a "positive" increase in score in the last session of the week.This shows that investors are gradually becoming less pessimistic about future prospects and accepting to raise price expectations higher than reality.Besides, the increase in score along with liquidity and strong buying force are probably all positive signs of the trend, reflecting that the level of confidence of the PS market has increased significantly.
The world stock market experienced a week of "cautious" recovery.
In the US, the stock market rose slightly as a dismal US jobs report dampened expectations for another interest rate hike this year.Specifically, US job growth was much lower than forecast in August after growing strongly for 2 consecutive months.Last week, Dow Jones increased 39.46 points (+0.18%), S&P 500 Index increased 4.9 points (+0.2%) and NASDAQ Composite increased 6.67 points (+0.1%).
In the last trading sessions of the week, it seemed that the energy and raw materials sectors were the two sectors leading the increase while the natural disaster "Hurricane Harvey" caused stocks of the US transportation and aviation industries to decline quite badly in the past week.
In the UK, the UK's FTSE 100 stock index has been almost flat since the beginning of June until now.Last week, this index only changed 0.28% and closed at 7447.21 points.The explanation for the above reason is because the latest third round of negotiations of the Brexit process ended with a harsh announcement, when both sides could not even agree on whether to continue negotiations or not.Mr. David Davis, Britain's Brexit secretary, said some concrete progress had been made while European Union representative Michel Barnier said the negotiations had made no progress.Britain's post-Brexit economic outlook is still quite vague up to this point.
In Europe, the most prominent is Denmark's OMX Copenhagen 20 stock index, which has continuously increased in the past week, from 1013.98 points on Monday's session to 1026.06 points on the closing day of the weekend.The reason comes from the fact that the government of this country is proposing to "cut taxes".According to Finance Minister Kristian Jensen, Denmark is proposing the equivalent of $3.7 billion in income tax cuts to encourage people to work and save for retirement.With that positive information, the country's stock market has had consecutive days of increasing points.
In Asia, North Korea's sudden missile launch caused the stock markets of South Korea and Japan to sell sharply in the middle of the week due to concerns about increasing tensions.The hardest hit was South Korea's Kospi 200 index, which fell by 3% in Wednesday's trading session, while other indices in Asia such as Japan's Nikkei 225 and China's Hang Seng Index had slightly lower volatility.
author: Pear Flower

title: VIC dropped at the end of the session, BID suddenly increased to the ceiling, market liquidity soared despite the approaching holiday
sapo: BID increased to the ceiling to 20,700 VND with soaring liquidity.Banking stocks raced to increase sharply.
content:
At the end of today's trading session, VIC shares reversed and decreased slightly.Liquidity reached 1.46 million shares.
BID caught the attention of the whole market when at the end of the session there was a surplus of hundreds of thousands of shares.Liquidity reached 5.42 million shares.
Along with BID increasing to the ceiling, the banking industry today also received great attention from investors when most stock codes increased sharply.CTG increased by 2.7%, Kien Long Bank's KLB also increased by 6.6%, SHB increased by 2.6%, STB increased by 2.2%, MBB increased strongly by 2.4%... VIB shares went against the flow of banking shares when they decreased by 1.4% to 21,100 VND.
The most notable highlight is that Vingroup's VIC shares continued to increase sharply to 50,400 VND/share - the highest in history based on adjusted price.Having stood still for a long time when the market had many good stories, VIC shares have probably accumulated enough and are now rising sharply with a series of supporting information.According to HSC Securities Company, the strong increase in VIC shares is due to investors' expectations about the timing and listing information of Vingroup Retail, which could take place in Q4.In early August, Bloomberg quoted a close source as saying that Vincom Retail - a member company that manages Vingroup's shopping center system - is planning to carry out an initial public offering of shares in the domestic market.The amount raised from this deal can be up to 600 million USD - including selling existing shares and newly issued shares.This will be the second largest IPO ever, after Vietcombank's IPO 10 years ago.Vingroup has not commented on this information, but the information has attracted the attention of both domestic and international investors.
Along with VIC, SDI shares also increased sharply to nearly 60,000 VND.
VietnamAirlines' HVN shares today "took off" to more than 25,000 VND even though today is a trading day without the right to receive a 6% cash dividend.
The group of high-liquidity stocks is still FLC and ROS.The trading activity of these stocks has contributed greatly to the overall liquidity of the market.The developments in these stocks make those who like highly volatile stocks constantly keep an eye on the electronic price list.
PVD, after going from the bottom price of 13,000 VND to more than 15,600 VND in just about 1 month, has continuously dropped sharply in recent sessions and today is no exception.A loss of 3% this morning brought PVD stock price to the range of 13,300-13,400 VND/share.
TAG-MWG temporarily cooled down this morning.The information that MWG bought shares in TAG is probably not enough of a story for investors to believe when TAG's efforts to open a supermarket chain did not help this company increase sales.Is MWG's purchase of shares enough basis to help TAG increase revenue? When Tran Anh is famous in the North and still "doesn't work", will Mobile World's involvement change the situation?There are still many opinions that say that buying an opponent is sometimes just to eliminate one player and Mobile World is doing this.However, this is just an outsider's prediction, and what Mobile World was thinking when making this acquisition move must only be answered in the future.
GTN stock today dropped slightly at the beginning of the session, but the sellers did not want to sell and the buyers still hesitated.After more than 1 hour of trading, this stock broke out strongly, increasing by 400 VND/share.The business results of this company show a remarkable change when the M&A has basically been completed.But, agricultural business is not like other industries, the gradual change is a measure of investors' patience in waiting for business results as well as stock changes.
author: Phuong Chi

title: Foreign investors boosted net buying of VIC, Vn Index jumped nearly 5 points in the session on August 30
sapo: VIC was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 38.73 billion VND.Next are CTD (11.45 billion VND), VNM (9.84 billion VND), DXG (9.17 billion VND), HSG (8.09 billion VND).
content:
The August 30 trading session ended with mixed movements of the indices.While VnIndex increased 4.62 points (0.6%) to 778.65 points thanks to the support of Bluechips, especially the duo VIC and ROS, Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index were both in the red.
On HSX, foreign investors net bought 973 thousand shares, equivalent to 68.3 billion VND in today's trading session.
VIC was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in the session with 38.73 billion VND.Next are CTD (11.45 billion VND), VNM (9.84 billion VND), DXG (9.17 billion VND), HSG (8.09 billion VND).
Closing the trading session, all 5 stocks in the top net buying increased, in which VIC was the most actively traded stock when it increased nearly to the ceiling to 49,200 VND, this is also the stock that had the most positive impact on VnIndex.
On the net selling side, NVL topped the list with 17.5 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are VCB (15.14 billion VND), HBC (13.03 billion VND), SKG (7.17 billion VND), SCR (5.99 billion VND).Among them, SKG is the most actively traded stock, increasing by 1,500 VND (4.6%) to 33,900 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors also returned to net buy 839 thousand shares, equivalent to 4.02 billion VND in today's trading session.
SHB topped the list of foreign net buyers on HNX with 6.73 billion VND.Next in the top net buying are HUT (2.33 billion VND), VNR (0.96 billion VND), API (0.6 billion VND), HKB (0.39 billion VND).Among them, API was the only stock that increased with an increase of 1,000 VND (3.4%) to 30,500 VND.
On the contrary, CVT topped the foreign net selling list with 3.03 billion VND.Closing the session, CVT decreased by 400 VND (0.9%) to 46,500 VND.
The top 5 foreign stocks with the most net selling in the session also include PVS (2.99 billion VND), PVE (0.51 billion VND), VGC (0.38 billion VND), IDJ (0.34 billion VND).
On Upcom, foreign investors had the 26th consecutive net buying session with 267 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 11.69 billion VND.
QNS topped the net buying list on Upcom with 4.07 billion VND.Next are IBC (2.37 billion VND), ACV (2.35 billion VND), SCS (1.17 billion VND), GEX (0.87 billion VND).Among them, SCS was the least actively traded stock, down 800 VND (0.9%) to 89,800 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: The number of declining codes dominated, VnIndex still increased by nearly 5 points thanks to VIC and ROS
sapo: The contrast of the indexes has an important reason because large capitalization stocks such as HPG, HSG, MSN, MWG, PNJ, ROS, VIC, SAB... all increased sharply.Notably, VIC increased by 3,150 VND (near the ceiling) and ROS increased by 3,000 VND.
content:
The afternoon session ended with mixed movements of the indices.While VnIndex increased 4.62 points (0.6%) to 778.65 points, Hnx-Index and Upcom-Index were both "on fire".
The contrast of the indexes has an important reason because large capitalization stocks such as HPG, HSG, MSN, MWG, PNJ, ROS, VIC, SAB... all increased sharply.Notably, VIC increased by 3,150 VND (near the ceiling) and ROS increased by 3,000 VND.
Overall on all 3 exchanges, the number of declining codes today dominated with 261 codes, while the number of increasing codes was only 238.
FLC continued to trade quite actively in the afternoon, however this stock still fell to the floor with a floor selling surplus of 1.7 million units.Along with FLC, "hot" stocks such as HAR and ART also continued to fall to the floor price, while HAI was only "slightly" above the floor price of 50 VND.
In today's session, real estate and construction are still the groups with more active transactions than the general market and the codes ROS, NLG, D2D, VPH, VIC, VCG, DXG, LDG, TDH... all closed up.
Financial and banking groups can no longer maintain the recovery momentum and many stocks that increased strongly in the recent period have declined such as ACB, BID, CTG...
-----------------
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 2.4 points (0.31%) to 776.43 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.01 points (0.01%) to 103.53 points and Upcom-Index decreased slightly 0.17 points (0.31%) to 54.28 points.
The entire market's liquidity is at a fairly low average level with 153 million shares, equivalent to a value of 2,325 billion VND.Of which, FLC alone matched nearly 47 million shares, equivalent to 371 billion VND.
This morning, FLC stock fluctuations were quite "dizzying" with unexpected fluctuations.Currently, FLC is falling close to the floor and has a surplus of 1.5 million shares.Similarly, ART also fluctuates quite unpredictably and is currently down 3,000 VND to 27,700 VND.
The duo HAI and HAR continue to be sold strongly and HAI has a surplus of nearly 3 million shares.Meanwhile, FIT and TSC regained their green color and gained points.
This morning, real estate and construction stocks traded quite actively with many stocks gaining points such as HBC, DXG, LDG, LGL, QCG, ROS, NLG, VCG.Besides, the active trading of Bluechips such as VIC, MWG, PNJ, VNM, MSN... also greatly supports the general market.
----------------
The August 30 trading session opened with the green color dominating right from the first minutes.Stocks in the Vn30 group, after suddenly being sold strongly yesterday such as VNM, SSI, VCB, MSN... have recovered and are the driving force to help the market increase, but the overall increase is quite weak.
At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex increased slightly by 2.15 points (0.28%) to 776.18 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.07 points (0.07%) to 103.6 points and Upcom-Index increased 0.05 points (0.08%) to 54.5 points.
Real estate and construction stocks are currently trading more actively than the general average with many stocks gaining points such as ROS, NLG, VPH, VCG, VNE, DXG, HBC, QCG...
FLC, after falling to the floor at the beginning of the session, has now recovered and is down just over 300 VND.The same is true for ART when this stock has exited the floor and is only down by more than 2,000 VND.Meanwhile, "hot" stocks such as HAI and HAR continued to be sold strongly and fell to the floor.
Steel stocks VGS, SMC, NKG, KVC, HPG, HSG... also traded quite well and simultaneously increased.The duo HAG and HNG, after yesterday's positive recovery session, reversed and dropped this morning.
author: Minh Anh

title: HNG dropped to the floor, VIC and EIB reached a "huge" deal, accounting for nearly 30% of HOSE liquidity
sapo: In addition, NVL, AAA, VNM, PNJ... were also negotiated with great value.
content:
At the end of the trading session on June 8, VN-Index decreased 3.33 points to nearly 750 points under the pull of ROS (floor price) and the three big banks VCB, CTG and BID.Among the banking group, only STB increased by 2.6%, the rest all decreased.VN30-Index still increased 0.34 points when DHG increased to the ceiling.
Today's trading volume reached nearly 263 million shares, equivalent to 5,229 billion VND, but of which up to 2,100 billion was from agreements.In the afternoon session alone, VIC was negotiated for more than 700 billion VND, EIB agreed for 53.4 million shares at the ceiling price, equivalent to 686 billion VND.In addition, NVL, AAA, VNM, PNJ... were also negotiated with great value.
In addition to AMD, ROS, TNT, TNI falling to the floor from the morning, HNG contributed another face to the floor in the afternoon session.HAG also decreased more than 4% to 8,220 VND.
Regarding positive groups, we can mention the oil and gas group.GAS, PVS kept the reference, PVD and PXS decreased but many other stocks such as PGS, PVB, PVT... increased in price.The steel group also kept good prices with green color at HPG, VGS, NKG, VIS, SMC.Only HSG decreased by 1.2%.
HNX-Index decreased 0.21 points to 97.25 points with volume reaching 74.5 points, equivalent to a value of 735 billion VND.
At the end of the morning session, VN-Index decreased 2 points to 751.46 points with a volume of nearly 110 billion VND and a transaction value of more than 1,980 billion VND.This red color is mainly due to ROS because this stock is still at the floor price.Meanwhile, VN30-Index increased more than 2 points.In this group, DHG excellently increased to the ceiling.Many codes increased well such as KDC, DPM, GMD, HPG, SSI, STB, FPT...
Banking stocks have cooled down, only STB increased 1.5%.Major stocks in the oil and gas industry fell sharply.Some hot stocks like AMD fell to the floor while CTF continued to rise to the ceiling.
On the HNX side, the index also increased by 0.12 points with a volume of more than 44 million units and a transaction value of more than 400 billion VND.On this floor, KLF dropped to the floor, BII increased to the ceiling.CEO and HUT increased well.
The market opened in red when more than 100 codes on HOSE decreased in price, and ROS fell to the floor, causing VN-Index to drop more than 4 points.However, very quickly, buying power poured in, pulling many stocks back up and the number of increasing/decreasing stocks became balanced.Although ROS still dropped to the floor, VN-Index only dropped 1.6 points.
In the real estate and construction groups, many stocks have increased in price quite quickly such as HBC, SCR, CTD, VCG, VGC... In the banking group, most are adjusting, only MBB and STB, especially STB, are still increasing positively.SHB is still hovering around 7,400 VND.
The securities group is somewhat more exciting, but the selling surplus is overwhelming the buying surplus.SSI keeps its green color well.In HCM, CTS is quite struggling and in VND, the sellers are winning.
Some individual codes such as VJC increased 1%, GMD increased 2.2%, FPT increased 0.2%, PNJ increased 0.1%.Some penny stocks hit the ceiling such as FCM, KSH, ATG, VOS, CDO... AMD fell sharply after a series of hot increases.EVG went public today and quickly increased 20% to 14,150 VND.
At 10:00 a.m., VN-Index decreased 2.47 points, volume reached 57.1 million units, equivalent to 936 billion VND.HNX-Index decreased 0.08 points, transaction value reached 200 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: TTF increased to the ceiling again, VN-Index increased thanks to VCB and VIC, liquidity reached 5,000 billion VND
sapo: Stock groups all fell quite sharply, including stocks that increased well in the morning session like SSI.
content:
Vn-Index closed up 1.76 points but still below the 725 mark. Trading volume reached over 214 million units, equivalent to 4,378 billion VND, including 533 billion VND in agreements.Some large transactions belong to NVL (92 billion), TTF (nearly 130 billion).VN-Index increased largely thanks to VCB, VIC and VJC.
HNX-Index increased 0.24 points and traded 54.45 points, equivalent to 622 billion VND.The index increased thanks to ACB and SHB.
TTF closed at the ceiling to over 8,000 VND after information that Tan Lien Phat had sold more than 36 million shares and was no longer a major shareholder.
In the banking group, only CTG and EIB decreased, while VCB, BID, STB, ACB and SHB remained in green.Meanwhile, the stock group all fell quite sharply, including stocks that increased well in the morning session like SSI.Maintaining good performance is the steel group with leading stocks such as HPG, HSG and NKG.In the real estate group, PDR maintained the purple color while VPH retreated sharply to 11,000 VND and DXG only closed at the reference price.
The market ended the morning session with an increase of 0.67 points for the VN-Index and 0.21 points for the HNX-Index.Many stocks have narrowed their green color, causing the index to also narrow its gain.
On HOSE, VCB, VIC, BID, HPG and STB are the stocks that create the green color for the index.Among them, STB ranks first in liquidity with a volume of more than 12 million units.HPG still increased by 1.1% and was strongly net bought by foreign investors.
On the contrary, GAS, BHN, SAB, VNM and CTD are the main factors restraining the increase of VN-Index.VNM also decreased by 200 VND and continued to be net bought by foreign investors with more than 450,000 units.Some stocks that this group is actively buying are HSG, KBC, MSN, NT2... while selling STB, SCR, DXG...
On HNX, prominent stocks are still SHB, ACB, and HKB with large liquidity.PVS is a stock that limits the growth of HNX-Index, like other oil and gas stocks.
Indices fluctuated in a narrow range even though green dominated.Real estate stocks are still the most active group so far.Here, PDR continued to increase to the ceiling, VPH increased sharply and a series of other stocks had significant increases such as DXG, HQC, DIG, NBB, NVL, NLG... Meanwhile, construction industry stocks such as HBC, CTD, VC3, ROS all decreased simultaneously.
Bank stocks are also quite positive.VCB, CTG, BID, SHB, STB all increased, STB is still the code with the strongest increase with 4.1%.Yesterday STB shined with a ceiling increase and huge volume matching.Currently, it is also the code with the largest trading volume on HOSE.On HNX, SHB is increasing 1.7% and matching nearly 7 million units - ranking first on this exchange.ACB temporarily stabilized the reference price and ranked 3rd.
Another big company, Hoa Phat's HPG, after finalizing the right to pay dividends in shares, continued to increase beyond its historical peak, today rising sharply to 32,850 VND and ranking 4th in terms of liquidity.
The stock group is not too bad as most of them are at reference level, only SSI and VND have positively increased in price.
Amid that excitement, oil and gas stocks were once again in the red.Most of the major stocks of this group were in a downward trend in the first quarter of 2017.
Some penny stocks like HKB increased to the ceiling at the beginning of the session but have now cooled down a bit, returning to green price and matching 1.4 million units.
As of 10am, VN-Index increased 1.22 points to 723.6, trading volume reached nearly 53 million units with a value of 1,286 billion VND.HNX-Index increased 0.16 points with a volume of nearly 17 million units, equivalent to 160 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: [Featured stocks of the week]VIC- starting the investment cycle?
sapo: At the end of 2016, Vingroup - Joint Stock Company (VIC - HOSE) achieved revenue of more than 58.5 trillion VND, corresponding to 2.6 billion USD, a growth of 72% compared to 2015. With the leading position, profit after tax increased 133% to 3.5 trillion VND.
content:
It can be said that VIC's short-term fluctuations are "small" compared to a 9-year period of being on the exchange.In September 2007, this stock began to be listed on HOSE with a charter capital of 800 billion VND.Currently, this number has reached more than 26 trillion VND, with capitalization reaching 119 trillion VND.
Last week, VIC increased nearly 3%, which is low compared to the rapid price increase of other real estate stocks in the same industry.The trading volume reached more than 800 thousand units.
The driving demand does not come much from the domestic sector but mostly from foreign investors who spent nearly 49 billion VND to buy more than 1 million shares.
Not to disappoint long-term investors, if they invested in VIC in the past year, they would also achieve a profit rate of more than 35%, much higher than the market average.
It must also be said that although it has traded actively in the short term, the rapid price increase of real estate stocks in the same industry is making short-term investors quite "impatient".
However, long-term technical indicators are fully supporting loyal shareholders.The price line is tending to break the short-term peak and surpass the highest price in more than 9 years of listing.The 20, 50 and 200 day moving averages are all below the current trading range.
In the short term, VIC is receiving attention from cash flow, when the average trading volume in the past week reached 814 thousand units, while the average of the last quarter was only 740 thousand units/session.
Just the beginning of an investment cycle?
Commenting on Vincgroup's impressive business results in 2016, an analyst from HSC Securities Company commented, "The strong growth in business results in 2016 is just the beginning of the results of an investment cycle; revenue will continue to grow stronger in the next 2 years."
VIC's revenue and profit through quarters.
Analysts estimate that the revenue of the real estate segment alone in 2017 could reach nearly 45 trillion VND.In detail, VIC will record large projects such as Times City & Park Hill (6.4 trillion VND) and Central Park (22 trillion VND), Gardenia (10.8 trillion VND), 3.3 trillion VND recorded from commercial townhouses/ground houses in many projects and 2.37 trillion VND recorded from beach villas.
At the same time, 3 new projects may be opened for sale early in 2017 including Skylake, Riverside 2, and Greenbay (Hanoi).With more than 4,800 units, the contract value for these projects is 30 trillion VND and will contribute revenue and profit from 2019.
Besides, shifting investment to the affordable housing segment is probably the appropriate solution because the demand for this segment is currently very high.VIC has an ambitious plan to open for sale 200,000-300,000 affordable apartments with prices from 700 million VND/unit in the next 5 years.
author: According to Mai Huong

title: 2016: Foreign investors net sold more than 7,828 billion VND on HOSE, VIC and VNM were the focus
sapo: This is the second consecutive year VIC leads the net selling value of foreign investors on HOSE, reaching a total of more than 9,767.7 billion VND.
content:
Vietnam's stock market ended 2016 with certain successes.The VN-Index ended the year reaching 664.87 points, an increase of 14.82% compared to the end of 2015. Meanwhile, the HNX-Index increased slightly by 0.2% to 80.12 points.
Total listed market capitalization in 2016 reached more than 1.64 million billion VND (72 billion USD), an increase of 345 trillion VND (26.6%) compared to the end of 2015.
However, contrary to the positive developments of the general market, foreign investors on the listed market traded somewhat negatively, in which foreign investors were very strong net sellers on HOSE but still maintained net buying momentum on HNX.In total, on both HOSE and HNX exchanges, foreign investors net sold more than 6,765.6 billion VND, corresponding to a total net selling volume of more than 136.3 million shares.
On HOSE, foreign investors boosted their net selling to more than 7,828 billion VND, corresponding to a net selling volume of nearly 198.6 million shares. Previously, foreign investors had 3 consecutive years of net buying since 2013.
The two stocks in the top capitalization of the Vietnamese stock market, VIC and VNM, contributed significantly to the net selling of foreign investors on HOSE.Of which, VIC was net sold more than 7,187 billion VND (152.8 million shares).Notably, this is also the second consecutive year that VIC leads the net selling value of foreign investors on HOSE. In 2015, VIC was also net sold more than 2,580 billion VND.However, VIC stock price in 2016 still increased by 25%.
Similar to VIC, VNM in 2016 had a net sale of more than 2,244 billion VND (16.3 million shares), this is also the main reason why VNM stock price tends to go down at the end of the year.However, for the whole of 2016, VNM still had an increase of 22.3%.
Ranked third in net selling value of foreign investors on HOSE is steel industry giant HPG, reaching 892.77 billion VND.However, 2016 can be said to be a 'brilliant' year of success for shareholders who hold this stock.HPG ended 2016 with a 75% increase compared to 2015.
On the contrary, MBB led the net buying value of foreign investors on HOSE, reaching 1,545 billion VND (101.25 million shares).Notably, the majority of foreign investors' purchases of MBB shares were carried out through agreements.Most typically, in the session on October 8, 2016, foreign investors bought more than 40.5 million MBB shares through agreement, equivalent to a value of more than 643.8 billion VND.Thanks to MBB, that session foreign investors had the strongest net buying in over a year.Despite strong net buying by foreign investors, MBB stock price did not have sudden fluctuations, this stock only increased by only 0.7% in 2016. Previously, in 2015 MBB was also the 6th strongest net bought stock by foreign investors on HOSE, reaching more than 644 billion VND.
Following that, CII was also net bought by foreign investors amounting to more than 1,115 billion VND (40 million shares).At the end of 2016, CII had an increase of 37%.
Unlike HOSE, foreign investors in 2016 continued their impressive net buying series on HNX, reaching more than 1,062 billion VND, an increase of 34% compared to the net buying value of 2015, corresponding to a net buying volume of over 62 million shares.Thus, since 2013, foreign investors on HNX have net bought a total of more than 4,028 billion VND.
Foreign investors on HNX had the strongest net purchase of PVS shares, reaching more than 220 billion VND (12.6 million shares).Next is SCR stock, with a net purchase value of more than 146 billion VND.SCR shares were transferred to be listed on HOSE in the last months of 2016. BVS was also net purchased for more than 143.6 billion VND.In the past year, PVS had a price increase of 8%, while BVS had a price increase of 38%.
On the contrary, KLS was the strongest net sold code on HNX, reaching more than 145 billion VND.KLS shares were delisted from July 21, 2016 due to business dissolution.
Next, VNR shares were net sold for more than 119 billion VND.At the end of 2016, VNR shares had a slight increase of 6.5% compared to 2015.
Although on the listed market foreign investors withdrew capital quite strongly, on the OTC market they attracted quite good foreign capital flows through private placement.A typical example is Novaland selling 10% of shares to 18 investors worth 120 million USD.About 70% of investors are overseas financial institutions.At the beginning of this year, Novaland also issued $60 million in convertible bonds to Swiss and Hong Kong investors.
Or in the case of Vietnam Airlines, at the 2016 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, Vietnam Airlines announced that after being approved by the Ministry of Transport, this unit is completing the negotiation of the Share Purchase Agreement (SSA) with the Japanese airline group ANA Holdings to sign at the end of May 2016.Vietnam Airlines sold more than 107 million shares to ANA Holdings for 21,000 VND/share.
author: According to Binh An

title: HSG,VIC, PSI, SAM, PGT, TNT, CTI, API, THW: Information on trading large amounts of stocks
sapo: Information on trading a large number of stocks on HNX/HSX.
content:
Hoa Sen Group Joint Stock Company (HSG): Hoa Sen Investment and Tourism Company Limited registered to buy 12 million shares.Before the transaction, Hoa Sen Tourism owned 40,498,715 shares (20.61%).The transaction is expected to take place from January 3 to February 1, 2017.

title: This is the reason why you should not sell VIC shares just because of Vingroup's "shock" non-profit announcement
sapo: Don't rush to look at the decision to dedicate 100% of Vinmec and Vinschool profits to society and sell shares.After all, shareholders don't lose much.
content:
Late yesterday, Vingroup issued a notice converting the Vinmec and Vinschool systems to a non-profit model, pledging to dedicate 100% of profits to society.Shareholders and investors of Vingroup's VIC shares may think about this point and take actions for today's trading session.However, before making your own buying or selling decisions, investors should read this article.
After all, Vingroup's action is to invest part of the company's profits for the company's future and for the community.To put it more simply, if you are a shareholder of the company and the profit distributed to Vingroup's shareholders is x dong, of which y dong comes from the operations of Vinmec and Vinshool, then without this decision, you would have been given a profit share of x amount of dong, but now it is only divided on (x-y) dong.As a shareholder, when you hear that your rights are being reduced, you may panic and take the wrong action today.Please calm down to consider more carefully.
-First: Vingroup is making profits mainly from real estate and retail (accounting for 78% of total profits), not from Vinmec or Vinschool (contributing only about 3% of profits) although perhaps many people know Vinschool for its students wearing beautiful uniforms and many buses transporting students to school around the city rather than the houses that require a lot of money to buy.To put it more simply, the profits from Vinmec and Vinschool (y) that investors lose their rights to are very small compared to Vingroup's overall profit source.That is not to mention the amount of 4,000 billion invested up to now to build Vinmec and Vinshool plus 5,000 billion VND to invest in building 2 universities, Vinmec Medical University and VinUniversity International University, only accounting for a total of about 7-8% of Vingroup's current total assets.
-Second, what do you think if your child or grandchild wants to apply to study in the Vinschool system but there are no more seats because the demand is many times greater than the supply?Or, your family member is sick and wants to use Vinmec's services but can't afford them?With the act of reinvesting 100% of profits from these two segments, the situation of demand exceeding supply is somewhat narrowed.Sacrificing a small profit for yourself and the community doesn't seem like much of a loss.
-Third, if you are still concerned about the loss of dividends, think that for short-term retail investors, this will not have any effect, the stock price will be adjusted anyway when the business finalizes the right to pay dividends.If there is a disadvantage, we must consider large shareholders who hold strategic shares for a long time.But, large, long-term, strategic shareholders will often accompany the decision to reinvest profits to serve the goal of sustainable development in the future.
-Fourth, in fact, Vingroup is the first listed corporation to bring up the issue of non-profit activities, so many people do not fully understand.Read carefully: Vingroup commits to spend 100% of the profits earned from Vinmec and Vinschool to use for reinvestment to continuously upgrade and develop the system, specifically investing in human resource development, upgrading facilities and equipment, awarding scholarships, sponsoring scientific research activities, technology transfer, strengthening international cooperation and linkages...
That is, use profits to reinvest.This is absolutely not new in the stock market.Many growing businesses have had to accept the trade-off of investors' short-term benefits to invest in the future.Businesses like Vingroup are not few in the market.
