The top 5 stocks with the most net selling in the session also included KBC (16.96 billion VND), PDR (14.08 billion VND), HBC (13.08 billion VND), DPM (7.4 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors net bought 310 thousand shares in today's trading session.However, in terms of value, this was a light net selling session of 7.23 billion VND.Thus, after 19 consecutive sessions of net buying, foreign investors have returned to net selling.
PVS continued to be the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors during the session with 7.37 billion VND.Next in the top net buying are VIT (1.99 billion VND), VND (1.1 billion VND), BVS (0.91 billion VND), CVT (0.78 billion VND).
Closing the trading session, all 5 stocks in the top net buying increased.Among them, VIT and CVT are the most actively traded stocks with increases of 3.2% and 3.3%, respectively.
On the net selling side, NTP topped the list with 11.7 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net sellers also include DBC (4.64 billion VND), AAA (3.43 billion VND), PLC (0.9 billion VND), VNR (0.78 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: VNM, VIC, VCB supported the market, VnIndex increased nearly 8 points
sapo: VNM this morning increased sharply by 4,000 VND to 162,000 VND and this is an important factor driving the market's upward momentum.Besides, Bluechips such as VIC, VCB, MSN, HPG, HSG, FPT... gaining points also helped strengthen the green color.
content:
Oil and gas stocks still maintain green color but the increase is not too strong and cash flow mainly focuses on a few codes such as PVS, PVD, GAS.Meanwhile, sugar stocks had a quite positive trading session with a series of gainers such as LSS, KTS, SLS, BHS...
Bluechips group VNM, VIC, GAS, FPT, BVH, HSG, MSN... had a pretty good trading session, especially VNM increased by 4,000 VND, VIC increased by 800 VND, VCB increased by 1,000 VND, which had a positive impact on the general trend of the market.
Oil and gas stocks still maintain green color but the increase is not too strong and cash flow mainly focuses on a few codes such as PVS, PVD, GAS.Meanwhile, sugar stocks had a quite positive trading session with a series of gainers such as LSS, KTS, SLS, BHS... Real estate and construction groups also had many strong gainers such as KBC, LGC, CTD, HBC...
In today's session, cash flow tends to diversify, focusing on basic stocks such as AAA, BMP, CVT, DBC, LAS, LIX...
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 7.88 points (1.25%) to 637.35 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.68 points (0.84%) to 81.67 points.
Towards the end of the morning, market transactions became more active with the increasing momentum expanding.VnIndex increased 7.45 points (1.18%) to 636.91 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.39 points (0.49%) to 81.39 points.Market liquidity improved significantly with 74 million units, equivalent to a value of 1,300 billion VND.
VNM this morning increased sharply by 4,000 VND to 162,000 VND and this is an important factor driving the market's upward momentum.Besides, Bluechips such as VIC, VCB, MSN, HPG, HSG, FPT... gaining points also helped strengthen the green color.
In this morning's session, stocks that benefited from the recovery of commodity and fuel prices such as oil and gas (PVS, PVD, GAS, PVC...), sugar cane (LSS, SLS, BHS...) all increased quite positively.
In addition, stocks with fundamental properties and positive business results also attract quite good cash flow such as AAA, VIT, BMP, CSV, TYA, CVT, etc.
After a period of deep correction, the market is showing positive signs in recent trading sessions.
Last night, WTI oil price increased by 1.22 USD (2.9%) to 43.02 USD/barrel, the highest level in nearly 2 weeks and this factor helped the group of oil and gas stocks PVD, PVS, GAS, PXS, PVC... become quite exciting.
Besides, the positivity of Bluechips, especially VNM (up 2,000 VND) and VIC (up 400 VND) has helped the green color in the market remain stable.
The positivity spread throughout the market, helping many industry groups such as securities, real estate, construction, sugar... increase points.The duo HAG and HNG also increased to the limit and currently have no surplus for sale.
At 10:30 a.m., VnIndex increased 4.05 points (0.64%) to 633.51 points;HNX-Index increased 0.28 points (0.34%) to 81.27 points.However, market liquidity is still quite low with 47 million units matched, equivalent to a value of 762 billion VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors continued to "consolidate" VNM, selling strongly VIC and MSN in the weekend session
sapo: On HNX, foreign investors had the 17th consecutive net buying session with 1.58 million shares, equivalent to 26.88 billion VND.
content:
The weekend trading session ended with red covering the two trading floors.Specifically, VnIndex dropped sharply by 4.55 points (0.72%) to 627.39 points due to pressure from Bluechips such as MSN and VIC.Meanwhile, Hnx-Index only slightly decreased 0.08 points (0.1%) to 81.07 points.
Foreign investors' trading was quite mixed as they were net sellers on the HSX but still net buyers on the HNX.Overall, the net buying value of foreign investors in today's trading session reached nearly 12 billion VND.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a net selling session of 1.83 million shares, equivalent to a value of 15.15 billion VND.
VNM continued to be bought quite strongly by foreign investors in today's trading session with 46.72 billion VND.Closing the session, VNM increased by 2,000 VND to 158,000 VND.
Other stocks in the top net buying also include HSG (8.7 billion VND), PVT (5.67 billion VND), VFG (4.33 billion VND), CTI (3.53 billion VND).
On the net selling side, VIC, MSN, VCB are the 3 stocks that foreign investors net sold the most with a value of 33.8 billion VND respectively;18.91 billion VND and 12.44 billion VND.Closing the trading session, all three stocks dropped quite sharply and this had a significant impact on the general market.
Among the top net sellers of foreign investors, HPG was the most actively traded stock with an increase of 500 VND (1.2%) to 43,100 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors had the 17th consecutive net buying session with 1.58 million shares, equivalent to 26.88 billion VND.
The stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX is still PVS with 14.85 billion VND.Closing the session, PVS increased sharply by 700 VND (4%) to 18,200 VND.Next in the top net buying are VCS (2.06 billion VND), NET (2.04 billion VND), VND (1.6 billion VND), VNR (1.5 billion VND).
On the contrary, AAA was the stock that foreign investors net sold the most with 3.99 billion VND.Other stocks on HNX were net sold by foreign investors insignificantly and no code was sold for more than 200 million VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC, MSN dragged VnIndex down in the weekend session
sapo: The efforts of VNM, FPT, HPG, HSG, BVH... were not enough to help the green color return to the market when VIC and MSN corrected too deeply.
content:
The afternoon trading session was quite gloomy when selling pressure increased sharply, causing the market to fall deeply.However, increased bottom-fishing demand has helped the market narrow its downward momentum.
Closing the session, VnIndex decreased 4.55 points (0.72%) to 627.39 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.08 points (0.1%) to 81.07 points.Market liquidity reached 165 million units, equivalent to a value of 2,526 billion VND.
VIC and MSN continued to fall deeply this afternoon and this is the main reason why the market corrected.Meanwhile, VNM, FPT, HPG, HSG, BVH... gaining points is not enough to help the green color return to the market.
Cash flow is quite differentiated and focuses mainly on a few stocks such as VCS, SVC, PAC, NTP, MWG, EVE, DBC, BMP...Meanwhile, speculative stock groups such as stocks, real estate, construction... traded quite gloomy and were mostly in the red at the end of the session.
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex decreased 3.53 points (0.56%) to 628.41 points;Hnx-Index decreased 0.33 points (0.41%) to 80.82 points.Market liquidity is at an average level with 84 million units, equivalent to a value of 1,212 billion VND.
Bluechips such as VIC, MSN, VCB continued to be sold strongly this morning.However, stocks such as HSG, VNM, STB, and GAS regained their green color, helping the market become more stable.
Also in this morning's session, steel was the group of stocks with the most active transactions with many stocks gaining points such as HPG, HSG, NKG, TIS...In addition, some stocks such as MWG, CVT, DBC, BMP, CAV... also attract quite good cash flow.
However, marketable stocks such as oil and gas, real estate, construction, stocks... in general are still trading quite gloomily and are mostly in the red.
The weekend trading session opened in red, covering 2 indexes.Bluechips stocks were under strong correction pressure, especially VIC and MSN, which pulled the market down deeply.
At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex decreased 6.35 points (1%) to 625.59 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.63 points (0.77%) to 80.52 points.
Marketable stocks such as securities (SSI, HCM, VND, SHS...), real estate - construction (VCG, HUT, SJS, CTD, KBC, HBC...) were also under strong selling pressure and simultaneously decreased.
Meanwhile, TTF continued to have its 14th consecutive floor price drop.Currently, the selling surplus on TTF has reached nearly 10 million units.Similarly, DRH also fell to the floor with a "white buyer" situation.
On Upcom, the pair of stocks VEF and VNB traded quite actively and increased quite strongly.In particular, VEF increased to the ceiling to 56,100 VND and currently has no surplus.
author: Minh Anh

title: VN-Index officially exceeded 640 points, exploding GAS and VIC
sapo: Standing out today is HPG with an increase of 200 VND to 39,800 VND/share and leading the trading volume on HOSE with more than 5.65 million units.
content:
Ending on July 1, VN-Index officially surpassed 640 points.HNX-Index increased 0.43 points to 85.15 points.
The boom at GAS and VIC created the main inspiration for the afternoon trading session.VIC continued to rise to historic prices while GAS sometimes increased to the ceiling of 66,500 VND.However, at the end of the session, increased supply caused the index to only increase by more than 8 points.
Not only GAS, stocks in the oil and gas group on the market are also green.In the banking group, VCB increased by 200 VND along with CTG and MBB.
Standing out today is HPG with an increase of 200 VND to 39,800 VND/share and leading the trading volume on HOSE with more than 5.65 million units.
As soon as the afternoon session started, the market jumped up.After 30 minutes of trading, under the pull of GAS and VIC, VN-Index jumped more than 11 points, surpassing 640 points as easily as a joke.HOSE liquidity is over 2,000 billion VND, of which 245 billion is negotiable.
VIC has increased its price to 51,000 VND - the highest level in history (according to adjusted price).
Near 1:45 p.m., VN-Index sagged and only increased by more than 9 points.
The indexes continued to increase quickly and strongly throughout the morning trading session.At one point, the VN-Index increased more than 6 points, but at the end of the session, the index only increased 5.48 points to 637.74.HNX-Index also reversed from red to green, increasing 0.1 point to 84.82.
HPG has risen to the top of the market with a matching volume of more than 3.3 million units and an increase of 600 VND.HSG is no less competitive, the volume exceeded 2 million units, an increase of 800 VND.
According to the assessment of VCBS Securities Company, the market's increase in the last sessions of June can be partly explained when the Funds closed their portfolio NAV.Meanwhile, considering short-term factors, stocks bought at the bottom in last Friday's session also had significant profits.Therefore, profit-taking pressure may exist in the coming sessions, especially in the context that the index is approaching the 640 point area.
However, opening the first trading session of July, the indexes maintained a positive green color and the cash flow into the market was somewhat larger than at the same time yesterday.On HOSE, VNM, VIC and GAS all increased points, providing solid motivation for VN-Index.The group of large stocks in the oil and gas industry such as GAS, PVD, PGS, PXS... all increased very well.Meanwhile, like yesterday, banking stocks blocked the index's rise when BID, VCB and STB all dropped.
The two giants of the steel industry, HPG and HSG, continue to conquer new peaks and are in the top of attracting money on this exchange.The codes with good liquidity that are increasing the most on HOSE are KSB, RDP (ceiling increase), EVE, MWG, VNM...
On HNX, VCG, VCS and PHP were green but the index was pulled down to red, also because the major banking code ACB dropped 300 VND to 18,700 VND, OCH dropped to the floor price of 7,500 VND.Here, the "non-peak stock" AAA is one of the stocks with the strongest increase on the exchange.In terms of matched volume, VCG is still the champion.
Near 10am, VN-Index increased 3.46 points to 635.7 points while HNX-idnex decreased slightly by 0.07 points.The total value of the two floors reached about 800 billion VND.
author: Tu Linh

title: VNM, VIC "hold" the green color for VnIndex
sapo: Although the market fluctuations are quite strong, the cash flow in today's session continues to focus on basic stocks, anticipating Q2 business results such as AAA, CVT, DGC, HCC, ITD, RDP, VCS, SKG...
content:
The afternoon session ended with mixed movements of the two indexes.Specifically, while VnIndex increased by 2.14 points (0.34%) to 632.26 points, Hnx-Index decreased slightly by 0.02 points (0.02%) to 84.72 points.
Liquidity in the entire market reached 167 million units, corresponding to a transaction value of nearly 3,000 billion VND.
In this afternoon's session, selling pressure increased significantly, causing many Bluechips to decline such as MSN, HSG, BVH... However, there were still some positive points such as VIC increasing by 1,400 VND;VNM increased by 2,000 VND... Notably, foreign investors returned to net buy nearly 230 thousand VNM shares in today's session.
Sugar stocks were under strong profit-taking pressure and only KTS and LSS had notable increases.Meanwhile, BHS and SLS both retreated to the reference mark.
Although the market fluctuations are quite strong, the cash flow in today's session continues to focus on basic stocks, anticipating Q2 business results such as AAA, CVT, DGC, HCC, ITD, RDP, VCS, SKG...
Although the green color still maintained, trading slowed down towards the end of the morning when demand could no longer maintain its exciting momentum.This is reflected in the decline in liquidity, reaching only 86 million units, equivalent to 1,713 billion VND.
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 3.89 points (0.62%) to 634.01 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.12 points (0.14%) to 84.86 points, a significant decrease compared to the mid-morning session when VnIndex increased 7 points.
This morning, VIC received quite a lot of attention when at one point it increased to the ceiling to 51,000 VND, but under general adjustment pressure, VIC is currently only increasing by 1,600 VND to 49,600 VND.In addition to VIC, Bluechips such as VNM, HPG, HSG, FPT, GAS also traded quite well, helping the green color to be maintained.
Banking stocks BID, CTG, ACB, MBB... traded not really actively this morning and this made the market no longer as excited as at the beginning of the session.
Sugar stocks such as BHS, KTS, LSS, SLS still maintained good demand and increased quite strongly this morning.Sugar cane is also the "hottest" stock group recently.
The prosperity of the world financial market last night helped Vietnam's stock market open the June 30 trading session with green covering the two trading floors.At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex increased 5.03 points (0.8%) to 635.15 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.34 points (0.4%) to 85.08 points.
Market liquidity improved significantly with 45 million units, equivalent to a transaction value of 740 billion VND.
VIC hit the ceiling price.Last June 27 was the trading day without the right to receive stock dividends at the ratio of 1000:110 for this enterprise.
The strong recovery of world oil prices last night also helped oil and gas stocks GAS, PVD, PVC, PVB... trade quite actively this morning.
However, the trading focus was on the sugar cane group with many stocks increasing strongly such as KTS, LSS, SLS, BHS...
In addition to stocks that benefit directly from the raw material market, cash flow is also heading to basic stocks to anticipate Q2 business results such as AAA, SKG, VCS, VKC, VNC, CVT, BMP....
Besides, Bluechips stocks such as VNM, FPT, HSG, FPT... increased sharply right from the beginning of the trading session, helping the market's upward momentum to be firmly consolidated.
author: Minh Anh

title: Week 9-13/5: Foreign investors sold strongly VIC, HPG, VnIndex struggled around 610 points
sapo: HPG and VIC were the two stocks that were sold the most by foreign investors last week with values ​​of 302 billion VND and 205.91 billion VND respectively.These transactions mainly took place through agreement on the sessions of May 9 and May 11.
content:
After the previous week's strong breakthrough, the market last week's trading was quite tense in the absence of supporting information as well as leading stocks.Bluechips groups such as VIC and VNM have a week off, giving "land to perform" for banking stocks such as VCB, BID, STB, SHB, ACB.Meanwhile, other stock groups in general traded quite gloomy and did not have many outstanding faces.
Foreign investors last week net sold 168 billion VND in the entire market.In particular, they were net buyers on HNX and net sellers on HSX.However, the net selling value mainly comes from put-through transactions.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 232.47 billion VND last week, mainly focusing on the two trading sessions of May 9 and May 11 through agreement.If these agreement transactions are not included, foreign investors still have a net buying week on the HSX.
Without a leading stock line, VnIndex struggled quite in the 600-610 point range.At the end of the trading week, VnIndex stopped at 610.82 points, up 0.7% compared to the previous week.
Topping the list of net foreign purchases last week was GAS with 69.13 billion VND.Next on the net buying list are MSN (53.62 billion VND), CII (42.42 billion VND), CTG (38.51 billion VND), PVT (33 billion VND).
On the contrary, HPG and VIC were the two stocks that were sold the most with values ​​of VND 302 billion and VND 205.91 billion, respectively.These transactions mainly took place through agreement on the sessions of May 9 and May 11.
The top 5 stocks with the strongest net selling in the session also included KSB (64.58 billion VND), SSI (27.78 billion VND), KSA (16.21 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors net bought in all 5 trading sessions last week with a total value of 64.7 billion VND and the buying momentum tended to strengthen towards the end of the week.
With the support of foreign investors, HNX-Index broke through the threshold of 81 points and ended the week at 81.27 points, equivalent to an increase of 1.12% compared to the previous trading week.
PVS is the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors on HNX with 34 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net buying also include PLC (11 billion VND), NET (7.31 billion VND), VCS (5.12 billion VND), VGS (4.55 billion VND).
On the net selling side, KLS topped the list with 3.23 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are VCG (1.94 billion VND), TNG (1.56 billion VND), PGS (1.06 billion VND), LDP (0.99 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: VNM -VIC- GAS: "criminals" caused VN-Index to drop nearly 12 points on April 19
sapo: VNM was the stock that had the most negative impact on VnIndex in today's trading session when it decreased by 4,000 VND (2.8%) to 139,000 VND.
content:
The trading session on April 19, 2016 was not really positive when VnIndex decreased 11.58 points (2%) and fell to 568.28 points.HSX market capitalization after today's trading session decreased by more than 23 trillion VND, equivalent to 1 billion USD.
Thus, after many times missing opportunities to surpass the 580 point threshold, investors have lost patience with the market and accelerated "exit sales" activities in many stocks.
In today's trading session, VNM, VIC, GAS, BID and BVH are the stocks with the most negative impact on the market's decline.These 5 stocks alone caused VnIndex to decrease by 7.74 points, equivalent to 1.34%.
VNM: VnIndex decreased 2.4 points (0.41%)
VNM was the stock that had the most negative impact on VnIndex in today's trading session when it decreased by 4,000 VND (2.8%) to 139,000 VND.At this price, Vinamilk's market capitalization is only 167 trillion VND.
VNM's decrease caused VnIndex to lose 2.4 points, equivalent to 0.41% in today's trading session.
VIC: VnIndex decreased 2.23 points (0.39%)
After a period of quite positive increases, VIC dropped sharply by 2,300 VND (4.4%) and fell to 49,700 VND.VinGroup's market capitalization is currently 96,410 billion VND.
VIC's decline also caused VnIndex to lose 2.23 points in today's session, equivalent to a decrease of 0.39%.
GAS: VnIndex decreased 1.19 points (0.33%)
The negative impacts of world oil prices have affected oil and gas stocks, especially GAS.Closing the session, GAS decreased 2,000 VND (4.3%) to 44,300 VND and this stock caused VnIndex to decrease 1.19 points, equivalent to 0.33%.
GAS's market capitalization currently reaches VND 84,761 billion.
BID: VnIndex decreased 0.68 points (0.12%)
BID's recent decline has shown no signs of stopping.At the end of the trading session, BID decreased by 400 VND (2.5%) to 15,600 VND.At this price, BIDV's capitalization reaches VND 53,332 billion.
In today's trading session, BID took away 0.68 points from VnIndex, equivalent to 0.68%.
BVH: VnIndex decreased 0.51 points (0.09%)
Closing the session, BVH decreased by 1,500 VND (2.9%) to 51,000 VND and this was one of the important reasons why VnIndex dropped sharply.Specifically, BVH's decrease caused the VnIndex to decrease by 0.51 points, equivalent to 0.09%.
Bao Viet's market capitalization decreased by 1,021 billion VND after today's trading session to 34,704 billion VND.
author: Tuan Ngoc

title: Week 11-15/4: VnIndex continuously "stumbled" before the 580 point threshold, foreign investors net sold VND 865 billion
sapo: Last week, there were many times when VnIndex was close to the 585 point threshold, but adjustments at Bluechips such as VNM and VIC always caused VnIndex to close below the 580 point threshold.
content:
The market last week had many opportunities to break out of strong resistance areas.However, the actual developments were quite disappointing as both indexes almost only moved sideways despite positive increases during the session.
Last week, foreign investors had a record net sale of more than 1,000 billion VND and net selling pressure was still maintained in the past trading week with 264 billion VND.However, it should be noted that the net selling volume was mainly sudden put-through transactions of VIC and MSN.If these transactions are excluded, foreign investors are still showing a strong net buying trend.
On the HSX, except for the April 12 session when foreign investors net sold 763 billion VND (mainly through VIC agreements), they net bought in the remaining 4 trading sessions.Overall, foreign investors net sold a total of 362 billion VND on the HSX in the past trading week.
In the first trading session of the week, VnIndex jumped 7 points to 579.27 points.However, the following trading sessions mainly moved sideways around the 580 point threshold.
Last week, there were many times when VnIndex was close to the 585 point threshold, but adjustments at Bluechips such as VNM and VIC always caused VnIndex to close below the 580 point threshold.
CII was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors last week with 157.55 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net buying also include SSI (139.96 billion VND), HPG (117.81 billion VND), GAS (74.34 billion VND), PVD (52.71 billion VND).
After consecutive periods of net buying, foreign ownership at SSI is now up to 54.54%.
On the net selling side, VIC topped the list with 865.22 billion VND (mainly negotiated on April 12).Other stocks in the top net sellers also include HSG (60.34 billion VND), VNS (36.06 billion VND), CTD (34.6 billion VND), NT2 (30.92 billion VND).
In particular, CTD's epidemic was not really positive when it decreased by 5.7% compared to the previous week to 167,000 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors were net buyers in all 5 trading sessions last week with a total value of 98.81 billion VND.In particular, the weekend trading session saw the strongest buying by foreign investors with nearly 42 billion VND.
Like VnIndex, Hnx-Index traded around the 80 point threshold and ended the week at 80.26 points, almost unchanged compared to the previous week.
Topping the list of foreign net buyers on HNX last week was PVS with 68.69 billion VND.The top 5 stocks with the most net purchases also include SHS (11.22 billion VND), SHB (9.18 billion VND), BVS (8.99 billion VND), IVS (4.47 billion VND).
On the contrary, DBC was the most sold stock with 12.12 billion VND.The next stocks in the top net sellers of foreign investors are KLS (3.95 billion VND), NDN (2.47 billion VND), PGS (1.8 billion VND), PTI (1.12 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC turned down, VnIndex once again "stumbled" before the 580 point threshold
sapo: In recent trading sessions, the fact that VnIndex exceeded 580 points but closed below this psychological resistance level is a quite familiar image.
content:
A familiar scenario in recent sessions was repeated when the trading market boomed for most of the trading time but was suddenly adjusted at the last minute.
Specifically, the VnIndex maintained its green color throughout today's trading session and at one point the index increased nearly 7 points thanks to excitement from VNM and VIC.However, the pressure to correct at the end of the session caused VNM to only increase by 1,000 VND, VIC even dropped, pulling VnIndex to narrow its upward momentum.
After news of pre-tax profit for the first quarter of more than 2,300 billion VND, up 61% over the same period, VCB also traded more actively.However, the general adjustment pressure from the market caused VCB to only increase slightly by 200 VND.
The group of steel stocks, after positive trading sessions, has slowed down and many stocks have turned down, such as TLH, TIS, VGS, POM...
Closing the session, VnIndex increased slightly by 0.37 points (0.06%) to 579.86 points, while Hnx-Index decreased slightly by 0.02 points (0.02%) to 80.26 points.Market liquidity reached 180 million units, equivalent to a value of 2,707 billion VND.
The morning trading scenario is quite similar to what happened in recent sessions when VNM and VIC played a role in bringing VnIndex above the 580 point threshold.However, this is still not enough to attract strong cash flow into the market and there is still a certain amount of caution.
There were no groups of stocks with strong increases. Instead, cash flow tended to go to a few separate stocks such as TTF, DMC, SBT and some small and medium-cap stocks such as ATA, KMR, KVC, VIS, VIP...
Pausing the morning trading session, VnIndex increased 3.6 points (0.62%) to 583.09 points, HNX-Index increased 0.2 points (0.25%) to 80.49 points.Market liquidity reached 85 million units, corresponding to a transaction value of 1,251 billion VND.
The positivity of Bluechips stocks, especially VNM, helped the market open the weekend trading session in the green with a gain.At 9:55 a.m., VnIndex increased 2.2 points (0.38%) to 581.69 points, Hnx-Index increased 0.29 points (0.36%) to 80.57 points.
In recent trading sessions, the fact that VnIndex exceeded 580 points but closed below this psychological resistance level is a quite familiar image.
"Hot" stock groups such as steel, rubber, real estate... traded quite quietly in the first minutes of the session and the codes mainly fluctuated around the reference threshold.
Meanwhile, pharmaceutical stocks traded somewhat positively with a series of stocks increasing strongly such as DHG, DMP, IMP, DCL, DBT....
SKG, after news of a 50% dividend payout, plans to increase profits by 24% and continues to receive a lot of attention and is currently increasing by 2,000 VND to 123,000 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session April 12: Foreign investors net sold more than 16 million VIC shares, continued to net buy on HNX
sapo: Foreign investors had a strong net selling session with more than 750 billion VND in the entire market.However, the majority of net sales were carried out through put-through transactions.
content:
Despite many efforts, the cash flow in today's trading session is not strong enough to help VnIndex overcome the resistance level of 580 points.At the close of the session, VnIndex only increased slightly by 0.57 points (0.1%) to 579.84 points;Meanwhile, Hnx-Index decreased slightly by 0.12 points (0.15%) to 80.54 points.
Foreign investors had a strong net selling session with more than 750 billion VND in the entire market.However, the majority of net sales were carried out through put-through transactions.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a strong net selling session with 14.63 million shares, equivalent to a value of 763.33 billion VND.
CII and HPG continued to be the two stocks with the strongest net buying by foreign investors in today's trading session with 37.65 billion VND and 36.38 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net buying also include PVD (24.63 billion VND), GAS (19.11 billion VND), SSI (17.99 billion VND).
At the end of the trading session, except for SSI, which decreased slightly by 100 VND, the remaining 4 stocks in the top net bought all increased.
In contrast, VIC was the stock with the strongest net sale by foreign investors with 16.6 million shares, equivalent to a value of 830 billion VND and transactions were mainly carried out via agreement.If not taking into account the sudden net selling at VIC, foreign investors were still net buyers in today's trading session.
In recent sessions, foreign investors have continuously sold VIC agreements but stock trading has been quite active and in today's session, the stock increased by 1,500 VND, equivalent to 3% to 52,000 VND.
The top 5 stocks with the most net selling in the session also included NT2 (17.88 billion VND), HSG (15.62 billion VND), HAG (12.17 billion VND), VNS (11.81 billion VND).In particular, negative information caused HAG to fall to the floor to 6,900 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors had the 10th consecutive net buying session with 1.16 million shares, equivalent to a value of 11.27 billion VND.
PVS continued to be the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors in today's trading session with 7.9 billion VND.Next on the net buying list are SHB (3.52 billion VND), BVS (1.84 billion VND), VGS (1.39 billion VND), IVS (1.35 billion VND).
Closing the session, VGS dropped quite sharply by 5.8% to 9,800 VND after the previous period of hot increase.
On the contrary, the top 3 positions in the net selling list are DBC (1.68 billion VND), KLS (1.34 billion VND), NTP (0.81 billion VND) with no change compared to the previous trading session.Other stocks such as VNR, NET... were net sold with negligible value.
author: Minh Anh

title: Week 4-8/4: VIC deal surge, foreign investors net sold more than 1,000 billion VND across the market
sapo: Last week, the net selling value of foreign investors in the entire market reached over 1,000 billion VND.However, if we remove transactions at VIC and MSN, foreign investors still had a fairly positive net buying week.
content:
The sharp decline of the stock market in the previous trading week has attracted "bottom-fishing" cash flow back to the market.As a result, both indexes had a strong breakthrough last week, in which VnIndex successfully surpassed the threshold of 570 points.
Information about room expansion activities continued to be a catalyst last week, helping stocks such as VNM, BMP, and KMR have a strong week of increases.
After a period of consecutive net buying, foreign investors net sold quite strongly, up to 1,029 billion VND in the last trading week.However, most of the net selling value lies in VIC, MSN and the transaction is carried out via agreement.If this transaction is excluded, foreign investors continue to have a net buying week.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a record net selling week, up to 1,072 billion VND and focused mainly on the two sessions of April 5 and April 6 with sudden transactions at VIC.
In the last trading session of the week, the net selling value was still quite strong with 165 billion VND and this time it was an agreement transaction at MSN.
After gloomy trading sessions last week, VnIndex broke out quite strongly and ended the week at 572.34 points, corresponding to an increase of 2.5% compared to the previous week.Among them, VNM is the stock that has the greatest influence on the index's upward momentum.
SSI was the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors last week with 115.55 billion VND.Next in the list of net foreign purchases are HPG (65.41 billion VND), MBB (31.7 billion VND), CII (29.32 billion VND), CTG (24.96 billion VND).
In particular, HPG had a quite positive trading week with an increase of 6.2% to 30,800 VND.
On the contrary, VIC and MSN were net sold quite strongly by foreign investors with 1,143 billion VND and 245 billion VND.Most of these transactions are carried out through agreements.
On HNX, not affected by sudden put-through transactions, foreign investors were net buyers in all 5 trading sessions with a total value of 42.75 billion VND.However, the net buying value of foreign investors tends to decrease towards the end of the trading week.
Similar to VnIndex, Hnx-Index also had a positive trading week with consecutive gaining sessions.At the end of the week, the HNX-Index stopped at 80.24 points, corresponding to an increase of 2.26% compared to the previous week.
The stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors last week on the Hanoi floor was PVS with 22 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net buying also include SCR (21.25 billion VND), IVS (8.7 billion VND), VND (7.07 billion VND), SHN (6.29 billion VND).
On the net selling side, NET topped the list with 29.48 billion VND.However, NET's transactions last week were extremely positive with an increase of 16% to 50,000 VND.
The top 5 stocks with the strongest net selling by foreign investors last week also included NTP (3.41 billion VND), LAS (1.67 billion VND), NDN (1.34 billion VND), VCS (0.9 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: Stop "discharging" VIC, foreign investors net bought more than 100 billion VND in the April 7 session
sapo: SSI continued to be bought quite strongly by foreign investors in today's trading session with 28.75 billion VND.Currently, foreign ownership at SSI has reached nearly 53%.
content:
Today's trading session was quite positive with the green color continuing to cover the entire market.Among them, the notable highlight is that VnIndex exceeded the threshold of 570 points thanks to the help of VNM and GAS.Similar developments, Hnx-Index also increased 0.38 points (0.48%) to 79.7 points.
The market's recent increase is also supported by foreign investors as they continuously buy net.There are no more sudden deals at VIC like the previous two sessions, foreign investors have net bought more than 113 billion VND across the market in today's trading session.
On the HSX, foreign investors returned to net buying 5.44 million shares, equivalent to 109.28 billion VND after 2 previous strong net selling sessions.
SSI continued to be bought quite strongly by foreign investors in today's trading session with 28.75 billion VND.Currently, foreign ownership at SSI has reached nearly 53%.
Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include CII (20.99 billion VND), HPG (18.42 billion VND), HAH (9.39 billion VND), CTG (9.03 billion VND).Among them, CII is the most actively traded stock with an increase of 5.4% to 25,300 VND.
On the net selling side, NT2 topped the list with 10.65 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net sellers also include HSG (10.2 billion VND), VCB (7.2 billion VND), DPM (4.69 billion VND), VNS (3.93 billion VND).
On HNX, foreign investors had the 7th consecutive net buying session with 1.4 million shares, equivalent to a value of 4.14 billion VND.
SCR topped the net buying list in today's trading session with 5.57 billion VND.The top 5 stocks with the most net purchases in the session also included PVS (3.97 billion VND), IVS (2.82 billion VND), VND (2.25 billion VND), SHB (1.4 billion VND).
On the other hand, NET was the strongest net sold stock with 15.09 billion VND.However, this stock had a pretty good trading session when it increased to the ceiling price of 47,300 VND.
Other stocks in the top net sellers of foreign investors also include DBC (1.26 billion VND), VKC (0.58 billion VND), NDN (0.33 billion VND), BCC (0.19 billion VND).Among them, VKC was the stock with the most disappointing trading when it dropped sharply by 4.7% to 14,100 VND.
author: Minh Anh

title: Foreign investors net sold more than 1,000 billion VND of VIC after only 2 trading sessions
sapo: On the HSX, foreign investors net sold nearly 6 million shares with a value of 443.32 billion VND in today's trading session and most of the net selling focused on VIC with 443 billion VND.
content:
Continuing the recovery momentum in the previous session, the market had a strong increase session with green covering the 2 trading floors.Of which, VnIndex increased 7.47 points (1.33%) to 567.79 points, HNX-Index increased 0.43 points (0.54%) to 79.32 points.
Like the previous session, the market increased but foreign investors had a strong net selling session of nearly 440 billion VND and this net selling force was still concentrated in VIC.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold nearly 6 million shares with a value of 443.32 billion VND in today's trading session.However, like the previous trading session, the net selling value was mainly concentrated in VIC and if not counting this sudden transaction, foreign investors still had a net buying session.
SSI is still the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors today with 25.85 billion VND.The top 5 stocks with the most net purchases in the session also included HPG (21.58 billion VND), BID (9.65 billion VND), CII (7.48 billion VND), MBB (7.28 billion VND).
Among them, HPG is the most actively traded stock with an increase of 3.1% to VND 30,200.
On the contrary, VIC continued to be strongly net sold by foreign investors with 10.88 million shares, equivalent to a value of 511.33 billion VND and the transaction was carried out via agreement method.
In the last 2 trading sessions, foreign investors net sold a total of more than 24 million VIC shares with a value of 1,143 billion VND.
Ranked 2nd in the net selling list is CTD with 11.5 billion VND.Closing the session, CTD decreased 1.1% to 178,000 VND and this was the stock's 5th consecutive adjustment session.
Other stocks in the top net sellers include VCB (9.99 billion VND), HSG (6.76 billion VND), SKG (5.48 billion VND) and all three of these stocks increased quite strongly.In particular, SKG increased quite strongly by 4.4% to 118,000 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors had the 6th consecutive net buying session with 1.5 million shares, equivalent to a value of 4.83 billion VND.
PVS is the stock that foreign investors bought the most on HNX today with 12.5 billion VND.Closing the session, PVS increased 2.6% to 15,600 VND.
Other stocks in the top net purchases of foreign investors include SCR (6.86 billion VND), VND (1.86 billion VND), IVS (1.71 billion VND), SHB (1.02 billion VND).
On the net selling side, NET topped the list with 18.57 billion VND.Next in the top net sellers are DBC (2.04 billion VND), DIH (0.54 billion VND), NDN (0.45 billion VND), AAA (0.21 billion VND).
author: Minh Anh

title: Session 4/5: "Discharging goods" VIC, foreign investors net sold 600 billion VND across the market
sapo: If not counting the sudden agreement transaction at VIC, foreign investors continued to have a net buying session.
content:
After a series of gloomy trading sessions recently, cash flow has returned, helping the two indexes flood with green.Closing the session, VnIndex increased 4.5 points (0.81%) to 560.32 points;HNX-Index increased 0.4 points (0.51%) to 78.89 points.
Although trading was positive, foreign investors had a strong net sale of nearly 600 billion VND in today's session.However, the net selling volume was mainly concentrated at VIC through agreement transactions and if this factor was not taken into account, foreign investors would still have net buying sessions on both exchanges.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold quite strongly nearly 11 million shares, equivalent to 611.3 billion VND and this is also a record net selling session in more than a year.
SSI continued to be a strong net buyer in today's trading session with 15.15 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net buying also include MBB (7.72 billion VND), KBC (5.88 billion VND), GAS (4.39 billion VND), FLC (3.8 billion VND).
Closing the trading session, all 5 stocks in the top net buying increased.In particular, FLC increased quite strongly by 3.2% to 6,500 VND.
On the net selling side, VIC topped the list with 13.27 million shares, equivalent to a value of 631.51 billion VND and transactions were mainly carried out via agreement method.If not counting this sudden number of agreements, foreign investors would have had a net buying session on the HSX.
The top 5 stocks with the most net selling in the session also included VCB (8.54 billion VND), HVG (7.04 billion VND), CTD (6.69 billion VND), PAN (5.82 billion VND).
In particular, except for CTD, which decreased by 1.6% to 180,000 VND, the remaining 4 stocks all closed in green with an increase.
On HNX, foreign investors had the 5th consecutive net buying session with 845 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 11.38 billion VND.
SHN is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in today's trading session with 2.97 billion VND.Next in the top net buying of foreign investors are VND (2.69 billion VND), SCR (1.79 billion VND), PVS (1.56 billion VND), DBC (0.85 billion VND).
On the contrary, foreign treasuries did not net sell too much shares on HNX today.NDN topped the net selling list with only 510 million VND, other stocks were net sold insignificantly.
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC, MSN dragged down VNM's efforts, VnIndex encountered difficulties before the 580 point threshold
sapo: While the natural rubber line has cooled down with the red color in most stocks, HNG alone - after unfavorable information announced yesterday, has increased to the ceiling.
content:
After the exciting minutes at the end of the morning session and the beginning of the afternoon session thanks to the information that some businesses will open room restrictions such as VNM and TNG, the market quickly came under pressure to correct when VnIndex approached the resistance area of ​​580 points.
VNM continued to maintain its strong upward momentum in the afternoon with an increase of 5,000 VND to 136,000 VND.However, some Bluechips such as VIC, MSN, GAS... dropped, pulling back the market's upward momentum.
Textile and garment stocks TCM, TNG, EVE... had a pretty good trading session with expectations of room expansion.However, these stocks were generally under correction pressure at the end of the session and only increased slightly.
Some stocks that have increased rapidly in recent times such as VCS, SKG, C32, and KSB are also under pressure to correct and decrease.
Closing the session, VnIndex increased 1.35 points (0.23%) to 577.26 points;Hnx-Index increased 0.18 points (0.22%) to 80.06 points.The number of increasing codes on the 2 exchanges was 226, while the number of decreasing codes was 201.
Market liquidity reached 190 million units, equivalent to a value of 2,883 billion VND.
Closing the morning session, all indexes increased but it seemed that VN-Index did not have enough motivation to reach 580 points.The giant VNM inspired the market with an increase of 3,000 VND to 134,000 VND.This enterprise has officially announced a list of 7 business lines that will be withdrawn, to clear the way for expanding foreign room.
As for the giants of the oil and gas industry, GAS and PVD, had the opposite situation with a slight decrease.
While the natural rubber line has cooled down with the red color in most stocks, HNG alone - after unfavorable information announced yesterday, has increased to the ceiling.
Last night, the European Central Bank (ECB) lowered deposit interest rates to negative levels and expanded the stimulus package.However, the ECB president said that a further reduction in interest rates will not happen.
This caused many stock markets around the world to react not really positively and Vietnam's stock market was no exception as it opened the trading session quite cautiously.
Stock groups that increased sharply in yesterday's trading session such as oil and gas, rubber... are slowing down and trading is struggling around the reference mark.
In general, there is no industry group that is trading really actively. Instead, cash flow tends to focus on a few stocks such as C32, EVE, VNS, TYA, ITA, CAV, DBC, HNG...
On Upcom, May Viet Tien's VGG continued to increase to the ceiling for the second consecutive session since its listing.Currently, this stock only matches more than 17 thousand units and has no surplus for sale.
Notable agreement transaction with 6 million HQC shares at reference price of 6,200 VND.
At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex decreased slightly by 0.03 points (0.01%) to 575.88 points.Meanwhile, Hnx-Index still stagnates at the reference level.
author: Minh Anh

title: VIC, MSN recovered at the end of the session, VnIndex closed down nearly 17 points
sapo: Thus, after touching the 520 point area, VnIndex temporarily rebounded during the trading session although the recovery was not too strong.
content:
The emergence of bottom-fishing demand caused trading to become more positive in the late afternoon.Large-cap stocks VNM, BVH, FPT, HSG... narrowed the decline;Meanwhile, VIC and MSN have regained their reference point.
However, GAS, HAG, and BID still closed at the floor price and this had a significant impact on the index.
Besides, real estate and securities stocks... also had many stocks with floor drops such as VIG, APS, AGR, FLC, LCG, LDG, NDN...
Similar is the group of oil and gas stocks with a series of codes that dropped sharply such as PVB, PVC, PVD, PVE, PXS, PVS...
At the end of the trading session, VnIndex only decreased 16.67 points (3.07%) to 526.37 points;HNX-Index also narrowed its decline to 2.13 points (2.82%) to 73.26 points.The number of declining codes in the whole market was 395, overwhelming compared to 77 gaining codes.
Liquidity on both exchanges increased to 224 million units, equivalent to a value of 3,085 billion VND.
Thus, after touching the 520 point area, VnIndex temporarily rebounded during the trading session although the recovery was not too strong.
At 1:35 p.m., VnIndex decreased 23.84 points (4.39%) to 519.2 points;Similarly, HNX-Index decreased 3.15 points (4.18%) to 72.23 points.Liquidity on the 2 exchanges increased to more than 2,200 billion VND.
The stocks that are having the most negative impact on VnIndex right now include VNM, GAS, BVH, HSG, MSN, VCB, BID.Among them, BID and GAS fell to the floor.
Pausing the morning trading session, market movements were still quite negative as both stock indexes dropped sharply.VnIndex narrowed its decline to only 17.36 points (3.2%) and retreated to 525.68 points.Similar developments, HNX-Index also lost 2.31 points (3.06%) to 73.08 points.
The number of declining codes in the entire market was completely overwhelming with 356 codes, while the number of gaining codes was only 59.
Liquidity on the 2 exchanges soared to 124 million units, equivalent to a value of 1,660 billion VND.
Bluechips stocks VNM, BVH, FPT, VCB, GAS... stocks SSI, HCM, VND, real estate, construction KBC, ITA, CTD, VCG, DXG... all sank in the red.Panic is happening throughout the market.
According to many stock experts, the 520 area will be the short-term support of the market.However, it is necessary to limit bottom-fishing actions at this time.
Although the market dropped sharply, bottom-fishing demand appeared to be quite cautious and only accepted to buy at low prices.Investors holding stocks seem to be impatient, pushing for "exit sales", causing the two indexes to drop even more than in the early morning.
At 10:00 a.m., VnIndex decreased 20.16 points (3.71%) to 522.88 points;Hnx-Index decreased 2.1 points (2.79%) to 73.28 points.
Market liquidity reached 60 million units, equivalent to a value of 800 billion VND.
Many Bluechips are falling quite strongly at this time, typically VNM (down 4,000 VND), MSN (down 2,000 VND), VCB (down 1,900 VND), FPT (down 1,600 VND), BVH (down 1,500 VND)....
The market opened a new trading week with quite negative developments.Immediately after the ATO order match, selling pressure was boosted at Bluechips such as VIC, VNM, BVH, MSN, GAS, FPT, VCB... causing the 2 indexes to drop quite deeply.
At 9:25 a.m., VnIndex lost 15.48 points (2.85%) to 527.56 points;Hnx-Index lost 1.69 points (2.24%) and retreated to 73.7 points.Immediately after that, VnIndex recovered slightly, currently losing more than 13 points.
Adjustment pressure spread to many other industry groups in the market such as stocks, real estate, oil and gas...and many stocks fell all the way down such as ITA, IJC, HDG, DPS....
The movements of Asian stock markets this morning were not really positive with red appearing in many indexes such as Hangseng Index, Topix Index, Kospi Index... However, the decrease in these markets in general was not too strong.
In the recent news report, many securities companies commented that VnIndex in the short term will fall to the support area of ​​520-530 points.
author: Hoang Anh

title: Session January 13: Foreign investors net bought MSN, continued to "discharge" VIC
sapo: Foreign investors had a net selling session on both exchanges with a value of 83 billion VND.The fact that foreign investors have not yet returned to net buying is still a barrier to the market's recovery.
content:
The positive psychological effect from the previous trading session and the recovery of the Asian stock market helped Vietnam's stock market trade quite vibrantly in the first minutes of the session on January 13.
However, the cash flow into the market was not strong enough, while profit-taking pressure was always present, causing the two indexes to weaken at the end of the session.Closing the session, VnIndex decreased 3.89 points (0.69%) to 560.37 points;Meanwhile, Hnx-Index only increased slightly by 0.01 points.
Foreign investors had a net selling session on both exchanges with a value of 83 billion VND.The fact that foreign investors have not yet returned to net buying is still a barrier to the market's recovery.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 2.34 million shares, equivalent to a value of 82.47 billion VND.This is also the 8th consecutive net selling session of foreign investors on the HSX.
MSN topped the list of foreign net buyers on the HSX with 13.67 billion VND.Next in the top net buying of foreign investors are SSI (7.06 billion VND), EIB (5.4 billion VND), KBC (2.87 billion VND), CII (2.39 billion VND).
In today's session, foreign investors net bought 454 thousand CII shares with a value of 5.4 billion VND, accounting for 85% of EIB trading volume.At the end of the trading session, EIB increased to 12,000 VND.
On the net selling side, VIC continues to top the list with 48.79 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net sellers also include PVD (18.36 billion VND), CTD (12.99 billion VND), GAS (6.72 billion VND), HPG (6.19 billion VND).
The oil and gas duo GAS and PVD had a quite positive trading session, increasing 0.9% and 2.7% respectively.
On HNX, foreign investors continued to slightly net sell 232 thousand shares in today's trading session, equivalent to a net selling value of 616 million VND.
IVS continues to top the foreign net buying list with 2.54 billion VND.Ranked 2nd in the top net buying is PLC with 1.54 billion VND.
On the contrary, PVS from a net bought position was net sold by foreign investors for 3.32 billion VND.At the end of the trading session, PVS increased slightly by 0.7% to 15,000 VND.
PVS is also the stock with the strongest net selling by foreign investors in today's trading session.Other stocks such as VNR, CEO, VND... were net sold with negligible value.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session January 11: Foreign investors "discharged goods", VIB continued to increase
sapo: Foreign investors' trading today was not really active, they continued to be net buyers on the HNX and net sellers on the HSX.In general, foreign investors had a light net selling session with a value of 390 million VND.
content:
The market opened the new trading week with not really positive developments when the red color appeared on both exchanges.The fact that Asian stock markets continue to be "fiery" today has had a significant impact on the trading psychology of domestic investors.
Closing the session, VnIndex decreased 2.18 points (0.39%) to 557.87 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.31 points (0.4%) to 76.1 points.
Foreign investors' trading today was not really active, they continued to be net buyers on the HNX and net sellers on the HSX.In general, foreign investors had a light net selling session with a value of 390 million VND.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a slight net selling session of 319 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 13.66 billion VND.This is also the 6th consecutive net selling session of foreign investors on the City floor.
VCB is the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors in today's trading session with 8.56 billion VND.Next in the top net buying are PAC (6.58 billion VND), MSN (5.45 billion VND), KBC (5.28 billion VND), BVH (3.86 billion VND).
Closing the trading session, no stocks in the top 5 net purchases of foreign investors increased.
On the contrary, VIC continued to be net sold quite strongly by foreign investors with 40.18 billion VND.Ranked 2nd in the net selling list is SSI with 6.24 billion VND.Both of these stocks ended the trading session in the green with increases of 0.9% and 0.5%, respectively.
Top net sellers of foreign investors also include ITA (3.45 billion VND), CTD (3.24 billion VND), HPG (2.53 billion VND).In particular, CTD decreased quite sharply by 3.2% to 149,000 VND.
On HNX, foreign investors had the 11th consecutive net buying session with 927 thousand shares, corresponding to a net buying value of 13.27 billion VND.
PVS continues to top the list of net foreign exchange purchases on HNX with 5.96 billion VND.3 other stocks continue to be in the top 5 net purchases of foreign investors including IVS (3.37 billion VND), PLC (1.24 billion VND), SHB (1.13 billion VND).
HLD is a new face appearing in the top 5 stocks with net buying by foreign investors in today's session with 0.47 billion VND.Closing the session, HLD dropped sharply by 5.1% to 16,700 VND.
On the net selling side, DBC was sold the most by foreign investors, only 0.64 billion VND.Other stocks such as VCG, BII... were net sold with negligible value.
author: Minh Anh

title: Session 4/1: HAG created a new bottom, foreign investors "discharged" VIC on the first day of the new year
sapo: On the first day of the new year, foreign investors net bought a total of more than 2 million shares across the market.However, in terms of value, this was a light net selling session of about 60 million VND and most of it concentrated in VIC.
content:
In the first trading session of the new year, the market received positive information such as the monthly PMI index increased beyond 50 points, gasoline prices decreased by nearly 400 VND or the official settlement time for stock transactions was shortened to T+2.
However, transactions on the two exchanges are generally still quite tense, with demand only accepting purchases at low price ranges.Negative signals from Asian stock markets, especially in China, had a significant impact on Vietnam's stock market on the first day of 2016. Closing the trading session, VnIndex decreased 4.62 points (0.8%) to 574.41 points;HNX-Index decreased 0.51 points (0.63%) to 79.45 points.
On the first day of the new year, foreign investors net bought a total of more than 2 million shares across the market.However, in terms of value, this was a light net selling session of about 60 million VND and most of it concentrated in VIC.
On the HSX, foreign investors net bought 484 thousand shares on the first day of the new year.However, in terms of value, this is still a net selling session with 17.24 billion VND.
TTF is the stock with the strongest net purchase by foreign investors in today's trading session with 14.9 billion VND.Among the top net buyers of foreign investors are SBT (3.75 billion VND), CAV (3.17 billion VND), DLG (3.11 billion VND), HSG (2.68 billion VND).
SBT and HSG are the two most actively traded stocks with increases of 3.7% and 2.2%, respectively.Meanwhile, DLG dropped to 6,600 VND.
On the net selling side, VIC was the stock sold the most by foreign investors with 53 billion VND.However, this did not much affect VIC's trading as the stock increased 3.9% to 47,500 VND and was also the highest price of the session.
Other stocks in the top net sellers include KDC (12.57 billion VND), HAG (4.68 billion VND), DPM (4.26 billion VND), CTG (3.79 billion VND) and these stocks all closed down.Notably, with a closing price of 10,100 VND, HAG fell to its lowest level since listing.
On HNX, foreign investors net bought 1.58 million shares, equivalent to 17.18 billion VND in today's trading session.This is also the 6th consecutive net buying session of foreign investors on the Hanoi floor.
IVS topped the list of net foreign buyers on HNX with 3.15 billion VND.Next in the top net buyers are PVS (2.61 billion VND), AAA (1.65 billion VND), SHB (1.49 billion VND), PLC (1.18 billion VND).AAA was the only stock that kept the green color with an increase of 2.4% to 12,600 VND.
On the contrary, DBC was the stock that was net sold the most with 0.67 billion VND.Other stocks such as TCT, PVI... were net sold with negligible value.
author: Minh Anh

title: VnIndex lost more than 4 points, VIC agreed for more than 380 billion VND
sapo: Tight cash flow combined with pressure from foreign investors to withdraw capital massively caused the market to quell each uprising.
content:
Another trading session with a series of pushed back efforts.VnIndex closed the session down more than 4 points, to 561.04 points and HNX-Index decreased 0.71 points to 78.89 points.
Tight cash flow combined with pressure from foreign investors to withdraw capital massively caused the market to quell each uprising.
Notable stocks today:
OGC reduced to 3,600 VND.Order matching was more than double that of yesterday's session.At the end of the session, OGC had a selling surplus of 455 thousand units.
HQC dropped another 200 dong today.If calculated in a 3-month series, HQC has dropped quite deeply.
SBT and BHS increased by 300 VND and 200 VND respectively.These 2 stocks are expected to enter FTSE's restructuring list with a purchase of more than 11 million shares for the 2 codes.NT2 - a stock predicted to be added by FTSE in this restructuring session - also increased sharply by 600 dong today.
HAG continues to find a new bottom today, dropping 200 VND to 11,500 VND/share.
The most notable put-through order today is VIC.This stock was negotiated for 9 million units, equivalent to more than 380 billion VND at a price of 42,500 VND/share.
In the early afternoon, selling pressure was still high, pushing the two exchanges down.Many large stocks such as HSG, BID, CTG... could not maintain their green color.
Currently, HoSE has 121 red codes, 81 increased codes;On HNX, there were 95 codes that decreased while only 53 codes increased.
The banking group recovered strongly this morning but in the early afternoon began to weaken and at 2:10 p.m. only STB increased by 600 VND/share.ACB, BID, CTG, NVB, VCB all dropped.
This morning's trading session, although many stocks increased again and the general index increased slightly, it continued to make investors impatient as the selling pressure was still very high.The strong net selling by foreign investors yesterday made investors somewhat hesitant to spend money.
Stock codes that recovered and increased today include VNM, which increased by 1,000 VND;STB increased by 100 VND;SRC increased sharply by 1,000 VND;HNG increased by 300 VND;HSG increased by 100 VND after yesterday's dividend news (yesterday, HSG increased sharply for one session);ITA increased by 100 VND...VIC increased strongly by 400 VND/share today.Yesterday, VIC announced information about restructuring ownership of member companies.
GAS lost 200 VND, HQC lost 100 VND;SBT and BHS both decreased in points.
VnIndex increased 1.07 points to 565.82 points and HNX-Index increased 0.11 points to 79.71 points.
author: Phuong Chi

title: Session 11/9: Foreign investors net sold VIC more than 61 billion VND
sapo: Foreign investors were net sellers on the HSX and net buyers on the HNX.Overall, they sold a net of 55.11 billion VND across the market today and focused mainly on VIC.
content:
The trading session at the beginning of the week was quite tense as cash flow seemed not ready to enter the market at this stage.VnIndex ended the session down 0.28% to 610.66 points, while HNX-Index decreased 0.1% to 81.42 points.
Foreign investors, after a series of 4 consecutive net buying sessions, net sold again today with 55.11 billion VND.However, if not taking into account the sudden agreement at VIC, this is still a net buying session by foreign investors.
On the HSX, foreign investors net sold 1.65 million shares in today's trading session, equivalent to a net selling value of 63.36 billion VND.
CII was the stock with the highest net purchase by foreign investors on the HSX in today's trading session with 10.93 billion VND.However, at the close of the session, CII fell 4.9% to 21,300 VND.
Next on the list of foreign net buyers is VCB with 7.52 billion VND and this is also a quite positive trading session for VCB when it increased by 2.6% to 49,100 VND.
Other stocks in the net buying list of foreign investors include HT1 (3.13 billion VND), NCT (2.84 billion VND), DPM (2.81 billion VND)...
On the contrary, VIC was sold the most by foreign investors during the session with 61.46 billion VND.In particular, foreign investors sold VIC agreements for more than 64 billion VND.
Next in the list of net sellers of foreign investors on the HSX are MSN (18.63 billion VND), SBT (6.58 billion VND), HVG (4.54 billion VND), BVH (3.64 billion VND)....
On HNX, foreign investors continued to have a light net buying session with 510 thousand shares, equivalent to 8.25 billion VND.
Topping the net buying list on HNX is PVC with 2.84 billion VND.Next are VKC (1.5 billion VND), CHP (0.78 billion VND), PHP (0.6 billion VND), CVT (0.46 billion VND)....
Among the top net sellers, VKC was the only stock that ended the session with an increase of 1.9% to 10,700 VND.
On the net selling side, no stocks were sold too strongly by foreign investors in today's session.LAS is the most heavily sold stock and is only worth 480 million VND.Other stocks such as AAA, SDP, HMH... were net sold with negligible value.
author: Hoang Anh

title: Session October 23: "Gathering" VIC, foreign investors net bought more than 112 billion VND in the weekend session
sapo: Foreign investors returned to net buying quite strongly, partly helping investor sentiment in the market become more positive in today's trading session.
content:
The weekend trading session took place with very positive signals when the green color was present on both exchanges.VnIndex closed the session up nearly 7 points and surpassed the strong resistance level of 600 points.
Not only that, foreign investors after a period of gloomy trading returned to net buying quite strongly in today's trading session with a net buying value of 112.39 billion VND.
On the HSX, foreign investors had a quite positive net buying session with 3.09 million shares, equivalent to 110.24 billion VND.
VIC continued to be "acquired" quite strongly by foreign investors during the session with a net purchase volume of 1.4 million shares, worth 61.88 billion VND.At the end of the trading session, VIC increased 4.5% to 44,400 VND.
In addition, foreign investors also had a strong net buying session of HPG (10.58 billion VND), SSI (10.28 billion VND), PVD (9.23 billion VND), BVH (7.94 billion VND) and all of these stocks ended in the green with a gain.
On the net selling side, HSG was the strongest sold stock with 6.02 billion VND.At the end of the trading session, HSG increased by 3.7% to 45,000 VND.
Among the top net sellers on HSX were CSM (3.13 billion VND), KDC (2.37 billion VND), TRC (2.24 billion VND), DRC (2.21 billion VND) and these stocks all closed down.
At the end of the trading session, except for HSG, which still maintained its upward momentum, other stocks in the top net sellers all closed in the red with a decline.
On HNX, foreign investors had a net buying session again, but the net buying amount was quite modest with 171 thousand shares, equivalent to a value of 2.15 billion VND.
PVS topped the list of foreign net buyers on the Hanoi floor with 6.68 billion VND.Next in line are IVS (1.22 billion VND), VE1 (0.57 billion VND), PIV (0.49 billion VND), LAS (0.32 billion VND).Of which, VE1 and PIV increased to the ceiling, IVS increased by 8.8%.
On the contrary, NTP continued to be the strongest net sold stock during the session with 2.53 billion VND.Other stocks in the top net sellers include TNG (1.56 billion VND), PVC (1.01 billion VND), HAD (0.89 billion VND), PBP (0.58 billion VND).
Closing the session, NTP increased 4.3% to 61,100 VND, while PBP decreased quite sharply (5.9%) to 17,700 VND.
author: Hoang Anh

title: Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong and his wife received dividends equal to 128 million VIC shares
sapo: In total, Mr. Vuong and his wife received 128 million shares from this dividend payment.
content:
Vingroup Corporation (stock code VIC) has just announced information about changes in ownership of major shareholders.
Accordingly, Ms. Pham Thu Huong, wife of Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company, received 18.8 million shares from the dividend payment in 2014 and the first quarter of 2015 in shares, increasing her holding from nearly 73 million shares (5%) to 91.8 million shares (4.99%) and is no longer a major shareholder of VIC due to the change in ownership ratio when Vingroup changed the number.number of outstanding shares.
Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, Chairman of the Board of Directors of the company, also received 109.2 million shares from this dividend payment, increasing his ownership from 423.2 million shares (ratio 29.01%) to 532.4 million shares (ratio 28.9%).Date of change of ownership: July 22, 2015.In total, Mr. Vuong and his wife received 128 million shares from this dividend payment from Vingroup.
Previously, Vingroup agreed to approve the 2014 dividend payment in shares at the rate of 14% and the 2015 advance dividend payment also in shares at the rate of 11.8%.In total, VIC recently issued about 376.3 million shares to pay dividends to shareholders (total payout ratio 25.8%).
In addition to 376.3 million shares issued to pay dividends, VIC also issued an additional 6.4 million shares to convert from international bonds.The total number of shares recently issued was 382.7 million.Therefore, the ownership ratio of shareholders also changes.
