author: Mai Nguyen

title: Notable stocks on June 12: VIC, HBC, SSI lead real estate, construction, and stocks to increase
sapo: Real estate, construction, and securities stocks are becoming the focus of the market in recent trading sessions.
content:
VIC: Increased 2,900 VND (5.8%) to 52,000 VND
Transaction information:
As a stock with large capitalization on the market, the impact of VIC's increase and decrease on VnIndex is huge.
In today's trading session, VIC increased by 2,900 VND to 52,000 VND, equivalent to an increase of 5.8%.This is VIC's strongest rising session in recent months and this also led to the increase of a series of stocks in the real estate group.
VIC liquidity reached nearly 3 million units, a sharp increase compared to the average trading volume of the stock's recent 20 sessions.Foreign investors bought 1.65 million units during the session and this was the second most purchased stock by volume on the market.
With today's rising session, VIC has temporarily surpassed the accumulation zone that has lasted from October 2014 until now.
Notable information:
According to information from the Vietnam Securities Depository Center (VSD), Vingroup - JSC has moved the last registration date to exercise the right to pay dividends by shares in 2014 and the first quarter of 2015 from June 18 to July 1, 2015.
In the recent IPO of Saigon Port, Vingroup, along with VPBank and Vietinbank, registered as strategic shareholders.Of which, Vingroup (VIC) registered to buy 80% and two banks, VPBank and Vietinbank, each registered to buy 11%.
Recently, Techcom Securities successfully arranged to issue bonds for Vingroup with a total issuance volume of 2,000 billion VND.Investors are mainly reputable banks and securities companies.These are non-convertible bonds, do not include warrants and are not secured by assets.
HBC: Increased 1,500 VND (6.3%) to 25,400 VND
Transaction information:
Since creating a bottom at the end of December 2014, HBC has had a period of strong growth in the market.At the end of the trading session on June 12, HBC had a market price of 25,400 VND, double the price 6 months ago.
At the opening session, HBC fluctuated around the reference range and even decreased slightly.However, from 10:15 a.m. onwards, the demand for HBC as well as real estate stocks was quite strong, quickly helping this stock increase.Towards the end of the trading session, HBC showed more positive trading and closed at 25,400 VND, this was also the highest price of the stock during the session.
HBC liquidity reached 1.6 million units, of which foreign investors participated in buying 545 thousand units.
Notable information:
Hoa Binh Real Estate has approved the plan to pay 2014 dividends in cash at a rate of 15%, equivalent to an expenditure of 86 billion VND.Implementation source from undistributed PAT until the end of 2014. Implementation time is expected in the second and third quarters of this year.
Previously, Hoa Binh Real Estate had just sold all of the company's treasury shares, earning about 87 billion VND.At the recent 2015 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, Hoa Binh Real Estate representative said that the company will pay cash dividends to shareholders after completing the sale of treasury shares.
HBC's 2015 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders also approved a plan to privately issue a maximum of 20 million shares to strategic shareholders with an issuance price not lower than 1.2 times the book value at the time of issuance.
SSI: Increased 700 VND (3%) to 24,400 VND.
Transaction information:
After creating a bottom last May, it seems that a new upward trend of SSI in particular as well as stock stocks in general is gradually forming.At the end of the June 12 trading session, SSI had a market price of 24,400 VND, up 28% compared to the bottom nearly 1 month ago.
Today's trading session continued to witness positive signals from SSI. This stock increased right from the opening and that continued until the end of the trading session.
Like previous rising waves, SSI often plays a pivotal role, attracting cash flow to participate in the stock group and today is no exception when the stock flow is trading excitedly.
SSI liquidity reached nearly 7.5 million units, of which foreign investors continued to strongly buy 2.67 million units.The continuous net buying by foreign investors recently has greatly contributed to SSI's strong upward momentum.
Notable information:
According to the announced business results of the first quarter of 2015, SSI recorded 283 billion VND in revenue and 111 billion VND in net profit, down 25% and 36% respectively compared to the same period in 2014.
SSI's total capital at the end of the period reached 9,985 billion VND, an increase of more than 1,000 billion VND compared to the beginning of the year.During the period, SSI successfully issued 500 billion VND of 2-year bonds, and at the same time issued shares to increase the company's charter capital.
SSI has registered to buy 10 million treasury shares at a price not exceeding 22,000 VND/share, transactions to be carried out from June 10 to July 9.
author: Hoang Anh

title: Notable stocks on June 1: VIC, VCB helped VnIndex increase more than 5 points
sapo: With an increase of 2,400 VND to 45,700 VND today, VCB surpassed GAS and became the stock with the largest market capitalization.
content:
VCB: Increased 2,400 VND (5.5%) to 45,700 VND
Transaction information:
After a few slow trading sessions the previous week, right in the first trading session of June, VCB returned to its leading position in banking stocks as well as the market during this period.
Opening the trading session, VCB traded quite slowly and only increased slightly.However, from nearly 10 a.m. onwards, trading at VCB became much more active and that attracted a strong increase in other banking stocks such as BID, CTG, ACB, MBB...The explosion of the banking group also helped VnIndex increase to close to the 580 point mark.
Towards the end of the afternoon session, profit-taking pressure came when stocks rose quite "hotly" but VCB hardly adjusted much.This stock closed at 45,700 VND, only 300 VND less than the highest price of the session, showing that cash flow is focusing on VCB very strongly.
VCB liquidity reached 1.2 million units, of which foreign investors bought more than 800 thousand units and trading volume remained stable above the average threshold of the last 20 sessions.
With today's strong increase, VCB's market capitalization has reached more than 121 trillion VND and has become the most influential stock on VnIndex.
Notable information:
According to the newly announced first quarter business results report, by the end of March 2015, Vietcombank achieved credit growth of 2.3%;Customer deposits increased by 3.34%.The bad debt ratio accounts for 2.97% of the total outstanding customer loans with an absolute figure of VND 9,831 billion.
Vietcombank's bad debt increased in all three groups (subprime debt, doubtful debt and potentially lossable debt), of which potentially lossable debt increased by 34% at VND 4,770 billion, accounting for nearly half of the total bad debt.At the end of 2014, this bank's bad debt ratio was only 2.3%.
Vietcombank's net interest income in the first quarter of the year was VND 3,496 billion, up nearly 20% over the same period;Profit from services in the first quarter reached 337 billion VND, up 23.4% over the same period;Profit from foreign exchange trading increased by 6.6% to 471 billion;from trading securities reached 96 billion VND.
After making a provision of 1,517 billion VND (an increase of 26.6% over the same period), Vietcombank had pre-tax profit of 1,456 billion VND, down nearly 3% over the same period last year.Profit after tax reached 1,135 billion VND.
VIC: Increased 1,400 VND (2.9%) to 48,700 VND
Transaction information:
Along with banking stocks, VIC's sharp increase in today's trading session contributed significantly to the strong increase of VnIndex.
VIC's trading took place actively right from the morning when the ATO session ended, VIC increased 600 VND to 48,100 VND.VIC's upward momentum continued and was strongest at around 10:00 am when VIC climbed to 49,200 VND and this was also the highest level of the session that this stock achieved.
Towards the end of the trading session, profit-taking pressure came to VIC and caused this stock to no longer maintain its strong upward momentum like the morning session. However, the closing price of the session at 48,700 VND can also be considered positive for VIC even though it has not surpassed the medium-term resistance area of ​​49,000 VND.
VIC liquidity during the session reached 1.23 million units, of which foreign investors bought quite a lot with more than 750 thousand units.
Notable information:
The Board of Directors of Vingroup has just issued a resolution approving the issuance of additional shares to pay stock dividends from accumulated EAT in 2014 and the first quarter of 2015 with a dividend payout ratio of 25.8%.
Recently, Vingroup has sent a document to the People's Committee of Lang Son province asking for a location to research and implement an investment project to build a commercial and entertainment center in Lang Son province.In addition to big cities such as Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Vingroup is investing in some localities such as Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Ha Tinh, Hue, Binh Dinh, Kien Giang, Quang Ngai...
According to information from the People's Committee of Thanh Hoa province, the Provincial People's Committee just had a working session with Vingroup - Joint Stock Company on the proposal to contribute capital to Song Am Company Limited to establish a two-member high-tech agricultural development company.
Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee also agreed on the policy of assigning Vingroup investment group to conduct surveys, feasibility studies and invest in two underground parking projects after the city revoked them due to many years of non-investment.
author: Hoang Anh

title: Notable stocks on May 18: GAS, VIC "pulled" the market down sharply, VCB suddenly went against the trend
sapo: The sharp decline of large capitalization stocks in the market such as VIC and GAS has caused many negative impacts on the market.
content:
GAS: Reduced by 3,000 VND (4.9%) to 58,000 VND
Transaction information:
The first trading session of the week ended with not very positive developments from the market when VnIndex dropped more than 8 points and fell below the threshold of 530 points.Among the factors that caused VnIndex to fall sharply, we cannot help but mention GAS when this stock dropped sharply by 4.9% to 58,000 VND.
During most of the trading time, although GAS was adjusted, the level was not too strong.Just from 13:30 onwards, the selling pressure on GAS increased suddenly and caused this stock to quickly drop sharply.
With the largest market capitalization, GAS's sharp decline has negatively affected the overall market.
GAS trading volume also increased significantly in today's trading session with more than 458 thousand trading units.Foreign investors bought 72,600 units during the session.
Closing the trading session at the price of 58,000 VND, also the lowest level of the session, caused GAS to fall below the medium-term support level created at the end of December 2014.
Notable information:
Recently, PVGas has decided to appoint Mr. Duong Manh Son as a Member of the Board of Directors and General Director of PVGas.Previously, on April 22, 2015, Mr. Le Nhu Linh (Chairman of the Board of Directors of PVGas) was appointed by Vietnam Oil and Gas Group to hold the position of concurrent General Director, replacing Mr. Do Khang Ninh until an official appointment decision is made.
Thus, Mr. Duong Manh Son was officially appointed to replace Mr. Le Nhu Linh's position after less than 1 month.
According to the announced first quarter business results, parent company PVGas net profit was 2,679 billion VND, down 15.78% over the same period.The company's first quarter EPS reached 1,414 VND/share.Regarding net revenue, in the first quarter alone, PVGas reached 13,636 billion VND, a slight decrease of more than 1% compared to the first quarter of 2014.Despite reducing management costs (down from 331 billion VND to 103 billion VND), the company's financial costs skyrocketed from 81 billion VND to 296 billion VND.
VIC: Reduced by 700 VND (1.3%) to 46,300 VND
Transaction information:
Along with GAS, VIC is one of the codes with the greatest influence on the market and VIC's drop in today's trading session has had a significant impact on the market.
Like many other codes on the market, from 13:30 onwards, VIC was sold quite strongly.At the end of the trading session, VIC decreased 700 VND to 46,300 VND and that was also the lowest price of this stock in the session.
VIC liquidity improved significantly with more than 1.65 million units traded.Notably, foreign investors bought into VIC quite strongly during the session with more than 1.35 million units.
After today's decline, VIC has nearly touched the support area of ​​45,500 VND and this is expected to help the stock "stop falling" because this support level has proven quite effective in supporting VIC's price since September 2014 until now.
Notable information:
According to the latest news, Vingroup has sent a document to the People's Committee of Lang Son province asking for a location to research and implement an investment project to build a commercial and entertainment center in Lang Son province.In addition to big cities such as Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Vingroup is investing in some localities such as Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Ha Tinh, Hue, Binh Dinh, Kien Giang, Quang Ngai...
According to information from the People's Committee of Thanh Hoa province, the Provincial People's Committee just had a working session with Vingroup - Joint Stock Company on the proposal to contribute capital to Song Am Company Limited to establish a two-member high-tech agricultural development company.
Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee also agreed on the policy of assigning Vingroup investment group to conduct surveys, feasibility studies and invest in two underground parking projects after the city revoked them due to many years of non-investment.
VCB: Increased 200 VND (0.5%) to 38,600 VND
Transaction information:
In today's trading session, VCB was actually a bright spot that appeared when it went against the trend in the context of a strong correction in the general market.
In the morning trading session, VCB did not really attract attention as this stock also fell quite sharply, even falling to 37,700 VND at one point.However, things have changed since the afternoon session when VCB Lien jumped right at the beginning of the session, despite the market's fluctuations.
VCB closed the session at 38,600 VND, only 100 VND less than the highest price of the session.The increase is not strong but it is very positive.
VCB liquidity reached 556 thousand units, a slight increase compared to the previous session.Of which, foreign investors bought 423 thousand units during the session.
VCB's next resistance level will be the old peak area, corresponding to the price of 40,000 VND.
Notable information:
According to the newly announced first quarter business results report, by the end of March 2015, Vietcombank achieved credit growth of 2.3%;Customer deposits increased by 3.34%.The bad debt ratio accounts for 2.97% of the total outstanding customer loans with an absolute figure of VND 9,831 billion.
Vietcombank's bad debt increased in all three groups (subprime debt, doubtful debt and potentially lossable debt), of which potentially lossable debt increased by 34% at VND 4,770 billion, accounting for nearly half of the total bad debt.At the end of 2014, this bank's bad debt ratio was only 2.3%.
Vietcombank's net interest income in the first quarter of the year was VND 3,496 billion, up nearly 20% over the same period;Profit from services in the first quarter reached 337 billion VND, up 23.4% over the same period;Profit from foreign exchange trading increased by 6.6% to 471 billion;from trading securities reached 96 billion VND.
After making a provision of 1,517 billion VND (an increase of 26.6% over the same period), Vietcombank had pre-tax profit of 1,456 billion VND, down nearly 3% over the same period last year.Profit after tax reached 1,135 billion VND.
Hoang Anh
author: Hoang Anh Tu

title: Stocks continued to have a rising session, VIC was strongly bought by foreign investors
sapo: GAS today increased by 1,000 VND.VNM increased by 2,000 VND despite revised information on long-term revenue plans being released.VIC increased by 1,100 VND.
content:
At the end of today's trading session, the two exchanges increased/decreased in opposite directions.VnIndex increased 5.5 points to nearly 560 points and HNX-Index decreased 0.33 points to 82.66 points.This is the third consecutive session that VnIndex has increased.
Market liquidity today focuses on familiar stock groups.Most notable is VIC.
-VIC closed the session up 1,100 VND to 48,600 VND, liquidating 1.7 million shares, foreign investors bought 1.25 million shares.
-CTG and VCB both increased in points
-GAS increased by 1,000 VND today.VNM increased by 2,000 VND despite revised information on long-term revenue plans being released.VIC increased by 1,100 VND
-HTL automobile stock increased to the ceiling despite quite low liquidity.
"The State Securities Commission (SSC) will review and amend the draft to suit the current situation of the market. In particular, the regulations on borrowing capital from securities companies will remain the same as the current regulations in Circular 210" - that is the information sent to investors by the media over the weekend.Although it was only a "consideration", this action of the State Securities Commission has helped the market react more positively.
By 10:30 this morning, VnIndex increased 4.25 points to 558.28 points and HNX-Index decreased slightly 0.13 points to 82.85 points.
Market liquidity is still quite low, reaching 453 billion VND on HoSE and 204 billion VND on HNX.
Foreign investors bought 375 thousand VIC shares - leading the market this morning - after information that Vingroup would buy back the Vinatexmart system.
Phuong Chi
author: Thanh Huong

title: [Real Estate 24h]:VIC shows off land fund of 81.1 million m2, Nam Cuong's trillion-dollar project to build banana plantations
sapo: The luxury apartment market is having a big change. From scarce supply to now, the market has begun to have more choices, abundant supply but purchasing demand has also increased significantly.
content:
Vietnam's preparations to invest in building the world's tallest TV Tower is attracting a lot of attention.Answering questions from public opinion, Mr. Nguyen Thanh Luong - deputy general director of VTV, head of the project investment preparation committee, said that capital for project investment will be taken from socialization money and the TV Tower mainly has economic significance and is a symbol of the Country.>>> What do VTV leaders say about the world's tallest TV tower?
The luxury apartment market is having a big change.From scarce supply to now, the market has begun to have more choices, abundant supply but purchasing demand has also increased significantly.Since Ata Mui Tet alone, the number of searches for real estate for sale and rent has skyrocketed, setting a new record with a jump of 20% compared to the peak of 2014. >>> New landscape in the luxury apartment market
According to experts' comments at the 2015 VNREA Member Conference in City.Da Nang was held on March 28, the real estate market has shown many signs of prosperity, the number of real estate transactions increased sharply, inventory decreased, real estate projects restarted strongly.However, bad debts in the market are still slow to be processed, market interest rates may increase at the end of 2015...still an obstacle for the real estate market this year.>>> The 2015 real estate market has many signs of improvement
Currently, the issues that many investors are concerned about are seaports, agriculture... and Vingroup is one of the corporations that grasps the trend and is a leader in this field.Vingroup said that the group currently has 81.1 million m2 of land fund for development in the next 10 years.>>> VIC has 81.1 million m2 of land fund for development in the next 10 years
According to data from the Foreign Investment Department, 23/28 EU member countries have invested in Vietnam with 1,607 valid projects, total registered investment capital reaching 19.7 billion USD.Notably, the real estate business sector ranks third in attracting capital from the EU with 34 investment projects with a total registered investment capital of 2.2 billion USD.>>> 2.2 billion USD from Europe poured into Vietnamese real estate
Goldmark City project at 136 Ho Tung Mau The project scale is a complex including luxury apartments, commercial - office - public service areas and other social amenities.Total project investment is about 10.8 trillion VND with more than 5,000 apartments.However, in August 2014, the Hanoi Department of Natural Resources and Environment put this project on the list of land confiscation due to "slow schedule" violations.Recently, a series of investors jumped into this land, changed the name and sold apartments at many different prices.To clarify these issues, the Bac Tu Liem District Construction Inspectorate said it will plan to inspect this project.>>> About to inspect the super project Goldmark City 136 Ho Tung Mau
The coastal expressway in the Northern Coastal region is expected to pass through 6 provinces of Quang Ninh, Thai Binh, Nam Dinh, Ninh Binh, Thanh Hoa and Hai Phong with a total length of 160km, as part of the Vietnam expressway construction plan until 2020. This route will be connected to the Quang Ninh - Hai Phong expressway that had previously started construction.>>> 6 provinces in the Northern coastal region met to discuss building a 160km coastal highway
Thach Phuc Urban Area project is designed and planned to become a bustling commercial center.The villas and low-rise houses in the urban area are arranged around two lake parks of over 40 hectares located adjacent to Highway 32, 17 km from Hanoi.However, the project is currently a wasteland for banana growers.>>> Nam Cuong's trillion-dollar project is a banana plantation
In the recent period, all segments of the real estate market have had a strong recovery, especially the mid-end segment attracting a lot of customer attention.Investors have almost ignored the high-end segment recently, focusing on the mid-range segment to answer the market's "thirst" for housing.Especially those with stable income in other provinces, the number of officials and civil servants buying houses in Hanoi is very large.>>> “Officials and civil servants from other provinces buy a lot of houses in Hanoi”
Thanh Mai
author: Thanh Hien

title: VIC has 81.1 million m2 of land fund for development in the next 10 years
sapo: Regarding the fields that many investors are interested in: seaports, agriculture... Vingroup said that it is currently too early to talk about these areas.
content:
The annual investment conference Vietnam Access Day 2015 organized by Ban Viet Securities Company last week attracted the attention of many large businesses and investors.Many notable information was given by businesses at this Conference.
One of the notable information is that Vingroup Corporation (VIC) has announced that the group currently has 81.1 million m2 of land fund for development in the next 10 years.The Group focuses on projects in "golden" positions.
Regarding the fields that many investors are interested in: seaports, agriculture..., Vingroup said that it is currently too early to talk about these areas.The group is looking for land funds in many localities for agricultural development.
Minh Anh
author: PV

title: March 24: Foreign investors net sold 61 billion on 2 exchanges, sold strongly GAS and PVD, bought VIC
sapo: Topping the net selling list on HOSE is PVD with a net selling value of 22.8 billion VND.Ranked 2nd is GAS with 16.44 billion VND.The codes with the most net selling were HAG (15.2 billion), KDC (12.9 billion), HPG (12 billion) and SSI (nearly 11 billion).
content:
On March 24, foreign investors continued to net sell more than 61 billion VND on the Vietnamese stock market
On HOSE, foreign investors net sold more than 516,200 shares, equivalent to 40.5 billion VND.Thus, except for the trading sessions on March 18 and March 20 during the week of restructuring the portfolio of the two ETFs, foreign investors have been net sellers continuously from March 6 until now.
Topping the net selling list is PVD with a net selling value of 22.8 billion VND.Ranked 2nd is GAS with 16.44 billion VND.The codes with the most net selling were HAG (15.2 billion), KDC (12.9 billion), HPG (12 billion) and SSI (nearly 11 billion).
Meanwhile, the most net bought  were VIC (17.9) billion VND, DXG (9.2 billion) and CTG (7.1 billion).
Similar to HOSE, foreign investors on HNX net sold more than 1.4 million shares, equivalent to nearly 21 billion VND.
Their net buying was insignificant.Topping the net buying list are SHB and SHS but still less than 1 billion VND.They net sold mainly at TIG (10.2 billion), PVS (7.7 billion) and HUT (nearly 3.3 billion).
Closing the trading session, these stocks all decreased in price.
In the news on March 23, Rong Viet Securities Company commented, "Along with recent speculation in the market related to the possibility of adjusting exchange rates by the State Bank, information related to Indonesia may be the reason that affected the psychology of foreign investors in today's session.
In theory, in a market where there is pressure to depreciate the local currency, the action of foreign investors is usually to sell the portfolio to convert to USD or delay disbursement.This theory can partly explain the net selling behavior of foreign investors in recent sessions."
Hai Long
author: Minh Trang

title: [Business March 23]:VIC expands investment, AGF is offered twice as expensive by SCIC
sapo: The Ministry of Industry and Trade is concerned about foreign enterprises encroaching on the distribution market;Viconship's shareholders were questioned by shareholders about the reason for the decrease in profits in 2015... other notable news of the day.
content:
"Big man" VIC continues to heat up the market when announcing the expansion of investment into agriculture, education and logistics.The Board of Directors decided to establish 6 subsidiaries, operating in the field of agricultural production and development, the field of education - training and the field of construction project management.
Continuously updating developments at the ongoing 2015 General Meeting of Shareholders, in which Viconship "heated" the issue of the election of the Board of Directors, shareholders questioned the cause of the decline in the 2015 profit plan. Explaining this issue, Viconship's Chairman of the Board of Directors said that the 2014 NPAT of up to 47 billion VND did not come from the company's main business activities, but from affiliated companies.Reversal of provisions for PSP shares, capital transfer profits, barge business, deposit interests...
Meanwhile, according to newly published General Meeting of Shareholders documents, Sao Ta Foods (FMC) in 2015 plans to profit 100 billion VND, growing 27% compared to 2014, Vietnam Italy Steel (VIS) submitted to the General Meeting of Shareholders to reduce revenue but increase profit plan by half for 2015.
Information about the results of the 2014 audited financial statements is notable: after the audit results, the PAT of Vietnam Petroleum Premium Services Joint Stock Company (PVR) was only 668.8 million VND, down 1 billion compared to before the audit.In addition, PVR has also collected money from customers from Van Phu and Viet Hung projects but has not yet issued VAT invoices.
Xuyen Thai Binh Joint Stock Company (code: PAN) announced that Tael Two Partners Ltd fund has purchased an additional 4,519,250 shares, increasing the number of shares held to 16,628,750 shares, equivalent to 20% of charter capital and is currently the largest shareholder of PAN.
HoSE will have more "hot products" when all 529.4 million DCM shares of Ca Mau Petroleum Fertilizer will officially be traded on HOSE starting from March 31, 2015. The reference price on the first trading day is 14,500 VND/share, with a price fluctuation range of +/-20%.Previously, DCM had a successful IPO in December 2014, whereby the largest shareholder, Vietnam Oil and Gas Group (PVN), would reduce its ownership from 75.56% to 51%.
The Ministry of Industry and Trade has just sent a document to many provinces and cities to note foreign investors contributing capital and buying shares in Vietnamese enterprises operating in the distribution sector.Accordingly, the People's Committees of provinces and cities need to direct local authorities to monitor and review share trading and capital contribution activities of foreign investors in Vietnamese enterprises operating in the above field.
Tran Trang
author: Thanh Tu

title: [Business March 12]: "Big guy" VIC also wants to jump into agricultural investment, CII earns trillions in deal with Philippine partner
sapo: However, the most notable information of the day was the fact that Vietnam Airlines held its first Shareholders' Meeting.
content:
The most notable news of the day was the fact that Vietnam Airlines held its first Shareholders' Meeting.The content that attracts attention is the election of members of the Board of Directors and Supervisory Board.Techcombank's representative, Mr. Nguyen Xuan Minh, has run for the Board of Directors of Vietnam Airlines.Mr. Minh represents 25.58 million VNA shares that Techcombank holds.Owning 22.4 million shares, Vietcombank nominated Mr. Lai Huu Phuoc to run for the position of Member of the Supervisory Board of Vietnam Airlines.
Following in the footsteps of the "giants", it is Vingroup's turn to propose investing in the agricultural sector in Quang Ninh.Vingroup plans to produce clean fruit and vegetable products for the market, applying high technology on large sample fields to reduce production costs and produce products with high export value.
CII's trillion dong revenue in the first two deals with Philippine partners made shareholders excited, City Technical Infrastructure Investment.Ho Chi Minh City (CII) announced that it has completed the first transfer of 20 million shares of CII Road and Bridge Investment Joint Stock Company (LGC) and issued the first phase of 491,275 LGC share exchange bonds, equivalent to 491,275 billion VND in bond par value to Metro Pacific Tollways Corporation (MPTC), earning 1,029 billion VND.With the proceeds, on March 16, CII will advance 2014 dividends to shareholders at a rate of 12%.The transfer of LGC shares and issuance of exchangeable bonds are expected by CII to bring positive effects to CII's operations in the first quarter of this year.
Viettel agreed to many specific policies when Prime Minister Nguyen Tan Dung and leaders of a number of ministries and branches had a meeting with the group's leaders.The Prime Minister agreed to the policy of increasing charter capital for Viettel;allowing the group to continue implementing the salary budget mechanism and salary autonomy, in order to attract and effectively promote high-quality human resources.In particular, the Prime Minister agreed to consider allocating about 100 hectares of land in the Hoa Lac high-tech park so that Viettel has premises to build and deploy high-tech research and production facilities in the future.
The seaport industry received positive news when the Ministry of Transport organized an online dialogue conference with shipping businesses and seaports to grasp the difficulties of businesses, thereby providing timely support policies.
In addition, a series of businesses have also announced dividend payment information. ELC will advance dividends in cash at a rate of 12%, expected payment time in April 2015 and agreed to submit to the General Meeting of Shareholders to pay additional dividends in shares at an expected rate of 8%.BIC advances 2014 dividends at the rate of 10% in cash on April 24.Chuong Duong Beverage paid an advance dividend for 2014 at the rate of 8% in cash on April 22.
The large stock transactions announced during the day belonged to the codes HAI, KDC, MBB, VFR VNE and HPG:
KLF International Investment Joint Stock Company (KLF) sold 8.526 million HAI shares from January 28 to February 9 but did not disclose the information.Meanwhile, from January 12 to February 11, Vinh Linh Investment Company Limited purchased 1,549,998 shares, equivalent to holding 0.6% of KDC's capital.Previously, this organization did not hold any KDC shares.
From February 9 to March 9, because the stock price was not as expected, MBCapital and its member funds failed to buy shares, including Vietnam Tiger Securities Investment Fund (VTF) which only bought 2,448,990 MBB shares out of a total of 3 million registered shares, Japan Asia MB Capital Investment Fund (JAMBF) unsuccessfully bought 2 million shares and MBCapital only bought 200,000 shares in300,000 shares registered, from March 13 to April 10, VTF Fund and JAMBF continued to register to buy 517,010 shares and 2 million MBB shares respectively to restructure the investment portfolio.
State Capital Investment and Trading Corporation, an organization related to Mr. Tran Van Quy, Chairman of the Board of Directors, registered to sell all 7,653,200 VFR shares, at a rate of 51.02%, but could not sell any shares because the expected price had not been reached.Meanwhile, the State Capital Investment and Trading Corporation (SCIC) continued to register to sell 18.9 million VNE shares, equivalent to 29.66% of VNE's capital to restructure its investment portfolio.Vietnam Infrastructure Holding Limited also registered to sell 2 million HPG shares to restructure its portfolio, thereby reducing its ownership to 1,333,565 shares, a ratio of 0.27%.
Tran Trang
author: Thanh Tu

title: Notable stocks on March 3: Speculative cash flow returned to the market, KSA-FCN-VIC increased strongly
sapo: The market had an increasing session with positively improved liquidity, including a significant contribution from speculative cash flows into mineral and real estate stock groups.
content:
FCN: Increased by 1,500 VND (ceiling increase) to 23,500 VND
Transaction information:
Along with the market's rising momentum, FCN also had a quite positive gaining session.However, with the ceiling increase, it is a bit surprising because FCN in the past has rarely had such a ceiling increase.
The market today exploded quite strongly with the increase in highly speculative stocks.FCN is usually not a highly speculative stock, not the most sensitive stock, but in this trading session, FCN made quite a strong impression.Perhaps part of the reason comes from the fact that its "brother" stock, FCM, rose to the ceiling quite strongly during the trading session.
FCN's liquidity during the session reached more than 850 thousand units, quite high compared to the trading volume of this stock in recent months.With the strong upward momentum in today's session combined with speculative cash flow returning to the market, it is likely that FCN's short-term upward momentum will not end soon.
Notable information:
At the end of 2014, FCN recorded a net profit of 142 billion VND, approximately the plan set for the year (148 billion VND), full year EPS reached 3,106 VND.In particular, there was a significant contribution of foundation revenue in the fourth quarter of 2014 when it grew by 50% over the same period.
According to VPBS's assessment, FCN's foundation construction segment will have competitive advantages due to advantages in scale, construction costs, construction capacity, along with a good brand in this field.At the same time, the remaining value of unfinished projects along with newly signed contracts will help FCN's revenue increase sharply in 2015. VPBS expects FCN's 2015 revenue to increase by 28% compared to the previous year.
KSA: Increased 600 VND (6.9%) to 9,300 VND
Transaction information:
Since 10:00 a.m., mineral stocks in general and KSA stocks in particular have increased strongly.At the end of the trading session, a series of stocks in this group increased to the ceiling strongly, specifically KSA.
The strong increase in the market accompanied by the rise in the mineral industry proves that speculative cash flow has returned to the market and usually that is when the market begins to rise strongly for at least the next 1-2 weeks.Among the waves in the mineral group, KSA is one of the most wave-sensitive stocks, as evidenced by the strong ceiling increase in today's trading session.
KSA's liquidity during the session reached more than 612 thousand units, surpassing MA20.At the end of the session, there were nearly 270 thousand units left to buy at the ceiling price, showing that the return cash flow is quite strong.
However, KSA's upward price trend will be most firmly confirmed when this stock overcomes the resistance area of ​​10,500 VND and then the destination will be the old peak of 14,300 VND.
Notable information:
In 2014, KSA achieved net revenue of 93 billion VND and 22 billion VND in net profit, up 230% and 18.5% respectively compared to 2013.
On January 13, 2015, KSA's Board of Directors approved 2014 business results with revenue of 97.66 billion VND and profit after tax of 22.08 billion VND.
On February 6, 2015, at Thang Hai Industrial Cluster, Ham Tan district, Binh Thuan province, Binh Thuan Mineral Industry Joint Stock Company (KSA) held a groundbreaking ceremony to build a titanium slag processing plant with a capacity of 60 thousand tons/year.The titanium slag processing factory was built on an area of ​​10 hectares with a total investment of 720 billion VND.
VIC: Increased 2,100 VND (4.5%) to 52,000 VND
Transaction information:
After a period of cumulative trading from October 2014 until now, it seems that VIC is preparing for a cycle of price increases again with quite active trading recently.With today's positive trading session, VIC is the locomotive pulling real estate stocks and is the psychological support for the market to increase.
VIC's liquidity during the session reached more than 2.37 million units, foreign investors bought quite strongly nearly 1 million units during the session.
In general, VIC's upward trend is just the beginning, but the current resistance level is acting to prevent VIC's upward momentum.If it overcomes the current resistance zone, there is a high possibility that VIC will increase back to the old peak set in August last year.
Notable information:
At the end of 2014, Vingroup recorded high growth when consolidated net revenue reached VND 27,738 billion, an increase of 51%;Gross profit from business activities reached 10,443 billion VND, an increase of 49%, profit after tax reached 3,790 billion VND and profit after tax from main business activities (excluding profits from share transfer activities) reached 3,636 billion VND, an increase of 26% compared to 2013.
According to sources from Hanoi People's Committee, Vinpearl Joint Stock Company has proposed to invest in building a 36-hole golf course project according to investment phases from 2016 to 2020 with a scale of 291 hectares.
The 2015 billionaire ranking list published by Forbes magazine lists the richest people in the world.Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Chairman of the Board of Directors of Vingroup - is the only Vietnamese person on Forbes' list.With assets of 1.7 billion USD, he ranked 1,118th on the list and was ranked by Forbes as the richest person in Vietnam.
Hoang Anh
author: Hoang Anh Tu

title: The two exchanges increased slightly, foreign investors bought strongly VIC, KDH and FLC
sapo: Banking stocks did not see much change today.
content:
Closing the morning session, VN-Index increased 2.32 points (0.4%) to 584.08 points.HoSE had nearly 130 increasing codes and 60 decreasing codes.
On the Hanoi floor, HNX Index also increased 0.61% to 84.98 points.
Among large stocks, VIC and MSN both increased by 1,000 VND.Notably, foreign investors bought 480 thousand out of a total of 1.15 million VIC shares that were matched.
Foreign investors also strongly bought two other real estate stocks, FLC (711 thousand units) and KDH (481 thousand units).Foreign investors have continuously bought net with large values ​​since the beginning of February until now.
HAG continued to increase by 600 VND after increasing by 700 VND in the previous session, to 22,600 VND with matching volume reaching 2.8 million units.Hoang Anh Gia Lai has reached an agreement to sell 50% of the shares of the HAGL Myanmar Center project to Singapore's Rowsley Group for 275 million USD.
Banking stocks did not see much change today.
TMT increased its ceiling to 19,100 VND before the company's management presented its 2015 plan with main targets 2-3 times higher than the results achieved in 2014.
author: Duc Hai

title: Notable stocks on February 11: SSI, FLC, VIC fly high on Mr. Cong Mr. Tao day
sapo: FLC once again became the focus of the market's attention when trading more than 18 million units during the session.In addition, SSI and VIC also had positive trading sessions, helping the market become more positive after gloomy trading days.
content:
SSI: Increased 900 VND (3.5%) to 26,600 VND.
Transaction information:
In a trading session where speculative cash flow spreads widely throughout the market, it is impossible not to have the presence of SSI, a common stock that leads speculative cash flow.
SSI ended the trading session up 900 VND to 26,600 VND, only 100 VND less than the highest price achieved during the session.SSI's session liquidity reached 1.9 million units.Not too high but compared to recent sessions it is acceptable.
After the correction, SSI has accumulated 7 sessions in the price range of 25,500 VND - 26,000 VND.SSI's trading session today was quite explosive, attracting cash flow that spread to the entire stock market.If in the coming trading sessions, SSI continues to increase beyond the resistance area of ​​28,000 VND, it will likely confirm the rising wave of the stock group.
Notable information:
Cumulatively for the whole year 2014, parent company SSI reached 1,601 billion VND in revenue, double the 806 billion VND in 2013. Currently, SSI still does not have a consolidated report for 2014.
SSI issued a total of 2,316,800 shares to 179 employees in the company with the total proceeds from the issuance being nearly 52.6 billion VND.Issue date is January 28, 2015, expected trading date is March 6, 2015.The issuance price for employees in the company is 22,700 VND/share.
FLC: Increased 700 VND (ceiling increase) to 10,900 VND
Transaction information:
Every time speculative cash flow returns, FLC immediately becomes the center of attention.In today's trading session, FLC became the stock with the best liquidity on the exchange with a trading volume of more than 18 million units.This is no longer a surprise because FLC has had much more "huge" trading sessions.
At the end of the trading session, FLC increased to the ceiling to 10,900 VND and had 1.5 million more units remaining at the ceiling price.
FLC has a tendency to trade up and down quite suddenly, hardly going through an accumulation period.However, FLC often follows the general trend of the market and rarely goes against it.Therefore, if the general market is positive in the coming sessions, FLC is completely capable of becoming a very noteworthy stock.
Notable information:
According to information from FLC Group Joint Stock Company (HOSE: FLC), the unit has made a plan to submit to the Shareholders' Meeting a plan to pay dividends in shares at the rate of 10% of charter capital, and to divide bonus shares at the rate of 10%.Thus, the Group's charter capital will increase by 20% after this plan.
For the whole year of 2014, FLC's profit is estimated at 400 billion VND, exceeding 15% of the yearly profit plan of 350 billion VND.
FLC leaders also estimate the group's 2015 profit to reach 1,000 billion VND.
The Board of Directors of HAI Agrochemical Joint Stock Company has approved the plan to distribute 15 million shares to FLC Group Joint Stock Company at the price of 12,500 VND/share.According to the assessment of Vietnam Assessment Report Joint Stock Company, FLC has entered the top 500 largest enterprises in Vietnam in 2014.
VIC: Increased 1,300 VND (2.8%) to 48,500 VND
Transaction information:
VIC had a quite positive trading session after a relatively long accumulation process.Closing the session, VIC increased 1,300 VND to 48,500 VND and this was also the highest price that VIC achieved during the session.
Normally, gas stocks have an accumulation base measured in months and a narrow fluctuation range, so when they bounce up, they will be very fast and strong.VIC currently has such a good accumulation foundation and today's trading session also showed VIC's strength.
The RSI indicator has surpassed the threshold of 58, so VIC's short-term growth ability is gradually being appreciated.
Notable information:
The chain of villas and villas under the Vinpearl Premium system including Vinpearl Premium Nha Trang Bay, Vinpearl Premium Golf Land- Nha Trang, Vinpearl Premium Phu Quoc and Vinpearl Premium Da Nang were officially opened for sale by Vingroup from January 25, 2015.
Recently, Vingroup also contributed 5.64 billion VND, equivalent to 94% of the charter capital of VME Company Limited.
Hoang Anh
author: Hoang Anh Tu

title: [Stocks December 26]VIC again "huge" deal, accounting for 18.6% of HSX value
sapo: Although the situation of green skin and red inside is occurring, with improved trading volume, there are many opinions that this can be considered a positive point for the market as some investors have begun to show signs of disbursement to explore again.
content:
The market was green and red, but liquidity improved, foreign investors were net buyers in the 5th session, large agreement transactions at VIC and PVX in the 2nd session with sudden volume, these were the highlights of the stock market on December 26.
Specifically, VN-Index reached 533.37 points, an increase of 1.36 points, equivalent to 0.26%.The major contribution to this increase was that GAS increased by 2.5 points and VCB increased by 0.9 points to 30,800 VND.
This morning, Vietcombank held an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders to approve the merger of a credit institution into VCB.
>> Vietcombank wants to merge another bank into VCB
Most of the HSX floor was flooded with red with only 61 green codes, 53 unchanged codes and 168 red codes.Market liquidity improved compared to yesterday's session with 102.8 million shares traded on the HSX equivalent to 1,769.8 billion VND and 69.3 million shares on the HNX equivalent to 718.22 billion VND.The total transaction value of the two exchanges reached nearly 2,500 billion VND.
Although the situation of green skin and red inside is occurring, with improved trading volume, there are many opinions that this can be considered a positive point for the market as some investors have begun to show signs of disbursement to explore again.
Regarding put-through transactions, today's session recorded the most prominent transaction in VIC with 6.3 million shares changed hands, equivalent to 293.4 billion VND.Including agreement and order matching, VIC's transaction value accounts for 18.6% of the entire transaction value of the Ho Chi Minh floor.Yesterday (December 25), VIC also received an agreement of up to 528 billion VND.
SAM agreed for 2.1 million units equivalent to 25.6 billion VND.Recently, HFC Vietnam Import-Export Investment and Trading Company registered to sell 10 million SAM shares after many times of buying and reselling.
>>> SAM: HFC Vietnam Investment and Import-Export Trading Joint Stock Company registered to sell 10,000,000 shares
The infamous stock PVX attracted attention again with its second floor price drop of 4,200 VND with a sudden increase in matched order volume of 11.3 million units - an increase of 3 times normal.Every time it's time to close the accounting books, PVX's profit - the decisive number for whether to leave or stay on the Hanoi exchange - causes this stock price to fluctuate wildly.
In addition, ORS shares of Phuong Dong Securities Joint Stock Company, after 2 sessions of ceiling increases, decreased by 2.6% today but the matched volume was still at nearly 700,000 shares - the 3rd highest volume session in a row due to new developments in the Huyen Nhu case.
Foreign investors today bought 130.26 billion VND on HOSE, of which the top net buying value was VIC 26.8 billion VND, VCB (21.8 billion), KDC (20.1 billion), MWG (13.5 billion) and PPC (9.3 billion).Meanwhile, foreign investors only net sold the most in HAG with a value of nearly 10 billion VND.
On HNX, foreign investors acted cautiously with a net buying value of 4.28 billion.The highest concentration is still PVS with net buying value of 2.4 billion, BCC (1.8 billion), SHS (1.34 billion).On the net selling side, only HOM was net sold nearly 3.2 billion, which is notable.
Thus, foreign investors were net buyers for the 5th session on both exchanges with a total net purchase value of 134.5 billion VND.
Hai Long
author: Trangminh

title: SacombankSBS: sold off HBC, PVD, VNM in the first 9 months of the year, invested heavily in buying SSI, MHC, VIC, PVC, POM, PVS
sapo: There was no recovery of outstanding debts and expense reimbursement as in the same period, in the third quarter of 2014, SBS's profit was 1.09 billion VND, a sharp decrease compared to 94 billion VND in the third quarter of 2013.
content:
Saigon Thuong Tin Bank Securities Joint Stock Company (SBS) has just announced the parent company's third quarter 2014 business results.
Brokerage revenue increased sharply
Notable in SBS's business activities is its brokerage activities.After a long period of silence due to restructuring, this securities company has begun to make significant progress in its business operations.
Total revenue in the third quarter of 2014 decreased slightly over the same period, reaching 11.75 billion VND.Accumulated 9 months reached 42.2 billion VND, equivalent to the same period.
Brokerage revenue in the third quarter alone reached 5.43 billion VND, a sharp increase compared to 1.51 billion VND in the same period last year.In the first 9 months of the year, the company achieved 12.46 billion VND in brokerage revenue, up 46% over the same period last year.
Self-trading business in the third quarter reached 3.62 billion VND, a sharp decrease compared to 6.06 billion VND in the same period, but accumulated in 9 months reached 23.09 billion VND, 2.5 times higher than the same period last year.
There was no recovery of outstanding debts and expense reimbursement as in the same period, in the third quarter of 2014, SBS's profit was 1.09 billion VND, a sharp decrease compared to 94 billion VND in the third quarter of 2013.Accumulated profit in 9 months is nearly 26 billion VND while the same period reached 97.42 billion VND.
Restructuring investment items
SBS's short-term investment portfolio at the end of the third quarter still had a balance of nearly 7 billion VND invested in SCR (Sacomreal);new investment of 5.31 billion VND in SSI;New purchase of 525 million VND in HAR shares;New purchase of 2.67 billion VND into MHC;New purchase of 885 million VND of ITA shares;10.95 billion VND of VIC shares;3.22 billion VND in PVC shares;1.37 billion VND in POM shares;1.68 billion VND in PVS shares…
Divest some capital from HBC (5.12 billion VND);PVD (3.02 billion VND);VNM (1.35 billion VND)…
The number of SBS employees at the end of the third quarter was 82 people.
Phuong Chi
author: Thanhhuong

title: VN-Index went upstream spectacularly, VIC suddenly fell to the floor
sapo: Compared to the lowest level of the day of 594.28 points, VN-Index has recovered nearly 10 points.
content:
Closing the trading session on September 25, VN-Index increased 1.51 points (0.25%) to 605.1 points.Meanwhile, the VN30 index still decreased by 0.27%.
Compared to the lowest level of the day of 594.28 points, VN-Index has recovered nearly 10 points.
The contrast between these two indices is due to the fact that GAS - not included in the VN30 - increased by 2,000 to 107,000 VND.Every change in GAS currently has a huge impact on VN-Index.
On Hanoi floor, HNX Index increased 0.94 points (1.07%) to 88.65 points.
The transaction value at HoSE reached approximately 2,800 billion VND and at HNX reached more than 1,000 billion VND.
Among major stocks, Mobile World's MWG and Vingroup's VIC hit the floor.
VIC's trading volume soared to 7.75 million shares.Today is the trading day for 472 million additional listed VIC shares.
On the contrary, many stocks hit the ceiling with large buying surplus such as NBB, LGC, PXS, KSH...
On both exchanges, the number of increasing codes dominated.
At more than 2:00 p.m., VnIndex turned to increase again.While the general index recovered slightly, it is worth noting that VIC fell to the floor and before the session ATC still had oversold at the floor.
NBB is currently at ceiling price and currently has 1.88 million shares bought at ceiling price, 35 thousand shares purchased at ATC while only 50 thousand shares sold at ceiling price.
............
At the end of the trading session, the 2 exchanges decreased at the end of the session.VnIndex has lost the 600 point mark!
Many stocks dropped, such as VIC down 3,000 VND;OGC decreased by 100 VND;SAM reduced by 100 VND...
................
VnIndex this morning regained its green color many times, but the index's green color was not sustainable.The market is still in a situation of "red on the outside, green on the inside".Some large-cap stocks are dropping, pulling the index down, although the number of gainers still outweighs the number of decliners.
VnIndex's effort to escape the situation of "red on the outside, green on the inside" is remarkable when in just 1 hour of trading, the index tried to rise several times.The index is constantly reversing colors.
The notable loser this morning was MWG with a decrease of 3,000 VND/share.VIC also decreased by 2,500 VND.KDC, MPC, BMP... also dropped this morning
VN30 this morning decreased by 2 points, equivalent to 0.31%.The decline of this group made VnIndex many times want to break out of the falling chain but failed.
On the upside were GAS and VNM with an increase of 1,000 VND/share.PNJ today had a ceiling purchase surplus of 43 thousand shares after information about its policy of divestment from SFC.
We would also like to remind investors about the current market context.Although the general index has not yet been able to break out due to the influence of some large-cap stocks, in general, buying orders at green prices have spread quite widely across the market.Many stocks have all 3 best buying prices in the green such as: LGC, FDC (just had information about adjusting the dividend rate and is asking shareholders for approval), DCL, TCM, PXS, HVG, GMD, SJS, DPR, PXI...
Phuong Chi
author: Thanhhuong

title: VIC suddenly reported a large profit in the second quarter
sapo: In the second quarter of 2013 alone, VIC's after-tax profit was VND 3,775 billion, a sharp increase of 458% compared to the same period in 2012.
content:
Vingroup Corporation (stock code VIC on HOSE) has just announced the results of its financial statements for the second quarter of 2013.
In the second quarter of 2013, Vingroup achieved revenue of VND 2,147 billion,
increased 13% over the same period last year, of which revenue from real estate rental activities
Real estate increased by 47%, revenue from block
Hotel business increased by 19% and revenue
Revenue from health care services increased by 53%.
Besides, in the second quarter,
Vingroup has begun handing over apartments to customers in projects
Royal City and Times City, under which the Company recorded a portion of the revenue
and profits from real estate transfer activities corresponding to the number of apartments discussed
delivered.
Profit after tax in the second quarter of 2013 reached 3,775 billion VND, a double increase
more than 5 times compared to the same period last year and equivalent to 38% of the 2013 profit plan. VIC
This profit level is achieved from the transaction of transferring 100% of the Company's equity capital
subsidiary for corporate partners, besides the business activities according to the
Vincom and Vinpearl brand groups also bring stable and profitable sources of profit
growth.
Regarding assets, as of June 30, 2013, the total asset value of
Vingroup reached 58,538 billion VND, an increase of more than 2,700 billion VND compared to the end of 2012, mainly
from real estate under construction at Royal City, Times City,
Vincom Village.
Regarding liabilities, as of June 30, 2013, total debt
Vingroup's banks and credit institutions are more than 19,072 billion VND, of which
Short-term debt is about 2,024 billion VND, long-term debt is nearly 17,048 billion VND (including
300 million USD international convertible bonds).Total debt decreased by 2,756 billion VND compared to
with the end of 2012. With a total capital of 58,538 billion VND, the ratio of debt to total
Capital accounts for about 32.6%;The ratio of net debt to total capital is 28.5%.
In addition, in the second quarter of 2013, Warburg Pincus Investment Fund
Consortium has officially signed an investment contract of 200 million USD to purchase approx
20% stake in Vincom Retail Joint Stock Company - a subsidiary of Vingroup and together with
Vingroup Corporation builds a retail real estate network and manages and operates the system
The largest shopping center system in Vietnam.In addition, according to this agreement, Warburg Pincus also commits to invest up to 25 million USD when the Group
Vingroup listed on foreign stock markets and this agreement also
allowing Warburg Pincus the right to invest an additional 100 million USD in the Joint Stock Company
Vincom Retail to further develop the Joint Stock Company's commercial center system
Vincom Retail in Vietnam.

title: VIC: Buyers pay nearly 12,000 billion VND in advance for 3 projects: Royal City, Times City and Vincom Village
sapo:
In 2011, Vincom achieved VND 821 billion in net profit - a decrease of 64% compared to 2010.
The Vincom Village project began recording revenue from Q4.
content:
According to Vincom's explanation, the decrease in revenue is mainly due to a decrease in real estate transfer revenue. This period only generated revenue from the transfer of resettlement apartments and office areas at Vincom Village, the previous period generated revenue from the transfer of apartments at Vincom Center Ho Chi Minh.
By the end of 2011, buyers of three projects Royal City, Times City and Vincom Village paid VND 11,951 billion in advance.This amount has not been recorded in revenue during the period because the real estate has not been completed and has not been handed over to the buyer.
Due to a sharp decrease in business revenue, pre-tax profit also decreased by 86% from VND 2,968 billion to VND 410 billion.
Cumulatively for the whole year 2011, Vincom achieved VND 2,314 billion in net revenue and VND 1,687 billion in financial revenue.
Profit before tax decreased by 53% from VND 3,143 billion to VND 1,470 billion.
Total debt from banks and organizations by the end of the year was more than 10,000 billion VND, down nearly 1,450 billion compared to the end of 2010;of which short-term debt is 4,625 billion VND.
In 2011, a large amount of long-term debt was converted to short-term debt due to maturity near the end of 2012.

title: VIC: Parent company reached 669 billion VND in net profit, down 71% compared to 2010
sapo: Profit decreased sharply compared to 2010 because in 2010 Vincom recorded sudden revenue and profit from selling real estate of the Vincom Center Ho Chi Minh project.
content:
Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) announced its own business results for the fourth quarter and the entire year 2011
In Q4, the company achieved 268 billion VND in revenue, down nearly 3,000 billion VND compared to Q4/2010.
Vincom said that rental revenue in Q4 increased by 15% over the same period.
The decrease in revenue is because in Q4/2010 the company generated more than 3,000 billion VND in revenue from transferring apartments and offices at Vincom Center Ho Chi Minh.
Financial revenue increased from VND 443 billion to VND 512 billion, mainly from profits from share transfers of Sinh Thai Company and dividends from affiliated companies.
Q4 profit after tax reached 172.6 billion VND, down 92% compared to 2,109 billion VND in the same period.
Cumulatively for the whole year 2011, parent company Vincom achieved VND 1,318 billion in revenue from real estate business and VND 1,390 billion in financial revenue.
Profit after tax decreased by more than 71% from VND 2,341 billion to VND 669 billion.

title: Vincom-Vinpearl merger: 1 VPL share exchanged for 0.77 VIC shares
sapo: VIC plans to issue more than 158 million additional shares to exchange for 100% of VPL's shares.The Board of Directors proposed to change the company's name to Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company, abbreviated as Vingroup JSC.
content:
At the upcoming 2011 Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders, Vincom Joint Stock Company will present to shareholders a plan to merge Vinpearl Joint Stock Company into Vincom at the VPL-VIC ratio of 1:0.77 (01 VPL share for 0.77 VIC shares).
After the merger, Vinpearl will become a one-member limited liability company 100% owned by Vincom or establish branches or organizations in other forms of operation in accordance with the provisions of law.
Vincom will issue additional Vincom shares to Vinpearl shareholders to exchange for 100% of the total number of outstanding Vinpearl shares. The number of exchanged shares will be rounded to the nearest unit, the fraction will be canceled.
According to the additional issuance plan submitted to the General Meeting of Shareholders, the number of VIC shares expected to be issued is 158,233,837 shares.
Along with the merger of Vinpearl into Vincom, the Board of Directors proposed to change the company's name after the merger to Vietnam Investment Group Joint Stock Company, abbreviated as Vingroup JSC.Register additional business lines such as travel agency, movie screening activities, transportation, processing and preservation of seafood, vegetables, transportation, aquaculture...

title: VIC: In 9 months, parent company reached 496 billion VND in net profit, up 138% over the same period
sapo: Vincom is asking for shareholders' opinions to merge with Vinpearl Joint Stock Company.
content:
Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) announced its parent company's business results for Q3 and the first 9 months of 2011.
In Q3, the company achieved nearly 240 billion VND in net revenue, down 17% compared to 289 billion VND in the same period.
Due to the sharp increase in cost of capital, gross profit decreased by nearly 100 billion VND from 223 billion VND to 123 billion VND.
According to Vincom's explanation, rental revenue decreased because Vincom Center Ho Chi Minh re-planned the shopping center, leading to a reduction in rental fees during the repair and renovation period.
Real estate transfer revenue in this period arose from the transfer of resettlement apartments while the previous period arose from the transfer of offices at Vincom Center Ho Chi Minh.
However, financial revenue increased suddenly from 117 billion to 421 billion VND, causing net profit from business activities to still increase by 100 billion to 254 billion VND.
Revenue from financial activities comes mainly from profits from transferring 83% of shares in Viettronics Real Estate and dividends earned from affiliated companies.
Financial expenses during the period were 238 billion VND, mainly loan interest.
Q3 profit after tax reached 199.4 billion VND, up 77.6% compared to 112.3 billion VND in the same period.
Accumulated in the first 9 months of the year, parent company Vincom reached VND 1,050 billion in net revenue and VND 878 billion in financial revenue.
NPAT reached 496.2 billion VND, up 138% compared to 232 billion VND in the first 9 months of 2010.
In Q3, Vincom set aside VND 2,300 billion to pay 2010 dividends to shareholders.

title: VIC: The General Meeting of Shareholders approved Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong to guarantee the convertible loan
sapo: Vincom plans to issue a maximum of 7.15 million shares to Credit Suisse or a third party receiving loan transfer from Credit Suisse.The conversion price is 144,341 VND/share.
content:
On August 9, the General Meeting of Shareholders of Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) approved a plan to issue private shares to serve the conversion of loans into shares.
Accordingly, the company plans to issue 7,153,200 shares, the specific number of shares will be decided by the Board of Directors based on the conditions and commitments of the convertible loan contract.
The expected conversion price is 144,341 VND/share and can be adjusted according to the conditions of the loan contract.
The issuer is Credit Suisse International (the Lender) or third parties receiving loan transfers from this organization.
Expected share distribution time is from September 2011 to July 2012.
The proceeds from the issuance are loans from lenders with a total value of 40 million USD used to supplement working capital.VIC shares have doubled in price in the past year
The Shareholders' Meeting also approved that Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong - Vincom's largest shareholder - agreed to guarantee the Company's obligations through signing a Pledge Contract with the Pledgee, who is the lender's representative.
In case Vincom cannot issue shares for conversion in accordance with the lender's requirements, Mr. Vuong will transfer the corresponding number of pledged shares to the pledgee.
According to the AGM report, the terms of the Convertible Loan are similar to the Convertible Bonds.Accordingly, the lender has the right to choose: (1) to receive back the principal and interest of the Convertible Loan at maturity (after 11 months) or (2) to convert the loan into shares at any time of the lender.
Accordingly, the lender has the right to choose:

(2) be able to convert the loan into shares at any time of the lender.

On July 26, 2011, the Chairman of the State Securities Commission (SSC) issued Decision No. 548/QD-UBCK on sanctioning administrative violations in the field of securities and stock market against Ms. Dang Thu Hoai (Address: No. 15B, Alley 24, Alley 175 Xuan Thuy, Cau Giay, Hanoi).
During the period from November 1, 2010 to February 25, 2011, Ms. Dang Thu Hoai used 02 trading accounts (01 main account and 01 account that received full authorization from her husband, Mr. Le Tien Dung) to continuously buy and sell shares of Vincom Joint Stock Company (stock code VIC) with high frequency and volume, accounting for a high proportion for the purpose of creating artificial supply and demand.to manipulate VIC stock prices, violating the provisions of Clause 4, Article 9 of the Securities Law.

title: VIC: 99.9% of bonds have been converted into shares
sapo: By May 31, bondholders had converted 99.9 million USD into 31,260,357 VIC shares with the adjusted conversion price after dilution equivalent to 60,000 VND/share.
content:
On December 15, 2009, Vincom Joint Stock Company became the first Vietnamese company to successfully issue 100 million USD of International Convertible Bonds and be listed on the Singapore stock market.The bond has a term of 5 years, a fixed interest rate of 6%/year and a fixed exchange rate throughout the bond's term of 18,775 VND/US dollar.The initial conversion price was 113,400 VND/share and adjusted to 60,000 VND/share.Credit Suisse is the underwriter for this transaction.
As of May 31, 2011, 99.9 million USD of fixed bonds (equivalent to 99.9% of the total value of the issuance) had been converted by bondholders into 31,260,357 shares of the Company (with the adjusted conversion price after the Company diluted shares through capital increase and bonus share division in 2010). The remaining 100 thousand USD of bonds were paid by Vincom.principal and interest to bondholders according to the clause "repurchase at the option of the Issuer", because the conversion amount has reached over 90%.
Thus, all 100 million USD of fixed bonds issued on December 15, 2009 of Vincom Joint Stock Company have completed payment before the maturity date, the company no longer has this long-term debt.In other words, this 100 million USD of foreign capital was successfully mobilized by Vincom and converted into the Company's equity capital.
It can be said that while domestic capital mobilization channels are facing many difficulties, the international capital market will be the destination of qualified and reputable businesses in Vietnam.
According to VIC

Size of the company?

body.In fact, Vincom's revenue includes two main sources: regular revenue
Regularly from office rental activities, shopping malls and irregular revenue
(usually quite large) from selling real estate products at projects.
The characteristic of real estate transfer revenue is that it is only recorded
at the time of product delivery to the customer.
Therefore, Vincom's revenue cannot be periodically stable
Like every period, there will be periods of sudden revenue growth.So the
Low first quarter revenue is not an indicator of the company's operating results
year.
- According to the financial report of the first quarter of 2011, the amount of cash and equivalents
VIC's money is only 648 billion VND, down 867 billion VND compared to the beginning of the year.While
Short-term revenues have not changed much compared to the beginning of the year and are difficult to calculate
The company can collect debts immediately.So you can let me know within
Where will VIC mobilize cash of nearly VND 2,000 billion in the next 3-4 months to pay dividends?
while still ensuring financial safety and solvency?
I think that based on just two reports 3 months apart
and without knowing clearly what accounts receivable include, we cannot make such a conclusion
okay.All receivables have payment terms specified in the contract.
When due, receivables will be collected, not every month
You also need to get some back.
There is certainly no need to borrow money because of the two separate sources of revenue
proceeds from the sale of the Vincom Center apartment complex and their Vincom Financial Tower building
I also have more than enough to pay this due dividend.
Dividend distribution aims to clearly divide profits
- Currently, the company still has a number of convertible bonds:
59.3 million USD.According to the agreement, bondholders have the right to convert at any time
any point from now until December 4, 2014.Before that, there was $40.7 million in bonds
converted into 12.73 million shares.So is there pressure to dilute shareholders and
Voting rights can also be an incentive for the company's current shareholders to decide
Are you planning to pay dividends from all profits in 2010 right now?
Mrs.?
As of June 6, 2011, the company no longer had convertible bonds
change any more.Almost all bondholders (foreign investors) have chosen
Plan to convert bonds into shares to become a public shareholder
company, demonstrating their high confidence in the company's potential and future.
Therefore, there is no way we will pay dividends because of pressure to dilute shareholders and rights
Vote as you stated.
- Madam, there are many opinions that the reason why VIC decided
use a "huge" amount of money up to 2,300 billion VND to pay dividends because of the ability
Growth potential is low, so the company only retains very little profit to reinvest
or because the company's large, dominant shareholders need cash resources for security
Are their activities and themselves the "driving force" for paying high dividends?
I can immediately answer that the above arguments are absolutely not
exactly.The main reason for Vincom's early dividend payment is to prepare for it
Listing shares on the Singapore stock market in the third quarter of next year
Vincom has announced since 2010.
We want a clear division between retained profits
in the previous period (belonging to the old shareholders) and future benefits of the stock
new shareholder by paying off most of the remaining profits that have accumulated in the past
now for old shareholders.This is also the action of large companies in the market
do so before they expect a large number of new shareholders to participate
company.This action is intended to ensure safety
fairness in profit division between old shareholders and new shareholders and has been
accepted world practice.
In other words, this is an action to protect rights
for shareholders currently owning VIC shares in the domestic market.
- Madam, recently a news site reported some information and accepted it
intention is different from the information you just gave us, so your opinion is the same
How?
I think the person who wrote that article didn't have enough information
belief and experience should have a distorted view
about Vincom.The information I share with you is official information,
has been internationally audited and has been regularly announced by us according to regulations.
