title: VIC: Started construction of VinMedicare international general hospital in Eco City area
sapo: The VinMedicare project is built according to the Hospital Facilities model, commonly known as a hospital - hotel.
content:
Today, February 27, 2011, South Hanoi Urban Development Joint Stock Company - investor of Eco City urban area - officially started construction of VinMedicare international general hospital.This is a hospital built according to the Hospital Facilities model (hospital - hotel) that meets international standards and is the top class in Vietnam.It is expected that phase 1 of the project will be completed and put into operation in the first quarter of 2012.
Located in the Eco City ecological urban area complex at 460 Minh Khai, Hanoi, VinMedicare international general hospital has a total area of 24,670 m2.The VinMedicare hospital project's investor is Hanoi South Urban Development Joint Stock Company (a member unit of Vincom Joint Stock Company - Vingroup).
VinMedicare was advised and developed by PwC - the world's leading medical consultant;At the same time, the construction was consulted by the VK - dwp joint venture (VK is Europe's leading prestigious hospital design consultant; dwp is a multinational construction design consulting firm).
This will be a general hospital with 500 patient rooms and clinics, a full range of specialties, and many specialized and high-tech support centers...
VinMedicare, in addition to fully meeting the requirements of a high-class medical unit, is also a "hospital - hotel" with many convenient services and many differences.Typical highlights of VinMedicare include:
One of the important points that create the "hospital - hotel" concept for VinMedicare is the patient room system.All inpatient or day treatment rooms at VinMedicare are built according to "5-star hotel" standards.All hospital beds are built as single patient rooms and are designed to have natural light, luxurious bathrooms and toilets, and enough space to arrange a bed or sofa for family members to stay overnight with the patient (if needed).
Vingroup expects that just before the Lunar New Year this year, VinMedicare hospital will be completed and begin operations.
author: duchai

title: VIC: Sold 3000/4000 Royal city apartments
sapo: VIC will account when completing construction and handing over to customers.Thus, in 2013, VIC is likely to "explode" in profits.
content:
On February 26, Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) held its 2011 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
Construction of elevated road on Ring Road 2: currently in the implementation policy phase.Ministry of Construction and City People's Committee.Hanoi has agreed to allow construction and is waiting for the Prime Minister's approval.Only then will it be implemented and the company will announce full information.
Royal City: Up to now, 3,000 apartments out of a total of 4,000 apartments in the project have been sold;However, it has not been accounted for in revenue and profit.The company will account when completing construction and handing over to customers.So in 2013 - when the project is completed, VIC will "explode" in profits.
Binh Tay Wine, District 6, Ho Chi Minh City: The land is located in District 6, on East-West Avenue. Previously, Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee asked Vincom to plan and then, if desired, invest in a 22ha area including the Binh Tay Wine area to "revive" this whole area.
Vincom's report also said: In 2011, the company will take advantage of its inherent advantages and experience to continue to invest in key real estate projects such as: shopping centers, entertainment areas, offices and high-end rental apartments in two big cities, Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City;Focus on real estate projects that can deliver an internal rate of return (IRR) greater than 25%.
Business results 2010
In 2010, VIC achieved 3,873 billion VND in net revenue, an increase of 1,899 billion (96%) compared to 2009.
Net revenue increased mainly from real estate transfer revenue (including transfer of apartments and part of the office area at Vincom Center) with revenue of VND 3,128 billion, an increase of 88% compared to 2009.
Revenue from leasing commercial centers and offices reached 715 billion VND, an increase of 156% compared to 2009.
Profit after tax reached 2,432 billion VND, an increase of 1,330 billion VND (121%) compared to 2009. EPS in 2010 reached 6,837 VND.
Profit after tax in 2010 increased sharply compared to 2009 due to the following main reasons:
- The gross profit rate from real estate transfer activities is 78% of revenue, bringing large profits to the company.
- During the year, the company had additional financial income from investment activities, especially the investment in the project 180-192 Nguyen Cong Tru (joint venture project with Vietnam Tourism Joint Stock Company in Ho Chi Minh City).
Main events in 2010 activities:
- January 2010, started construction of the Royal City Project at 72A Nguyen Trai, Hanoi.In 2010, the number of apartments that customers registered was 1,892 units and 60% of the area in the commercial center was also registered for rent.
- Vincom Center building at 72 Le Thanh Ton, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City with 27 floors and 6 basements was opened on April 30.
- In December 2010, the 25-storey Vincom Financial Tower modern office building with an area of ​​2,146m2, extending 34m on Nguyen Cong Tru street, in the financial center of Ho Chi Minh City was completed.
VIC will deduct 2,300 billion VND of 2010 profit to pay dividends.Based on the expected cash flow plan for 2011, the Board of Directors estimates the dividend payment schedule as follows:
However, the Board of Directors will base on the actual cash flow plan for 2011 to adjust and decide on all issues related to dividend payment.
Plan for 2011
In addition to maximizing the efficiency of existing real estate, Vincom aims to focus all resources to implement other real estate projects such as Royal city, Eco city and Vincom Village projects in Hanoi, Eden A project in Ho Chi Minh City.
Convert shares and list in Singapore
VIC price movements in 6 months
As of January 21, 2011, VIC had converted 68.7 million USD in bond par value into nearly 21.5 million shares with par value of 10,000 VND/share.
The remaining amount of 31.3 million USD bonds calculated at the current conversion price of 60,000 VND/share will be converted into 9.8 million shares, equivalent to 2.6% of the outstanding amount.
The company is also conducting procedures to offer and list shares on the Singapore stock market.
VIC's shareholders' meeting elected additional members of the Board of Directors and independent members of the supervisory board who reside in Singapore - this is one of the requirements to be able to list shares on this country's stock market.
The new member of the Board of Directors is Mr. Roy Chung Yee Ling, Singaporean nationality, CEO of RL Capital Management.

According to VIC, this is the total expected land cost for the entire Eden project, inThe land cost for Eden B area is 1,200 billion VND (paid in 2008) and the estimated land cost for Eden A area is 2,500 billion VND.

title: VIC: Signed apartment purchase and sale contract and received retail space rental registration for Royal City project
sapo: Building R1 has completed the foundation and begun signing apartment purchase and sale contracts and receiving registration to rent retail space in the commercial center.
content:
On October 11, 2010, Hoang Gia Real Estate Investment and Development Joint Stock Company - a subsidiary of Vincom Joint Stock Company - officially announced that it had completed the foundation of Royal 1 building (R1) of the Royal City project complex.
The investor has begun signing apartment purchase and sale contracts and receiving registration to lease retail space at the largest commercial center in Vietnam.
Royal City was built on a land area of ​​120,945 square meters, the main southwest gateway to the center of Hanoi capital at 74 Nguyen Trai, Thanh Xuan, Hanoi.
Royal City is a complex urban area designed with a smart connection between functional building complexes and large mixed public works following ecological architecture, with a garden and green park area of ​​about 70,000 m2, with European architectural style.
The project was announced in June 2010, after 4 months from the date of announcement, the foundation of the R1 building has been completed on schedule.
According to the roadmap, after completing the foundation, the investor will begin signing apartment purchase and sale contracts at building R1 - the first building of the complex.From this point on, customers who have signed an apartment purchase contract have full right to choose the interior design from the sample designs offered by the investor.
In addition, Royal City also has an additional 200,000 square meters of high-end shopping mall floors, including 2 basements and 2 aboveground floors, considered the largest commercial area in Vietnam.Therefore, although construction has just begun, up to now, 30% of the expected space, equivalent to about 70,000 square meters, of the commercial center in Royal City has customers registered to rent.
In addition, Royal City also has 3D and 4D movie theaters, a food park with 60 restaurants.The largest underground parking lot in Vietnam, over 300,000 square meters with a modern management system, applying smart technology...
According to the plan, after completing the construction of the foundation;All items of the Project will be constructed and completed at the same time.It is expected that the entire project will be completed, put into operation, and handed over to customers in 2013.
K.T

title: VIC: Issued 160 million additional shares to increase charter capital to 3,600 billion VND
sapo: With an additional capital of 1,600 billion VND, VIC will spend about 700 billion VND currently and will be used for the Eden Project;900 billion VND for ECO City Project and Royal City project.
content:
According to the resolution of the Board of Directors of Vincom Joint Stock Company (code: VIC), the company has approved a plan to increase charter capital.
Accordingly, VIC is expected to issue about 160,300,672 additional common shares in the form of stock dividends and share offerings to existing shareholders, bringing VIC's total charter capital after additional issuance to VND 3,600 billion.
Regarding stock dividends, VIC's 2009 profit is expected to be about 1,200 billion VND.In particular, 2009 business results and retained profits were about over 500 billion VND;Based on the operating results of its subsidiaries, it is expected that VIC's profit will be 700 billion VND corresponding to the proportion of shares held in the subsidiaries.
Specifically, VIC expects that in the first and second quarters of this year, the company will pay dividends at the ratio of 1,000:601 (each shareholder owning 1,000 shares will receive 601 new shares).
Offering shares to existing shareholders, VIC plans to offer about 400 billion VND from issuing additional shares to existing shareholders;ratio 1,000: 202 (shareholders owning 1,000 shares will receive the right to buy 202 additional shares issued equal to the par value - 10,000 VND).
With an additional capital of 1,600 billion VND, VIC will spend about 700 billion VND currently and will be used for the Eden Project, of which 450 billion VND is and will be used to pay compensation for site clearance for area A of the Vincom Trade - Service - Hotel - Office - Luxury Apartment and Underground Parking Center project in District 1, City.HCM;The remainder will be used to complete area B of the project.
About 900 billion VND will be used to implement other projects such as: ECO City project (land of 8/3 Textile Company and Hanosimex in Minh Khai, Hanoi) is allocated about 700 billion VND, Royal City Project at 74 Nguyen Trai is allocated about 200 billion VND and other real estate projects in Hanoi.
From February 24 to February 26, VIC will officially consult shareholders in writing on stock dividends and approve the offering plan to increase charter capital.
Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange also announced that the ex-rights trading day is February 5, 2010 (in case of agreed sales with a volume of 100,000 shares or more on February 5 and February 8, 2010, the seller will not be entitled to rights).

title: VIC: Foreign investors' room at HoSE decreased to 29%
sapo: From November 25, the Depository Center fixed the holding level of foreign investors in Vietnam for Vincom shares listed on HoSE at 29%.

title: VIC: Successfully issued 100 million USD of international convertible bonds
sapo: Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) announced that it has successfully issued 100 million USD of 5-year international convertible bonds.
content:
On November 17, 2009, Vincom Joint Stock Company successfully issued 100 million USD of 5-year international convertible bonds and this bond was also listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange immediately after issuance.
This is Vincom's first convertible bond issuance and also the first convertible bond issuance by a Vietnamese enterprise to the international market.
This issuance by VIC and Credit Suisse (Singapore) Limited - the sole underwriter and the main advisory organization for this issuance, signed a bond subscription agreement at the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited.
The characteristic of this round of Vincom's convertible bonds is that they have no collateral, with a 5-year term, and were issued to diversify capital mobilization channels and provide long-term capital for the Company.
The purpose of this bond issuance is to mobilize capital to serve the implementation of the Company's large real estate projects, including large-scale high-end real estate complexes in Hanoi: "Royal City" and "Eco City".
This bond can be converted into common shares of Vincom with the conversion price being calculated on the basis of the closing price of Vincom shares of 108,000 VND on the issuance date.The bonds are issued in USD and will earn an annual coupon rate of 6%/year, payable every 6 months at the end of the term.
Vincom's convertible bonds were accepted to officially list on the Singapore Stock Exchange from November 11, 2009.The additional shares issued after converting from bonds will be listed at the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange, where Vincom shares are currently traded.
According to Mr. Le Khac Hiep - Chairman of the Board of Directors of VIC, the successful issuance of this round of international bonds means a turning point for VIC, and also opens a new direction for Vietnamese companies in mobilizing capital and proactively integrating and participating in international capital markets.
K.T According to Vincom

title: VIC: Q3/2009 profit was 95.66 billion VND, up 145% over the same period in 2008
sapo: Accumulated in the first 9 months of 2009, Vincom Joint Stock Company's consolidated after-tax profit reached 154.36 billion VND, an increase of 33% over the same period in 2008.
content:
Vincom Joint Stock Company announced a consolidated report on business results for the third quarter and the first 9 months of 2009, according to which, in general, VIC's main operating revenue decreased slightly but financial investment revenue increased sharply compared to the same period in 2008.
In the third quarter of 2009, VIC's total revenue reached 216.34 billion VND, an increase of 41% compared to the total revenue of the same period in 2008.
However, most of VIC's revenue was obtained in the third quarter from financial investment activities, reaching 145,087 billion VND, double the third quarter of 08 (76.54 billion VND).Meanwhile, revenue from sales and service provision in the third quarter reached 69.79 billion VND, a slight decrease of nearly 9% compared to the same period in 2008.
Interest costs decreased by 35% over the same period, other costs remained low, causing VIC's profit after tax in the third quarter to reach 95.66 billion VND, up 145.65% over the same period in 2008 and up 73.8% over the previous quarter.
Accumulated in the first 9 months of 2009, VIC's total consolidated revenue reached 519.174 billion VND, up 11.6% over the same period in 2008. Profit after tax reached 154.36 billion VND, up 33% over the same period in 2008. Profit after tax of parent company shareholders was 147.54 billion.EPS for the first 9 months of 2009 is 884 VND/share.
As of September 30, 2009, VIC's total assets reached 8,176,757 billion VND, of which the company had short-term financial investments of 2,147 billion VND (an increase of 517 billion compared to the beginning of 2009), long-term financial investments of 1,126 billion VND;Cash reached 287 billion VND, nearly 11 times higher than the beginning of the year.
The cost of construction in progress is 2,999 billion VND.Of which, 2,420 billion VND for buildings in Ho Chi Minh City, more than 1 billion VND to prepare the Long Bien golf course and ecological area project, 567.44 billion VND for the Vincom Park Place project, in addition to the cost of preparing projects at 74 Nguyen Trai, Yen Phu Ha Tay;No. 4 Le Thanh Tong Hai Phong....
VIC's total liabilities as of September 30 were 5,524 billion VND, of which long-term debt was 4,645 billion VND.The value of VIC's treasury shares is up to more than 880 billion VND.
Vincom Joint Stock Company currently has 4 subsidiaries and joint venture companies: PFV Investment and Trading Company Limited (investor of Vincom Park Place tower - VIC with 74.41% equity);Vincom Securities Joint Stock Company (VIC holds 75% shares);Hoang Gia Real Estate Investment and Development Joint Stock Company (VIC holds 51% of shares), Hai Phong Real Estate Investment and Development Joint Stock Company (41% of shares).

title: VIC: Please extend the time to buy treasury shares until March 6, 2009
sapo: Although Vincom Joint Stock Company (stock code: VIC) is allowed to buy treasury shares exceeding 10%, as of January 6, the company has not completed the transaction to buy back more than 4 million treasury shares.
content:
Vincom Joint Stock Company registered to buy 4,098,320 shares as treasury shares during the period from October 6, 2008 to January 6, 2009, bringing the total number of treasury shares held after completing the purchase to 11,998,315 shares.
Previously, on September 26, 2008, Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange issued an official dispatch agreeing to allow the number of company treasury shares purchased each day to exceed 10% of the number of VIC shares traded on the day immediately before purchasing treasury shares to ensure the minimum daily purchase rate is 3% of the registered volume.
However, the company has not yet completed this transaction.
On January 6, 2008, Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange said that Vincom Joint Stock Company had sent an official dispatch requesting to extend the time to buy shares as treasury stocks until March 6, 2009.
Treasury shares are shares that have been issued and are bought and resold on the market by the issuing organization.
Listed organizations may repurchase no more than 30% of the total number of common shares, part or all of other shares issued.
During each trading day, a listed organization can only place an order once with a minimum volume of 3% and a maximum volume of 5% of the total volume requested in the application.In special cases, the Stock Exchange may allow listed organizations to place trading orders exceeding 5% of the volume requested in the application.
In case a listed organization repurchases treasury shares exceeding the ratio of 25% of voting shares, it must be done through bidding according to the regulations of the State Securities Commission.
Listed organizations must finish buying or reselling listed shares within 3 months from the date of approval.In case of acquisition, listed organizations are only allowed to sell after holding for at least 6 months.

VPTC  is located at Vincom City Towers building (191 Ba Trieu, Hanoi) with an area of ​​about 500 square meters.

It is expected that by the end of 2008 the Exchange will be operational.

title: VIC: Issued corporate bonds in 2008
sapo: Vincom Joint Stock Company - Vincom JSC (code VIC) will issue 2,000 - 2,600 bonds with par value of 1 billion VND/5-year term bond.
content:
On April 4, 2008, the Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange officially announced that Vincom Joint Stock Company (VIC) issued corporate bonds in 2008.
Accordingly, Vincom Joint Stock Company - Vincom JSC (code VIC) will issue 2,000 - 2,600 bonds with par value of 1 billion VND/bond, bonds usually without collateral, with a term of 5 years.Total issuance value ranges from 2,000 - 2,600 billion VND depending on the actual number of registered investors.
The interest amount will be paid in arrears, with one annual payment on the issuance date, starting 1 year from the date of bond issuance.
The form of bond is book entry.Official bond offering start date: April 2, 2008, release date (expected): April 18, 2008.
The object of this bond issuance will be private issuance to financial institutions, banks, securities companies, investment funds...
Bonds are freely transferable according to the provisions of law.Depending on the production and business situation and capital capacity, after 3 years from the date of issuance, the issuing organization can buy back the bonds before maturity according to the agreement with the bond owner.Bond owners have the right to decide whether to sell their bonds to the issuer or not.

title: VIC issued 2,000 billion VND in bonds
sapo: The Board of Directors of Vincom Company has just approved the issuance of VND 2,000 billion in corporate bonds with interest rates ranging from 11% - 16%/year.
content:
Vincom Bond is a regular bond, paying interest in advance and making periodic annual interest payments.The number of bonds issued is 2,000 bonds, maximum 2,600 bonds depending on the actual number of investors registered to buy.
Bond term is 5 years.The first year enjoys a fixed interest rate, expected from 11% - 16%/year, the specific level will be determined after agreement with the Investors.
The following years are calculated at a floating interest rate, expected to be equal to the average 1-year postpaid savings deposit interest rate of the Head Office of 4 Agribank, Vietcombank, BIDV and ICB banks plus a maximum of 4%/year.The specific additional percentage will be determined after agreement with the investor.
VIC bond issuance date (expected) is April 18, 2008.Location for selling bonds, paying bond principal and interest at Vietnam Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Securities Company Limited (Agriseco).
The subject of issuance is private issuance to Financial Institutions, Banks, Securities Companies, Investment Funds... Bonds are freely transferable in accordance with the provisions of Law.
Depending on the production and business situation and capital capacity, after 03 years from the date of issuance, Vincom can buy back the bonds before maturity according to the agreement with the bond owner.
